2048.intro: 2048 is a sliding number puzzle where you merge matching tiles on a small grid to build toward the 2048 tile. Each slide adds a new tile, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Keep your highest-value tile in one corner and build the rest of the tiles in a line along one edge.
Before every slide, look at where the new tile will appear and whether it could block a merge you need.
Try to keep open space on the grid. A crowded board leaves you with fewer safe moves.
Avoid sliding in the same direction over and over without checking the result. Mixing directions often keeps your tiles in order.
When you are stuck, think about which move creates a pair of matching tiles next to each other, and aim for that.
faq: What is the goal of 2048?
Your goal is to merge matching tiles until you create a tile with the value 2048. The game is about planning slides so that the grid does not fill up before you get there.
How do I play 2048?
Slide the tiles on the grid in one direction at a time. When two matching tiles touch as they slide, they merge into one tile with double the value.

fish-sort-puzzle.intro: Fish Sort Puzzle looks relaxing, but the holding tray turns every level into a small planning puzzle. These tips help you clear more tanks without getting stuck.
tips: Before tapping, scan the bubbles for fish that already have an open matching tank and send those first.
Treat the holding tray as an emergency space, not storage. Every fish parked there makes the next mistake more expensive.
Try to finish a tank you have already started (two of three fish) before opening a new color.
Save boosters for the moment the tray is almost full instead of using them early.
If a level goes wrong, restart quickly: the early moves decide most levels.
faq: Is Fish Sort Puzzle free?
Yes. You can play Fish Sort Puzzle online for free in your browser, with no download and no sign-up.
Does my progress save?
Progress is saved locally in your browser, so you can come back and continue on the same device.

stickman-gun-shooter-3d.intro: Stickman Gun Shooter 3D is all about survival: enemy stickmen attack from every side and the goal is to last as long as possible. A few habits make a big difference.
tips: Keep moving. Standing still makes you an easy target for the enemy stickmen.
Strike first: enemies that see you first usually win the duel, so check corners before you walk into the open.
Learn each weapon. Shotguns hit hard up close, rifles like the M16 and AK-47 are better at range.
Reload when the area is clear, not in the middle of a fight.
Use walls and objects as cover and peek out only to shoot.
faq: Is Stickman Gun Shooter 3D free?
Yes, it is free to play online in your browser with no download.
Is it suitable for kids?
The game contains shooting and blood effects, so it is meant for older players.

daddy-mouse.intro: Daddy Mouse is a colorful platform adventure where a brave mouse collects cheese and heads home to his family through forests, icy mountains, volcanoes, the sea and castles.
tips: Explore off the main path: hidden routes often lead to extra golden stars.
Watch trap patterns for a moment before jumping, most of them move in a fixed rhythm.
Collect the cheese on the way rather than rushing to the exit.
Before a boss fight, take a second to learn its attack pattern, then strike in the gaps.
On mobile, use the on-screen controls with your thumbs resting near the jump button.
faq: Can I play Daddy Mouse on my phone?
Yes. It works in the browser on desktop with a keyboard and on mobile with touch controls.

referee-simulator-3d.intro: Referee Simulator 3D puts the whistle in your hands. Instead of scoring goals, you decide fouls, penalties, offsides and cards, and you can check the VAR monitor when you are not sure.
tips: Stay close to the ball. A referee who keeps up with play sees incidents from a better angle.
When a decision is close, use the VAR monitor and review the slow-motion replays before you blow the whistle.
For offsides, check the position at the moment the pass is played, not when the ball arrives.
Remember the second yellow: a player who is already booked gets a red for the next cautionable foul.
Career mode rewards accuracy, so it is better to review than to guess.
faq: What can you do in Referee Simulator 3D?

You referee football matches: judge fouls, penalties, offsides, handballs and goal-line decisions, show cards and use VAR reviews, and climb from a regional league to international matches in career mode.

drifty-road-rush.intro: Drifty Road Rush is a fast arcade driving game where every corner needs a clean drift. The longer you survive, the harder the roads get.
tips: Start the drift slightly before the corner instead of in the middle of it.
Learn the rhythm of the turns, most runs end on a corner you entered too late.
Weave through traffic early, before the road starts to bend again.
Grab rewards only when it is safe; a crash ends the run and costs more than a coin.
Spend rewards on new vehicles to find one that suits your drifting style.
faq: Is Drifty Road Rush free to play?
Yes, play it free in your browser with no download.

fire-truck-driving-simulator.intro: Fire Truck Driving Simulator lets you drive a fire truck through four modes: Level Mode, City Mode, Free Mode and Parking Mode.
tips: Start in Free Mode to learn how the heavy truck brakes and turns before taking on timed missions.
In Level Mode, take the fastest safe route: crashing costs more time than driving a little slower.
In City Mode you choose which emergency missions to accept, so start with the closest ones.
Use Parking Mode to practice tight turns, it helps in every other mode.
Brake early before corners, a fire truck needs much more room to stop than a car.
faq: How many modes does Fire Truck Driving Simulator have?
Four: Level Mode with 10 levels, City Mode with free emergency missions, Free Mode and Parking Mode.

my-town-home-family-playhouse.intro: My Town Home: Family Playhouse is an online dollhouse with six rooms to explore. There is no score and no time limit, you create your own family stories.
tips: Visit every room first to see what you can interact with, there are more objects than you notice at first.
Move characters between rooms to build a story, for example breakfast in the kitchen and a garden afternoon.
Try the mini-games, like washing the teddy bear or popping the right balloons.
On mobile, drag items and characters with your finger; on desktop use the mouse.
Play together with a younger sibling or child and take turns telling the story.
faq: Is My Town Home: Family Playhouse free?
Yes, it is free to play in your browser on phone or computer.

black-hole-swallow-master.intro: In Black Hole Swallow Master you start as a tiny black hole and have to grow as big as possible before the timer runs out. A little planning goes a long way.
tips: At the start, only chase small objects. Trying to swallow something too big just wastes precious seconds.
Sweep across areas packed with small items instead of hunting single objects: dense clusters make you grow fastest.
Keep an eye on the timer and save the largest objects for later in the round, once your black hole is big enough to eat them.
Move in smooth paths around the level rather than zig-zagging, so you don't pass the same empty spots twice.
If a level ends early, replay it and plan a route: you will already know where the best targets are.
faq: How do you get bigger in Black Hole Swallow Master?
Swallow objects that fit inside your black hole. Every object you collect makes it grow, so you can eat larger things as the round goes on.
Is there a time limit?
Yes. Each round is timed, so the goal is to swallow as much as possible before time runs out.

get-10-ultimate.intro: Get 10 Ultimate looks like a simple counting game, but merging your way to 10 and beyond takes real planning. These tips help you build higher numbers.
tips: Only adjacent numbers of the same colour can be matched, so look for groups before you tap the first one you see.
Bigger groups are worth waiting for: let small numbers collect next to each other instead of merging every pair right away.
Try to build your highest number near one side of the board, so new tiles have space to fall in around it.
Think one move ahead: check which tiles will end up touching after a merge before you make it.
The difficulty rises with every new number you create, so play more carefully once you pass 7 or 8.
faq: How do you play Get 10 Ultimate?
Match adjacent numbers of the same colour to combine them into a higher number. The goal is to create the highest number you can, starting with 10.
Can you go higher than 10?
Yes. Reaching 10 is the first big goal, but you can keep merging to create even higher numbers as the game gets harder.

stickman-kombat-2d.intro: Stickman Kombat 2D is a quick 1v1 arena fighter where timing matters more than mashing buttons. Here is how to win more matches.
tips: Learn the punch, kick and special attack combos on the first easy opponents before the tougher fighters show up.
Dodge first, then hit back: attacking right after an enemy swing is the safest moment to land a combo.
Chain attacks together instead of single hits. Combos do far more damage than random clicks.
Try different stickman fighters. Each one feels a bit different, so pick the one whose timing suits you.
If an enemy keeps beating you, slow down and watch its attack pattern for a round before going aggressive.
faq: How do the controls work in Stickman Kombat 2D?
The game uses simple mouse click or tap controls to punch, kick and use special attacks, so you can start fighting right away.
Does Stickman Kombat 2D have different modes?
Yes. You fight through multiple levels and game modes against increasingly tough stickman opponents.

fire-truck-driving-simulator-2024.intro: Fire Truck Driving Simulator 2024 puts you behind the wheel of a fire engine racing to emergencies through city streets, country roads and mountain paths.
tips: Drive with WASD and take corners slowly: a heavy fire truck needs more room to turn than a car.
Use the siren to clear a path through traffic, especially in busy city streets.
Speed matters, but crashing costs more time than braking early. Slow down before tight turns and obstacles.
Mountain paths are the trickiest routes, so keep a steady speed there instead of flooring it.
Stay calm when the timer is tight: a clean, steady route usually beats a risky shortcut.
faq: What are the controls in Fire Truck Driving Simulator 2024?
Use the WASD keys to drive the fire truck. The game plays best on a computer with a keyboard.
What is the goal of the game?
Reach emergency scenes quickly and safely, navigating traffic and obstacles on city, rural and mountain roads.

biryani-cooking-indian-super-chef-food-g.intro: Biryani Cooking Indian Super Chef Food Game lets you cook a classic chicken biryani step by step, from chopping onions to layering basmati rice.
tips: Follow the recipe steps in order: preparing the ingredients first makes the cooking steps go smoothly.
Get the onions, peppers and spices ready before you start cooking so nothing is missing later.
Pay attention to the spices (cumin, curry, chilli and pepper): they are what gives the biryani its flavour.
Take your time with the basmati rice step, it is the heart of the dish.
Finish by serving the dish nicely: presentation is part of being a super chef.
faq: What do you cook in this game?
You prepare a chicken biryani, a rice dish popular across India and Pakistan, using ingredients like basmati rice, onions, ghee and spices.
Can I play it on my phone?
Yes. It runs in the browser on phones, tablets and computers with no download.

piece-of-cake-merge-and-bake.intro: Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake is a cozy merge puzzle where you combine ingredients to cook dishes while restoring your grandfather's abandoned café. Progress comes from cooking, earning money, and repairing each area.
tips: Start by merging basic ingredients whenever two matching items sit on the table, since that is how you unlock more complex dishes.
Expand your cooking table early so you have room to hold ingredients and work on several matches at once.
Spend the money you earn on restoring the café interior first, then move to the facade once you have enough to cover it.
Look for places on the table where a merge would free up space, and avoid filling every slot with items you cannot yet combine.
Check the café areas regularly, because each newly restored location adds a fresh stage and a clear sense of progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake?
Your goal is to revive your grandfather's café by cooking dishes for visitors and restoring the building. Unlocking new dishes helps you develop your kitchen over time.
How do I unlock more complex dishes?
Combine ingredients on the cooking table to create new ones, working up from simple items to more advanced recipes. Each combination brings you closer to new dishes.

zigzag-snow-mountain.intro: Just Freeskiing is a ski simulation with slopestyle, halfpipe, big-air, jibbing and backcountry challenges. You aim to master each challenge and beat the best scores.
tips: Start with the in-game tutorials and get comfortable steering before you attempt any tricks.
Pick one challenge type, such as the halfpipe or big-air, and practise it until your landings feel consistent.
Try the Training mode to test tricks without pressure, then move to Challenge or Competition mode when you are ready.
Use the Replay option to watch your runs and spot where you lost speed, balance or a clean landing.
Learn a few tricks well before adding more, since a clean landing matters more than a long list of moves.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The aim is to beat the world's best scores and master the given challenges to improve your freeskiing skills. Working through the challenges in different locations is the core of the game.
How do I control the skier?
The game is listed with mouse control, and the description also mentions tilt or virtual joystick navigation. Simple buttons handle basic moves, while 2x taps and swipes unlock more advanced options.

splash-rivals.intro: Splash Rivals is a team paint shooter where two teams of four fight to cover the arena in their colour. Spray the ground, take down rivals, and keep your paint topped up to stay in the fight.
tips: Keep an eye on your paint tank while you fire, since running it empty leaves you unable to spray or splash effectively.
Use Left Shift to swim through your own team's paint when you are low on paint or health, then get back into the fight.
Spray the ground as you move so your team builds coverage, not just scores hits on rivals.
Hold Tab now and then to check the scoreboard and see where your team needs more coverage or help.
Save your special for a moment when it can swing a fight, such as when several rivals are close together.
faq: What is the goal of Splash Rivals?
Your team of four tries to cover the arena in your colour while splashing the rival team. The side with more coverage and kills puts itself in a stronger position.
How do I refill my paint and recover health?
Swim through your team's paint using Left Shift. This refills your paint tank and restores health.

gun-trigger.intro: Gun Trigger is a one-player shooter where you play a stylish agent moving through levels in slow motion. Success depends on firing at exactly the right moment to eliminate enemies and clear each level.
tips: Wait for your aim to line up with an enemy before you tap, since a shot fired early is a wasted shot.
Use the slow-motion moments to read the scene and track where each enemy is before you commit to a shot.
Keep your taps deliberate and steady rather than rapid, because timing matters more than speed.
Before each shot, check whether any enemies remain in view so you can plan the order you take them out.
If you miss, pause for a beat and reset your focus instead of firing again immediately.
faq: How do I shoot in Gun Trigger?
Tap or click on the screen to fire your weapon. The shot only hits when your aim is lined up with an enemy, so wait for that moment.
What is the goal of each level?
You need to eliminate the enemies and safely clear the level. Each level is complete once the threats are gone.

defend-the-castle.intro: Defend the Castle is a strategy puzzle where you build and upgrade defenses with gold and wood. Your job is to stop waves of enemies and keep the King safe.
tips: Spend gold and wood in small, planned steps rather than all at once, so you still have resources if a wave hits harder than expected.
Mix cannons and archers instead of relying on one type, since each can answer different threats in the same wave.
Decide early whether a resource is better used for a new defense or an upgrade to an existing one, and keep that choice consistent across waves.
Watch which direction enemies approach from and place your strongest defenses where they reach the castle first.
Keep an eye on the King throughout each wave, because protecting him is the core goal and a breach can end the run.
faq: What is the main goal of Defend the Castle?
You build and upgrade defenses to resist enemy waves and protect the King while keeping your stronghold standing.
What resources do I use to build defenses?
Gold and wood are the two resources used to build and upgrade your defenses.

hero-rescue-puzzle.intro: Hero Rescue Puzzle is a logic puzzle where you use the mouse to shoot sticks, save the princess, defeat goblins and collect treasure. Plan each shot before you fire.
tips: Look at the whole screen before you shoot, and work out which shot clears the most threats at once.
Decide whether the goblins or the princess's safety is the bigger risk in the current setup, and deal with that first.
Treat each shot as a one-time choice, since a poor shot can block the path to the princess or the treasure.
Aim slowly and check where your shot will land before you click, so you do not waste a stick.
If a stage stops making sense, reset your thinking by checking which objects are connected to the princess, the goblins and the treasure.
faq: What is the goal of Hero Rescue Puzzle?
Help the hero save the princess, defeat the goblins and collect the treasure by shooting the sticks.
How do I control the game?
The game uses mouse control only, so you aim and shoot with the mouse.

hidden-object-clues-and-mysteries.intro: Hidden Object: Clues and Mysteries is a relaxed adventure where you search charming rooms and cafés for concealed items while a detective guides you. Move across each location and zoom in to spot what is hidden.
tips: Scan the whole scene first by moving left and right before zooming in, so you know which areas are worth a closer look.
Zoom in on cluttered corners, shelves, and tabletops, since small items often blend into busy backgrounds.
Pay attention to the detective's voice, as the guidance can point you toward the kind of clue you are looking for.
Take your time in each location rather than rushing, because the game is designed for relaxation and careful searching pays off.
If you get stuck, switch your focus to a different part of the room and return later with fresh eyes.
faq: How do I move around a scene?
You can move freely left and right across each location to see different parts of the room. Use this to scan the whole scene before you zoom in.
How do I find the hidden objects?
Zoom in on areas of each location to look closely for concealed items. Your keen eye and clever thinking are needed to uncover all of them.

garden-master.intro: Garden Master puts you in charge of a hardworking gnome who tends plants, drives off gophers, and collects golden seeds to unlock upgrades. This guide covers ways to keep your garden healthy and growing.
tips: Check on your plants regularly so none fall behind while you deal with other tasks.
Deal with gophers early, before they have a chance to damage several plants at once.
Save your golden seeds for upgrades that help the most with your current problems, such as protecting plants or growing them faster.
Keep an eye on which areas of the garden need the most attention and visit them first.
If a run goes badly, try a different order of tasks next time to see what works best for you.
faq: What is the main goal in Garden Master?
You grow and care for your plants, keep gophers away, and collect golden seeds to unlock upgrades for your garden.
What are golden seeds used for?
Golden seeds are collected to unlock upgrades that help you develop your garden further.

tb-world.intro: TB World is a creative dress-up and decorating game with no fixed storyline. You build your own characters, looks, and cozy interiors, and decide what each scene is about.
tips: Pick one character or room first and finish it before starting another, so you can see how your ideas fit together.
Choose a simple theme, such as a cozy winter look or a sunny bedroom, to give your choices a clear direction.
Try a few accessories on a character before settling on an outfit, since small pieces can change the whole look.
Move decor around with swipes before placing it for good, so you can compare how a room feels with different arrangements.
Use the wide range of characters and items to tell a short story, such as what a character does in the room you have designed.
faq: Is there a goal I need to reach to finish TB World?
No. The game has no strict rules or fixed storylines, so you decide what your scene or story is about and when it feels complete.
How do I dress up a character?
Tap on clothing and accessories to add them to your character. You can use this to build a different look for each story you create.

mahjong-classic.intro: Mahjong Classic is a mahjong solitaire where you clear the field by matching pairs of chips that are not blocked. Every random layout has a solution, and you can replay favorite fields like Turtle, Fort, and Crab.
tips: Before each move, check which chips are free on the edges of the layout, since a chip can only be selected when no other chip blocks it.
Prefer pairs that open up chips underneath or beside them, so that more options become available for later moves.
Keep track of the flower and season chips, because each flower pairs with any other flower and each season pairs with any other season.
Save Undo for when you spot a mistake, since it returns your last pair and can keep a difficult field from ending early.
Use Hint when you are stuck, and use Spotlight to narrow down which chips are available before you commit to a choice.
faq: How do I win a round?
You win by clearing every chip from the field. Match chips with the same symbols, and remember that you can only select chips that are not blocked by others.
How do flower and season chips pair?
All flower chips count as a pair with each other, and all season chips count as a pair with each other. You do not need to match a specific flower or season.

hedgies.intro: Hedgies is a farming game where a hardworking hedgehog turns an abandoned plot into a lively homestead. You grow crops, craft goods, and build skills like cooking and fishing.
tips: Plant crops early so you have a steady supply of ingredients for cooking later on.
Try fishing and cooking as you go, since both skills are central to the hedgehog's way of life in the valley.
Use crafted goods to improve your homestead, because a well-equipped farm makes every other task easier.
Keep the valley's community in mind by sharing your food and goods, which fits the game's welcoming spirit.
Work on one area at a time, such as the farm or the water, so your progress stays focused and easy to track.
faq: What is the main goal of Hedgies?
Your goal is to turn an abandoned plot of land into a thriving farm and help the valley become a lively community. The game focuses on growing, crafting, and building skills.
Which skills can my hedgehog learn?
The game highlights cooking and fishing as key skills, along with crafting. Practising these helps your homestead grow.

bus-simulator-game-2026.intro: Bus Simulator Game 2026 is a driving game where you steer a big bus over muddy, bumpy, and rocky roads. Each level brings new terrain and challenges to handle.
tips: Ease off the speed on rough patches, since the road surface is uneven and can make the bus fall or crash.
Use short, steady key presses instead of holding a direction, so you can correct your path before you drift toward trouble.
Look ahead at hills and rocky sections and plan your line early so you are not reacting at the last second.
Keep your bus centered on the safest part of the road when dirt or mud makes the edges harder to judge.
Take each new level slowly at first to learn how the bus handles on different surfaces before you try to go faster.
faq: What is the goal of Bus Simulator Game 2026?
You drive your bus through hills, dirt roads, and rocky paths while driving carefully to avoid falling or crashing. Each level adds new challenges along the way.
How do I control the bus?
Use W or Arrow Up to move forward, S or Arrow Down to move back, A or Arrow Left to move left, and D or Arrow Right to move right. Use the mouse to click any buttons.

deadly-descent.intro: Deadly Descent is a driving simulator where you steer your car down a mountain track and try to reach the finish line. Obstacles along the route can destroy your car on impact.
tips: Slow down before tight stretches and obstacle-heavy sections, since a single collision can end your run.
Learn the layout of each track on early attempts so you can anticipate where obstacles are coming from.
Keep your speed steady rather than rushing, because the simulation rewards careful driving over reckless speed.
Try to beat your own best result on each track, since the records table only keeps your top distance.
Pay attention to how your car handles on different sections, as the realistic physics affects how it reacts to turns and bumps.
faq: What is the goal of Deadly Descent?
The goal is to drive your car down the mountain and reach the end of the track in one piece. Hitting obstacles on the way will destroy your car.
How is my score measured?
Each track has a records table that saves your best result, which is the maximum distance your car was able to travel on that track.

mahjong-lines.intro: Mahjong Lines is a calm logic puzzle where you clear the board by connecting pairs of identical tiles. Paths may bend up to two times, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Before tapping anything, scan the whole board for matching pairs and check which ones have a clear route between them.
Start with tiles near the edges or in open areas, since they tend to free up paths for the tiles around them.
Remember that a connecting line can only pass through empty cells, so removing a tile can open new routes while blocking others.
Use the hint option when you cannot see a move, then plan the next few connections rather than rushing through the board.
If you get stuck, try the shuffle option to rearrange the remaining tiles and look at the board in a fresh way.
faq: What is the goal of Mahjong Lines?
The goal is to remove all tiles from the board by connecting identical pairs. A level is complete once every tile has been cleared.
How many turns can a connecting path have?
A valid path can have no more than three straight lines, which means up to two turns. Paths that need more turns will not connect.

apex-combat.intro: Apex Combat is a fast 2.5D arcade beat em up set in cyberpunk streets. You fight through waves of cybernetic enemies, using combos, special abilities, and optional co-op with friends.
tips: Learn what each of the four fight keys (Z, X, C, V) does by testing them on a single enemy before facing a crowd.
Use the WASD keys to keep moving and create space, so you are not pinned by several enemies at once.
Practice chaining attacks into combos, since the game rewards devastating combo play over button mashing.
Save your special abilities for tough moments when you are surrounded or low on health, rather than spending them early.
If you play with a friend, split up to cover more enemies, or stay close to help each other when the hordes get large.
faq: What is the goal of Apex Combat?
You battle through hordes of cybernetic enemies across futuristic cyberpunk environments. Keep moving forward and fighting to progress.
Which keys control the game?
Use W, A, S, and D to move your character. Use Z, X, C, and V to fight.

hidden-object-street-of-secrets.intro: Hidden Object: Street of Secrets puts you in the role of a lead detective solving a mysterious case. Search atmospheric scenes, from evening streets to quiet rooms, for the items on your list.
tips: Pan left and right across the whole scene before you start searching, so you know what is there.
Zoom in on small areas such as shelves, tables and corners, since details in these rooms often matter.
Read your item list carefully and look for objects that match the names and shapes shown.
When you get stuck, use the insightful assistant's hints to point you toward a crucial detail rather than guessing.
Keep the sound on, since the calm detective soundtrack helps you settle into each scene and focus.
faq: What is the goal of each scene?
You need to find all the hidden objects on your list in each scene to move forward in the case.
How do the hints work?
Your assistant offers hints and guides you to crucial details when you need help finding something.

good-sort-master-triple-match.intro: Good Sort Master: Triple Match is a puzzle game about tidying shelves. You drag items around so that identical items sit together and form sets of three.
tips: Scan the whole shelf before you move anything so you can spot which identical items are already close together.
Start with the items whose matching pieces are closest, since clearing a set of three is the main way to make progress.
Work on one shelf at a time to keep the layout easy to follow and avoid losing track of where each item is.
If you get stuck, look for an item whose twins are spread out and bring one of them closer before trying anything else.
Before you move on, check every shelf to make sure no items are left, because a level is only complete when all of them are removed.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to remove all the items from the shelves. Items are cleared by placing three identical items on the same shelf.
How do I move items?
Drag an item to the shelf where you want it to go. Place it next to identical items so you can build a set of three.

roof-rails-color-stack-3d.intro: Roof Rails - Color Stack 3D is an arcade runner where your character slides along rails on its own while you steer. Build a tall stack of cubes, avoid hurdles, and reach the end point.
tips: Steer early and steadily with the left and right keys instead of making sudden large moves, since the runner keeps moving forward on its own.
Collect cubes whenever the path allows, because a taller stack is what lets you keep sliding along the rails.
Watch for hurdles well ahead and line up your stack with a clear lane before you reach them, since hitting one shrinks your stack.
Look for shortcuts on the track. They can get you to the end point faster and help you keep your stack intact.
Pick up diamonds and coins along the way, since they can be used to buy new skins and unlock levels.
faq: How do I control the runner?
Use the left and right keys to move the runner across the track. The runner keeps moving forward by itself.
What happens when I hit a hurdle?
Your stack gets smaller and parts of it can fall off. Steer around hurdles to keep as many rails as possible.

zombie-bears-night-shooting.intro: Zombie Bears Night Shooting is a 2D shooter where you hunt zombies with a range of weapons, from sniper rifles to machine guns. You play with the mouse and must stop the undead before they transform or overrun the survivors.
tips: Scan the area for hidden spots before you fire, since the game rewards finding zombies first and taking your shot at the right moment.
Save your sniper rifle for strong super zombies and use faster weapons on the weak crawling undead to avoid wasting time.
Pay attention to the helpless victims and shoot the nearest infected threat first, because a zombie that transforms is harder to deal with.
Upgrade the weapons you use most often so your favorite gun stays effective as the enemies get tougher.
Take your time when aiming at a target, since the game tests observation and marksmanship more than rapid clicking.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Bears Night Shooting?
Your goal is to hunt down the zombies in your way and defend victims by shooting the undead before they transform. You need to find and eliminate each target before it is too late.
How do I control the game?
The game uses mouse control only. You aim with the mouse and pull the trigger to open fire.

steal-an-egg-grow-animals.intro: Steal an egg from guarded nests, carry it back to your safe zone, and hatch it in your pen. Upgrade your speed to escape the guards and collect pets from common to mythical.
tips: Plan your route before you grab an egg, since the guards chase you while you carry it back to your safe zone.
Spend early earnings on your treadmill and speed training, because a faster character makes it easier to escape and reach new locations.
Use the right mouse button to look around before you sneak in, so you can spot where the guards are standing.
Keep track of the eggs in your pen as they hatch, so you know which pets you have already collected and which rarities you still need.
Buy trails when you can afford them, since they add speed-training multipliers that help you gain speed faster.
faq: What is the main goal of Steal An Egg?
Steal eggs from guarded nests, run them back to your safe zone before the guards catch you, and place them in your pen to hatch.
How do I move and jump on PC?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the right mouse button to look around, and the Space bar to jump.

vegan-quest.intro: Vegan Quest is an arcade game where you guide a vegan hero through falling food. Collect vegan treats for points and avoid the non-vegan pitfalls as the challenge builds.
tips: Watch the whole screen rather than only the item directly in front of you, so you can spot treats and pitfalls before they reach your hero.
Plan your next move early. Quick decisions matter, but moving at the last second often leads to a missed treat or a hit.
Keep your hero toward the middle of the play area when you can, so you have room to reach either side as food falls from different spots.
Pay attention to how the obstacles change as you go. Challenges grow over time, so adjust your pace and focus as the speed or density increases.
Stay calm and steady rather than rushing. Precision is rewarded, and a single well-timed catch can be worth more than frantic movement.
faq: What is the goal of Vegan Quest?
Your aim is to collect vegan treats to boost your score while dodging the non-vegan pitfalls that fall alongside them.
How does the difficulty change during play?
The challenges become more demanding as the game goes on, with obstacles intensifying and requiring faster decisions and more precision.

fragbyte.intro: FRAGBYTE is a first-person wave survival shooter set in a hand-drawn ink arena. Enemies keep coming, and each wave is harder than the last. Your aim is to see how many waves you can last.
tips: Use right-click to aim down sights when enemies are at range, especially the laser snipers, since steady aim matters more than spraying.
Switch weapons with keys 1-4 as soon as the situation changes, such as the pump shotgun for close crowds and the marksman sniper for distant targets.
Save the ink grenade for groups clumped together or for enemies that are hard to hit directly, rather than using it on a single target.
Use the grapple hook and wall-jumps to reposition mid-fight so you are not standing still in the open while enemies close in.
Chain headshots one after another to build your score, and keep moving between shots so you do not get pinned down.
faq: How do I get a higher score?
Chain headshots to climb the score. Staying accurate and avoiding long pauses between kills helps you keep the chain going.
Is there a final wave or level to finish?
No. There is no final level, and each wave hits harder than the last, so the challenge is to survive as long as you can.

kobadoo-emojis.intro: Kobadoo Emojis is a memory game where you remember and sequence a series of emojis. The challenge grows as you advance, so it tests your focus and recall.
tips: Look at the whole emoji sequence before you start, and try to notice its order rather than each emoji on its own.
Group the emojis into small chunks, such as three or four at a time, so they are easier to hold in memory.
Give each emoji a quick mental label or story, which can make the order stick more easily.
Stay calm and focused as the difficulty rises, since rushing is the most likely way to mix up the sequence.
Take a short break if you start losing track, then return with fresh attention.
faq: What is the goal of Kobadoo Emojis?
The goal is to remember the emojis shown and arrange them in the correct sequence. The game becomes more complex as you advance.
How hard does the game get?
The description says the complexity grows as you move forward, so early levels are a good way to warm up your memory before the harder challenges.

hidden-objects-island-secrets.intro: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets is a hidden object adventure where a magical crystal scatters items across different eras of one island. Search each location for the objects on your list to uncover what happened.
tips: Check the object list before you start searching so you know exactly what shape or item to look for.
Scan the whole scene first, then zoom in on crowded areas like ruins or cluttered corners where small items tend to blend in.
Move left and right across each location in steps rather than jumping around, so you do not miss anything near the edges.
Use the hint when an item stalls you for a long stretch, then go back to searching the rest of the scene on your own.
Pay attention to the guide's hints as you move between eras, since clues about the next location can help you spot items faster.
faq: What is the goal of Hidden Objects: Island Secrets?
Your goal is to find all the hidden objects on the list in each location to uncover the island's secrets. Each location is a separate puzzle you complete before moving on.
How do I move around a location?
Move left and right across the scene to see more of it. Use the zoom to examine small details that are hard to spot at normal size.

paint-and-escape.intro: Paint & Escape is a neon stealth-action game where you sneak past guards, paint a graffiti masterpiece on a glowing spot, and escape. Each level is a new building, so you'll need to adapt as the guards get smarter.
tips: Before moving, watch the patrol routes of the guards, security cameras, and guard dogs so you can plan a safe path to the glowing spot.
Finish painting first, then plan your escape route before you start, since the guards get harder to avoid as you go.
Collect the spray cans on each level if you want the 3-star rating, and keep an eye out for them on the way to the exit.
Use paint bombs on nearby guards when you need to clear a path, and throw them with SPACE, E, or F.
Press WASD or the arrow keys in short bursts to move quietly past guards instead of running straight through their view.
faq: What is the goal of Paint & Escape?
Sneak past the guards, paint your graffiti on the glowing spot, and then escape the level before the guards catch you.
How do I throw a paint bomb?
Press SPACE, E, or F to throw a paint bomb at a guard nearby.

rivals-fps-online-shooter.intro: RIVALS FPS is a multiplayer first-person shooter set in colorful 3D arenas. You can join other players or create a map, team up with friends, and fight across several game modes.
tips: Use crouch (C) when you are behind cover or waiting for an enemy, since a lower profile makes you harder to spot.
Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, so opponents have a harder time predicting where you will be.
Learn each map's layout early, then return to the same spots to find good angles and routes to your team's objectives.
Coordinate with friends in a team so you can cover each other while one player reloads or repositions.
Check the leaderboards to see how you compare, and use that as a guide to which modes or skills to practice next.
faq: How do I start playing?
To start a game, either create a map or join other players already in a match.
What is the E key used for?
E is used to interact with objects in the game world.

numicolor.intro: Numicolor is a coloring-by-number game for relaxing and focusing. You pick a color from the palette and fill matching numbered areas across a growing collection of images.
tips: Use the theme and difficulty filters to pick a picture that suits your mood, and choose an easier one when you want a calm session.
Work on one color at a time: select it, then tap every highlighted area with that number before switching colors.
If you are stuck, use a hint to find an uncolored detail instead of scanning the whole picture.
Try the Reveal or Mystery modes when the classic mode starts to feel repetitive.
Check the collection now and then, since new images are added regularly and may give you a fresh theme to try.
faq: How do I know which areas to color?
Pick a color from the palette, then tap the highlighted areas that show the matching number.
What is the hint for?
Use a hint to locate an uncolored detail when you cannot find where to continue.

flag-memory-match.intro: Flag Memory Match is a memory game with flags from 98 countries. Flip cards to find matching pairs, earn points, and work through six levels of increasing difficulty.
tips: Remember where each flag sits as soon as you see it, since a flag you have already revealed is the easiest match to make later.
Scan the whole board before flipping a second card so you can use the first card you reveal to plan your next move.
Break the board into sections in your head and track the flags in each one, which keeps the layout easier to recall.
Take your time on the early levels to build a habit of noticing repeated colors and shapes, because those details help you spot pairs faster.
Expect the later levels to demand more focus, so stay patient and avoid rushing guesses when the board gets crowded.
faq: What is the goal of Flag Memory Match?
The goal is to flip cards and find all the matching pairs of flags. Each pair you match brings you closer to clearing the level.
How many levels are there?
The game has six levels, and each one is more difficult than the last. Start with the first level to get comfortable with the flags before moving on.

memory-cards.intro: Memory Cards is a sequence memory game where you identify and select cards in the correct order. Levels grow more challenging as you move through the stages, making it a good brain workout.
tips: Pay close attention from the start, since each level builds on the order you have already learned.
Try to group cards into small chunks, such as sets of two or three, so the sequence is easier to remember.
Say the order quietly to yourself as it appears, which can help lock it into memory before you select.
Take a short break if you feel tired, because focus usually matters more than speed in a memory game.
Notice which types of sequences give you trouble and spend extra attention on those when they come up again.
faq: What is the goal of Memory Cards?
The goal is to identify and select the cards in the correct order. Getting the sequence right lets you move on through the levels.
How does the difficulty change?
The levels become increasingly challenging as you advance. Later stages ask you to hold and recall more complex sequences.

jumper-jam.intro: Jumper Jam is an arcade game similar to Doodle Jump. You control a small character, collect coins, and try to set a new record in a colorful browser game.
tips: Keep your eye on where you will land next rather than only the platform you are on, so you can plan each jump.
Use the mouse click or tap timing carefully, since each jump depends on when you press.
Grab coins when they are on your route, but don't take big risks to reach them if it could end your run.
Stay calm after a few missed jumps and reset your focus, because rushed inputs are a common reason runs end early.
Try short practice runs to learn the rhythm of the jumps before aiming for a high score.
faq: What is the goal of Jumper Jam?
Control your character, collect shiny coins, and try to set a new record. The game is built around jumping and staying alive as long as you can.
How do I control the character?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. Your input controls the jumps, so timing matters more than speed.

nuts-puzzle-sort-by-color.intro: Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color asks you to move colored nuts onto screws until each screw holds a single color. Later levels add more colors and harder rules, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Before each move, look at the top nut on every screw and check which moves would free up a screw that is empty or nearly empty.
Avoid stacking a different color on top of a nut you will need soon, since you can only move a nut onto a screw that is empty or whose top nut matches it.
On hard mode levels, colors stay hidden until you move the nut above them, so make a test move that reveals useful information before committing to a plan.
Use undo when a move blocks your progress, and use reset only when you have checked that a fresh start is simpler than backtracking.
Save the extra screw option for tight levels, since extra screws can only be won from chests and the winner's wheel.
faq: What is the goal of Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color?
Sort the colored nuts onto screws so that every screw ends up holding nuts of only one color.
How do I move a nut?
Tap the nut you want to move, then tap the screw where you want to place it. The move only works if that screw is empty or its top nut matches the color of the nut you are moving.

aod-art-of-defense.intro: AOD - Art Of Defense is a tower defense game with strategy and RPG elements, set in a post-apocalyptic world. You command a squad defending your base against Mr. Evil's forces.
tips: Use the scroll wheel or pinch zoom to check the whole battlefield before placing towers, so you can spot where enemies approach your base.
Mix tower types such as tanks, machine guns, and rockets rather than relying on one kind, since each handles enemies differently.
Spend upgrades steadily on the towers that are already doing the most work instead of spreading resources thinly across many towers.
Level up your heroes between battles and bring them into fights where their abilities can help you hold a weak point.
Save powerful area attacks like nuclear bombs or ion satellite strikes for dangerous waves and formidable bosses rather than using them early.
faq: How do I place a tower?
Use the left mouse button to place a tower on the map. Use the scroll wheel or pinch on a touchpad to zoom in or out first if you need a closer look.
What is the goal of each battle?
Your goal is to protect your base and stop enemy forces from breaking through. The game also includes escape, fog, and survival modes that change how you play.

math-fight-club.intro: Math Fight Club is a math game where you build your own fighter, solve equations, and battle math legends in the ring. Quick calculations help you outsmart each opponent.
tips: Work through each equation step by step before you answer, since a careless mistake can cost you the round.
Practise mental arithmetic on the simpler problems so you can answer quickly when the pressure rises.
Pay attention to the type of equation each opponent throws at you, and notice which kinds give you trouble.
Keep track of which opponents you have already beaten so you can focus your practice on the tougher matchups.
Take your time with the character customisation, but do not let it distract you from the maths that wins fights.
faq: What is the main goal of Math Fight Club?
You battle math legends in the ring by solving equations and outsmarting your opponents. The aim is to rise to become the math champion by beating every legend.
How do I win a fight?
You win by solving the equations faster and more accurately than your opponent. Quick, correct calculations are the key to outsmarting your foes.

bike-race-rush.intro: Bike Race Rush is a bike racing adventure where you speed around town, ride over slopes, and pull off flips and stunts. Collect coins, finish quests, and climb the ranks.
tips: Watch the slopes ahead so you can time your jumps and tricks before you reach the edge.
Keep your reactions sharp while speeding around town, since quick changes in direction help you avoid trouble.
Collect coins whenever you can, because they are one of the main ways to earn new bikes.
Check your quest list often and plan your route to finish quests while you progress.
Try a few flips and stunts in safe spots to learn how your bike responds before attempting harder runs.
faq: What is the main goal of Bike Race Rush?
Collect coins, complete quests, and pass ranks while doing flips, tricks, and stunts on the slopes. The game also rewards quick reactions while speeding around town.
How do I control my bike?
The game is played with a mouse or by clicking. Use these inputs to steer and perform your tricks.

bike-stunt-master-mini-rush.intro: Bike Stunt Master Mini Rush is a motorcycle racing game where you race across challenging tracks, perform stunts, and compete against rival riders. Use the on-screen controls to steer, accelerate, brake, and pull off bike stunts.
tips: Brake before tight turns and jumps rather than after, so you keep control of the bike when you land.
Pick up power-ups when they are on your path, but don't swerve into obstacles to reach them.
Try stunts during safe stretches of track, and learn how your bike lands before attempting them in tricky sections.
Check whether a bike upgrade suits the track you are racing on, since the environments range from beaches and jungles to deserts and night tracks.
Replay the early levels to earn rewards and unlock new bikes, then compare how each one handles.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You race through challenging tracks, dodge obstacles, and compete against rival riders to complete levels and earn rewards.
How do I control my bike?
Use the on-screen controls to steer, accelerate, brake, and perform bike stunts.

merge-royal.intro: Merge Royal combines Solitaire-style card strategy with 2048-style merging. Match cards, aim for higher numbers, and keep your logic and speed sharp as the puzzle grows.
tips: Look for matching cards that can merge before you make any move, and pick the merge that keeps your board open for the next one.
Think a step ahead about where new cards will land, so you don't fill a space you will need for a bigger merge later.
Work toward higher numbers gradually instead of rushing, since building up in small steps usually leaves you more options.
Stay relaxed and take your time when the board feels crowded, because careful choices matter more than fast ones in this puzzle.
Use short play sessions to practice, and notice which merge patterns you repeat so you can spot them faster next time.
faq: What is the main goal in Merge Royal?
The goal is to merge matching cards and aim for higher numbers while solving the card puzzle. Planning ahead helps you keep the board manageable.
Does Merge Royal need quick reactions?
The game rewards both logic and speed, so it helps to spot merges quickly. Still, slowing down to check your options often prevents mistakes.

bubble-shooter-tap-and-pop.intro: Bubble Shooter: Tap & Pop is an arcade bubble shooter where you shoot bubbles to connect them and create cascades across varied levels. Upgrades, bonuses, and new bubble types help you handle tougher challenges.
tips: Look for shots that connect several bubbles at once, since creating cascades is central to the game.
Plan your shot before firing and check which bubbles you can reach from your current position.
Save unlocked bubble types for levels where they can clear obstacles that regular bubbles struggle with.
Use upgrades and bonuses when a level feels stuck rather than spending them early on easier levels.
Read each level's task or goal before you start, because the objectives change from level to level.
faq: What is the main goal of Bubble Shooter: Tap & Pop?
Your aim is to shoot and connect bubbles to clear each level, while completing the task or goal shown for that level. Cascades of connected bubbles help you progress faster.
How can I get better at clearing the harder levels?

Focus on strategic shots that set up cascades and use the new bubble types you unlock when the layout calls for them. Upgrades and bonuses are also available to help with the most challenging obstacles.

kobadoo-numbers.intro: Kobadoo Numbers is a memory game built around two-digit sequences that get harder as you progress. It is designed to train working memory, focus, and attention.
tips: Break each two-digit sequence into pairs or short chunks so it is easier to hold in your head.
Say the numbers silently or aloud as you see them to reinforce them before they disappear.
Practice in short sessions, since steady repetition builds working memory better than long, tiring rounds.
Stay focused on the current sequence and avoid thinking ahead to the harder ones, which can cause you to lose the numbers you already have.
Notice which types of sequences you miss most often and give those extra attention in later rounds.
faq: What is the goal of Kobadoo Numbers?
The goal is to memorize two-digit sequences that become increasingly difficult as the game goes on. It is designed to strengthen working memory, focus, and mental agility.
How does the difficulty change during play?
The sequences become increasingly difficult, so later rounds ask you to remember more or harder numbers. Staying calm and focused helps you keep up as the challenge grows.

midnight-valet.intro: Midnight Valet is a 3D valet parking simulator set during a night shift at a busy city club. You take keys, park cars, and return each one when its guest comes out.
tips: Hang each key on the key board as soon as you park, so you always know which keys are in the lot.
When a guest comes out, look at the key number first, but remember tipsy guests may give the wrong one, so check the car's colour instead.
Prioritise hasty guests, since their countdown timer keeps running while you walk and drive.
Drive carefully and use the handbrake when you need to stop precisely, because scratches bring threats.
Keep the mafia boss's black-gold sports car in mind: it belongs in the VIP spot only.
faq: How do I take keys and hand a car back?
Stand near the guest or car and press Space to take keys or open the key board. Press Space again to get in or out of the car, and to hand over the car.
How do I find the right car for a guest?
Check the key number on the key board. Tipsy guests may say the wrong number, so find their car by its colour instead.

rabbit-punch-rabbit.intro: Rabbit Punch Rabbit is a fast reaction clicker where you hit the hare the moment it pops up. You can play alone or challenge a friend or the computer on the same device.
tips: Keep your cursor or finger close to the play area so you can react as soon as the hare appears.
The hare only shows for a moment, so focus on the spot where it is most likely to appear rather than scanning the whole screen.
Avoid tapping early or repeatedly in one place; wait for the hare to show, then strike once and move on.
In two player mode, watch your opponent's timing and try to stay calm, since the player who hits first gets the points.
Stay relaxed and focused for the whole round, because a short lapse in attention is often what costs you the hare.
faq: What is the goal of Rabbit Punch Rabbit?
The goal is to hit the hare before it disappears. The player who hits it first is rewarded with points.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or a tap on the screen to hit the hare when it appears.

kobadoo-shapes.intro: Kobadoo Shapes is a trivia game where you memorize a sequence of colorful shapes and then recreate it. Each level gets harder as the sequences grow more demanding.
tips: Look at the whole sequence first and group the shapes into small chunks, such as pairs or repeating patterns, so they are easier to hold in memory.
Say the shapes to yourself in order, using simple names or short phrases, to give your memory a second route to the sequence.
Keep your attention steady during the memorizing phase. Blinking or glancing away can cost you the start of the sequence.
Stay calm when the difficulty goes up. Take a moment to reset before each new level rather than rushing your recall.
Notice which shapes or colors you tend to mix up, and focus your attention on those spots in future sequences.
faq: What is the goal of Kobadoo Shapes?
The goal is to memorize a sequence of shapes and then replicate it correctly. Success lets you move on to the next level.
How does the difficulty change as I play?
The game says difficulty ramps up across multiple levels, so the sequences become more challenging as you progress.

hazmob-fps-online-shooter.intro: Hazmob FPS is a fast multiplayer first-person shooter with several game modes and close-quarters maps. Battles are short and reflex-driven, so quick movement and sharp aim matter most.
tips: Learn the controls early: WASD to move, Space to jump, and Shift to run let you reposition quickly between fights.
Use crouch (C) and aim (right mouse or V) when you are about to engage, since close-quarters maps reward players who stay low and aim before peeking.
Switch weapons with keys 1, 2 and 3 as soon as you know the enemy's position, so you are never caught holding the wrong gun.
Try the skills on keys 4, 5 and 6 and the alternative skills on E and Q in quiet moments, so you know what they do before a tense fight.
Check the leaderboard with P between rounds to see how you are doing, and use that to decide whether to play more aggressively or more carefully.
faq: What is the main goal of Hazmob FPS?
You play against other players in multiplayer matches, and the goal depends on the mode you pick, such as Team Deathmatch, Capture the flag or Elimination.
How do I aim and shoot?
Hold the right mouse button or press V to aim, and use the left mouse button to shoot. Aiming before you fire is useful in close-quarters fights.

push-the-crazy-crowd-stickman-clash-3d.intro: Push the Crazy Crowd: Stickman Clash 3D is a hypercasual running game where you push enemies off the platform and bridge while racing to the finishing line. You play with the mouse.
tips: Keep your attention on the edges of the platform and bridge, since enemies are knocked off the sides when they are pushed there.
Click the left mouse button in quick, steady presses rather than holding it down, so you can aim each push at the crowd in front of you.
Watch the crowd as it moves and push the largest groups toward the edge first, because each push can clear several enemies at once.
Stay focused on the finishing line so you do not spend all your clicks on small clusters that are not in your way.
If you lose ground in a crowd, step back and reposition before pushing again, so your next click has a better chance to clear enemies.
faq: What is the goal of Push the Crazy Crowd?
Your goal is to push the enemies off the platform and bridge and reach the finishing line as the last stickman standing.
How do I push enemies in this game?
Click the left mouse button to push enemies. The game description also mentions swiping with a finger to push them off the platform.

backgammon.intro: Backgammon is a classic two-player board game where you roll dice and move your pieces around the board. The goal is to take all of your pieces off the board before your opponent does.
tips: Pay attention to the dice you roll and plan several moves ahead rather than only choosing the most obvious one.
Be careful with single pieces left alone on a point, because an opponent who lands on them can send them back and slow you down.
Try to move your pieces forward steadily so you are not stuck with many chips far behind when the opponent gets ahead.
Think about the whole position, not just one move, since the game rewards long-term planning over short-term luck.
Watch how many chips your opponent has left to move and adjust your plan to block them or race them home when it makes sense.
faq: Is Backgammon mostly luck or skill?
The dice add luck to each turn, but the instructions note that strategy matters more over the long run. Good planning across many turns tends to win more games.
What is the winning condition?
You win by removing all of your chips from the board before your opponent removes all of theirs.

word-finder.intro: Word Finder is a word search puzzle where you connect letters to find words related to a clue. The tiles shift as you progress, so each puzzle changes while you play.
tips: Read the clue first and list a few related words in your head before you start swiping. This narrows the search.
Look for common word endings and beginnings such as -ing, -ed, or un- to spot words faster in the letter grid.
Find the easier words first. Each word you clear can change the grid, which may reveal new options for the harder ones.
Save the Spyglass, Light Bulb, and shuffle for when you are truly stuck, rather than using them right away.
Pay attention to bonus words. Finding extra words earns rewards, so it is worth scanning for them once the main words are done.
faq: What is the goal of Word Finder?
Your goal is to find all the words related to the clue in each puzzle to clear the level.
How do I select a word?
Swipe over the letters in the correct order to connect them and form a word.

my-first-100-words.intro: My First 100 Words is a language game where players explore several languages by spotting emojis and hearing how words are pronounced. The challenges grow harder as the adventure goes on.
tips: Listen to each pronunciation carefully before moving on, since hearing the sound is a key part of the learning.
Say the words out loud, even quietly, so the sounds stick better than they would from just reading or looking.
Take one language at a time instead of jumping between them, which makes it easier to notice how its words sound.
Revisit words you found tricky once the challenges get harder, so the vocabulary you built earlier stays fresh.
Talk about what you learned afterward, such as which cultures or languages stood out, to build on the cultural side of the game.
faq: What is the main goal of My First 100 Words?
The goal is to explore multiple languages by spotting emojis and hearing their correct pronunciations. Over time, this helps build vocabulary and cultural awareness.
Does the game get harder as you play?
Yes, the game includes increasing challenges as you progress. Taking your time with early words can make the later ones easier to handle.

super-runcraft.intro: Super RunCraft is a 3D endless runner set in a long Minecraft-style land. Run along your lane, collect golden coins, and avoid obstacles for as long as you can.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your character, so you can spot obstacles early and react in time.
Use the arrow keys or touch controls to shift lanes smoothly instead of making sudden moves near an obstacle.
Follow rows of golden coins where they lead you, since they often point toward a safe path through the course.
Keep an eye out for special items such as the Hoverboard and plan your route to pick them up when they appear.
Stay calm as the run goes on, because the endless format rewards steady, careful steering over rushed decisions.
faq: What is the goal of Super RunCraft?
The goal is to keep running through the Minecraft-style land while collecting golden coins and special items and avoiding obstacles in your path.
How do I control my runner?
You play with the arrow keys or by touching the screen. Use these controls to move along your running lane and dodge obstacles.

find-the-frog-hidden-objects.intro: Find the Frog is a relaxed hidden object puzzle set in black-and-white scenes. Your job is to spot the hidden frogs and tap or click them to bring out their colors.
tips: Scan the scene in sections, moving from left to right or top to bottom, so you don't miss frogs hiding near the edges.
Look for small patches of color or shapes that don't match the background, since a frog can blend into its surroundings.
Keep track of which areas you've already checked so you can spend your search time on the parts of the scene you haven't covered yet.
Save the Magnifying Glass power-up for a frog you truly can't find, so you still get the satisfaction of searching on your own.
Take a short break if you've been searching a long time, then return with fresh eyes, as the frogs are often easier to spot after a pause.
faq: What is the goal of Find the Frog?
Your goal is to find all the hidden frogs in each level. Finding every frog completes the level, and finishing a whole world adds its location-themed frogs to your collection.
How do I reveal a frog once I spot it?
Tap the frog with your finger on mobile, or click it with your mouse on PC. This brings out its vibrant colors.

halloween-fighters.intro: Halloween Fighters is a street fighting arcade game where you pick one of 11 monsters and work your way through 12 haunted arenas. Three giant bosses wait at the end of the ladder.
tips: Learn the direction-plus-button pairs early. Holding forward with an attack gives a strong hit, back gives a medium one, and down gives a low attack or sweep, so pick the one that fits the distance.
Use light attacks with no direction to keep pressure up when you are close to your opponent, since they are quick to start.
Practice chaining hits into combos on an easier difficulty before you move up, so the timing feels natural when the stakes are higher.
Watch for guards and use your heavier attacks to break them when your opponent is blocking, rather than repeating the same light hits.
Save your glowing supers for moments when you have an opening, and be ready for the bosses to take more punishment before they fall.
faq: How do I punch and kick?
Press Z or J to punch and X or K to kick. Combine these with the arrow keys or WASD to change the strength and height of the attack.
What is the best way to start on a new monster?
Choose a difficulty level that lets you get comfortable with your monster's moves. Move up to harder levels once you can chain combos consistently.

kobadoo-arithmetic.intro: Kobadoo Arithmetic is a number game where you memorize sequences and calculate sums. Levels grow more complex as you progress, training both math and memory.
tips: Break longer number sequences into small groups, such as pairs or threes, so they are easier to hold in memory.
Work out sums in steps rather than all at once, which keeps mistakes low when numbers get bigger.
Keep your pace steady at the start so you build the habit of accurate recall before the levels get harder.
When you make a mistake, note which type of problem caused it, such as addition or remembering the order, and focus your next round on that.
Play in short sessions. Frequent brief rounds are often easier to stay focused on than one long run.
faq: What is the goal of Kobadoo Arithmetic?
The goal is to memorize number sequences and calculate sums as you move through increasingly complex levels.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes. The levels become increasingly complex, so the challenge grows the further you progress.

fall-bros.intro: Fall Bros is a 3D action game inspired by Fall Guys. You play the Hex-A-Gone level, trying to survive as long as possible by staying on the platforms while knocking opponents off.
tips: Use WASD to move and SPACE to jump, and practice short hops so you can land precisely on the hex platforms.
Keep an eye on where opponents are standing, since getting too close to the edge makes you an easy target to be kicked off.
Stay toward the middle of the platform where the footing is safest, and move outward only when you need to reach something.
Time your jumps to avoid landing right next to other players, which gives them a chance to push you off.
Watch the movement of the platforms as the round goes on and adjust your position before the ground becomes unstable.
faq: What is the goal of Fall Bros?
The goal is to survive the longest by not falling off the platforms. Kicking opponents off the platforms also helps you stay in the game.
How do I move and jump?
Use the WASD keys to move around and press SPACE to jump.

geometry-arrow-2.intro: Geometry Arrow 2 is a skill arcade game where you steer a small arrow through a cave to reach the portal at the end alive. You dodge obstacles across 13 levels that mix arrow and wheel segments.
tips: Start with the early levels to learn how the arrow responds to input before moving on to harder ones.
Keep your input steady and short rather than holding it down constantly, so you can react to each obstacle as it appears.
Pay attention to the wheel segments, since they are new in this part and may need a different rhythm than the arrow sections.
Watch the path a few moments ahead of your arrow so you can plan your next move instead of reacting at the last second.
If you keep failing the same spot, leave the level with ESCAPE, return to the menu, and try again with a fresh focus on that section.
faq: What is the goal of Geometry Arrow 2?
The goal is to guide your arrow through the cave and reach the portal at the end of each level without crashing into obstacles.
How do I control the arrow on PC?
Use the left mouse button or the SPACEBAR to move the arrow, and press ESCAPE to exit a level.

mahjong-unlimited.intro: Mahjong Unlimited is a classic tile-matching puzzle with endlessly generated levels. You match identical tiles to clear the board, with or without a timer and at four difficulty modes.
tips: Before you pick a tile, check that it is free on its left or right side and not covered from above, since only those tiles can be selected.
Each tile appears four times on the board, so when you spot one, look for the other copies to plan which pairs you can clear.
Clear tiles that are blocking others first, because uncovering more tiles gives you more options.
If you are new, start on an easier difficulty and try the untimed play so you can focus on reading the layout.
Save the hints for positions where you cannot see a clear move, rather than using them right away.
faq: What is the goal of Mahjong Unlimited?
Your task is to remove all tiles from the playing field by selecting two identical tiles at a time.
Which tiles can I select?
You can only select tiles that are free on the left or right and are not closed at the top.

summer-rider-3d.intro: Summer Rider 3D is a fast surf runner where you glide over water on a surfboard or jet-ski, dodge waves and obstacles, and grab starfish as the speed builds. You can play solo or head-to-head with a friend.
tips: Look a little ahead of your rider rather than just at the wave directly under you, so you have time to switch lanes before an obstacle arrives.
Make small, quick steers instead of holding a key down, since over-steering can carry you into the next hazard.
Use jumps early to clear obstacles you can see coming, and avoid jumping into a spot where you cannot see the landing.
Collect starfish when the path is safe, but do not chase them into danger, because a crash ends your run.
Expect the speed to climb over time, so stay calm and focus on steady reactions rather than panicking when the pace picks up.
faq: What is the goal of Summer Rider 3D?
You ride across the water, steer around waves and obstacles, and collect starfish while the speed keeps increasing. The aim is to keep going as long as you can.
Which keys control the rider?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to move left and right and to jump. On touch devices, tap the left or right side to steer and tap both sides together to jump.

obby-1-digging-power-per-click.intro: Obby: +1 Digging Power per Click is a clicker where you train your strength, mine down through the ground, collect loot, and sell it. Upgrade your pickaxe and rebirth to keep digging toward the bottom.
tips: Keep clicking to build your strength, since every click adds to your digging power.
Pick up loot as you go, then sell it when you have a good amount so you can afford upgrades.
Spend your money on pickaxe upgrades before anything else, because more digging power per click speeds up every part of the run.
Watch for the point where progress slows down, and consider rebirthing then instead of grinding the same depth longer.
Use Space to jump over obstacles on your way down, and use E to pick up loot as you move.
faq: What is the goal of Obby: +1 Digging Power per Click?
The goal is to mine down and reach the bottom. You do this by training your strength, collecting and selling loot, upgrading your pickaxe, and rebirthing.
How do I move and collect items?
Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and E to pick up items. On mobile devices, the controls are shown on the screen.

kobadoo-flags.intro: Kobadoo Flags is a trivia game about flag knowledge. You memorize flags as the challenges get harder, which makes it a good test of recall for flag fans.
tips: Learn flags in small groups, such as by region or by shared colors and symbols, so they are easier to recall later.
Pay attention to details like stripes, emblems, and color placement, since small differences between similar flags can be the deciding factor.
Focus on the flags you mix up most often, and review them on purpose instead of replaying only the ones you already know.
Take a moment to settle your focus before each new challenge, because memory tasks get harder as the game goes on.
Notice which types of flags give you trouble and build a quick mental checklist you can run through when you are unsure.
faq: What is the main goal of Kobadoo Flags?
The goal is to test and improve your knowledge of flags by memorizing them as the challenges become more difficult.
Does the game get harder as you play?
Yes. The description says the challenges intensify, so later rounds ask more of your memory than the early ones.

bus-driver-simulator-3d.intro: Bus Driver Simulator 3D lets you drive a bus through well-known cities and varied terrain. You can pick a fast-paced racing mode or a relaxed free mode, with traffic and weather that change how you drive.
tips: Start in free mode to learn how the bus handles before you try racing. Get a feel for its size and turning space first.
Watch the traffic around you and leave extra room when vehicles are close. Slow down early rather than braking hard at the last moment.
Adjust your speed when the weather changes. Wet or poor conditions usually call for more distance and gentler steering.
Change your approach for each terrain type. Hills, rough ground, and busy city streets each need a different pace.
In racing mode, focus on smooth, consistent driving over sudden bursts of speed. Steady runs tend to hold up better than rushed ones.
faq: What is the difference between racing mode and free mode?
Racing mode is the more intense option, built around speed and competition. Free mode is relaxed, so you can drive at your own pace and explore the cities.
How do traffic and weather affect the game?
Traffic and weather change as you drive, so the same route can feel different each time. Plan for slower progress and more caution when conditions get harder.

skate-hooligans.intro: Skate Hooligans is an endless 3D city arcade game where you pick a hero, dodge obstacles, and collect coins. Your aim is to build the highest score you can.
tips: Watch the road ahead rather than the obstacles right in front of you, so you have time to steer around them.
Grab coins whenever it is safe, since they help you buy skateboards and upgrade bonuses.
Pick up upgrade bonuses early in a run, because they can make the rest of the run easier to manage.
Use short, clear swipes or taps to change direction instead of holding keys, which keeps your movements predictable.
Try a few runs in a row to learn the pattern of obstacles, then aim to beat your own high score.
faq: What is the main goal of Skate Hooligans?
The goal is to score as many points as you can while avoiding dangerous obstacles and collecting coins along the way.
How do I move my skater?
Use the arrow keys or swipe to move. Swiping is the way to steer on touch screens.

three-cups-game.intro: Three Cups Game is a memory and focus challenge where you follow a cup that hides surprises. The pace speeds up with each level, so attention matters as much as memory.
tips: Pick one cup and keep your eyes on it from the start, instead of scanning all three at once.
Watch the movement closely and try to picture where the target cup ends up before the moves finish.
Stay relaxed and avoid rushing your answer, since the game rewards precision as well as speed.
Expect the pace to rise at each level, so take a short mental reset between rounds to stay sharp.
If you miss a round, note which movement confused you and focus on that moment next time.
faq: What is the goal of Three Cups Game?
Track the elusive cup that hides surprises as the cups move, and keep your focus through each level. Each win is worth celebrating as you move forward.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes, the pace intensifies with each level, so the movements become faster and require more attention.

body-drop-3d.intro: Body Drop 3D is an arcade simulation where you launch a crash test dummy with limited balls and watch ragdoll physics take over. Aim carefully to cause as much damage as you can.
tips: Since your balls are limited, take a moment to plan each shot before you release it rather than firing quickly.
Try different angles on the same scenario to see how the dummy reacts, since the game encourages creative approaches.
Pay attention to how the ragdoll body tumbles after each impact, and use that to judge where your next shot should land.
Work out which angles cause the most damage, then repeat those approaches in later attempts to build a reliable method.
Unlock new scenarios by experimenting with the scenarios you already have, so each new setup gives you fresh ideas to test.
faq: What is the main goal of Body Drop 3D?
The goal is to aim and unleash powerful impacts with your limited balls to maximize the damage done to the crash test dummy. You can also unlock new scenarios as you play.
How do I get the most damage out of each shot?
Plan your aim before each launch and try different angles, since the game rewards creative approaches. Watching how the ragdoll reacts will help you refine your next throw.

mahjong-puzzle-tile-match.intro: Mahjong Puzzle: Tile Match asks you to clear the board by linking identical tiles that line up in the same row or column. Each layout rewards careful planning over quick clicks.
tips: Scan the whole board before your first click and look for pairs of identical tiles that already share a row or column.
Remember that matches can span empty space, so a tile far across a gap can still be a valid partner.
When two matching tiles are not lined up, look for a move that brings one of them into the same row or column as its twin.
Plan two or three moves ahead, because clearing one pair can open or block the path to the next.
Work steadily and take breaks when a layout gets crowded, since focus is what the harder levels test most.
