faq: What is the goal of Mahjong Puzzle: Tile Match?
The goal is to clear the entire board by matching identical tiles. You win once every tile has been removed.
How do I make a match?
Click on two identical tiles that are horizontally or vertically adjacent, or that sit in the same row or column with empty space between them.

chess-online-multiplayer.intro: Chess Online Multiplayer lets you play classic chess against the computer, a friend on the same screen, or players online. You can pick your difficulty and time control to suit your pace.
tips: Before every move, check whether your opponent can capture any of your pieces, and make sure each piece you move is protected.
Take control of the center of the board early, since central pieces have more room to move and support your attack.
Turn on the move highlighting to see every legal square for a piece before you commit, which helps you avoid blunders.
Use the hints when you are stuck, then try to understand why the suggested move works so you can find it yourself next time.
After a game, open the analysis to review your mistakes, and focus on the moments where your position suddenly got worse.
faq: How do I win a game?
You win by checkmating your opponent's king, which means the king is under threat and has no legal move to escape.
What should I do if I make a mistake?
Use the cancel move feature to take back a move you regret before the game moves on.

parmesan-partisan.intro: Parmesan Partisan is an arcade defense game where you play a cheese guardian. Fend off waves of rats with shotgun blasts, balance strategy with speed, and use upgrades to protect your cheesy realm.
tips: Watch which rats are closest to your cheese, since stopping them before they reach it is the core of defense.
Shotgun blasts spread out, so aim at groups of rats that are bunched together to clear more of them at once.
Balance quick reactions with planning: rushing every shot can leave you exposed when a new wave arrives.
Pick upgrades that match how you are playing, such as ones that help you hold a position or handle crowds more easily.
Pay attention to where each wave is coming from so you can shift your focus before the rats get through.
faq: What is the goal of Parmesan Partisan?
You defend your cheesy realm from rat invasions by stopping them with shotgun fire and upgrades. The description does not list specific win conditions, so watch for in-game prompts.
What controls does the game use?
The game does not list its controls in the description or instructions. Check any on-screen prompts when you start playing to learn how to aim and fire.

12-minibattles.intro: 12 MiniBattles is a two-player arcade game where you and a friend face off across a range of physics-based mini games, with games chosen at random. Each game uses a single button, so the challenge comes from timing and reading the action.
tips: Since each game uses only one button, focus on timing rather than trying to press buttons quickly. Waiting for the right moment often beats mashing the key.
Games are picked at random, so do not expect a fixed order. Stay alert at the start of each round to figure out which game you are playing.
Watch how your opponent reacts to the physics in each game. Their mistakes often show you the safest moment to act.
Soccer and sniper warfare are two of the game types, and they reward very different habits. Adjust your approach as soon as you know which one you are in.
Keep rounds short and switch players often if you are playing with a friend on one keyboard. Taking turns to test each game helps you learn the controls faster.
faq: How do the two players control the game?
Player 1 uses the A key and Player 2 uses the L key. Each player only needs that single button for every game.
Which games can I play in 12 MiniBattles?
The game includes a variety of game types that are played at random, including a soccer match and sniper warfare. The mix changes each time you play.

chess-online-playing.intro: Chess Online Playing lets you play classic chess against real opponents online, against a computer AI, or with a friend on the same device. Pick a mode from the main menu and start a game.
tips: Choose a difficulty level against the computer that you can win sometimes, so you learn from losses without getting discouraged.
Before each move, check whether your king is under threat and whether the piece you are moving was protecting something important.
Look at the opponent's last move first to see which piece they just activated or what they may be threatening.
When playing online, keep an eye on the clock, since the game can also be won on time and not only by checkmate.
Use the Themes section to switch piece shapes and board colors if a particular look makes it easier for you to track the pieces.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The main goal is to checkmate the opponent's king. You can also win if your opponent runs out of time.
How do I move a piece?
Click on the piece you want to move, then click on the square where you want it to go.

monsters-wheels-2.intro: Monsters Wheels 2 is a monster truck game with 24 levels across jungles, a beach, an amusement park and a desert. Each event asks for something different, from racing and crushing cars to backflips and time trials.
tips: Learn which event type you are in before you start, since a race, a car-crushing run, a backflip and a timed run each reward different driving.
Save nitro for the stretches where you need extra speed, such as straight sections of a race or a timed run where the clock is tight.
Use the lean controls while airborne to keep your truck balanced before you land, especially when attempting a backflip.
Spend the prize money from each event on the engine, suspension, tyres or nitro that your current challenges struggle with most.
Try all three trucks, since each one can be upgraded separately and may suit different events better.
faq: How do I accelerate and brake?
Press Up Arrow or W to accelerate, and Down Arrow or S to brake and reverse. On mobile, acceleration is automatic and you use the tilt buttons to rotate.
How do I use nitro?
On PC, press Space or X. On mobile, use the Nitro button.

steel-directive-city-zero.intro: Steel Directive: City Zero is a 2D action shooter where you play as an armored enforcer retaking the city across 20 missions. Fight through human gangs and robots, then complete each mission's objectives to reach extraction.
tips: Use tactical cover before you start shooting, and press C to kneel when you need to make yourself a smaller target.
Save your shield (F) for moments when enemy fire is heavy, and use it instead of taking damage you could have avoided.
Switch weapons with Q as you move between enemy types, so you are not reloading with R in the middle of a fight.
Reload with R during quiet moments between waves rather than when enemies are close.
Before heading to extraction, check what the mission asks for, such as rescuing civilians, collecting evidence, or disabling security systems.
faq: How do I shoot and move?
Use A and D or the Left and Right arrows to move, and Space to jump. Shoot with a mouse click or the J key.
How do I deal with the boss fights?
Use Shift to dodge incoming attacks and G to throw grenades. Keep your shield ready with F and use cover when you need a break.

jewel-coloring-crystal-sorting.intro: Jewel Coloring: Crystal Sorting is a calm puzzle where you sort crystals by color into matching board cells to reveal a sparkling picture. Each correct placement brightens the image a little more.
tips: Before you pick up a crystal, check which color it is and find its matching cell first, so every move has a clear target.
Look for cells that are already open and fill those before tackling blocked ones, which keeps the board from getting crowded.
Use the storage area only when the right cell is temporarily blocked, and try to move the stored crystal back as soon as its spot opens.
Plan the order of your moves so that you do not fill storage slots with crystals that could have gone straight to the board.
Save hints and boosters for moments when you are truly stuck, so you can still enjoy solving the rest of the level on your own.
faq: What is the main goal of Jewel Coloring: Crystal Sorting?
Your goal is to place every crystal into the cell that matches its color, which completes the picture on the board.
How do I move a crystal?
Select a crystal, check its color, and then move it to a matching cell on the board. The game's controls are simple and designed for quick tapping and placing.

hoops-and-fruits.intro: Hoops & Fruits is a hoop-tossing game with colorful fruit targets. Use drag-and-drop moves to work through levels and build your score by hooping several fruits at once.
tips: Look for shots that can catch more than one fruit, since hooping multiple fruits at once is how you score big.
Watch how each throw lands before repeating it, so you can adjust your next attempt instead of guessing.
Try a few different approaches on each level to see which ones hit the most targets.
Take a moment to plan before each release, especially on harder levels where a small mistake can cost a hoop.
Play in short sessions and come back fresh, because steady focus usually helps more than rushing through levels.
faq: What is the main goal of Hoops & Fruits?
Toss hoops over the fruit targets and work through the levels. The game rewards you for hooping multiple fruits at once.
How do I score big in Hoops & Fruits?
Aim for throws that catch several fruits in one hoop. Those combined catches give you the largest scores.

cerkio.intro: Cerkio is a minimalist ball game where you launch a ball into a target. Across 30 levels that grow more complex, timing and one-touch controls are the core skills.
tips: Watch the ball's movement for a few seconds before you touch the screen, so you understand the pattern before committing to a launch.
Aim for consistent timing rather than speed. A calm, steady tap usually works better than a rushed one.
Pay attention to how each new level changes the layout, since the later levels add complexity you will need to read quickly.
If you miss, pause briefly and think about what went wrong before trying again, instead of repeating the same attempt.
Because the controls use one touch, keep your inputs simple and deliberate, which also helps when you practice one-hand play.
faq: What is the goal of Cerkio?
Your goal is to launch the ball into the target on each of the 30 levels. The levels become more complex as you progress.
How do the controls work?
Cerkio uses one-touch controls, so you launch the ball with a single touch. Timing is the main skill the game tests.

hidden-object-my-hotel.intro: Hidden Object: My Hotel is a hidden-object game where you tidy up cluttered hotel rooms and find items hidden in each messy scene. Look closely and use hints when an item is hard to spot.
tips: Scan each scene in a steady pattern, such as left to right or top to bottom, so you don't miss items near the edges.
Use the left and right movement to check the whole room before you start searching in one spot.
Zoom in on crowded corners, shelves, and small details, since the cleverly placed items can be easy to overlook at normal size.
Keep track of what you still need to find and come back to tricky areas later with fresh eyes.
Save hints for items you have checked several times, so you still get the satisfaction of finding most objects yourself.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to help the heroine restore her hotel by finding hidden items in messy rooms and tidying them up.
How do I move around the rooms?
Move left or right to explore the scene, and use zoom to look at details more closely.

gelatino.intro: Gelatino is an arcade game where you steer a brave popsicle through sunny lands. Swing past traps, collect ice cubes, and avoid the heat to keep your popsicle from melting.
tips: Plan your route a few steps ahead so you can react to traps and heat before they reach you.
Grab ice cubes when you can do so safely, since keeping the popsicle cool is the core of the challenge.
Practice small, precise movements rather than large, rushed ones, especially when zigzagging between hazards.
Change your strategy on the fly if a path gets crowded with heat, rather than committing to one plan.
Pay attention to how the popsicle's condition changes as you play, and adjust how boldly you move based on that.
faq: What is the goal of Gelatino?
Guide the popsicle through sun-soaked lands while avoiding traps and heat, and keep it intact to finish the expedition.
What are the controls in Gelatino?
The game page does not list specific controls, so start by testing small inputs to see how the popsicle responds to movement.

playground-man-ragdoll-show.intro: Playground Man! Ragdoll Show! is a relaxed 3D puzzle game where you solve physics-based challenges by controlling a wooden stickman or other objects on the level. Solving puzzles unlocks new levels.
tips: Before you act, look at the whole level and note which objects can move or break, since each puzzle is built around the world's physics.
Make small, controlled movements first to see how the stickman and objects react, then plan bigger moves once you understand the physics.
If a puzzle seems stuck, try a different approach with the objects around you rather than repeating the same move, because the levels are designed to have creative solutions.
Keep your movements steady on the screen or with the mouse, since the stickman responds to how you drag, and sudden jerky motions can make results harder to predict.
If you want to compare your progress, check the global leaderboards to see how your best results stack up against other players.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to solve the puzzle on each level by controlling the stickman or other objects. Completing puzzles unlocks new levels.
How do I control the stickman?
On a phone, move your finger across the screen. On a PC, hold down the left mouse button and move the mouse.

turbo-crash-test.intro: Turbo Crash Test is a physics-based stickman game where you launch your stickman through chaotic obstacles. Earn rewards to unlock new vehicles and harder levels, then review your crashes in replays.
tips: Earn rewards in the early levels first, since they unlock the vehicles and challenges you will need later.
Try a different vehicle when a level keeps ending the same way, because each one may handle the crash differently.
Watch your replays after a run to see exactly where the stickman lost speed or hit an obstacle, then adjust your next attempt.
Look at the layout of each obstacle course before you start, and plan which hazards you want to hit for the biggest crash.
Focus on one level at a time instead of rushing ahead, so your skills build up before the challenges get harder.
faq: What is the main goal of Turbo Crash Test?
The goal is to propel your stickman through chaotic obstacles and create dramatic crashes. Rewards you earn help you unlock new vehicles and levels.
How do I control the stickman?
The game's instructions do not list specific controls, so check any on-screen prompts when you start a level. Experiment briefly in the first level to learn how the launch works.

pregnant-mother-simulator.intro: Pregnant Mother Simulator lets you follow a pregnancy from start to finish as a girl with a loving husband. Your job is to look after yourself, give birth, and raise a healthy baby.
tips: Check on both the mother and the baby regularly, since the game asks you to keep both health and well-being under control.
Include the walking and pregnancy exercises in your routine, because they are part of how you care for yourself.
Pay attention to how the mother feels before moving on, since the game is built around the difficulties of pregnancy.
After the birth, keep up your daily activities while caring for the baby, so you don't fall behind on either side.
Use swipes or taps on mobile, or the left mouse button on PC, in short, steady inputs so that actions are easy to control.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You go through the stages of pregnancy and then raise a healthy baby. Your success depends on looking after both the mother and the child.
How do I control the game on a computer?
On PC, use the left mouse button to interact with the game. On a mobile device, touch or swipe the screen.

hellforge-demon-protocol.intro: Hellforge: Demon Protocol is a side-scrolling run-and-gun shooter with 20 industrial missions. Each mission ramps up in difficulty, so steady play and good use of your tools matter.
tips: Use checkpoints as safe progress points, and try to reach the next one before pushing into dangerous areas.
Keep your two weapon slots loaded with options that suit different enemies, and switch quickly with Q or 1 and 2 when a new threat appears.
Dodge with Shift during enemy attacks and gunfire rather than relying only on your shield, since your lives are limited to three.
Watch for the 16 trap types and slow down in unfamiliar areas so you can react before getting caught.
Keep your grenades and shield for tough moments like boss fights or crowded rooms, and reload R when there is a safe gap.
faq: What is the goal of Hellforge: Demon Protocol?
Complete the 20 industrial missions in the campaign while fighting through patrol soldiers, shield troops, gatling brutes, mech hounds, berserkers and bosses.
How many lives do I get and what happens when I lose them?
You start with three lives. Checkpoints let you return to a point you have already reached instead of starting the level over.

penalty-kick-wiz.intro: Penalty Kick Wiz is a sports duel where you take shots and make saves against an opponent. Success depends on quick decisions, reading your rival, and choosing strategic plays under pressure.
tips: Watch your opponent closely before each action, since their stance and movement are the clearest hints about what comes next.
Avoid repeating the same choice again and again. An opponent who sees a pattern will start to anticipate you.
Make your decision early but stay flexible, so you can adjust if your opponent changes direction at the last moment.
Treat each shot and each save as a fresh read rather than trying to remember a single winning move.
Stay calm after conceding or missing a chance, because reflexes and focus matter as much as the scoreline.
faq: What is the main goal in Penalty Kick Wiz?
You compete in a penalty duel, aiming to outwit your opponent and win through well-timed shots and saves.
What skills matter most in this game?
Split-second decision making, anticipation of your opponent's moves, and sharp reflexes are the core skills the game tests.

stickman-warriors.intro: Stickman Warriors is a fighting RPG where you climb the ranks by battling powerful Saints. Build your stickman's attributes and work toward the top S rank.
tips: Check your daily rewards every time you play, since they add up over time and can strengthen your stickman.
Pay attention to the attributes you choose for your stickman, and pick ones that suit your fighting approach.
Before each battle, think about the Saint you are facing and whether your current stickman is ready for that fight.
Use each win to measure your progress, and do not rush into tougher battles before your stickman feels prepared.
Plan your upgrades around the rank you want to reach next, so each improvement supports your next step up.
faq: What is the main goal in Stickman Warriors?
The main goal is to ascend the ranks by mastering combat against powerful Saints, eventually reaching the S rank.
How do daily rewards help?
Daily rewards give you extra resources that can help you strengthen your stickman for harder battles. Claim them regularly to make steady progress.

zombie-barrage.intro: Zombie Barrage is a top-down defense shooter where you hold a barricade against waves of zombies and mutated bosses. Earn coins between rounds and upgrade your weapons and gear to keep up.
tips: Aim carefully before you fire, since the description stresses precise aiming over spraying shots.
Watch your ammunition closely and avoid firing into clusters that are already dying or about to be overrun.
Spend coins between rounds on upgrades that help you survive the next wave, rather than spreading them thinly across everything.
Keep an eye on the barricade's condition throughout each wave, because it is the core of the defense and the attacks get stronger over time.
Before a boss wave, make sure your weapons and gear are upgraded, since bosses are the biggest threat to the barricade.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Barrage?
Your goal is to hold the barricade against increasingly dangerous waves of zombies and defeat the mutated bosses that appear.
How do I aim and shoot?
On desktop, move the mouse to aim and click to shoot. On mobile, tap the screen to shoot.

hidden-objects-island.intro: Hidden Objects: Island is a hidden object adventure where you explore scenic locations and search for items tucked into each picture. Puzzles and rare treasures add variety as you work through the scenes.
tips: Scan each scene in sections, from edges to center, so you do not miss small items hidden in corners.
Look for items whose shape or color blends into the background, since these are often the hardest to spot.
Save hints for items you have searched for without success rather than using them right away.
Pay attention to the scene's setting, such as a beach, garden, or fishing village, to help guess where an object might be placed.
Take short breaks between scenes to keep your focus sharp when looking for small details.
faq: What is the main goal of Hidden Objects: Island?
Your goal is to find the hidden objects in each picture, solve the puzzles, and collect rare treasures as you uncover the secrets of each location.
How do I find objects in the pictures?
Click or tap on the objects you spot in the scene. Hints are available to reveal hard-to-find items faster.

merge-mine-idle-clicker.intro: Merge Mine is an idle clicker where you tap a diamond-rich vein, upgrade your tools, and merge them to mine faster. Your mining empire keeps earning diamonds even when you step away.
tips: Tap the vein steadily early on, since your own taps are the main source of diamonds before automation builds up.
Spend diamonds on tool upgrades that add the most mining power rather than spreading them thinly across everything.
Plan your merges so you combine tools that give you a clear boost, instead of merging whatever is closest.
Check back after being away to collect the diamonds your mining empire built up while you were gone.
Reinvest the diamonds you gather into automation so your income keeps growing without constant tapping.
faq: What is the main goal of Merge Mine?
Your goal is to grow a mining empire by tapping the diamond vein, upgrading tools, and merging them to boost your mining power. Over time, you accumulate more and more diamonds.
How do I increase my diamond income?
Upgrade your tools and merge them for enhanced mining power, and automate your mining so diamonds come in without constant tapping. Choosing which upgrades to buy first makes a noticeable difference.

car-wash-idle.intro: Car Wash Idle is a 3D idle arcade game where you run a car wash, clean dirty cars, collect cash, and spend it on upgrades and new washing stations. Your business keeps growing as you reinvest your earnings.
tips: Spend early cash on upgrades that speed up washing, since faster cleaning means more cars served and more money coming in.
Check your upgrade options regularly and buy the one that improves your earnings the most for the money you have.
Keep your character near the cars and stations you are working on so you stay focused on the jobs that pay out.
Unlock new washing stations as soon as you can afford them, because each new area adds another source of income.
Hire helpers once your income is steady, so the business keeps earning while you are busy moving around or upgrading.
faq: What is the goal of Car Wash Idle?
The goal is to grow a small car wash into a large car cleaning business by cleaning cars, earning cash, and expanding with upgrades and new areas.
How do I move my character?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move. Drag the mouse to move the camera around your character.

flamit.intro: Flamit is a fast reflex game where you light torches across 30 icy levels before a dwindling flame runs out. Expect snowy obstacles, icy enemies, and two different game modes to try.
tips: Watch the flame or timer from the start, since it keeps dwindling. Spend less time on any one spot so you have time to reach the remaining torches.
Study each icy level before you commit to a path. Plan a route past the snowy obstacles so you are not backtracking when time is short.
Keep track of where the icy enemies move and pass them with a safe gap rather than cutting close. A single mistake can cost you valuable time.
Stay calm and keep your reactions sharp, because the game rewards quick decisions. If a level feels hard, pause your thinking for a moment and then pick the clearest route.
Try both game modes to see which one suits your style. Playing each one can also help you learn the rhythm of the levels.
faq: What is the main goal in Flamit?
Light the torches in each icy level before time runs out and the flame goes out. Each level has its own challenge to get through.
What makes the levels difficult?
The levels include snowy obstacles and icy enemies while you race against a dwindling flame. Planning your route ahead of time helps you avoid getting stuck.

boat-war-mayhem.intro: Boat War Mayhem is a shooter where you steer an inflatable raft down jungle rivers, dodging traps and enemy fire while blasting obstacles and collecting cash. Staying mobile and aiming well are the core skills.
tips: Keep your raft moving rather than sitting in one spot, since staying still makes you an easier target for enemy fire.
Scan the river ahead for explosive traps early so you have time to steer around them instead of reacting at the last moment.
Use your weapon on incoming obstacles that are blocking your path, and pick the ones you can clear safely before they reach you.
Grab scattered cash when it is close to your route, but don't swerve into danger to reach it.
Practice switching between mouse and keyboard movement to find the control style that lets you react fastest.
faq: What is the goal of Boat War Mayhem?
Your aim is to survive the river showdown by outlasting rival combatants while dodging traps and enemy fire. Collecting cash along the way is also part of the challenge.
How do I move my boat?
You can use the mouse to navigate, or use the WASD or arrow keys to move the boat. Choose whichever feels more precise for you.

arrow-exit-puzzle.intro: Arrow Exit Puzzle is a logic game where you clear every arrow from the grid by tapping them in the right order. You have three health points, so each wrong move costs you, and careful planning matters more than speed.
tips: Before you tap anything, scan the grid and check which arrows have a clear path in their direction. Start with those, since they are the least likely to cost you health.
Look for arrows that are blocking others. Clearing the blocker first often opens a path for the arrows behind it.
Work through the board in small steps and track what remains after each tap. Keeping a mental list of the arrows left helps you avoid repeating a losing sequence.
Watch your health points closely. With only three, a few early mistakes can end the game, so slow down when the board gets crowded.
If a board becomes hard to solve, reset your thinking by focusing on one region at a time instead of the whole grid at once.
faq: What is the goal of Arrow Exit Puzzle?
Your goal is to clear every arrow from the grid by tapping them in the correct order. Each tap makes an arrow move in its designated direction.
What happens when an arrow is blocked?
If an arrow runs into an obstacle, it stops and you lose 1 health point.

sudoku-online.intro: Sudoku Online is a browser puzzle with four classic difficulty levels and extra modes: X-Sudoku, Windoku, Killer Sudoku, and Kropki. Every puzzle has one solution that you can reach through logic alone.
tips: Start with the cells that have the most filled neighbors, since fewer possible digits make the correct one easier to spot.
Use notes mode to list candidate digits in each cell, and cross them out as the grid fills in. This matters most on Hard and Expert.
After each new digit, check the row, column, and box it sits in for cells that now have only one candidate left.
In Kropki, read the dots carefully: a white dot means the two digits differ by 1, and a black dot means one digit is exactly twice the other.
If you get stuck, go back over your last few moves. The puzzle is built as a chain of logical steps, so a missed step can be traced back.
faq: How do I win a standard Sudoku puzzle?
Fill the 9×9 grid so every digit from 1 to 9 appears exactly once in each row, column, and 3×3 box. The pre-filled cells are your starting clues.
What extra rule does X-Sudoku add?
In X-Sudoku, digits must also be unique along both main diagonals. Keep that in mind when you narrow down candidates near the diagonals.

stickman-street-fighting-3d.intro: Stickman Street Fighting 3D is a 3D street brawler where you play a stickman who fights foes using strategic blows and quick reflexes. Break objects, grab weapons, and prove you are the toughest on the street.
tips: Watch your opponents for a moment before attacking, since reading their movements can help you pick the right time to strike.
Mix up your blows instead of repeating one attack, so enemies have a harder time predicting and blocking your moves.
Keep an eye on your surroundings and break nearby objects when you can, because they may drop power-ups that give you an advantage.
Use weapons when you find them to add extra punch, but stay aware of your position so you do not get cornered.
React quickly when enemies start a big attack, and use the opening after they finish to counterattack.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman Street Fighting 3D?
Your goal is to dominate the streets by defeating your foes with strategic blows and quick reflexes. Winning fights is how you prove you are the toughest stickman around.
How do power-ups work in this game?
You get power-ups by breaking objects you find during fights. Break objects whenever it is safe, since they can give you an unexpected boost.

offroad-monster-truck-game.intro: Offroad Monster Truck Game is a driving adventure where you control powerful monster trucks on rugged tracks. Each course tests your balance, speed, and handling across mud, rocks, and steep hills.
tips: Watch the terrain ahead of you. Muddy paths, rocky roads, and steep hills each call for a different approach.
Keep your speed under control on steep hills so the truck stays balanced instead of tipping or sliding.
Ease off when the ground gets rough. Keeping the truck steady usually matters more than going as fast as possible.
Use each track to learn how the truck responds on different surfaces, then apply that to the next section.
Use the mouse to click any buttons in the menus, such as starting a track or moving between screens.
faq: What is the goal of Offroad Monster Truck Game?
Your goal is to drive a monster truck through each challenging offroad track while keeping it under control. The tracks test your driving skills, balance, and speed.
How do I control the monster truck?
The instructions only say that buttons are clicked with the mouse. Check the on-screen prompts in the game for any driving controls.

morphit.intro: Morphit is a fast arcade challenge where you change your shape to get past incoming obstacles. It rewards quick reactions and good timing as the pace builds.
tips: Watch obstacles as they approach so you have time to decide which shape you need before they reach you.
Focus on timing rather than rushing. Changing shape at the right moment matters more than changing it as often as possible.
Stay alert from the start, since the environment is fast-paced and a moment of distraction can cost you the run.
Keep adapting. If one shape is not working against the obstacles coming at you, switch your approach instead of repeating the same move.
Practice a few rounds to learn how the obstacles arrive, which will help your reactions feel more natural over time.
faq: What is the goal of Morphit?
Your goal is to morph your shape quickly enough to overcome incoming obstacles and survive as long as you can.
What controls does Morphit use?
The game's instructions do not list specific controls, so the best way to learn them is to try the game and see how your shape responds.

2-minute-football-qb-legend.intro: 2 Minute Football QB Legend is a quick American football game built around passing and scoring touchdowns. You play as the quarterback, tapping to throw to open receivers while trying to outscore a simulated opponent before time runs out.
tips: Before the ball is snapped, pick a play that suits the situation, since your choice shapes which receivers get open.
Once the players start moving, scan the field and look for the receiver who is the least covered by defenders.
Tap close to the receiver you want to throw to, so your pass goes to the player you have already picked as open.
Use the running control to move the ball carrier when no receiver looks open, and steer left or right to avoid defenders.
Keep track of the score as the clock runs down, since you must finish with more points than your opponent to win.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Complete passes and score touchdowns by getting the ball into the end zone. You need more points than your opponent when the game ends to win.
How do I throw the ball?
Tap near the player you want to throw to once the players start moving. Look for the least guarded receiver first.

funny-shooter-2.intro: Funny Shooter 2 is a shooting game built around quirky enemies, a large set of weapon upgrades, and a playful, colorful world. Each battle is meant to be fast and lighthearted.
tips: Pay attention to how each quirky enemy moves and attacks before you commit to a fight, since their behavior is the main thing that changes from one encounter to the next.
Spend your upgrades on weapons that suit your style, and avoid switching setups too often so you can learn how each one performs.
Explore the whimsical world at a steady pace rather than rushing ahead, so you can spot pickups, paths, and details you might otherwise miss.
Keep an eye on your surroundings during battles, because the chaotic action can shift quickly and staying aware of enemy positions helps you react in time.
If a fight becomes overwhelming, step back, reassess what you have equipped, and try a different approach instead of pushing forward the same way.
faq: What is the main goal of Funny Shooter 2?

The game focuses on battling quirky enemies with a customizable arsenal while moving through a whimsical world. The description does not list specific objectives, so exploring and fighting are the core activities.
Does the game offer many ways to customize my weapons?
Yes, the description mentions endless customization options for upgrading your arsenal. Experimenting with different combinations is a good way to find what works for you.

robot-band-find-the-differences.intro: Robot Band is a find-the-differences puzzle set in a whimsical world of musical robots. You compare images and uncover small changes as you move through the levels.
tips: Compare the two images one section at a time instead of scanning the whole picture at once, so small changes are easier to notice.
Check the robots first, since details like instruments, faces, and body parts are common places for differences to hide.
Look at edges and corners of each image, where small changes are easy to miss.
If you get stuck, take a short break and come back with fresh eyes, since patience is part of the challenge.
Keep track of which differences you have already found so you do not waste time rechecking the same spots.
faq: What is the goal of Robot Band?
The goal is to spot the differences between pairs of images as you progress through the levels. Each discovery brings you closer to finishing the puzzle.
What skill does this game test?
It tests your observation skills and patience. Noticing subtle discrepancies is the main challenge.

city-bus-simulator-driving-games.intro: City Bus Simulator Driving Games puts you in charge of a city bus. You pick up passengers, drive busy roads, park carefully, and drop people off at their destinations through a series of driving missions.
tips: Slow down before turns and stops so you keep control of the heavy bus and can line up smoothly at each stop.
Use the brake early rather than late, especially when approaching a passenger pickup, so you can stop without overshooting.
Check the camera angle with C and switch to whichever view makes it easier to judge the bus's width and the space around it.
Take your time when parking. Pull in slowly and make small steering adjustments instead of large swings of the wheel.
If a level is giving you trouble, you can use N to skip it, but practicing the pickup and drop-off routine first will help you handle later missions.
faq: What is the main goal of City Bus Simulator Driving Games?
You drive a city bus, pick up passengers from different locations, and drop them at their destinations while completing driving missions. Parking carefully is part of the job.
What are the basic controls on desktop?
Use W, A, S, and D to move the bus, Space to brake, and P to pause. Ctrl opens settings, C changes the camera angle, and N skips a level.

sokoballs.intro: Sokoballs is a puzzle game where you guide balls onto switches. Each level asks you to plan your moves, and the challenge grows as you go.
tips: Look at the whole level before you move anything, and find where each ball needs to end up.
Plan a few moves ahead so you don't push a ball into a spot where it blocks your path or gets stuck.
If you reach a dead end, restart the level rather than trying to fix a bad position.
Start with the switch that looks easiest to reach, then work out the order for the rest.
Take a short break when a level stalls, then come back and check your plan again with fresh eyes.
faq: What is the goal of Sokoballs?
Your goal is to maneuver the balls onto the switches in each level. Solving one level leads to the next, more difficult puzzle.
Does the difficulty increase over time?
Yes, the puzzles get harder as you progress, so planning ahead becomes more important in later levels.

gym-simulator-online-escape.intro: Gym Simulator Online, Escape is a training-based escape game where you build your character's strength, then defeat bosses to move on to the next level. Progress comes from training, boss fights, and spending your earnings wisely.
tips: Spend your Power Points on skins only when you have a clear need, since Power Points also determine how much damage you deal to bosses in each hit.
Save your Trophies for pets when you can, but remember that Trophies are also required to advance to the next level, so do not spend them all at once.
Check the Wheel of Fortune regularly, because it can give you a large amount of Trophies or Power Points faster than regular training.
Try different combinations of training rather than sticking to one type, since the game does not force a single way to build your character.
Watch for new difficulty levels, training loads, and pets as they unlock, and move up when you feel comfortable with your current training setup.
faq: What is the main goal of Gym Simulator Online, Escape?
You train to strengthen your character, defeat all the bosses, and unlock the chance to move on to the next level.
How do I control my character on a computer?
Use WASD to move, the Space bar to jump, the left mouse button to swing, and the right mouse button to rotate the camera.

word-cross.intro: Word Cross combines a classic crossword with a hidden-word search. Swipe across letters to build words, fill the grid, and build your vocabulary at your own pace.
tips: Scan the letter board for short words first, since they can unlock letters that help you spell longer words that cross them.
Try swiping in every direction, not just left to right, because words can be hidden horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
Save your hints and boosters for words you have truly tried and cannot find, so they are available when a level gets harder.
Read the dictionary definitions of words you discover so the new vocabulary sticks and is easier to spot in later levels.
There is no time limit, so take a short break if you feel stuck and come back with fresh eyes.
faq: How do I make a word?
Swipe to connect letters in any direction. The word is added to the grid when it matches a hidden word.
What are the hints and boosters for?
Hints, magnifying glasses, and firecrackers help you find hidden words when you are stuck on a level.

save-the-girl-epic.intro: Save The Girl Epic is a puzzle game where you guide a girl through dangerous levels and find a way out. Each level brings new challenges, so expect to retry a few times.
tips: Look at the whole level before you act. Identify where the dangers are and where the exit is so you know what you are working toward.
Treat each failed attempt as information. Note which danger caught the girl and plan a different approach for your next try.
Take your time between moves. Since the game is played by tapping, a slower, more deliberate approach helps you avoid rushed mistakes.
Pay attention to how each level's challenges differ. Techniques that worked in one level may not apply to the next, so adjust your plan each time.
Keep patience when progress slows. The description notes that you may need many attempts, so stepping away briefly can help you return with a clearer head.
faq: What is the goal of Save The Girl Epic?
Your goal is to rescue the girl, help her avoid the dangers in each level, and find a way out.
How do I control the game?
The game is played by tapping. Tap the screen to play and follow the on-screen prompts for each level.

tap-3d-wood-block-away.intro: Tap 3D Wood Block Away is a puzzle game where you rotate wooden blocks and tap them away in the right order to reveal 3D structures. Levels grow harder as you move forward.
tips: Rotate the structure by swiping before you tap, so you can see which cubes are fully exposed on every side.
Look for blocks that stick out from the rest of the shape; these are usually the ones you can remove first.
Avoid tapping at random. Removing the wrong cube early can leave you with a harder layout to solve.
Take a short look at the whole structure from several angles before each move to plan the order of removals.
If a level feels stuck, rotate the view again and check the back and bottom of the shape, since the next valid block is often hidden there.
faq: What is the goal of Tap 3D Wood Block Away?
The goal is to clear the wooden blocks in the correct order so the 3D structure is revealed. Each level becomes trickier as you progress.
How do the controls work?
Swipe to rotate the structure and tap a cube to remove it. Use rotation to check which blocks are free before you tap.

speed-evolution.intro: Speed Evolution is a sky-track racing game where your ride changes as you progress. Dodge hazards, level up, and rebirth for bigger multipliers.
tips: Use Space or the round touch button to jump over spikes early, and save your steering for lanes that are clear of saws, spinners, lasers and lava.
Watch each obstacle type as it appears so you learn its timing before you commit to a lane change.
Keep steering small and steady with WASD, the arrow keys or the right-side joystick, since sharp corrections can push you into hazards at higher speed.
Try the E, Q and R keys for shield, dash and hover when you are in a tight spot, and remember that hover is only available on later rides.
Plan your rebirth around the multipliers rather than rushing it, because the bigger bonus only matters if you have built up progress first.
faq: What is the main goal of Speed Evolution?
You race down an 11-stage sky track, leveling up and evolving your ride while avoiding hazards. Each metre you cover makes you faster.
How do I jump and dodge obstacles?
Press Space on a keyboard or tap the round button on touch screens to jump. Use WASD or the arrow keys, or the right-side joystick, to steer around hazards.

canjump.intro: Canjump is an arcade game where you guide a monster across dangerous terrain using a single button. Time your jumps well to clear obstacles and enemies and push for a higher score.
tips: Watch the obstacle pattern for a few seconds before you act, so you can predict when the next jump is needed.
Practise timing rather than rushing. A well-timed jump is more useful than pressing the button as often as possible.
Expect the challenge to ramp up over time, so stay calm and focused as the obstacles and enemies get harder.
Keep your attention on the terrain ahead, not just on the monster, so you can react before a threat reaches you.
Short practice runs can help you build reflexes, and each run is a chance to get a little further toward a higher score.
faq: What is the goal of Canjump?
The goal is to aim for the highest score while your monster navigates perilous terrain, jumping over obstacles and avoiding enemies.
How many buttons do I need to play?
Canjump is controlled with only one button, so the challenge comes from timing your jumps correctly.

going-right.intro: Going Right is an arcade game where you guide a bird back to its nest, using one-touch controls to steer past obstacles. Collect coins to customize your bird as you progress.
tips: Tap with small, steady timing rather than holding back and reacting late, since each tap affects where the bird goes next.
Watch the obstacles a few moments ahead of the bird so you can plan your taps in advance.
Try the different modes to find which pace and challenge suits you best before pushing for a high run.
Pay attention to your rhythm after a mistake; slowing down and resetting your taps can be more useful than rushing.
Collect coins whenever it is safe to do so, then spend them on customization to make your bird easier to track on screen.
faq: What is the goal of Going Right?
Your goal is to guide the bird back to its nest by flying through the obstacles in its path. Each attempt is a short aerial journey that tests your timing.
What controls does the game use?
The game uses one-touch controls, so every input is a tap. Your skill comes from deciding when and how often to tap.

obby-mini-games.intro: Obby: Mini-Games is a platform game where you compete against other players in several mini-game modes. Win each mode to stand on the golden winner's pedestal and collect Cups.
tips: In Colorful Floor, keep your eyes on the color shown at the top of the screen and plan your next step before you land, so you are already moving toward a matching tile.
In Glass Bridge, you cannot see which tile is safe, so pick one and commit. Staying still at the edge only gives other players time to pass you.
In Falling Tiles, do not stop on a tile you have already crossed, because it will disappear after a second. Keep moving forward onto new tiles.
In Parkour, use the camera to check the path ahead before each jump, since a wrong landing can cost you progress through the colorful levels.
Practice moving and jumping with your controls in Parkour first, since good timing and steady movement help in every other mode too.
faq: What is the goal of Obby: Mini-Games?
You play against other players in different modes and try to win each one. Winning lets you stand on the golden winner's pedestal and earn Cups.
How do I move and jump on desktop?

Use WASD to move, the Spacebar to jump, and the mouse cursor (with Tab) to look around. On smartphone, use the joystick on the left to move, the button on the bottom right to jump, and finger movements on the right side to rotate the camera.

moto-x3m-spooky-land.intro: Moto X3M: Spooky Land is a racing game set on haunted tracks. You ride through eerie courses, pull off stunts, and dodge obstacles while unlocking creepy new gear.
tips: Treat every obstacle as a timing challenge and watch the track ahead so you can react before you reach it.
Plan your stunts around where you will land, since a clean landing matters more than a flashy jump on these tracks.
Replay tracks you find tricky to learn where the hazards appear, then take the same line with more confidence.
Keep your speed up between hazards, because the game is built around riding fast rather than slowing down for every danger.
Play each run for a while before deciding a section is too hard, as the spooky tracks reward patience and steady practice.
faq: What is the goal of Moto X3M: Spooky Land?
The goal is to ride the spooky tracks, perform gravity-defying stunts, and dodge obstacles while surviving the ghoulish adventure.
How do I unlock new gear?
The description says you unlock creepy new gear by riding well, but it does not list specific requirements, so keep playing to see what becomes available.

pull-him-out-online.intro: Pull Him Out Online is a logic puzzle where you draw sticks in the right order to free a hunter trapped by obstacles and reach the hidden treasure safely. Each level rewards careful planning over quick clicks.
tips: Look at the whole screen before you draw anything. Note where the hunter is, where the treasure is, and which obstacles stand in the way.
Think about the order of the sticks, not just their placement. Some sticks may only work correctly if another one is drawn first.
Try to find the path that keeps the hunter safe at every step. If a draw leads to a danger, use that as a clue about what the solution is not.
Use the mouse carefully and make smooth, deliberate strokes so the stick lands where you planned.
If you get stuck, step back and test a different idea rather than repeating the same move. Trying a new order often reveals the answer.
faq: What is the goal of Pull Him Out Online?
The goal is to draw sticks in the correct order so the trapped hunter can get to the hidden treasure safely.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse. Draw the sticks on the screen to build the solution to each puzzle.

call-of-tanks.intro: Call of Tanks is an action game where you deploy tanks on the battlefield to defeat your opponent. You win by combining the right units and upgrading both your attack and your defenses.
tips: Pick a balanced mix of units rather than relying on one type, since the description stresses that the right combination is the key to winning.
Watch what your opponent deploys and choose your next card to answer it, especially when they start building a strong push.
Spend upgrades on your tanks for attack when you are pressing forward, and on defenses when you need to hold the line.
Unlock and compare the available bases early, because a stronger base gives you more defense to rely on during tough moments.
On desktop, click cards quickly and steadily; on mobile, tap the card you want and check the battlefield before tapping again so you do not deploy at the wrong moment.
faq: What is the main goal of Call of Tanks?
The goal is to deploy tanks on the battlefield and defeat your opponent. Choosing the right units is central to winning.
How do I deploy a unit?
On desktop, click a card with the mouse. On mobile, tap a card to deploy the unit on the battlefield.

diner-in-the-storm.intro: Diner in the Storm is a 2D escape puzzle where you shelter in a diner during a sudden storm. The exit is simple to reach, but getting the other people inside to follow you is the real challenge.
tips: Move around the whole diner before you head for the door, so you know where everything is and who is inside.
Click on people and objects with the left mouse button, since interacting is how you learn what each person needs to feel ready to leave.
Read each line of dialogue before pressing Space to continue, because the answers you get may hint at how to convince the others.
Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys in small steps so you can stop and check details instead of rushing past them.
Keep in mind that leaving is easy for you but not for everyone, so plan to talk to every character before you go.
faq: What is the main goal of Diner in the Storm?
You need to escape the diner safely while the storm rages outside. Getting everyone else to leave with you is part of the challenge.
Which controls do I need to play?
Use the left mouse button to interact, A and D or the left and right arrow keys to move, and Space to continue dialogue. Movement keys are optional if you prefer clicking.

slope-racing-3d.intro: Slope Racing 3D is a fast ball racer where you guide a ball down an endless, changing slope. You dodge obstacles, use boost pads, collect gems, and make the most of power-ups.
tips: Look ahead rather than at the ball itself, so you can react to obstacles before you reach them.
Aim for boost pads when you can do so safely, since speed is a big part of the challenge.
Grab gems when they are on your route, but do not drift into danger just to collect them.
Save power-ups for a tricky stretch or a sudden obstacle instead of using them the moment you get them.
Expect the challenges to increase as you go, so stay calm and keep your reactions sharp as the slope speeds up.
faq: What is the main goal in Slope Racing 3D?
Guide the ball down the slope as far as you can while avoiding obstacles, hitting boost pads, and collecting gems.
How do I get better at dodging obstacles?
Watch the path a few moments ahead of the ball so you have time to adjust before each obstacle arrives.

the-tall-man.intro: Explore a dark, foggy forest at night, collecting nine pages while managing a fading flashlight and staying ahead of the Tallman. Move carefully, because the threat is always close.
tips: Keep an eye on the battery indicator and switch your flashlight off when you do not need to look at something, so the light lasts longer.
Check the mini-map often to remember where you have already searched, which saves time and battery.
Watch the Tallman countdown on the HUD and plan your route so you can keep moving toward unexplored areas before it runs out.
Use Shift to run only when you need to cover ground quickly, since sprinting in the dark can make it easier to lose track of your surroundings.
Expect the game to grow harder as you find more pages, so spend extra care on the last few pages and the atmosphere of the level.
faq: What is the main goal of The Tall Man?
Your goal is to collect all nine mysterious pages scattered across the forest before the supernatural entity arrives. You must do this while managing your light.
How do I move and look around?
Use W, A, S and D to move and the mouse to look around. Hold Shift to run.

bubble-pop-legend.intro: Bubble Pop Legend is an arcade bubble shooter where you aim and shoot to pop colorful bubbles and clear the board. Matching groups of bubbles is the key to each level.
tips: Before each shot, look at the whole board for the largest group of matching colors you can reach. Popping a bigger group clears more bubbles at once.
Aim carefully before you tap, since every shot counts toward your score. Taking time to line up a good shot is often better than rushing.
Try to finish levels with fewer shots, because using less shots gives you a higher score and a better chance at 3 stars.
Save your boosters for harder moments on the board instead of using them right away. Planning when to use them helps you clear the tougher levels.
Keep an eye on the colors left on the board so you can plan your next shot. Thinking one move ahead helps you avoid getting stuck with scattered bubbles.
faq: What is the goal of Bubble Pop Legend?
Your goal is to pop all the colorful bubbles on the board to win each level. Matching 3 or more bubbles of the same color pops them.
How do I aim and shoot?
Swipe to aim the shooter, then tap anywhere to shoot. Take your time with the aim so each shot goes where you planned.

shooting-blocky-combat-swat-gungame-surv.intro: Shooting Blocky Combat Swat GunGame Survival is a pixel shooter with five multiplayer modes, offline levels, and a choice of 18 guns. This guide covers the controls and some habits that help you get started.
tips: Use WASD to keep moving while you aim, since standing still makes you an easier target. Strafing side to side is a simple way to make your position harder to predict.
Try different guns early on, because the game offers 18 to choose from. Notice which ones feel comfortable for your aiming and stick with those for a while.
Press Q to change camo and E to swap attachments, and experiment with combinations on each gun. Small changes can suit your play style better than the default setup.
Use SHIFT to run when you need to reposition quickly, and SPACE to jump when you want to change height or dodge. Save these moves for moments that matter rather than using them constantly.
Open the TAB menu between rounds or when you need a moment to check your options. Staying aware of the menu keys means you can adjust quickly without losing track of the match.
faq: What is the goal of the game?

The game is a shooter where you fight in arenas across five game modes, either with friends in multiplayer or alone in offline levels. Use your guns and movement to outplay your opponents in each mode.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim, look around, and shoot. Press the mouse controls while keeping WASD movement going so you can aim and move at the same time.

snake-2048.intro: Snake 2048 is a .io game where you start as a small cube and grow by eating smaller cubes. Avoid larger ones, because crashing into them ends your run.
tips: Only go after cubes that are smaller than your current mass. Eating something bigger is not an option, so check sizes before you move in.
Keep an eye on the larger snakes on screen and steer away from them early. Turning at the last moment often leads to a crash.
Stay near the smaller cubes while you are still small, since they let you grow safely. Build mass steadily instead of rushing into the middle.
On desktop, move the cursor smoothly so the snake turns in clean arcs. Sudden jerks can send you straight into a bigger opponent.
Try both difficulty levels to see which one suits you. Start on the easier one if you are still learning how the sizes work.
faq: What is the goal of Snake 2048?
Grow as large as you can by eating cubes that are smaller than your mass. The game also rewards you for climbing the leaderboard against other players.
How do I lose a round?
You lose if your snake crashes into a cube with a larger mass than yours. Keep track of relative sizes to avoid this.

age-of-tanks-warriors-td-war.intro: Age of Tanks Warriors: TD War is a strategy battle game where you lead a tank army through the ages, from the Stone Age to a sci-fi space future. Each level pits your cave against your opponent's cave in a fight for control.
tips: Check how many soldiers you have ready before each deployment, since you may not have enough to match the enemy troops in time.
Time your deployments so your soldiers arrive in numbers that can meet the enemy army, rather than sending small groups one at a time.
Spend your upgrades on the army and weapons you use most, so each era's stronger units build on what already works for you.
Expect the fortresses to get tougher as the levels advance, so focus on efficient wins and steady upgrades rather than rushing into every fight.
Keep your own fortress safe by stopping enemy troops before they reach it, because losing your fortress ends the level.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Defeat the opposing army and destroy their shelter before they destroy your fortress. Each level is a survival battle against the enemy force.
How do I send my soldiers into battle?
Click the small icon in the bottom right corner of the screen to deploy soldiers. The game is played with one-click battle controls.

royal-couple-halloween-party.intro: Royal Couple Halloween Party is a dress-up game where you style royal couples in Halloween outfits. You use point-and-click controls to mix and match wardrobe pieces into themed looks.
tips: Pick a theme first, such as spooky, magical, or elegant, and choose pieces that fit it. This keeps each outfit feeling unified.
Try the couple's outfits in pairs so that the two looks complement each other rather than clashing.
Swap out one piece at a time and compare the result. This makes it easier to see which item improves the overall look.
Experiment with unexpected combinations, since mixing wardrobe items is how you create unique ensembles.
Take a moment to review the full outfit before moving on, so you can check that the colours and styles work together.
faq: What is the goal of Royal Couple Halloween Party?
The goal is to create enchanting Halloween outfits for royal couples by mixing and matching wardrobe pieces into thematic ensembles.
How do I control the game?
You use easy point-and-click controls to select and combine clothing items from the wardrobe.

hero-rescue.intro: Hero Rescue is a 3D pull-the-pin logic puzzle where you control a hero with your mouse. Pull the right pins in the right order to rescue the man and the girl and collect the loot.
tips: Study the whole screen before you pull anything. Find where the man, the girl, the loot, and the enemies are so you can see which pin matters most.
Think about the order of pulls, not just the next one. Some pins may block the path to the rescue, so ask what each pull will release before you make it.
Keep the enemies and adversities in mind when you plan. Remove the threats that could reach the hero first, then go for the loot.
If a pull leads to a bad result, try a different sequence rather than repeating the same move. Logic puzzles usually reward a fresh approach.
Move the mouse slowly and deliberately. Precise, calm clicks are easier to control than quick, careless ones.
faq: What is the goal of Hero Rescue?
The goal is to save the man and pull him out together with the girl, while collecting the loot along the way. You do this by solving each pull-the-pin puzzle.
How do I control the game?
The game is controlled entirely with the mouse. Click and move to pull the pins.

taxi-rush.intro: Taxi Rush is a driving game where you race through busy city streets to deliver passengers quickly and safely. You steer through traffic, avoid roadblocks, and meet passenger demands to earn rewards.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your car alone, so you can spot dense traffic and roadblocks early and change lanes before you reach them.
Read each passenger's demands before you set off, and plan the route that fits them best.
Plan your route before you move, since the game rewards strategy as well as speed.
Spend your rewards on upgrades and customizations that suit how you drive, whether you prefer speed or handling.
Keep your driving steady and safe, because the goal is to deliver clients swiftly and safely, not just quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Taxi Rush?
Race through the city, deliver each client on time and safely, and earn rewards that you can use to upgrade your taxi.
How do I control the taxi?
Use the left mouse button and the W, A and D keys to drive the car, as described in the game's instructions.

epic-duck.intro: Epic Duck is an arcade adventure about exploring charming levels, finding hidden keys, and unlocking doorways. It mixes puzzle-solving with precise timing and reflex challenges.
tips: Explore each level fully before rushing ahead, since keys are hidden and you need them to open doorways.
Look at the layout of a level for areas that seem out of reach or blocked, as these often hide the next step.
When a moment depends on timing, slow down and watch the pattern for a few attempts before committing.
If you get stuck, step back and check what you have already found, such as keys you have collected and doors you have not yet tried.
Practice the reflex parts in short bursts so your timing improves without wearing down your focus on the puzzles.
faq: What is the main goal in Epic Duck?
Your goal is to progress through each level by finding hidden keys and unlocking doorways. Clever exploration and precise timing help you move forward.
How do I find the hidden keys?
Explore every part of a level rather than heading straight for the exit. Keys are hidden, so checking unusual spots is the best approach.

heist-idle.intro: Heist Idle is a 3D idle heist game where you rob jewelry stores, banks, and museums, dodge security, and escape with loot. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and the mouse to press buttons and buy upgrades.
tips: Keep an eye on security cameras and lasers before you move through a room, and time your steps to avoid them.
Grab valuable loot and get out. Carrying treasure is how you build up cash, so plan your route to the exit before you grab the next item.
Spend your cash on character upgrades early on, since they make the rest of your heists easier to manage.
Recruit crew members as soon as you can afford them, because they are needed for the bigger heists.
When you unlock a new location, expect tougher security, so check how the new area works before rushing in.
faq: What is the goal of Heist Idle?
Your goal is to build a criminal empire by robbing locations, escaping with valuable loot, and collecting cash. Each new area you unlock offers better rewards.
How do I move and interact with the game?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move your character. Use the mouse to interact with buttons and upgrades.

magline-moto.intro: Magline Moto is a stunt bike racer where you ride glowing energy-ring wheels through 30 levels across three worlds. This guide covers controls, combat and how to make the most of flips and nitro.
tips: Use the front laser on obstacles and enemies that block your line, rather than trying to ride around them every time. Clearing a path early can make a level much easier to finish.
Save nitro for the big gaps. Build up your speed before you reach a jump so you have enough momentum to clear it.
Practice your flips in the air on safe stretches first. Once you know how long a jump lasts, you can time your flips for bonuses without losing control on landing.
Keep an eye on the ground ahead, not just the bike. Spotting drones, mines and laser gates early gives you time to lean, brake or fire.
If a level keeps beating you, press R to restart quickly and try a different line. Short, focused attempts often work better than long, frustrating runs.
faq: How do I earn time bonuses?
Flip your bike in the air to earn time bonuses, as described in the game's instructions. Practise on open jumps first so you can land cleanly after each flip.
What is the front laser used for?
Press Space to fire the front laser at drones, aliens, mines, barrels and laser gates. Use it to clear obstacles that stand in your path.

police-car-chaser.intro: Police Car Chaser is a 3D driving game where you chase criminals through busy roads and complete missions while dodging obstacles. Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer and keep your target in sight.
tips: Ease off the accelerator before sharp turns so the car stays under control on busy roads.
Watch the road ahead for obstacles and start steering early rather than making last-second swerves.
Use short taps of the brake or reverse to correct a bad line instead of stopping completely during a chase.
Keep your eyes on the criminal's car, but glance ahead often so you don't crash into traffic or obstacles.
If your browser supports the Spacebar handbrake, try it on tight corners to turn faster without losing much speed.
faq: What is the goal of Police Car Chaser?
Your goal is to chase down criminals, complete each mission, and finish every chase by catching your targets. Avoiding obstacles along the way is part of the challenge.
Which keys control the police car?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to drive. Up or W accelerates, Down or S brakes or reverses, and Left or A and Right or D turn the car.

val-d-agri-race.intro: Val d'Agri Race is a car chase game set on the streets of Viggiano. You dodge traffic, escape patrols, and collect coins to unlock and customize cars.
tips: Keep an eye on traffic ahead so you can weave around it before you need to brake hard.
Save your temporary powers for moments when patrols are closing in, since they only last a short time.
Collect coins whenever it is safe to do so, because they fund the cars you can unlock and customize.
Use the destruction in the chases to open up exclusive rides, but avoid crashing in ways that slow you down.
Plan your route through the streets before a chase gets intense, so you are not reacting to every turn.
faq: What is the main goal of Val d'Agri Race?
Race through the streets of Viggiano, dodge traffic, and escape the patrols chasing you. Coins and destruction help you unlock new cars.
How do I unlock new cars?
Collect coins to unlock and customize flashy cars. Causing destruction during chases also gives you access to exclusive rides.

superbike-hero.intro: Superbike Hero is a 3D racing game where you compete in the Superbike Series across Europe and the Middle East. Steer, boost past rivals, take corners cleanly and upgrade your bike between races.
tips: Save your boost for straights or after you have passed a rival, so you are not left with an empty boost when a tight corner comes up.
Slow slightly before a sharp bend rather than braking hard in the middle of it, which keeps your speed up through the turn.
Use the hang-on technique around tight corners to keep your line steady, and practise it early in the race to get a feel for the bike.
Pick up coins when they are on your racing line, but do not swerve dangerously just to grab a few extra.
Spend the coins you collect on upgrades between races, and focus on the areas that match how you are losing time on the track.
faq: How do I steer on mobile?
Use touch controls to steer your bike left and right. Keep your movements smooth so you do not overcorrect on corners.
How do I steer on desktop?
Use the cursor keys or the WASD keys to steer. Tap and hold gently to make small adjustments instead of sharp jerks.

favorite-puzzles.intro: Favorite Puzzles is a jigsaw game where you assemble pictures piece by piece. You can pick how many pieces to use, from a small set up to 1200, and choose between classic and realistic play.
tips: Start with a small piece count to learn how the pieces fit together, then raise the count once you are comfortable.
Use the example and grid options when you get stuck on a section, rather than trying to guess every placement.
Sort pieces by edges and corners first, then build the border before filling in the middle of the picture.
In Realistic mode, group pieces by color or pattern on the field so you can spot matches faster.
Zoom out with the mouse wheel to see the whole layout, and zoom in when you need to check fine details.
faq: How do I move a puzzle piece on PC?
Point the cursor at a piece, hold the left mouse button, and drag it to the spot where you want it.
What does the piece count setting change?
It sets how many elements the picture is divided into, from 6 to 1200, so a higher number makes the puzzle harder.

cat-and-granny.intro: Cat and Granny is a first-person prank game where you play an orange cat causing chaos around Granny's house while making her blame the black cat. Sneak, knock things over, and avoid getting caught.
tips: Knock things over only when the black cat is nearby, so Granny blames him instead of you.
Watch Granny's position before each prank and keep your distance when she gets close.
Hide in a box as soon as Granny comes near, since a stern scolding is the risk if she catches you out in the open.
Use the R key for a hint when you are stuck on how to set up a prank.
Plan a sequence of pranks in one area before moving on, so you can clear objects efficiently and stay out of sight.
faq: What is the goal of Cat and Granny?
Cause mischief around the house and make Granny think the black cat is to blame so you can become her favorite again.
How do I hide from Granny?
Press Q to hide in a box when Granny gets too close. Staying hidden helps you avoid a scolding.

injection-invasion.intro: Injection Invasion is an arcade platformer where you guide a boy through a world of incoming injections. Quick reflexes and good timing help you survive as long as possible.
tips: Watch the incoming injections for a moment before moving, so you can read their pattern instead of reacting late.
Keep your timing steady rather than rushing. Small, precise movements usually keep you safer than big, panicked ones.
Plan a route a few steps ahead so you always have an open space to move into when the next injection arrives.
Stay calm when the pace picks up. Most failures come from overreacting to one threat and getting caught by the next.
Play a few short runs to learn how the obstacles come in, then apply what you noticed to try to last longer each time.
faq: What is the goal of Injection Invasion?
The goal is to survive by dodging the incoming injections, and the game challenges you to see how long you can last.
What skills matter most in this game?
Quick reflexes, precision, and timing are the main skills, along with strategy in choosing where to move to avoid danger.

arrow-cube-3d.intro: Arrow Cube 3D is a logic puzzle where you clear every arrow from a six-sided cube. Plan the order of removals so that each arrow has a clear path when you tap it.
tips: Before tapping anything, rotate the cube and look at all six sides, since arrows on the back can be blocked by ones you might not notice at first.
Find the arrows that are blocked by the fewest others and check what sits directly in their path. Those are often good candidates to plan around.
Work backward from the arrows that block the most others. Clearing a blocker early can open several paths at once.
If you get stuck, rotate the cube to a new angle. A path that looks blocked from one side may be clear from another.
Take a moment to plan the full sequence before you begin tapping. Small mistakes in order can leave an arrow stuck with no way out.
faq: What is the goal of Arrow Cube 3D?
Your goal is to remove every arrow from the cube to complete the level. You do this by tapping arrows in the right order.
Why can't I remove a certain arrow?
An arrow can only move when nothing blocks its path. Look for other arrows in its way and remove those first.

going-up-rooftop.intro: Going Up Rooftop is a 3D parkour climb across city rooftops. Use jumps, slides, ziplines and ladders to keep moving higher while managing stamina and the changing weather.
tips: Keep an eye on your stamina bar before committing to long sprints or climbs, since running out can leave you stuck mid-route. Sprint in short bursts and save energy for the harder jumps.
Use Shift to sprint toward a gap, then time your Space press so you jump at the edge rather than early. Good timing matters more than speed on most leaps.
Crouch with Ctrl to pass under low obstacles and through narrow gaps instead of trying to go over them. Crawling is often the safer route when the way ahead looks tight.
Check each checkpoint as you pass it, since it marks where you will restart after a fall. Collect coins along the way when they are on your route, as they unlock new outfits.
Expect rain, snow and wind to make higher floors harder to control. Slow down and adjust your jumps a little on those levels rather than repeating your usual pace.
faq: What is the goal of Going Up Rooftop?
The only rule is to keep moving up across the rooftops. You climb walls, leap between ledges and use ladders, poles and scaffolding to get higher above the streets.
How do I move and jump in the game?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Space to jump and grab the next ledge, Shift to sprint and Ctrl to crouch and crawl. Move the mouse to look around and steer the camera.

elastic-man.intro: Elastic Man is a playful physics toy with no goal. You pinch and drag the stretchy face of a balloon-like man with your mouse and see how far it bends.
tips: Start with gentle pulls at different spots on the face to see how each area stretches before trying bigger drags.
Try pulling from the edges and from the center separately, since the same drag can look very different depending on where you grab.
Release your grip and watch the face snap back, then pull again, to get a feel for how the elastic reacts.
Use the medium quality mode, which the game recommends for stable performance and for keeping the face from looking too creepy.
Experiment with short, quick drags and slow, steady drags to compare the results and find the style you enjoy most.
faq: Is there a way to win or finish Elastic Man?
No. The game has no goal, so it is meant for open-ended play where you pull and stretch the face however you like.
How do I control the face?
Use the mouse to pinch and drag the elastic face. The face stretches like a balloon when you pull it.

octopus-run.intro: Octopus Run is an underwater runner where you guide a powerful octopus through the ocean depths. You hunt divers and fish, dodge obstacles, and collect money to upgrade your abilities and attacks.
tips: Pick one control method early, either WASD or the mouse, and stick with it so your movement stays consistent while you dodge obstacles.
Keep an eye on what is ahead rather than only on your octopus, so you have time to steer around obstacles before you reach them.
Collect money when it is safe to do so, since it is what you use to upgrade your abilities and attacks.
Hunt divers and fish when your path is clear, and focus on dodging when obstacles are crowded, so a single mistake does not end your run.
Think about which upgrade helps your play style most, such as movement or attacks, and spend your money on that first.
faq: What is the goal of Octopus Run?
You play as an octopus running through the ocean depths, hunting divers and fish while dodging obstacles and collecting money.
How do I move my octopus?
Use the WASD keys or the mouse to move, as stated in the game's instructions.

screw-sort-3d.intro: Screw Sort 3D is a logic puzzle about taking apart 3D mechanisms and sorting screws, bolts, and nuts into matching boxes. Careful observation matters more than speed.
tips: Before clicking anything, look over the whole structure and note which screws are blocking others.
Check the colors of the available boxes first, so you know which parts you can send where.
Only click screws whose color matches an open box, since the instructions say to pick only corresponding colors.
Work through the mechanism in a sensible order, taking out the outer parts before trying to reach the ones underneath.
If a move leaves you stuck, step back and reassess the remaining parts rather than clicking at random.
faq: What is the goal of Screw Sort 3D?
The goal is to unscrew the parts of each 3D mechanism and sort them into the boxes whose colors match. You need to finish the sorting in the correct order to avoid losing.
How do I avoid losing a level?
Sort the parts in the correct order and only click screws that match the colors of the available boxes. Plan a few steps ahead so you do not block yourself.

road-restore.intro: Road Restore is a 3D driving game where you repair roads, repaint markings, and install guardrails across many sectors. Your truck does the repair work as you drive, so your main job is steering and managing supplies.
