tips: Keep an eye on your supplies and head back to the depot for a refill before they run out, so you do not lose time on a stretch of road.
Spend your earnings on truck upgrades first if you find work is slow, since better equipment helps you cover more damaged asphalt per pass.
Stay in a sector a little longer to finish every job when you can, because earning all three stars is the way to get the most from it.
Return to earlier sectors once your truck is upgraded, as they can be quicker to complete with better equipment.
Use repeatable contracts when you want extra earnings without moving on to a new sector.
faq: What is the goal of Road Restore?
Your goal is to fix roads across 70 sectors by driving over damaged asphalt, repainting road markings, and installing guardrails. Finishing every job in a sector earns all three stars.
How do I steer the truck?
On keyboard, use WASD, ZQSD, or the arrow keys. With a mouse, hold the left button and drag on the game area to use the virtual joystick.

driver-club-highway-racing.intro: Driver Club: Highway Racing is a high speed driving game built around dodging traffic and overtaking cars. Your reflexes decide how far you get on the highway.
tips: Keep your speed up but use the brake (S or down arrow) early when a gap closes, so you can steer out of a tight spot instead of crashing into traffic.
Look for openings two or three cars ahead rather than reacting only to the car directly in front. Moving into a gap early gives you more room to pass.
Try the C key to switch camera views and find the one that makes it easiest to judge distances to nearby cars.
Win races to earn money, then spend it on a new car or upgrades. A faster car makes overtaking far easier in later sections.
Once you are comfortable with traffic, try the racing mode, where faster opponents make each section more demanding. Use the P key to pause and reset your focus if things get overwhelming.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You need to overtake other cars to pass each section as quickly as possible. In the racing mode, a strong opponent is added to the challenge.
How do I earn money and what can I spend it on?
Money is earned for winning races. You can spend it on new cars and upgrades for those cars.

endless-car-chase.intro: Endless Car Chase is a racing game where you escape relentless police through busy streets. Customize your car, collect power-ups, and chase a high score.
tips: Watch the police cars closely and plan your route a few moves ahead rather than reacting only when they get close.
Grab power-ups when you can do so safely, but don't swerve into traffic or obstacles just to reach one.
Use sharp maneuvers in tight spots, and look for open lanes before you commit to a turn.
Try different car customizations over several runs to find a setup that suits how you like to drive.
Keep your run going for as long as possible, since a longer chase gives you more chances to build a high score.
faq: What is the main goal of Endless Car Chase?
Your goal is to evade the police for as long as you can while racing through hectic streets. The game is built around pursuing a high score.
How can I get a higher score?
Stay alive longer, avoid crashes, and keep moving through the chase. Collecting power-ups can also help you survive longer runs.

santabalt.intro: Santabalt is a festive endless runner where you guide Santa across rooftops, leaping and dodging obstacles at speed. One tap or click controls every jump, so timing is everything.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead rather than the rooftop under Santa, so you can start your jump early enough to clear them.
Try short, steady taps instead of holding back, since timing your press is what keeps Santa on course.
Pay attention to how the speed changes as you go, and adjust your rhythm before the run gets too fast to react to.
Focus on one obstacle at a time instead of trying to plan far ahead, which helps you react more reliably.
If you fall, restart quickly and focus on the first few obstacles to rebuild your rhythm before pushing for a longer run.
faq: What is the goal of Santabalt?
The goal is to keep Santa running and leaping between rooftops for as long as possible while avoiding obstacles. The longer Santa's journey lasts, the better you are doing.
What controls does Santabalt use?
You play with a single input: a tap or a click. Use it to make Santa leap between rooftops and clear obstacles.

mahjong-3.intro: Mahjong 3 is a puzzle game that blends match-3 and mahjong. Clear a board full of tiles by matching identical ones, and use boosters to finish levels and earn coins.
tips: Scan the whole board before you start matching, so you can spot identical pairs that are hard to see at first glance.
Save your boosters for levels where you get stuck, rather than spending them early when the board is still open.
Watch for tiles that are blocking others and plan your matches so you open up the board rather than leave tiles buried.
Focus on clearing the board first, since completing a level is what earns stars.
If a level feels stuck, step back and look at which tile types are left, then work out which matches will free up the rest.
faq: What is the goal of Mahjong 3?
Your goal is to clear every tile from the board by matching identical tiles. Clearing the board completes the level.
How do I earn stars and coins?
You earn stars for completing levels. Coins are earned as you play, and you can use them with the boosters to help finish levels.

race-rocket-arena-car-extreme.intro: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme is a 3D survival racing game set in a post-apocalyptic world. You drive combat cars through dangerous arenas, fight with weapons, and unlock new vehicles.
tips: Use nitro (Up or W) on straight stretches and open ground, and ease off when you need to steer through tight spots or traps.
Keep Space for rockets when a rival is in your line of fire, rather than firing constantly and running out of time to aim.
Save the shield (E) for moments when you see incoming danger, so it covers the threats that matter most.
Brake (Down or S) before sharp turns and hazards to keep control of your car instead of sliding into destruction.
Use the mouse to navigate menus and choose upgrades, then spend early upgrades on the parts that suit your driving style.
faq: What is the goal of RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme?
You race and fight your way through arenas full of traps and destruction, staying in the fight while you compete. Unlocking new vehicles and upgrading your combat cars is a key part of progressing.
What do the Q and E keys do?
Q activates your superpower and E raises your shield. Use them at the moments when they can make the biggest difference in a fight.

cozy-coloring.intro: Cozy Coloring is a color-by-number game where you pick a picture, choose colors from a palette, and tap the numbered areas to fill them in. It suits a short, calm break.
tips: Pick one color at a time and fill every matching area before switching, so you don't lose track of which numbers you've done.
Start with the larger areas to build the picture's overall look, then move on to the smaller details.
Keep an eye on the animated areas for your selected color, since they show where each tap goes.
Use a hint as soon as a tiny section is hard to spot, rather than zooming in and searching for a long time.
Try a simple picture first to get comfortable with the palette, then move on to more detailed mandalas or illustrations.
faq: How do I color a section?
Choose a color in the palette, then tap the matching numbered sections. Each area is colored with one tap.
What should I do if I can't find a small area?
Use a hint. The game offers hints for small details that are hard to find.

car-crash-test.intro: Car Crash Test is an arcade game about smashing cars in a 3D world with realistic physics. Earn coins through demolition, unlock new cars, and take on challenging tracks.
tips: Think about where a crash will do the most damage before you act, since coins come from strategic demolition rather than random wrecking.
Watch how the physics carries momentum through a crash so you can predict which parts of a car will break off and where the wreck will fly.
Try the time dilation effect at key moments to study a collision in slow motion and plan your next hit more precisely.
Save up coins for the cars you want, and spend them on unlocks that suit the tracks you find hardest.
If a track keeps beating you, return to earlier ones to build coins and get more comfortable with how each car handles.
faq: How do I earn coins in Car Crash Test?
Coins are earned through strategic demolition, so focus on causing damage that is planned rather than random. The more deliberate your crashes, the more progress you can make.
What can I spend my coins on?
Coins let you unlock new cars. Each new car gives you another option for smashing things up.

bmg-ragdoll-car-race.intro: BMG: Ragdoll Car Race is a racing game built around crashes, where physics and destruction are a big part of the fun. You drive through an open world with varied tracks, stunt zones, and hidden routes.
tips: Use the handbrake (Space) before tight corners so you keep control instead of sliding into obstacles.
Save Nitro (Shift) for straight stretches or after a clean corner, since a boost taken mid-turn often sends you off course.
Explore the open world slowly at first to spot hidden routes, which can be faster than the main path.
Press R to restart quickly when a run goes wrong early, rather than driving on with a damaged start.
Watch how obstacles and ramps behave on each level type, since extreme tracks and stunt zones reward careful approaches more than raw speed.
faq: What is the goal of BMG: Ragdoll Car Race?
The game is about racing through varied levels and challenges, with speed and driving skill both being tested. Crashes are a regular part of the experience.
What are the basic controls on PC?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to move, Shift for Nitro, Space for the handbrake, and R to restart. On smartphones, the on-screen keys are used instead.

jigsaw-pusha-pusha.intro: Jigsaw: Pusha Pusha is a puzzle game where you walk and push crates onto altars. Move each crate onto its altar to complete the puzzle.
tips: Look at the whole screen before your first push and note where each crate needs to end up on an altar.
Walk around a crate to reach the side you need before pushing, since you can only push in the direction you are facing.
Avoid pushing a crate into a spot where it could get stuck against other crates or edges, because you may not be able to move it back.
Work on one crate at a time and check that the path to its altar is clear before you start pushing it.
Use either the arrow keys or W A S D, whichever feels more comfortable, and keep the same set for the whole game.
faq: What is the goal of Jigsaw: Pusha Pusha?
Your goal is to place each crate onto an altar. Once every crate is on an altar, the puzzle is solved.
How do I move and push crates?
Use the arrow keys or W A S D to walk, and walk into a crate to push it. Keep moving in the same direction to slide it further.

flufflings-pocket-pets.intro: Flufflings: Pocket Pets is a cozy cat care game where you feed, play with, and decorate for visiting strays. Keep your yard appealing so more cats come and stay happy.
tips: Place food and toys early so more cats arrive, since the description says more food and toys bring more visitors.
Keep bowls filled with food and water, because a well-fed cat is happier when it leaves and leaves behind more coins.
Play with cats by dragging and releasing the ball to lift their mood before they head out.
Hold a cat to read its characteristics before deciding whether to adopt it with a collar.
Use the gate to pause new arrivals when your yard feels crowded, then open it again once you have caught up on care.
faq: What is the goal of Flufflings: Pocket Pets?
The goal is to look after stray kittens, build a cozy home and yard for them, and earn coins from the cats that visit. Adopting cats with a collar keeps them with you permanently.
How do I get more cats to visit my yard?
Leave food outside and buy toys and decorations, since more food and toys bring more fluffy guests. The gate can also be clicked to stop new cats from coming when you need a break.

hoop-world.intro: Hoop World is a 3D basketball game where you perform aerial acrobatics and flipping dunks using precise mouse clicks. Its controls are simple, but the moves are meant to look spectacular.
tips: Start by getting a feel for how your mouse clicks affect your jumps before trying the more complex flips.
Focus on timing rather than speed, since each perfect dunk depends on when you click.
Practice the same move several times in a row to build a rhythm you can repeat under pressure.
Pay attention to your position in the air so you can react and keep your dunk on target.
Keep your clicks deliberate and precise instead of rapid, because the game rewards accuracy.
faq: What is the goal of Hoop World?
The game focuses on performing aerial acrobatics and flipping dunks with style. Each perfect dunk is the main achievement to aim for.
What controls does Hoop World use?
The game is played entirely with the mouse, using precise clicks to control your moves. The controls are described as simple.

run-and-jump-jumbo-runner.intro: Run & Jump Jumbo Runner is an arcade race across changing terrain. You dodge obstacles and fly through the course, where timing and precision matter most.
tips: Watch the obstacles a few steps ahead rather than the one directly in front of you, so you have time to react.
Keep your taps steady and timed to the terrain instead of tapping as fast as you can, since precision is central to this game.
Pay attention to how the speed changes after your quick taps so you can judge when the course is getting harder.
Start each run by learning the rhythm of the first few obstacles, then keep that rhythm as the terrain shifts.
After a mistake, take a moment to see what caused it before starting again, because most failures come from reacting too late.
faq: What is the main goal of Run & Jump Jumbo Runner?
The goal is to race through the terrain, dodge obstacles, and keep flying forward as the challenges get harder.
How does speed change during a run?
Each quick tap unlocks faster speeds and new challenges, so the game becomes more demanding the longer you keep going.

1-speed-escape-prison.intro: Escape a prison by running, jumping and climbing through obstacle courses. Your speed grows as you move, so each run can feel faster than the last.
tips: Keep moving in every run, since each step adds to your speed boost. Pausing early wastes the momentum that makes later sections easier.
Spend upgrades on stamina as well as speed, because stamina affects how fast you move during escape levels. Balancing both helps you get through longer courses.
Use your prison cell to train between runs. Collecting energy or working out on the exercise machines are the ways to raise your stats.
Look for hidden paths when a route seems blocked. Scanning the level before you commit to a jump can save you from repeated falls.
Check the Upgrades button once you have enough money, and buy what fits your current weak point. Saving up for a specific upgrade can be more useful than spending money as soon as you earn it.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to escape from prison by completing obstacle courses, avoiding traps and getting through each level. Finishing the final level is the main objective.
How do I move and jump on PC?

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, press Spacebar to jump, and hold right-click to rotate the camera. On mobile, the controls are on the interface and you swipe on the right side of the screen to rotate the camera.

tentrix.intro: TenTrix is a block puzzle played on a 10x10 grid. Falling blocks must be placed carefully so you can clear full lines and score points.
tips: Because the shapes cannot be rotated, look at each piece's exact outline before deciding where it goes.
Keep the surface of your stack as flat as you can, so future blocks have clean spots to land.
Avoid leaving single empty squares trapped under blocks, since they are hard to fill later.
Plan a few moves ahead by checking which rows and columns are close to being full.
Clear lines when you can, but do not rush a placement that will leave the grid harder to manage.
faq: What is the goal of TenTrix?
Arrange the falling blocks on the 10x10 grid so that full lines are cleared and you score points.
Can I rotate the blocks?
No. The shapes in TenTrix cannot be rotated, so you need to plan placements using the shape as it falls.

city-car-driver-mega-real-sim.intro: City Car Driver Mega Real Sim is a 3D city driving game where you steer and drive through detailed streets in your browser. You follow on-screen objectives while practicing your car control.
tips: Start by getting a feel for steering with WASD or the Arrow keys at a slow speed before you try to go fast.
Use the Space bar handbrake sparingly, mainly for tight turns, so you keep control of the car.
Read each on-screen objective before you set off so you know where you are heading next.
If you fall behind or get stuck, use the game menus to restart rather than continuing a run that is going badly.
Pay attention to the surroundings in the city environment, since turns and traffic are easier to handle when you plan ahead.
faq: How do I steer the car?
Use WASD or the Arrow keys to steer and drive. Hold the keys to keep the car moving in the direction you want.
What does the Space bar do?
Pressing Space activates the handbrake, which helps you take sharp turns. Use it carefully so you do not lose control.

haunted-house-idle.intro: Haunted House Idle is a 3D idle management game where you build and grow your own haunted attraction. Welcome visitors, guide them through spooky areas, and expand into new rooms.
tips: Spend your early cash on upgrades to your character's speed and capacity, since moving faster and carrying more visitors helps every other part of the house.
Hire helpers as soon as you can afford them, because they keep the attraction running while you are busy elsewhere.
Automate attractions when the option appears, so your earnings keep coming in while you explore or work on other areas.
Check your open tasks regularly, as completing them can be a good way to grow your earnings and move forward.
Unlock new haunted areas in turn and compare how each one pays out before spending, so your cash goes where it grows fastest.
faq: What is the main goal of Haunted House Idle?
The goal is to build and expand your haunted attraction into a larger spooky entertainment business by earning cash and unlocking new areas.
How do I move my character and interact with the game?
Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to move. Use the mouse to press buttons, buy upgrades, and navigate menus.

escape-school-duel.intro: Escape School Duel is a running escape game set inside a school full of traps and teachers. You can play solo for a best time or head into 2 player mode and race through the hallways.
tips: Learn the layout of each section early, since every area has its own danger and knowing where traps sit saves time on later attempts.
Use the run button in long corridors where you need distance, but ease off before tight spots so you keep control of your jumps.
Double jump is useful for clearing obstacles you cannot get over with a single jump, so practice the timing of the second press.
When you are near a teacher or the principal, slow down slightly and watch their position before committing to a path past them.
In 2 player mode, keep an eye on your rival's position so you can choose a safer route or push forward when they get stuck.
faq: What is the goal of Escape School Duel?
You need to get through the school and escape, dodging traps and slipping past staff along the way. Solo players chase their best time, while 2 player turns each hallway into a race.
What controls do I use in 2 player mode?
Player 2 moves with the Arrow Keys, jumps with L, and runs with K. Pressing jump twice performs a double jump.

barry-prison-parkour-escape.intro: Barry Prison: Parkour Escape! is an obby where you outwit the warden, pass tests, collect coins, and get out of prison. Parkour skill and item use both matter along the way.
tips: Rotate the camera with the mouse before each jump so you can see the next platform and the landing spot clearly.
Save the Shift jetpack for a long gap or a difficult jump instead of using it early, so you still have it when you need it most.
Pick up coins as you pass them, but only detour for a coin when the route is safe. Falling back costs more time than a short detour.
Check your inventory with Tab before a test or a tricky section, so you know which items you have and can use them with Enter at the right moment.
On mobile, use the on-screen buttons and move in short, steady inputs so you don't overshoot platforms.
faq: What is the main goal of Barry Prison: Parkour Escape!?
Your goal is to outwit the warden, pass the tests, collect all the coins, and get out of prison.
Which keys control jumping and movement?
Use WASD to move and Space to jump. On a computer, the mouse rotates the camera.

rubber-doodle.intro: Rubber Doodle is a physics puzzle where the lines you draw become rubber bands. Use them to catch, fling, and guide a ball into the cup across 75 hand-drawn stages.
tips: Before drawing, study where the ball starts and where the cup sits, and plan a path that uses bands to change the ball's direction.
When launching with a stretched band, pull back firmly but not too far, since overstretching makes the band snap.
Use Z to undo a band that isn't working instead of restarting, and use R only when the whole layout has gone wrong.
Try wrapping bands around pegs and bouncing off walls to build longer routes, because the ball can carry momentum through them.
Save the light bulb hint for stages where you are stuck after testing a few ideas, so you still get to discover your own solutions.
faq: What is the goal of each stage?
Your goal is to guide the ball into the cup using rubber bands you draw, stretch, and release.
How do I release the ball?
Tap the band that is holding the ball to let it go. You can also stretch a band and let go to launch the ball.

commando-force-2.intro: Commando Force 2 is a first person shooter with team battles and free-for-all matches across several maps. Its weapons and Battle Pass rewards give you reasons to try different playstyles.
tips: Learn each map's layout before committing to a fight, since knowing where you can take cover and where enemies tend to come from helps you stay alive.
Try a few different weapons early on to find one that suits your aim and pace, then stick with it long enough to get comfortable.
In team battles, stay close enough to your squad to support each other, rather than running off alone to chase kills.
In free-for-alls, avoid fighting every opponent you see; pick your fights and reposition when you're low on health or ammo.
Check the Battle Pass regularly so you know which rewards you're working toward, and play the modes that help you progress.
faq: What is the main goal in Commando Force 2?
The game focuses on combat, with team battles where you work with allies and free-for-all matches where every player is against each other. Winning fights and staying effective are the core of play.
How can I get better at Commando Force 2?
Focus on learning the maps and getting comfortable with a few weapons rather than switching constantly. Strategic positioning often matters as much as aim.

fashion-princess-dress-up-for-girls.intro: Fashion Princess is a dress-up game where you style a princess and compete in fashion battles. You pick outfits, shoes, jewelry and hairstyles to impress the judges and unlock new models.
tips: Before each battle, read what the outfit needs to achieve and pick a look that fits that theme rather than choosing pieces at random.
Build a coordinated look by matching colors and styles across dress, shoes, jewelry and hairstyle, since the judges score the whole outfit.
Try a few different combinations in the same round to see which pieces earn the highest marks.
Save your crystals for models and dances you really want, and collect them steadily as you play so you can unlock more options.
Experiment with different accessories and hairstyles early on to learn which styles suit each model, then reuse what works.
faq: What is the goal of Fashion Princess?
Your goal is to dress your princess and win fashion battles by getting the highest scores from the judges. Unlocking new items and becoming a top model is the long-term aim.
How do I earn higher scores?
Choose the right clothes and hairstyles for each round. Your taste and creativity affect how the judges score your look.

ember-boy-and-ripple-girl.intro: Ember Boy and Ripple Girl is a two-player puzzle-platform game where fire and water heroes work together to escape each level. Success depends on timing, switching between characters, and using both abilities at once.
tips: Before moving, look at where fire and water can safely travel, since each character is hurt by the other's element.
Use the WASD keys for one character and the arrow keys for the other so you can control both at the same time.
Check the switches and moving platforms before you commit to a jump, because one character often needs the other's action to get past a hazard.
Take a moment to explore each area fully before rushing to the exit, as the path forward is often hidden behind a puzzle.
If you get stuck, reset your thinking by asking which character's ability is needed next, then plan the timing of both moves together.
faq: What is the goal of Ember Boy and Ripple Girl?
The goal is to escape each level by guiding both elemental heroes to the exit. You need to use both characters' abilities together to get there.
How do I control the two characters?
The game uses the WASD keys and the arrow keys. Each set of keys is used for one of the two characters.

plant-squad.intro: Plant Squad is a tower defense game where you place plants to stop waves of zombies. Combine plants to create stronger ones and plan your defenses to clear every zombie.
tips: Think about where you place plants before committing, since the zombies are also preparing for the battle and will test your defenses.
Try combining different plants to create stronger ones, and use the stronger plants where threats are biggest.
Spread your defenses so that no single lane or area is left without protection as zombies advance.
Keep an eye on which zombies are getting through and adjust your next placements to cover those gaps.
Use the mouse to make quick, deliberate moves rather than rushing, because each placement shapes the rest of the fight.
faq: What is the goal of Plant Squad?
Your goal is to clear out all the zombies and save the world by using your plants to defend against them.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse, using clicks to select and place plants on the field.

strike-galaxy-attack.intro: Strike Galaxy Attack is a 2D arcade shooter where you pilot a single spaceship through endless waves of colorful space birds. Dodge enemy movement while firing streams of gunfire and picking up upgrades.
tips: Keep your ship moving rather than sitting in one spot, since staying still makes it easier for birds to line up hits on you.
Watch the pattern of each incoming wave so you can slip through gaps before they close in.
Prioritize collecting upgrades when it is safe to do so, as they are the main way to make your ship stronger.
Focus on the birds closest to you first, because they pose the most immediate danger to your ship.
Stay calm in crowded waves and move to open space instead of reacting to every enemy at once.
faq: What is the goal of Strike Galaxy Attack?
The goal is to survive endless waves of space birds while shooting them down and working toward dominating the galaxy. Staying alive longer is the main measure of progress.
How do I get stronger during a run?
Collect the upgrades that appear during play to enhance your spaceship. Upgrades can help you outmaneuver enemies as waves get harder.

sorter-ragdoll-playground-shooter.intro: Sorter: Ragdoll Playground Shooter is a physics-based shooter where you aim at ragdoll enemies and watch them react to every hit. Earn money, buy new weapons, and clear each level.
tips: Move your weapon around the scene before you fire so you are lined up on the target rather than chasing it after a shot.
Watch how each ragdoll reacts to a hit, since the way a body flies or falls shows where the damage landed and helps you judge your next shot.
Use explosive weapons when enemies are grouped close together, because one blast can affect several ragdolls at once.
Spend your earned money on weapons that suit the level's layout, such as a shotgun for close targets or a rifle for distant ones.
Take your time with each shot in the early levels to build precision, then move faster once you are comfortable with how the physics behave.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You clear each level by eliminating the ragdoll enemies using the weapons you have available. Clearing levels also unlocks new challenges.
How do I aim and shoot?
Move your weapon anywhere on the scene, aim toward the ragdoll, then tap to attack.

realistic-car-crash-king.intro: Realistic Car Crash King is a crash-test sandbox where you drive, jump, and smash a range of vehicles across different maps. Each collision deforms the car, so you can see how much damage each machine can take.
tips: Try the same ramp or obstacle with several vehicles using N to switch cars, so you can compare how each one deforms on impact.
Press R to reset a car after a bad crash when you want to test the same setup again from the start.
Press F to repair a car when you want to keep testing its handling or durability instead of starting over.
Use the Spacebar handbrake to control your turns before a jump or obstacle, which helps you hit your target at the angle you want.
Press C to change the camera and watch the metal deformation and detached parts up close during a crash.
faq: What is the main goal of Realistic Car Crash King?
The game is built around crash testing, so your aim is to drive, jump, and smash cars and see how much damage each one can survive. You can also create your own destruction scenarios.
How do I move my car?
Use the WASD keys to drive. The Spacebar works as a handbrake.

bottle-avenger-royale.intro: Bottle Avenger Royale is an arcade shooter where you play as a bottle avenger fighting off zombies and enemies to survive. You upgrade your weapons and build up your attributes as you go.
tips: Buy guns whenever you can afford them, since merging guns of the same level is how you reach stronger weapons.
Look for two guns of the same level you can merge, and do it as soon as you have the chance rather than letting duplicates pile up.
Spend skill points on the attributes that match how you are fighting, so your upgrades support your current weapon instead of being spread thin.
Keep moving and clicking or tapping to aim and fire, because standing still against a crowd of zombies makes it hard to survive.
Pay attention to which enemies are closing in first and deal with them before they surround you.
faq: What is the goal of Bottle Avenger Royale?
The goal is to survive by battling zombies and enemies. Upgrading your guns and attributes helps you last longer.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The game is controlled entirely through clicking or tapping.

epic-sword-battle-fight-in-the-ragdoll-a.intro: Epic Sword Battle! Fight in the Ragdoll Arena! is a 3D sword fighting game where knights and gladiators duel in an arena with ragdoll physics. Your goal is to cut enemies, dodge their blows, and become the arena champion.
tips: Watch your opponent's sword before you commit to a strike, since timing decides most duels.
Dodge first and attack second. Stepping out of a blow often leaves the enemy open for a clean hit.
Aim for accuracy rather than swinging wildly. The guide says faster and more accurate strikes raise your chances, so slow down slightly when you need a precise hit.
Keep your movement smooth, using small slides on mobile or steady mouse movement on PC, so you can react quickly when an enemy changes direction.
Try different swords and opponents across the levels to learn how each one moves, then adjust your timing to match.
faq: How do I move and attack on PC?
Hold down the left mouse button and move the mouse to move your fighter and strike enemies with your sword.
How do I play on a mobile device?
Slide your finger across the screen to move your fighter and strike with your sword.

color-sort-puzzle-milk-tea-sorting.intro: Color Sort Puzzle: Milk Tea Sorting is a liquid sorting puzzle where you pour colored water between bottles until each bottle holds only one color. Levels grow harder, so careful planning helps.
tips: Before you pick up a bottle, check which color is on top and whether a bottle with that same top color or an empty bottle is available to pour into.
Look at the full stack in each bottle, not just the top layer, since a color buried underneath may need to be uncovered before it can be sorted.
Keep one bottle empty when you can, because an empty bottle gives you a place to move a color that is blocking another.
Check that the target bottle has enough space before you pick up, so you do not start a move that cannot be completed.
There are no time limits, so take a moment to plan several moves ahead on harder levels rather than rushing into the first pour you see.
faq: How do I move water between bottles?
Tap or click a bottle to pick it up, then tap or click another bottle to pour the colored water into it.
When is a pour allowed?
You can pour only if the top color matches the target bottle's top color or the target is empty, and the target has enough space.

war-of-tanks-3d.intro: War of Tanks 3D is a tank battle game where you command your tank across varied terrain. Success depends on careful aiming, smart positioning, and outmaneuvering enemies.
tips: Take a moment to study the terrain before you move. Hills, cover, and open ground can decide where you should position your tank.
Aim deliberately rather than firing as fast as possible. Precise shots matter more than rapid, scattered fire in this game.
Keep moving to avoid becoming an easy target. Repositioning between shots can help you dodge return fire.
Use the environment to protect your tank. Placing obstacles between you and enemies can give you time to aim and respond.
Watch how enemies move and time your attacks around their positions. Striking when a foe is exposed or repositioning is often more effective than attacking head-on.
faq: What is the main goal in War of Tanks 3D?
Your goal is to dominate the battlefield by defeating enemy tanks. Strategy, precise aiming, and good use of the terrain all help you achieve this.
How important is aiming in this game?
Aiming is central to the game, since the description emphasizes meticulously aiming your cannons. Taking time to line up shots usually pays off more than firing hastily.

robot-car-transform-race.intro: Robot Car Transform Race is a colorful arcade kart racer where you steer through sharp turns and dodge obstacles while competing against other drivers. Your goal is to reach the finish line in first place.
tips: Think about your line through each corner before you reach it, since choosing a good racing line is central to staying ahead.
Ease off slightly before a sharp turn rather than braking hard in the middle of it, so you keep control of your car.
Watch the track ahead for obstacles and adjust early, because a small change of direction is easier than a last-second swerve.
Keep an eye on your rivals' positions so you know when you need to push harder to take the lead.
Replay tracks you find difficult and focus on one section at a time to build up your skills on each course.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to race against other drivers, avoid obstacles, take corners carefully and reach the finish line in first place.
How do I win a race?
Finish ahead of the other drivers by combining fast acceleration with clean cornering and careful obstacle avoidance.

rocket-car-football-championship.intro: Rocket-powered cars play football in a floodlit arena. Drive into the giant ball, boost, jump and fly to score in the orange goal before time runs out. Work through five cups from Bronze to Champions.
tips: Use boost in short bursts so you can get back to the ball quickly after a jump or a fast run.
Watch where the AI teams rotate and defend, and aim your shots at gaps they leave open.
Keep your car near your own goal when the opponent has the ball, so you can get back in time to block shots.
Try different matches in 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 to learn how the car handles before you enter the Championship.
Win cups to unlock stronger cars, then use the Garage to match a car's stats and upgrades to the way you like to play.
faq: How do I win a match?
Score more goals than the opponent before time runs out. If the score is tied, the match goes to overtime, where the next goal wins.
What are the basic controls?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive and steer. Press Shift, K or right mouse to boost, and Space, J or left mouse to jump.

bouncing-egg.intro: Bouncing Egg asks you to guide a fragile egg across a pixel-art world by bouncing on rotating circles and smashing menacing faces. Simple tap controls make it easy to start, but precise timing is what keeps the egg intact.
tips: Watch a circle rotate for a moment before you tap, so you can judge where it will be when your egg lands.
Stay patient and avoid tapping quickly in a row, since rushed taps are the most likely way to lose your timing.
Start each new stage by observing the pattern of the circles and faces before committing to a bounce.
Treat every bounce as a separate decision rather than trying to plan a long sequence all at once.
Expect the challenge to escalate, so practice the basic bounce timing until it feels comfortable before moving on.
faq: What is the main goal of Bouncing Egg?
Bounce your egg on the rotating circles to smash the menacing faces while keeping the egg intact as the challenge escalates.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple tap controls, so the main skill is deciding exactly when to tap as the egg moves.

evil-invader.intro: Evil Invader is a fast arcade shooter set on a dystopian battlefield. You fight off waves of monstrous foes using a range of weapons, power-ups, and level-ups in a survival challenge.
tips: Watch how each enemy moves and fires before committing to a fight, since the game rewards learning their patterns.
Save power-ups for tough moments, such as when several enemies arrive at once, rather than using them on easy targets.
Pay attention to which weapons you are carrying and choose the one that fits the enemies in front of you.
Level up whenever you can, because unlocking stronger firepower is what helps you survive the later waves.
Stay mobile and avoid staying in one spot too long, since the enemies in this survival challenge keep coming.
faq: What is the goal of Evil Invader?
The goal is to survive the relentless waves of monstrous enemies on the battlefield while using your weapons and power-ups to fight back.
How do I get stronger weapons?
You level up during the game, and leveling up unlocks more devastating firepower to use against tougher foes.

dotto-botto.intro: Dotto Botto is a retro platformer where you guide a pixel hero through hazardous levels, avoiding spikes and enemies. Jump and dodge carefully, collect power-ups, and reach the final boss.
tips: Watch each spike and enemy for a moment before moving, since the game rewards precise timing over rushing.
Make a habit of checking the level layout before jumping, so you know where safe landing spots are.
Pick up power-ups when you can do so safely, but don't take risks that could cost you a life.
Treat challenges as puzzles: pause to look for the intended path instead of retrying the same jump blindly.
Save your most careful play for the final boss showdown, and learn its movement patterns before attacking.
faq: What is the goal of Dotto Botto?
Guide the pixel hero Dotto Botto home by getting through diverse levels, avoiding spikes and deadly enemies, and defeating the colossal final boss.
What do I need to do to avoid losing progress?
Your main task is to jump and dodge with precision, because spikes and enemies are the main hazards in every level.

word-search-hidden-words.intro: Word Search Hidden Words is a classic puzzle where you find listed words hidden in a letter grid. Words can run in any direction, and you can collect secret hidden words for bonus coins.
tips: Scan the grid for the first letter of each target word before checking the rest, since this narrows your search quickly.
Look for words running diagonally and backwards, not only across and down, because the game allows swipes in every direction.
Pay attention to letters you have already found, as they can hint at secret hidden words that are not on the main list.
Work on one word at a time and cross it off in your mind to avoid rechecking the same area of the grid.
Take a short break if you get stuck, then return with fresh eyes, since a new look often reveals a word you missed.
faq: How do I select a word in the grid?
Swipe across the letters in a straight line. You can swipe up, down, left, right or diagonally.
How do I find the secret hidden words?
Swiped words can give you hints toward the hidden ones. Collect 6 hidden words to earn bonus coins.

color-pixels-coloring-by-numbers.intro: Color Pixels is a coloring game where you fill black-and-white pictures with color by following the numbers. Pick a category, choose a picture, and work through the numbered areas at your own pace.
tips: Zoom in with the slider, pinch, or mouse wheel when you work on small areas, then zoom out to check how the whole picture looks.
Choose a color from the palette first, then color every area with that number before switching, which keeps your work organized.
Start with larger areas and leave tiny sections for later, when your eye is more focused.
Look at the number in each area before you pick a color so you do not have to undo mistakes.
Save your boosters for large or detailed pictures where coloring would otherwise take a long time.
faq: What is the goal of Color Pixels?
The goal is to turn a black-and-white picture into a colorful artwork by coloring each area that matches its number.
How do I choose a picture to color?
Select a category from the gallery, then pick the picture you want to start with.

perimeter-legate-edition.intro: Perimeter - Legate Edition is a strategy game where you lead the Exodus civilization across a battlefield that changes as you terraform it. Build defenses, take territory, and adapt as the land evolves.
tips: Look at the terrain before you build. Terraforming reshapes the battlefield, so check how the land is changing before you commit to a defensive line.
Build defensive perimeters that protect the territory you have already taken. Holding ground you control is easier than retaking it later.
Expand in steps rather than all at once. Secure one area, then move to the next so your people are not spread too thin.
Review your position regularly, since the environment keeps evolving. A line that worked earlier may leave gaps after the terrain shifts.
Think about survival first. Keep enough resources and defenses in place to hold your people through attacks before you push for more territory.
faq: What is the main goal of Perimeter - Legate Edition?
You lead the Exodus civilization to seize territories and survive in a changing world. The description frames victory as the end goal of this effort.
How does terraforming affect gameplay?
Terraforming reshapes the battlefield, so the layout you planned for can change over time. Paying attention to these changes helps you decide where to build and where to hold ground.

yummy-toast.intro: Yummy Toast is a fast-paced kitchen game where you craft toast with a variety of ingredients to fill customer orders. Speed and precision both matter as you unlock harder levels.
tips: Read each customer's order fully before you start adding ingredients, so you don't have to fix a mistake under time pressure.
Build accuracy first. Getting an order exactly right is more useful than rushing a wrong one out the door.
Once your accuracy feels steady, work on speed by setting up your common ingredients in a consistent order each time.
Pay attention to which ingredients you use most often and learn their positions so you can grab them without hesitating.
Expect the levels to get harder, so treat the early ones as practice for building a steady rhythm.
faq: What is the main goal of Yummy Toast?
Your goal is to craft toast with the right ingredients to satisfy customer orders, while unlocking more challenging levels as you go.
Do I need speed or precision more?
The game relies on both, so aim for accurate orders first and then work on serving them faster.

screw-match.intro: Screw Match is a color-matching puzzle about sorting screws. You move screws from a glass nut onto the matching-color box at the top, and a new box appears once the holes on a box are full.
tips: Look at the glass nut first and note which screw colors are on top, since only the top screw can be moved.
Before moving a screw, check the boxes at the top and make sure one has a free hole in the matching color.
Fill one box's holes before starting another so you don't leave several boxes partly filled with different colors.
If a box becomes full, a new one appears, so keep an eye on the top area after each move to see what changed.
Plan a few moves ahead when a color is buried under other screws, so you don't block the path to the screw you need.
faq: What is the goal of Screw Match?
The goal is to put each screw from the glass nut into a box at the top that has the same color. Matching all the screws keeps the puzzle moving.
What happens when the holes on a box are full?
A full box is replaced by a new box. This lets you keep sorting screws without the board getting stuck.

dune-surfer-3d.intro: Dune Surfer 3D is an arcade game where a stickman who turns into a ball in the air must draw, surf and slide out of colorful, dangerous dunes. Keep your line clear of hazards and don't sink into the sand.
tips: Plan your drawn line before it reaches the dune slope, since the line decides whether you stay on the surface or sink.
Keep your eyes on white obstacles first, because touching them ends the run instantly.
Test other colored obstacles with care early on, since you won't know their danger until you touch one.
Use dune speed bumps as a safety margin, but don't rely on them for long because their protection is limited.
Watch for rolling stones, darts, sharks and alligators ahead, and adjust your line well before you reach them.
faq: What is the goal of Dune Surfer 3D?
Draw, surf and slide your way out of the dunes while avoiding the hazards along the way. The game ends if you crash or sink into the dune.
How do the stickman and ball forms work?
You are a ball while you are in the air and a stickman while you are surfing. Both forms still need to avoid crashing into obstacles.

idle-craft-3d.intro: Idle Craft 3D is a clicker game about rebuilding your home. You recruit workers, summon elders to manage fatigue, and watch the 3D world change as your progress builds.
tips: Keep an eye on fatigue so your workers stay productive, and use elders to manage it before it builds up too far.
Balance your resources instead of spending everything on one thing, so you can keep improving your workforce and rebuilding.
Put your early effort into strengthening your workforce, since a stronger team helps the rest of your progress move faster.
Because progress continues while you are idle, it is worth leaving the game running and checking back to decide your next move.
Plan your upgrades in stages rather than all at once, and review your resource balance each time you return.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Craft 3D?
The goal is to rebuild your home by recruiting workers, summoning elders, and managing fatigue while your 3D world transforms around you.
Does my progress continue when I stop playing?
Yes. The game is built for continuous progress, so your rebuilding carries on even when you are idle.

cooking-city.intro: Cooking City is a fast restaurant game where you cook and serve guests in different kitchens, cafes and restaurants. Work quickly, keep dishes from burning, and unlock new venues as you go.
tips: Watch the clock on every order and decide which customer to serve first, since slow service is the main pressure in the game.
Keep an eye on your cooking stations so nothing sits on the heat too long. Pulling a dish at the right moment matters more than rushing it.
Learn the recipes early. Repeating the same meals helps you prepare them faster and keeps your kitchen moving during busy periods.
Spend your coins and diamonds on kitchen upgrades first, because faster equipment makes every later level easier to handle.
Try a new venue once you have a steady routine in your current one, so you can learn fresh dishes without falling behind on orders.
faq: What is the main goal of Cooking City?
You prepare dishes and serve guests as quickly as possible while keeping an eye on the clock. Each level asks you to manage time and cook well at the same time.
What are coins and diamonds used for?
Both currencies can be spent on upgrading your kitchen and buying enhancements. Diamonds can also be bought in the game, along with booster packs.

bus-parking-out.intro: Bus Parking Out is a logic puzzle where you move colored buses around a parking lot to clear a path for the selected bus. Each bus has its own size and direction, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Before moving anything, check which buses block the selected bus and what each of them needs to get out of the way.
Look at each bus's size and movement direction first. A long bus can block more space than it looks, so note which way it can slide.
Clear the path in small steps and recheck the lot after each move, since one move can open or close options for other buses.
Watch the passengers as you go. Collecting matching passengers is part of the goal, so plan routes that pick them up instead of only freeing the bus.
If you get stuck, step back and try a different order of moves rather than repeating the same ones. Efficient solutions usually use fewer moves.
faq: What is the goal of Bus Parking Out?
Clear the paths around the selected bus so it can leave the parking lot, and collect the matching passengers along the way in the most efficient way.
How do I control the buses?
Select a bus and move it in the direction it is allowed to travel, using the game's movement controls shown in the lot.

demolition-derby-life.intro: Demolition Derby Life is a single-player derby simulator where you smash opponents, upgrade your car, and try to outlast the competition in the arena. Winning depends on tactical destruction as much as raw impacts.
tips: Stay mobile and avoid getting boxed in, since a car that is stuck near other wrecks is easy to finish off.
Look for opponents that are already damaged and target them, because eliminating rivals is how you stay in the fight longest.
Treat each impact as a trade: a heavy hit can also wreck your own car, so pick collisions that cost the other driver more than they cost you.
Pay attention to how your car is holding up and plan upgrades around the weaknesses you notice, such as durability if you are taking too much damage.
Play a few rounds to learn how the arena and competition behave before you commit to a risky strategy.
faq: What is the main goal of Demolition Derby Life?
Your goal is to survive the arena by smashing your way to victory and outlasting the competition.
How should I spend upgrades on my car?
The game does not list specific upgrade types, so choose upgrades that help you survive longer and deal more damage based on how your car is performing.

golf-battle.intro: Golf Battle is a 3D mini golf game for casual players. You compete in a golf battle match, with the mouse as your only control, and the goal is to become King of the match.
tips: Take a moment to line up each shot before you commit, since the mouse is your only control and a rushed shot is hard to correct.
Watch how your ball moves after each hit so you learn how strong your shots need to be on the course.
Plan your route before you start, looking for the most direct line that avoids obstacles and wide detours.
Stay calm after a bad shot and focus on the next one, because a steady game usually beats a few risky swings.
Pay attention to your opponent's play and compare scores as you go, so you know whether you need to take more risks.
faq: What is the goal of Golf Battle?
The goal is to become King of the golf battle match by playing better than your opponent in this mini golf contest.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with the mouse, so use it to aim and make your shots.

fiva-26-soccer.intro: Fiva 26: Soccer is a fast arcade football game played in your browser. Pick a country, build your squad, and face rival teams in short matches. This guide covers controls and habits that help you win more.
tips: Hold the pass button only as long as you need to aim, then release, so the ball reaches the team-mate you picked rather than a spot you didn't intend.
Use sprint with Shift on desktop, or the on-screen sprint button on mobile, when you have space ahead, and ease off when you need precise control near the ball.
Pass to open team-mates before you shoot, since a clear chance is usually better than a rushed strike from a tight angle.
Spend coins on upgrades for the players you use most, so your squad improves in the areas that matter for your style of play.
Log in each day and check your daily quests, since they give you a set of goals to work toward every session.
faq: How do I move my player?
On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, use the left joystick on screen.
How do I pass the ball?
Hold the pass button to aim at a team-mate, then release to send the pass. On mobile, use the on-screen pass button in the same way.

robo-butcher.intro: Robo-Butcher is a 2D platform-arena battle game where you play as a humanoid robot. Fight through waves of robotic enemies, upgrade your arsenal, and test your endurance and skill.
tips: Watch how each enemy moves and attacks before committing, since the description stresses tactical agility over brute force.
Grab power-ups from crates when it is safe to do so, and think about how each one changes the way you handle the next wave.
Look for enemy weaknesses and aim your attacks at them rather than spreading damage across every target.
Keep your position in the arena flexible so you can dodge and reposition instead of getting pinned in one corner.
Spend your upgrades with the waves ahead in mind, so your arsenal fits the threats you are most likely to face.
faq: What is the goal of Robo-Butcher?
You fight relentless waves of robotic adversaries in 2D platform-arena battles, aiming to outmaneuver and defeat them to gain supremacy.
How do I get stronger during a fight?
You can upgrade your arsenal and seize power-ups from crates as you progress through the battles.

hexa-master-3d-sort-puzzle.intro: Hexa Master 3D is a color sorting puzzle built on hexagon tiles. You match and merge tiles to reach each stage's color arrangement, with a calm pace and soft sound effects.
tips: Look at the whole board before each move so you can see which colors are blocked or buried under other tiles.
Work on one color group at a time instead of moving tiles at random, which keeps the board from becoming cluttered.
Keep stacks tidy and organized, since a neat stack is easier to read and makes the next match clearer.
Save your helpful tools and power-ups for stages that feel stuck rather than using them on the first attempt.
Check in each day for the daily login rewards, and spend them on garden upgrades or board appearance when you are ready.
faq: What is the goal of each stage?
You need to match and merge the hexagon tiles to reach the precise color arrangement the stage asks for. Each new stage brings new difficulties.
How do I play the game?
Tap the tiles to shuffle, match, and organize them, then stack them into the correct arrangement. The game is built around tapping and matching.

cozy-jigsaw-puzzles.intro: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzles lets you assemble detailed pictures piece by piece at your own pace. Pick a difficulty that fits the time you have and enjoy a calm session.
tips: Start with a smaller puzzle to learn how pieces snap together before moving to larger boards.
Look for pieces that connect to each other and drag them together so they form groups that move as one.
Use the zoom button on large puzzles to work on one section at a time, which makes matching colors and shapes easier.
On harder difficulties, check each piece's orientation before placing it so you don't waste time rotating it afterward.
Save the hint button and magnet power-up for pieces you have checked several times, so you get the most value from them.
faq: How do I win a puzzle?
Complete the entire picture by placing every piece on the board. Finishing the puzzle earns coin rewards.
What happens when a piece is in the right place?
Pieces snap into place automatically when they are positioned correctly, so you can tell right away when a match is right.

spinning-oia-oia-cat-bricker.intro: Spinning Oia Oia Cat Bricker is a block game where you aim carefully and break bricks across levels that grow harder over time. Its bright visuals and lively sound make each round feel upbeat.
tips: Focus on your aim before each shot, since precise hits clear bricks faster than rushed ones.
Look for gaps and weak spots in the brick layout so you can break through in a way that opens up more targets.
Pay attention to how each level's pattern changes, because the escalating difficulty means the same approach may stop working later on.
Take short breaks between tough levels to keep your timing and focus sharp.
Play calmly rather than rushing, since steady, accurate play tends to go further than fast, careless attempts.
faq: What is the main goal of Spinning Oia Oia Cat Bricker?
The goal is to break bricks by aiming accurately and moving through each level as the challenge increases.
Does the game get harder as I progress?
Yes, the description says the levels escalate, so later stages are more demanding than the early ones.

core-rush.intro: CORE RUSH is a sliding puzzle set across 48 rooms. Your rover moves until it hits something, so each slide needs planning to collect every core and reach the exit.
tips: Before each slide, check where the rover will stop, since it keeps moving until it is blocked. Plan the full route rather than sliding one step at a time.
Look at the whole room first and collect the cores in an order that avoids getting stuck in a dead end.
Breaking crates and triggering chain reactions can open new paths, so consider what a crate might clear before you move past it.
Aim for efficient routes if you want three stars. Fewer moves usually means a cleaner solution.
Use UNDO (Z on desktop) to test a route without losing progress, and use HINT when you are stuck. Restart with R if a room becomes too tangled.
faq: How do I move the rover?
Use WASD or the arrow keys on desktop, drag with the mouse, or use the direction buttons. The rover slides until it is blocked by a wall or object.
What do I need to do to clear a room?
Collect every core in the room and then reach the exit. Some rooms also use crates, gates and portals to shape your route.

face-breaker.intro: Face Breaker is a ball and paddle game where you keep a square-faced ball in play to smash blocks across 45 levels. The ball speeds up with every bounce, and the clock keeps the pressure on.
tips: Watch where the ball is heading before it reaches the paddle, so you have time to move into position rather than reacting at the last moment.
Expect the ball to be faster in later bounces, so focus on steady, controlled movements instead of large, sudden ones.
Clear the blocks that are easiest to reach first, which keeps your route open and lets you respond to the ball more freely.
Pay attention to the clock and try to keep the ball moving, since a slow start leaves less time for later levels.
Take a short break between levels to reset your focus, because the timing needed grows as the levels get harder.
faq: What is the goal of Face Breaker?
Your goal is to keep the square-faced ball in play with your paddle and crush blocks through all 45 levels.
Why does the game get harder as I play?
The speed of the ball increases with each bounce, so you need faster reactions and better timing to keep it in play.

merge-wall-last-stand.intro: Merge Wall: Last Stand is a tower-defense puzzler where you summon fighters, merge matching heroes into stronger ones, and hold a wall against waves of monsters. Your army fights on its own while you plan merges and spells.
tips: Spend gold on summons early, but keep enough to summon again when a wave is about to hit, so your grid never sits half empty.
Merge as soon as you have two identical heroes; a higher-tier hero usually does far more damage than two low-tier ones.
Look at which monsters are coming before you pick a blessing, since some monsters pounce, dodge or heal and call for different answers.
Save meteor, freeze, wall repair and rage for the hardest moments, such as boss waves or when the wall is close to breaking.
Check your wall health after each wave; repairing early is safer than waiting until a single breach ends the mission.
faq: What is the main goal of each mission?
Survive all of the waves without letting monsters break through your wall. Surviving every wave wins the mission, and you can earn up to 3 stars.
How do I make a stronger hero?
Drag one fighter onto another fighter of the same level. The two merge into a single hero of a higher tier.

mini-switcher.intro: Mini Switcher is a retro-style arcade platformer where you flip gravity to guide a small blob to the goal across about 30 levels. It also includes a speed run mode for testing your skill.
tips: Plan your gravity switches a few steps ahead instead of reacting only when you are already falling toward a hazard.
Watch how each enemy and obstacle moves before you commit, since they behave differently and a pattern you learn early will help in later levels.
Use short, controlled switches rather than tapping rapidly, so you keep a clear view of where the blob will land.
If a level keeps defeating you, pause on the start area to study the route, then try again with a specific plan for the tricky section.
Once you are comfortable with the levels, try speed run mode and focus on consistent, clean routes rather than rushing into risky moves.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Switcher?
Your goal is to switch gravity to guide the small blob character safely to the goal in each level. The game has around 30 levels to work through.
How do I control the blob on desktop?
Press X or Space, or use the left mouse button, to switch gravity. On touch devices, tap the screen to switch gravity.

soccerlat-3d-football-online.intro: SoccerLat is a real-time 3D football match against other players, with fouls, set pieces and a referee who notices late tackles. These tips help you play cleaner and score more.
tips: Shooting and passing share one button: hold right click to charge and release to strike, so practise how long to charge for each distance.
To bend the ball, move sideways as you strike, and aim the camera higher when you want to loft a cross or chip the keeper.
Time your slide tackle (C) carefully: a late slide is a foul, and the referee will give it.
Press E to raise your hand and ask for the ball instead of chasing it, so teammates can find you in space.
If your lobby is short of players, turn on the bot goalkeepers so both goals are covered.
faq: Can I play SoccerLat with a gamepad or on my phone?
Yes. It supports mouse and keyboard, a gamepad, and touch controls with an on-screen joystick on mobile.
What happens if the match is a draw?
If the score is level at full time, the match goes to a penalty shootout.

jigmerge-puzzles.intro: Jigmerge Puzzles splits a photo into shuffled tiles and lets you rebuild it piece by piece. It is calm and satisfying, and a little method makes every level faster.
tips: Start with the tiles that have strong details, like edges of an animal, a car or a horizon line, and connect those first.
Once two fragments merge, move the whole group together instead of placing single tiles around it.
Look at colors and shapes across tile borders: a matching color line is usually the fastest clue.
Build one corner or one area at a time rather than scattering small groups across the board.
If you are stuck, swap two tiles that look out of place; correct pieces snap together on their own.
faq: Is Jigmerge Puzzles free to play?
Yes, you can play it free in your browser on desktop or mobile, with no download.
Does the game run out of pictures?
No. Levels cycle through themes like animals, nature, food, winter and cars, and new images are added over time.

5-nights-at-tung-tung-hotel-horror-3d.intro: In 5 Nights at Tung Tung Hotel you work the night shift in a creepy hotel and have to make it to morning five times. Careful resource use matters as much as quick reactions.
tips: Check the cameras regularly so you know where the threats are before they reach you.
Close doors only when you need to and watch your power: running out before morning is the fastest way to lose a night.
Pick up notes and items whenever you can; they explain the hotel's secrets and help you reach the endings.
Use the items you find instead of saving them forever, especially on the harder later nights.
Play with sound on, since noises are often your first warning that something is close.
faq: How many nights do I need to survive?
Five. Survive each night until morning to move on, and keep finding notes to unlock one of the endings.
Can I play on mobile?
Yes. On mobile you move with a joystick and look around by swiping; on desktop you use WASD and the mouse.

sunny-farm-match-3.intro: Sunny Farm is a cozy match-3 with 400 levels, from your home farm to the Sky Islands. Every level has its own goal, so reading it first is the key to three stars.
tips: Check the level goal at the top before your first swap: crops, hay, turf, baskets and fireflies all need different moves.
Make four in a row for a rake, a 2x2 square for a beehive and an L or T shape for a barrel; five in a row gives the magic watering can.
Swap two special pieces into each other to set both off at once for a much bigger clear.
To bring baskets down, match below them; to dig up turf, match right on top of it.
Finish with moves to spare: leftover moves turn into points and help you earn three stars.
faq: Is Sunny Farm free?
Yes. It is free to play with no sign-up, on phone, tablet and computer.
Is there a Halloween event?
Yes, the Pumpkin Festival lets you catch jack-o'-lanterns on the board and open festive chests.

drive-quest.intro: Drive Quest is an open-world driving adventure with cities, ports, highways and secret zones to explore. These tips help you get more out of the map and the challenges.
tips: Steer with WASD or the arrow keys and use Space as the handbrake to swing the car into tight drifts.
Press C to switch the camera when you need a better view for stunts or narrow roads.
Explore away from the main highways: the map hides secret areas worth finding.
Try the drifting, stunt and speed challenges to put each of the 35 cars to the test.
Customize your favourite vehicles so you can tell your cars apart and drive in your own style.
faq: How many cars are in Drive Quest?
There are 35 customizable vehicles.
Do I need to download Drive Quest?
No, it runs in your browser for free.

noob-in-mine-sandbox-and-craft.intro: Noob in Mine - Sandbox & Craft gives you a blocky 3D world with two very different ways to play: relaxed building in Creative mode or a fight to stay alive in Survival mode. These tips help you get more out of both.
tips: Start in Creative mode to learn the controls and block types with unlimited materials before taking on Survival.
In Survival, gather resources and craft your first tools during the day, because zombies and monsters come out at night.
Build a simple shelter early so you have a safe place to retreat to when darkness falls.
Explore caves, forests and villages to find new resources, but keep track of the way back to your base.
Use dynamite carefully: it clears space fast, but it can also destroy the structures you spent time building.
faq: What is the difference between Creative and Survival mode?
Creative mode gives you unlimited blocks to build anything you like. In Survival mode you gather resources, craft tools and defend yourself against zombies and monsters at night.
Is Noob in Mine suitable for kids?
Yes. The game uses friendly graphics and easy controls designed so younger players can build and explore.

mahjong-connect-classic.intro: Mahjong Connect Classic is a calm tile-matching puzzle with one key rule: two identical tiles can only be removed if a line with at most two 90-degree turns can join them. These tips help you clear the layouts as the difficulty climbs.
tips: Look at the outer edges first: tiles on the border are the easiest to connect because the line can run around the outside.
Before clicking, trace the path in your head and count the turns; more than two turns means the pair cannot be removed yet.
Remove pairs that open up blocked rows and columns, not just the first match you spot.
When three or four copies of the same tile are visible, think about which pairing frees up the most space.
Clear tiles from the crowded middle of the board gradually so you do not leave isolated pairs that can no longer connect.
faq: How do you connect tiles in Mahjong Connect Classic?
Click two identical tiles. They are removed if they can be joined by a line with up to two 90-degree turns that does not pass through other tiles.
Does the game get harder?
Yes. You solve several layouts, and the difficulty increases as you progress.

mask-of-six-moons.intro: Mask of Six Moons is a pixel-art action platformer where you dive through moon gates, fight monsters and hunt for better weapons. With 12 weapon types and random bonuses, a little planning goes a long way.
tips: Try several of the 12 weapon types, from greatswords and scythes to bows and chain whips, and keep the one whose moves suit your style.
Equip a second weapon (K or right click) so you can switch between close-range and ranged attacks during a fight.
Check weapon bonuses in the status screen (I): rare weapons can carry unique effects worth more than raw damage.
Spend level-up points on the five stats with your main weapon in mind, and unlock dash, double jump and wall jump to move more safely.
Save healing (Q) for boss fights like the Drowned Carillon in the Sunken Crypt or the Mother Bloom in the Fungal Caverns.
faq: What are the controls in Mask of Six Moons?
Move with A/D or the arrow keys, jump with Space or W, attack with J or left click, use the second weapon with K or right click, dash with L or Shift and heal with Q. A gamepad is also supported.
How many areas are there?
Two gates are open now: the Sunken Crypt and the Fungal Caverns. More gates are planned in future updates.

momo-horror-story.intro: Momo Horror Story is a 3D horror survival game: after contacting Momo by message, you are hunted by the monster and must hold out until the timer hits 00:00 and the police arrive. These tips help you survive the night.
tips: Turn on the generator early, since many other tasks are easier once you have power.
Use the flashlight (right mouse button) to search dark rooms for keys, but keep moving while you look.
Close the windows as soon as you can; finishing tasks quickly leaves you more time to avoid the monster.
Save running (Left Shift) for escapes instead of using it all the time.
In Gun mode, reload (R) when you are safe rather than in the middle of a chase, and keep grenades (G) for emergencies.
faq: How do you win Momo Horror Story?
Complete the tasks, such as turning on the generator, finding keys and closing windows, and survive until the timer reaches 00:00, when the police arrive and you can escape.
What game modes are there?
There are two modes: Classic and Gun mode.

pool-blast-merge-balls.intro: Pool Blast: Merge Balls mixes billiards with a merge puzzle: shoot the cue ball so that balls with the same number collide and combine into bigger ones. These tips help you set up chain reactions and keep your score climbing.
tips: Drag slowly to line up the aiming line before releasing; a precise shot is worth more than a powerful one.
Use cushion bounces to reach matching balls that are blocked by others.
Look for spots where one merge will push the new, bigger ball into another ball of the same tier to start a chain reaction.
Keep matching numbers close together instead of scattering them around the table.
Hold the Bomb and Magnet boosters for moments when you are about to run out of moves.
faq: How does merging work in Pool Blast?
When two balls with the same number or tier collide, they merge into the next bigger ball.
When does the game end?
You need to keep making successful merges; the game ends when you run out of moves.

age-evolution-run.intro: Age Evolution Run is a runner that sends your hero sprinting through the ages of humanity, from primitive beginnings to a futuristic finish. Use these tips to evolve faster and get further in each run.
tips: Grab as many points as you can along the track, since points are what level you up and unlock the next era.
Keep your eyes a little ahead of your runner so you can switch lanes early and avoid traps.
Smash through barriers only when you are confident your current form is strong enough; otherwise steer around them.
Pick up power-ups whenever they are on your path, they make the next stretch of obstacles and rivals much easier.
Spend your rewards on upgrades between runs to unlock new looks, weapons and abilities for your hero.
faq: How do I control the runner in Age Evolution Run?
Move with the WASD or arrow keys, or use the left mouse button.
How do I unlock new eras?
Collect points to level up; each new era unlocks new forms and abilities for your hero.

loot-hole.intro: Loot Hole is a cartoony first-person digging game: dig down through your front yard, haul treasure back up and sell it at your yard stall. These tips help you reach the 1000 m bottom quicker.
tips: Sell everything you carry at the yard stall before heading back down, so no trip is wasted.
Upgrade your backpack early; a bigger bag means fewer trips to the surface.
Swap to better shovels, pickaxes and drills as soon as the rock layers start to slow you down.
Push to the end of each layer, because every layer finishes with a hidden landmark and a guaranteed rare find.
Check the neighbour board for requests and keep items they ask for instead of selling them straight away.
faq: How deep can you dig in Loot Hole?
The goal is to dig all the way to the bottom, 1000 m down, through ever harder layers of rock.
What can I buy with my coins?
Coins buy better shovels, pickaxes and drills, bigger backpacks, jetpacks and explosives.

home-design-decorate-house.intro: Home Design: Decorate House combines match 3 puzzles with renovating a huge mansion, from the kitchen and library to the garden, pool and tennis court. These tips help you clear levels and unlock rooms faster.
tips: Look for matches near the bottom of the board first; falling tiles can set up free combos.
Make matches of four or five whenever possible to create stronger pieces that clear more of the board.
Read the level goal before you start and focus your moves on it instead of on random matches.
Finish one room at a time so you unlock new house areas sooner.
Take your time between moves; there is no rush, and a planned move saves the level more often than a quick one.
faq: What do you do in Home Design: Decorate House?
You solve match 3 puzzles to earn progress and use it to design and decorate rooms of a mansion.
Which areas can I decorate?
The game includes rooms such as the library and kitchen, plus outdoor areas like the garden, swimming pool, playground and tennis court.

slendrina-must-die-the-asylum.intro: Slendrina Must Die: The Asylum is a first-person horror shooter set in an abandoned asylum, where you must find 8 old medical books while Slendrina and her mother hunt you. These tips help you survive longer.
tips: Move carefully and crouch with Left CTRL in tight corridors so you can react before something reaches you.
Use Left Shift to run only when you need to escape or cross open areas, then slow down again to listen.
Reload with R whenever you have a quiet moment, so you are never caught with an empty weapon.
Switch weapons with the mouse wheel: keep the shotgun for close encounters and the MP5 or gun for range.
Pick up items with F as you explore and keep track of which rooms you have already searched for books.
faq: What is the goal in Slendrina Must Die: The Asylum?
You need to find 8 Old Medical Books hidden in the abandoned asylum.
What weapons are in the game?
There are three weapons: a gun, an MP5 and a shotgun, plus grenades on the G key.

pregnant-mom-simulator-family-life.intro: Pregnant Mom Simulator Family Life lets you play as a virtual mom handling pregnancy, baby care and daily household life in a 3D home. These tips help you complete missions smoothly.
tips: Try all three modes, Pregnancy, Baby Care and Life Without Him, since each one has its own set of tasks.
Read each mission's task list before you start so you know which chores to do first.
Group nearby chores together, like cooking and cleaning the kitchen, to finish levels faster.
Don't skip hospital checkups in Pregnancy Mode; they are part of the mission progress.
In Baby Care Mode, keep an eye on your newborn's needs between other tasks to keep the baby happy.
faq: How many modes does Pregnant Mom Simulator Family Life have?
Three: Pregnancy, Baby Care and Life Without Him.
What kind of tasks are in the game?
You cook meals, clean the house, shop for groceries, attend checkups and complete baby care activities.

insect-clicker.intro: Insect Clicker turns every tap into tarantula coins, and the real game is deciding which upgrade to buy next. These tips help your insect grow faster.
tips: Click steadily in the first minutes: early coins come almost only from your own taps.
Put your first coins into upgrades that raise the insect's output before spending anything on looks.
Compare upgrade prices with what they add and pick the one that pays itself back fastest.
Buy new skins once your income is stable, so they never slow down your progress.
On mobile, tap with two fingers in turn to keep a steady rhythm without tiring your hand.
faq: What are tarantula coins used for in Insect Clicker?
They are the game's currency. You spend them on upgrades that increase your insect's output and on new skins.
How do I earn coins faster?
Keep clicking and reinvest coins into output upgrades early; every upgrade makes each later click worth more.
