find-out-hidden-object.intro: Find Out Hidden Object is a scavenger hunt across lively scenes where you tap items from a list. A calm, systematic search finishes scenes much faster than random tapping.
tips: Read the whole item list first so your eyes know what shapes and colors to look for.
Zoom in and swipe through the map one section at a time instead of jumping around.
Look for objects hidden by matching colors or tucked behind furniture, plants and edges of the scene.
Keep hints for the last one or two items that you really cannot spot.
Finish scenes to unlock new maps; replaying a scene you know is a quick way to warm up.
faq: How do I unlock new maps in Find Out Hidden Object?
Collect all hidden objects in a scene to complete it, which unlocks new maps and mystery locations for free.
What do hints do?
A hint helps you locate one of the target objects when you are stuck on a scene.

animal-hospital.intro: Animal Hospital is a night-shift horror game where some patients are only pretending to be animals. Careful checks keep anomalies out while you treat the real cats, dogs and rabbits.
tips: Compare every photo with the paperwork: an extra eye, the wrong coat color or an odd shadow are warning signs.
Listen as well as look, because some anomalies give themselves away with a voice that is subtly wrong.
Press F to open the patient chart and G for the records log before you admit (E) or refuse (R) anyone.
Between patients, run the generator, check the cages and glance at the security cameras so nothing builds up.
In co-op (up to 4 players), split jobs: one player handles reception while others treat patients and watch cameras.
faq: Can I play Animal Hospital with friends?
Yes. You can play solo or in co-op with up to 4 players.
What are the PC controls?
WASD to move, mouse to look, E to interact or admit, R to refuse, F for the patient chart, G for the records log and Q for the flashlight.

the-specimen-zero.intro: The Specimen Zero drops you into a hostile facility full of creatures, with only your wits and whatever ammo you find. Moving smart matters more than shooting fast.
tips: Make finding door keys your main goal; every key opens the route to the next room.
Pick up every weapon and ammo you see, and reload with R when things are quiet, not mid-fight.
Avoid monsters when you can instead of fighting every one, especially when ammo is low.
Use F to interact with doors and items and Space to jump over obstacles while escaping.
Before running into a new room, look around from the doorway so creatures do not catch you by surprise.
faq: What is the goal in The Specimen Zero?
Escape the facility by finding the door keys and moving from room to room while avoiding or fighting the monsters.
What are the controls?
WASD to move, Space to jump, F to interact, R to reload and Esc for the menu.

cake-sort.intro: Cake Sort asks you to combine colorful slices into whole cakes on a 4x4 grid. A little planning keeps the board open and the desserts coming.
tips: Place a new plate next to plates that already share a flavor so slices can merge into a whole cake.
Keep at least a few empty cells free; a full 4x4 grid ends the run quickly.
Avoid scattering many flavors around the board, especially as more flavors are added.
Finish nearly complete cakes first to clear plates and make room.
Come back daily to collect the daily rewards.
faq: How big is the board in Cake Sort?
You build cakes on a 4x4 grid, so space management is a big part of the puzzle.
Can I play Cake Sort on my phone?
It is designed for PC and Mac and plays best with a mouse, but you can drag trays with touch as well.

jelly-sandbox-playground.intro: Jelly Sandbox Playground is an open 2D ragdoll sandbox with no missions: you place characters, weapons, objects and vehicles and watch the physics decide what happens.
tips: Start with one character and a single object to get a feel for how impacts and falls behave before building bigger scenes.
Launch items across the map from different heights to see how speed changes the collision.
Combine vehicles with ragdoll characters for the most dramatic physics reactions.
Switch between calm experiments and full chaotic battles; there is no objective, so try both.
On desktop use the mouse to drag and place objects; on phones and tablets use touch.
faq: Does Jelly Sandbox Playground have levels or missions?
No. It is a free-form sandbox with no required objective, so you create your own scenes and battles.
What can I place in the sandbox?
Characters, weapons, objects and vehicles, all with ragdoll physics and destruction.

bee-swarm.intro: Bee Swarm puts you in control of a honeybee in a 3D voxel meadow, collecting pollen from flowers and turning it into honey back at the hive.
tips: Fill up on pollen, then fly straight back to the hive so no trip is wasted.
Upgrade cargo capacity early so each flight brings back more pollen.
Boost flight speed next to shorten the trips between flowers and the hive.
Hire helper bees as soon as you can; they automate pollen collection while you explore.
On desktop fly with WASD or the arrow keys, or hold the left mouse button; on mobile use the virtual joystick.
faq: How do I make honey in Bee Swarm?
Collect pollen from blooming flowers and return it to your hive, where it is turned into honey.
What are helper bees for?
Helper bees collect pollen for you, so your swarm grows and works automatically.

emergency-dispatcher-911.intro: Emergency Dispatcher 911 casts you as the person on the other end of the emergency line, making fast decisions and sending help where it is needed.
tips: Read each situation carefully before dispatching; a wrong choice under pressure costs time.
Prioritize the most critical cases first when several calls are waiting.
Send aid quickly, since speed is a big part of saving lives in each scenario.
Spend rewards on upgrading your setup so you are ready for more complex cases.
Treat it as a strategy game: plan ahead instead of reacting to every call at once.
faq: What do you do in Emergency Dispatcher 911?
You handle lifelike emergency scenarios, make critical decisions and dispatch aid as quickly as possible.
Can I upgrade anything?
Yes, you can upgrade your setup to handle more complex cases.

trimino.intro: Trimino is a triangular domino game for one player against bots, where tiles score when matching numbers meet on shared edges and the first to 400 points wins.
tips: Always look for placements where equal numbers meet on every shared edge.
Aim for bonuses: opening plays, bridges and closed hexes all add to your score.
Play high-value tiles when you can, because you score the sum of the tile's numbers.
Avoid getting stuck: drawing from the boneyard costs 5 points and passing costs 10.
Try to empty your hand first for the extra bonus and to end the round on your terms.
faq: How do you win Trimino?
Reach 400 match points before the bots. A round ends when someone plays their last tile or the game is blocked.
Is there a tutorial?
Yes, the menu includes a tutorial, plus daily rewards, quests and a skin shop.

leaf-blower-autumn-yard.intro: Leaf Blower: Autumn Yard is a cozy 3D cleaning game: walk your leaf blower across yards full of autumn leaves, sell the bags for coins and upgrade your gear.
tips: Drag anywhere or use WASD / arrow keys to move; leaves close to you are sucked into the bag.
Head to the compost crate as soon as your bag is full so you never waste time.
Upgrade suction size and bag capacity first to clean much faster.
Buy robot helpers to keep cleaning on their own while you work elsewhere.
Check under leaf piles for hidden treasures, and try the spooky Halloween yards at night.
faq: How do I earn coins in Leaf Blower: Autumn Yard?
Empty your full leaf bag at the compost crate to sell the leaves for coins.
Are there Halloween levels?
Yes, you can clean spooky Halloween yards at night and collect hats like a pumpkin head and witch hat.

the-egg-stealing-master.intro: The Egg Stealing Master mixes 3D stealth with a pet-collecting loop: every egg you sneak out becomes a pet you can hatch, sell and turn into upgrades. These tips help you steal more and get caught less.
tips: Watch where the guards are looking before you grab an egg. A short wait is cheaper than losing the run.
Carry each egg straight back to your pen so it starts hatching; an egg in your hands earns nothing.
Spend your first coins on speed upgrades. Being faster makes every later trip safer and quicker.
Sell pets you do not need to fund upgrades, and keep the rare ones that are worth more.
On PC use WASD and press E near an egg; on mobile use the joystick and the action button.
faq: How do I steal an egg in The Egg Stealing Master?
Walk up to an egg and press E (or the action button on mobile), then bring it back to your pen to hatch it while avoiding the guards.
What are coins used for?
You earn coins by selling the pets you hatch and spend them on upgrades such as more speed and on trails.

idle-zoo-tycoon.intro: Idle Zoo Tycoon starts with a small park and grows into a big wildlife attraction. Your zoo keeps earning while you are away, so smart spending decides how fast it grows.
tips: Tap the zoo often at the start; early tapping income speeds up the first animal unlocks.
Unlock new animals whenever you can, because every species raises popularity and revenue.
Upgrade enclosures you already own before expanding too far, so your income keeps up with your costs.
Build exhibitions that attract more visitors, since visitors are what drive your earnings.
Come back after a break to collect what the zoo earned automatically and reinvest it straight away.
faq: Does Idle Zoo Tycoon earn money while I am away?
Yes. The game description says your zoo generates money automatically, even while you are away, so you can collect it when you return.
How do I make my zoo more popular?
Unlock new animals and build exhibitions. Each new animal increases your zoo's popularity and boosts your revenue.

animal-care-tycoon.intro: Animal Care Tycoon puts you in charge of an idle animal hospital that starts as one small treatment room. Heal pets, earn coins and grow it into the biggest veterinary center in the city.
tips: Treat patients quickly at the start; healed animals are your main source of coins for the first upgrades.
Upgrade equipment early so you can treat colds, viruses and fractures faster.
Hire vet doctors and staff as soon as you can afford them, so the hospital keeps running while you manage other rooms.
Unlock new rooms to take in more animals at once, which means more coins per minute.
On PC move with WASD or the arrow keys and click to interact; on mobile use the joystick and tap.
faq: What animals can I treat in Animal Care Tycoon?
Cats, dogs and sheep, and even exotic animals such as zebras. Each patient arrives with its own problem, like a cold, a virus or a fracture.
Can I hire helpers?
Yes. You can hire professional vet doctors and staff to keep your animal hospital running smoothly.

wild-animal-hospital-vet-doctor.intro: Wild Animal Hospital Vet Doctor lets you run a clinic for wild animals that need emergency care. Each patient comes in with colds, bruises or wounds, and it is your job to get them healthy again.
tips: Look at each animal carefully first to see what it needs before picking a tool.
Follow the steps one at a time; finishing a treatment in order is faster than jumping between tools.
Take your time with wounds and bruises, the game rewards careful work more than speed.
Treat every new patient as a new puzzle, since each wild animal can have a different problem.
Play with a mouse click on PC or a simple tap on phones and tablets.
faq: Is Wild Animal Hospital Vet Doctor good for kids?
It is a cute, simple doctor game controlled by clicking or tapping, which makes it easy for younger players.
What do I do in Wild Animal Hospital Vet Doctor?
You work as a doctor in a clinic that takes in sick and injured wild animals and treat them for colds, bruises and other wounds.

trick-your-brain-puzzle.intro: Trick Your Brain Puzzle is a point-and-click puzzle where you drag objects around a scene to solve tricky situations. Each level asks you to find the right sequence of actions before the timer runs out.
tips: Look over the whole scene before you move anything, and note which objects look like clues or obstacles.
Try to work out the order of actions first, since the game asks you to interact with objects in the correct order.
Remove obstacles that block other objects before you try to use those objects.
If a move ends in a funny failure, treat it as information and try a different object or order on your next attempt.
Keep an eye on the timer and move on from a stuck step to a different clue rather than repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Complete the objectives shown in the level before the timer ends. Finding the correct solution to the situation is how you win.
How do I interact with objects?
Tap, drag, and release objects onto the scene to use them. Every object you move can change what happens next.

knock-your-mind.intro: Knock Your Mind is a quirky puzzle game where each level hides a different brain teaser. You solve them by looking closely, testing ideas, and interacting with objects on screen.
tips: Read each puzzle fully before you act, since the wording and the scene often contain the clue you need.
Look for small details in the background and on objects, because hidden clues are a core part of the challenge.
If your first idea does not work, try a different kind of action instead of repeating the same click or drag.
Consider the simplest answer first, and then the stranger ones, since the solution can be either.
Keep notes of what you tried on a tricky level so you do not repeat the same failed attempts.
faq: What is the goal of Knock Your Mind?
Your goal is to solve the brain-teasing challenge in each level so you can move on to the next one. Each level has its own unique puzzle.
How do I interact with objects?
With a mouse, click and drag objects to interact with them. On a touchscreen, tap and drag objects instead.

petdoku-cozy-puzzle-games.intro: Petdoku mixes Minesweeper-style deduction with Sudoku-style number logic. Solve the grid to uncover the hidden map of your dog's favorite territory.
tips: Mark cells with an X when you are sure they do not hold a dog, so your board stays easy to read.
Use Drag to mark several cells at once when a whole row or section is clearly ruled out.
Check each placed dog against the cells around it before adding the next one, so a wrong guess does not spread through the puzzle.
Use Undo right after a mistake instead of working around it, since reversing one move is quicker than fixing several.
Save Hint for a cell you are stuck on, and try to reason out the rest yourself first.
faq: What is the difference between Tap and Double Tap?
A single tap marks a cell with an X. A double tap places a dog in that cell.
How do I mark many cells quickly?
Use Drag to mark multiple cells in one motion. Swipe moves across cells to mark them as you go.

tnt-sandbox.intro: TNT Sandbox is a block-based 3D sandbox where you blow up a randomly generated world with TNT. Explosions and building earn rewards, which you can spend on stronger TNT.
tips: Start by testing a few small explosions near open ground so you can see how far each blast reaches before using bigger charges.
Use the spreading fire mechanic on trees and other blocks to clear large areas with less TNT than placing charges one by one.
Spend rewards on more powerful TNT only after you have a feel for which blocks resist your current explosives.
Explore caves and bodies of water early, since the terrain changes what you can blow up and how fire spreads through the world.
Mix building and destruction: build a structure, then blow it up, to keep earning rewards from both activities.
faq: What is the main goal of TNT Sandbox?
Your main goal is to blow everything up with TNT. Explosions and building both earn rewards.
How do I move and jump?
On a computer, use WASD to move and Space to jump. On mobile, use the joystick to move, the button in the lower right corner to jump, and swipe the screen to rotate the camera.

peel-the-potato.intro: You start in a snowy bunker and must clear a mountain of potatoes to find the key to the vault. Peel, sell, and upgrade your way through to escape as fast as you can.
tips: Carry capacity limits how much you can haul at once, so get a bucket, sack, or cart early to cut down on trips to the table.
Hold the mouse button on the skin to peel, and keep your hands busy while you walk between piles so your time isn't wasted.
Use the number keys 1-4 to switch between tools as you go, and pick the one that matches the pile in front of you.
Check the upgrade book with TAB regularly so you can see which upgrades you can afford and spend your coins on the ones that speed up collection the most.
Keep an eye on your escape timer and compare each run with your fastest record, changing one thing at a time, such as your tools or route, to see what actually saves time.
faq: What is the goal of Peel the Potato?
Collect potatoes, peel them, sell them on the conveyor for coins, and use those coins to upgrade your tools. The aim is to find the hidden key and open the vault as fast as possible.
How do I peel a potato?
Hold the left mouse button on the potato's skin, or hold Space. Peeling is what turns a potato into something you can sell.

cod-duty-call-fps.intro: COD Duty Call FPS is a fast-paced first-person shooter set in a near-future conflict. You play an elite special forces operative moving through warzones and enemy facilities in a story-driven campaign.
tips: Keep moving with WASD and use Shift to run between cover, so you are not standing still when enemies spot you.
Use Space to jump when you need to clear a low obstacle or change your position quickly during a firefight.
Aim carefully before you fire, since the game rewards precision. Short bursts are usually more accurate than holding the trigger.
Scan each new area before you advance, especially urban streets and enemy facilities, to spot threats before they reach you.
Treat each mission as a step in the larger story. Paying attention to the objectives helps you understand what the campaign is asking you to do next.
faq: What is the main goal of COD Duty Call FPS?
You play as an elite special forces operative on a high-stakes mission to prevent a global catastrophe. You move through the campaign by completing missions across different regions.
How do I move and aim?
Use WASD to move, Shift to run, and Space to jump. Use the mouse to aim and shoot.

merge-a-mansion.intro: Merge a Mansion is a puzzle game where you combine basic materials to build bigger structures, growing from a small cabin toward a large estate. Your buildings earn cash over time, which you can spend to expand and improve your builds.
tips: Once you have a basic shack, let it run while you plan your next merge, since its passive income keeps adding up.
Spend your cash on better materials and extra space rather than saving it all, so you can start bigger merges sooner.
Upgrade buildings when you can, because a higher building level earns more money for the rest of your play.
Use the scroll wheel to zoom out and check your whole layout before committing to a merge, so you don't block useful space.
If you want the secret Ultimate Estate, plan to stay patient and keep building toward the Grand Estate first.
faq: What is the goal of Merge a Mansion?
Combine basic materials to build grander structures, climbing from a tiny cabin up to a sprawling Grand Estate. The secret Ultimate Estate is beyond that.
How do I merge objects?
Drag with the left mouse button to move objects and combine them. Use the scroll wheel to zoom in and out to see your layout more clearly.

hide-and-seek-horror-escape.intro: Hide And Seek: Horror Escape is a horror escape puzzle set in abandoned schools and haunted hospitals. You choose whether to play as the hider or the seeker, and you can search for hidden secrets and treasures along the way.
tips: Try both roles before settling on a favorite, since hiding and seeking likely call for different habits and different ways of reading a room.
Explore each area slowly and completely before moving on, because secrets and treasures are easy to miss on a quick pass.
Click or tap on objects that look out of place or unusual, as these are the most likely to hide something useful.
Keep track of where you have already searched so you do not waste time going back over the same spots.
Take a short break if you get stuck, then return and look at the scene again with fresh eyes.
faq: How do I control the game?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use the same input to choose your role, move through locations, and interact with objects.
Should I start as the hider or the seeker?
There is no required order. Starting with the role that feels more natural is a good idea, then switch to the other to see how the experience changes.

clutter-master.intro: Clutter Master is a relaxed puzzle where you tidy a messy room by placing each item where it belongs. Work through each room at your own pace, and a secret waits at the end.
tips: Scan the whole room before you start moving things so you can spot which items clearly belong together.
Pick up items you are sure about first, since placing them early leaves fewer objects to sort out at the end.
Before you click again to release an item, check that it sits in the right spot, because you move on only once everything is organized.
If you are stuck on one item, switch to another and come back later with fresh eyes.
Take your time and enjoy the calm pace, since there is no rush mentioned in the game.
faq: How do I move an object?
Click an object to grab it, drag it to the correct spot, then click again to release it.
What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to place every item in the room where it belongs. Once everything is organized, the game moves you to a new room.

age-of-apes.intro: Age of Apes is an arcade battle game set in a primitive jungle, where you play a monkey competing against other opponents. Progress comes from collecting bananas and using them to evolve your monkey.
tips: Keep collecting bananas whenever you can, since they are the resource that powers your upgrades.
Spend your bananas on upgrades early so your monkey can handle tougher opponents as the battle grows.
Watch where other opponents are moving and avoid getting cornered in one spot during fights.
Stay alert throughout the match, because the description calls the battles nervous and the fights can change quickly.
Use short, precise mouse clicks or taps rather than rushing, so each action you take counts.
faq: What is the main goal of Age of Apes?
The goal is to win the battle for supremacy in the jungle against other opponents. You do this by evolving your monkey and collecting resources along the way.
How do I control my monkey?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap to direct your monkey and take actions during the game.

hero-city.intro: Hero City is a shooting game where you defend a city from alien and demon invaders. Fast movement and accurate shots matter as the waves get harder.
tips: Move constantly rather than standing still, since the game rewards swift movement and staying out of trouble.
Take a moment at the start of each wave to see where the enemies are coming from before you commit to a position.
Focus on precision over spraying shots, because each wave tests your aim as well as your reflexes.
Pay attention to how each new wave differs from the last and adjust your approach early instead of reacting late.
Plan a route through the environment so you always have a clear line of fire and a way to escape.
faq: What is the goal of Hero City?
You defend the metropolis from alien and demon invaders by surviving and beating each escalating wave. The game is built around protecting the city.
How does difficulty change during play?
Each wave is more demanding than the one before, so the challenge grows as you progress. Staying sharp from the first wave makes the later ones easier to handle.

scoop-empire.intro: Scoop Empire is a 3D ice cream shop tycoon game. You grow your shop by serving customers, unlocking rooms and staff, and travelling through five worlds.
tips: Keep ice cream moving from the machine to the counter, since customers can only be served once it is there. Carry a steady supply rather than waiting at the register.
Spend your early cash on price tiles that unlock machines, tables, and staff, because those speed up everything else you do.
Clean dirty tables and use the bin promptly so your shop stays ready for new customers.
Walk into floating power-ups when you see them, since their boosts are timed and work best when used during busy periods.
Check the Trader by the door and the Supplier by the drive-thru whenever you pass by, as their special deals can save cash.
faq: How do I earn cash in Scoop Empire?
Pick up ice cream from a machine, drop it on the counter, then stand at the register to serve customers and collect your cash.
How do I unlock new areas and staff?
Stand on a price tile to unlock machines, tables, rooms and staff. Save up cash first so you can unlock the items that matter most to you.

draw-to-goal-soccer-game.intro: Draw To Goal is a soccer puzzle where you draw lines to guide the ball into the net instead of kicking it. Each level tests your logic, timing, and angle choices.
tips: Before you draw, look at the whole level, including obstacles, moving objects, and where the goal sits, so you can plan the route first.
Hold the left mouse button to draw, and try a simple line first to see how the ball reacts before adding more.
Think about angles: a line that bounces the ball off a surface can often reach a goal that a straight line cannot.
Pay attention to timing around moving objects, since the ball may need to pass through a gap at the right moment.
If a level feels stuck, try a completely different path rather than adjusting the same line over and over.
faq: How do I draw lines in Draw To Goal?
Use your mouse and hold the left mouse button to draw. Release the button to finish the line and let the ball move along your path.
What is the goal of each level?
Your aim is to guide the soccer ball into the goal to score and complete the level. Every level must be finished to move on.

match-4.intro: Match 4 is a 2048-style puzzle where you merge colorful hexagons and numbers on a changing grid. It rewards planning ahead and looking for chain reactions.
tips: Before each move, check how the grid will look afterward, not just which merge is available right now.
Look for moves that set up chain reactions, since one merge can open up several more.
Keep an eye on how the grid changes after every move so you can adapt your plan instead of following a fixed pattern.
Avoid rushing. Taking a moment to compare a few options usually leads to better long-term results than picking the first merge you see.
faq: What is the main goal of Match 4?
The goal is to merge colorful hexagons and numbers and aim for a high score while solving the puzzle continuously.
How can I get a higher score?
Plan ahead for chain reactions and adapt to the evolving grid, because well-timed merges can build on each other.

go-find-the-cake.intro: Go Find the Cake is a puzzle adventure where you help a caring sister collect cakes and deliver them to the children. Each level tests your logic, timing, and planning.
tips: Look at the whole level before you move so you can plan a route that reaches every child.
Pick up a cake with F only when you are ready to use it, since your route depends on what you are carrying.
Work out the order of deliveries first, then check that your path does not block your own way forward.
Watch the timing of moving obstacles and take a moment to think before each step rather than rushing.
If you get stuck, go back to the start of the puzzle in your head and test a different route, because many levels have more than one way to solve them.
faq: What is the goal of Go Find the Cake?
You help a caring sister collect delicious cakes and deliver them to the children. Each level asks you to plan a route so everyone gets a treat.
How do I move and pick things up?
Use W, A, or D, or the arrow keys, to move. Press F to pick up a cake.

sand-fall.intro: Sand Fall is a falling-block puzzle game where placed blocks turn into sand. Build connected same-color paths from the left side of the board to the right to clear it and keep the pile below the danger line.
tips: Before each drop, look at the sand already on the board and choose a spot that extends a matching color path rather than stacking blocks at random.
Keep the pile low. Once sand climbs near the danger line, you have little room to recover, so clear paths early.
Use fast drop only when you are sure of the landing position, since a rushed placement can block a path you need later.
Aim for the shortest connected route across the board. Fewer, cleaner bridges leave more space for future blocks.
In Level Mode, count the bridges you still need before each move so you know whether a careful placement or a quick clear matters more.
faq: What is the main goal of Sand Fall?
Create connected paths of the same color from the left side of the board to the right side to clear sand, earn points, and keep the pile below the danger line.
What ends a run?
The run ends if the sand pile reaches too high, above the danger line.

capy-cafe.intro: Capy Cafe is a cozy idle shop game where you run a café as a capybara barista. Grow a tiny tea stand into a busy boba café by harvesting, brewing, and serving customers.
tips: Stand beside a station and pause so your capybara can harvest, brew, or serve on its own. Stations only work while you are next to them.
Keep an eye on which stations need you to stand still while they work, and plan your route so you are not moving away too soon.
Spend your earnings on new drinks and stations as soon as you can afford them, since these expand what your café can make and serve.
Hire helper capybaras once you have the money, so the other corners of the café keep running while you work on expanding.
On mobile, push the joystick further to move at full speed when you need to get between stations quickly, and use a gentle drag when you only need small adjustments.
faq: What is the goal of Capy Cafe?
The goal is to grow your small tea stand into a bustling boba café by serving a steady stream of happy customers. You do this by harvesting ingredients, brewing drinks, and reinvesting your earnings.
Do I need to click buttons to play?
No. You move your capybara to a station, plant, brewer, fridge, or the cashier and pause beside it, and the work happens automatically.

fish-love-game.intro: Fish Love Game is a puzzle game about saving fish from bombs, lava, and a crab. You help the fish stay safe as you work through each puzzle, using only mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Before you act, scan the whole screen to find every danger, including bombs, lava, and the crab, so you know where the threats are.
Look at how the fish are placed relative to the hazards. Moving one piece can change the path to the others, so think about the order of your moves.
If a puzzle isn't working, stop and check what each danger does before trying again. Repeating the same move rarely helps.
Use short, deliberate taps or clicks rather than rushing. Mistakes in this kind of puzzle often come from acting too quickly.
Pay attention to the music and sound effects, which can signal when something has changed on screen.
faq: What is the goal of Fish Love Game?
Your goal is to save the fish from danger and get them to be together through each puzzle. The fish cannot live without each other, so keep them safe as a pair.
How do I control the game?
You play with your mouse or by tapping the screen. Click or tap where you want to act.

left-4-die.intro: Left 4 Die is a survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world, where you fight off zombies, complete missions, and upgrade your gear. This guide covers the controls, the shops, and how to stay alive as the hordes grow.
tips: Keep an eye on your ammo and reload with R during quiet moments, not in the middle of a fight with a crowd.
Use keys 1 to 4 to switch weapons quickly so you always have the right tool for close or distant enemies.
Visit the armor dealer before taking on a tough mission, since staying alive longer gives you more time to clear zombies.
Check the commander for new missions regularly, because completing them is one of the main ways to earn money and experience.
Spend your earnings carefully, buying weapons and armor that match the difficulty you are facing, since higher levels bring bigger zombie hordes.
faq: How do I earn money in Left 4 Die?
You earn money and experience by completing missions from the commander and by killing zombies.
How do I switch between weapons?
Press keys 1 to 4 to select a weapon. Use these keys to change quickly during a fight.

crowd-runner.intro: Crowd Runner is a one-finger running game where you steer a small group of jelly runners through gates and hazards to the finish. Your crowd size decides how high you climb and how many coins you earn.
tips: Read both gates before you commit. A x3 or +20 gate is usually worth steering toward, but compare it with the red gate beside it before choosing.
Keep your crowd as large as you can before the hazards start. Every hazard takes a bite, so a bigger crowd gives you more room for losses later in the run.
Watch the hazard pattern for a few seconds before you move. Saws, hammers and crushers have a rhythm, so you can slide through gaps instead of reacting late.
Spend coins on a bigger starting crowd first if you plan to play many runs. A higher starting number carries through every level.
On boss levels, count your runners against the boss before you reach him. If your numbers look too low, use a one-run boost before you set off next time.
faq: How do I win a level?

Reach the finish line with as many runners as you can, since the more runners you have, the higher you climb on the victory stairs. On boss levels, you win by bringing enough runners to beat the boss.
Can a single hazard end my run?
No. Each hazard only knocks out some of your runners, but if enough hazards hit your crowd, the run can end.

bomb-banana.intro: Bomb Banana is a 3D puzzle adventure with three monkeys who each have a different ability. Switch between them to search the house, read the manual, and defuse the bomb before time runs out.
tips: Start with the blind monkey to find the bomb, then switch to the others once you know where it is.
Open the manual early with M and check the instructions before touching the bomb, so you know what each step needs.
Use the 1, 2 and 3 keys (or the monkey portraits on touch controls) to switch characters quickly instead of walking back and forth.
Use Zoom with Z when a bomb control is small or hard to read, so you do not press the wrong part.
Pause with P when you need a moment to think, since time keeps running while you play.
faq: What is the goal of Bomb Banana?
Find the bomb in the house, follow the instructions, and solve every bomb puzzle before time runs out.
How do I switch between the monkeys?
On desktop press 1 for the blind monkey, 2 for the deaf monkey, or 3 for the mute monkey. On touch controls, tap the monkey portraits.

my-resale-cases-and-sales.intro: My Resale: Cases and Sales is a clicker tycoon where you open cases, sell the items you win, and haggle with different kinds of buyers. Build your balance, your income, and your collection of items.
tips: Use the Work section early on. Tapping the computer is your steady source of cash, and leveling up income makes every later step faster.
When an item drops from a case, decide between Keep and Sell based on how much money you need right now. Holding onto items you may want for your collection can pay off later.
Before you put an item up for sale, try a few prices on the slider. Start a little high so you have room to come down when buyers push back.
Read each buyer type before you reply. Impatient buyers may need a quicker answer, while chatty buyers can be handled with a friendly reply, so match your choice of ready-made line to the buyer.
Claim your daily gifts every time you log in. They add up over time, and they help you work toward the goal of a full collection of a hundred items.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to earn more money than other players and build a collection of a hundred items. Leaderboards show how you compare with collectors, tycoons, and top sellers.
How do I get items to sell?
Open cases using the open button. The roulette spins on its own, and then you choose to keep the item or sell it.

obby-run-star-speed-and-pets.intro: Obby: Run Star is a 3D runner where you click to build speed, dash across tracks, collect pets, and use Rebirth to climb the leaderboards. Your aim is to become the fastest runner.
tips: Click to build up speed early, since speed is the core of every run and affects how far you can fly.
Collect and assemble your pet team, because pets multiply your income and speed up your progress.
Use Rebirth when progress slows down. Your run restarts, but the permanent speed bonuses carry over to help you go further.
Use the camera controls to look ahead along the track so you can plan your jumps and keep moving.
Spend upgrades on your stats steadily rather than all at once, so you improve speed and unlock new worlds over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby: Run Star?
Your main goal is to become the fastest and most maxed-out runner by building speed, earning more, and climbing the leaderboards.
How does the Rebirth system work?
Rebirth restarts your run, but you keep permanent speed bonuses that help you climb the leaderboards faster.

extreme-balancer.intro: Extreme Balancer asks you to roll a ball across narrow wooden bridges and tracks without letting it fall. Each level ends at a finish point, and a fall restarts the level.
tips: Move slowly and steadily on the narrow sections, since small sudden movements are what usually send the ball off the edge.
When you reach a moving platform or spinning part, stop and watch its pattern for a moment before you commit to crossing.
Once you have read the timing, cross in one controlled run rather than stopping halfway on a moving part.
Take note of where you fell on each attempt, then slow down or adjust your timing at that exact spot on the next try.
Keep the ball centered on the path as you go, because leaning toward an edge leaves less room to correct.
faq: What is the goal of Extreme Balancer?
Your goal is to roll the Balancer Ball across each level's bridges and paths to the end. If the ball falls, the level restarts.
What happens if the ball falls off the track?
The level restarts from the beginning, so you will need to try the section again and improve your timing.

the-superhero-league.intro: The Superhero League is a puzzle adventure where you play as a hero working through missions, solving puzzles, and trying to save the world. You control your hero with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Read each mission's goal before you start clicking, so you know what the puzzle is asking you to achieve.
Try a few different clicks early on to see how the hero responds, then stick with the approach that makes progress.
When a level feels stuck, pause and look at the whole screen for clues you may have skipped rather than repeating the same move.
Since the levels are challenging, take short breaks between missions to keep your focus sharp.
Keep track of which strategies worked on earlier levels, as the same thinking can help you with harder puzzles later.
faq: What is the goal of The Superhero League?
Your goal is to complete missions, solve puzzles, and save the world by becoming the strongest hero in the League.
How do I control my hero?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so you can use either a mouse or your finger on a touchscreen.

super-wings.intro: Super Wings is an endless running game where you help Jett, the jet plane, deliver packages around the world. Use the mouse or click to keep Jett moving through each run.
tips: Keep your attention on the path ahead rather than on your current position, so you can react to what is coming next.
Practice your timing with short runs first, since small, steady inputs usually work better than rushed clicks.
Watch how each run starts, so you know what to expect before the first challenge appears.
Take short breaks between runs to stay focused, especially when you notice your reactions slowing down.
Try to keep a calm, steady rhythm, because staying relaxed makes it easier to respond to sudden changes.
faq: What is the goal of Super Wings?
The goal is to keep running as long as you can while helping Jett deliver packages around the world.
How do I control Jett?
The game is played with the mouse or by clicking, as stated in the instructions.

infinite-bike-trials.intro: Infinite Bike Trials is an action game where you ride a motorbike through 200 hard levels. Your goal is to complete each level, and you can buy new bikes or change your rider's color as you go.
tips: Use the WASD keys for all movement, and make small, short key presses so you don't overcorrect and lose balance.
Take each level slowly at first to learn its layout, then try to repeat the parts you handled well.
Since the levels are described as hard, don't rush. Restarting a level to practice a tricky section is a sensible way to improve.
Save up for a new bike if you find your current one struggling with the levels, since buying one is an option in the game.
Spread your play across sessions. With 200 levels, short focused rounds can help you stay sharp and avoid frustration.
faq: What is the main goal of Infinite Bike Trials?
Your mission is to complete each of the 200 levels. Each level is described as hard, so steady progress matters more than speed.
How do I control the bike?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to control your bike. The game's instructions list WASD as the only control scheme.

weight-balance-journey.intro: Weight Balance Journey is an arcade race where you steer along a track, pick foods to change your body weight, and aim to hit an exact target on the scales. Each level asks you to time your choices carefully.
tips: Keep an eye on your current weight and the target before each food pickup, so you know whether you need to gain or lose weight.
Choose fruits when you need to lose weight and fast food when you need to gain, rather than grabbing whatever is closest.
Plan your route ahead of the scales. Adjust your weight a little before the scale instead of making a large change right at it.
Watch for obstacles early and steer around them, since hitting one can disrupt your weight balance.
Use short, steady drags to move left and right. Small corrections are easier to control than large sudden moves.
faq: What is the main goal of Weight Balance Journey?
You race along the track and change your body weight so that it matches the exact target shown for the level, then hit the scale at the right moment.
How do I move my character?
Hold the mouse button down and drag left or right to move along the track.

block-bloom.intro: Block Bloom is a colour-matching puzzle where you send shooters into limited firing slots to clear blocks off a moving conveyor belt. Planning which shooter to use and when is the key to winning.
tips: Check which colours are on the conveyor before you tap a shooter, so every shooter you send in has matching blocks to hit.
Keep an eye on your free slots. A shooter whose colour is not on the belt will sit there and block a slot for nothing.
Watch the shot counters. A shooter that runs out of ammo disappears and frees its slot again.
Only shooters with nothing above them can be tapped, so look for the open ones and plan your moves around them.
Look ahead on the belt. If a colour you can reach is coming, it is often better to wait for it than to fill a slot too early.
faq: What is the goal of Block Bloom?
Clear every block on the conveyor belt to win the level.
What causes a game over?
If every slot is filled with shooters that have no matching blocks to shoot, the board jams and the game ends.

stack-up.intro: Stack Up is a relaxed single-player puzzle game. You connect stacks of the same color to build longer chains, aiming for stacks of 10 or more while the levels grow steadily harder.
tips: Plan your chains before you tap. Look for the longest run of one color on the board and link through it first.
Aim for stacks of 10 or more, since bigger stacks give more score and help you meet level goals.
Keep an eye on your remaining moves. Each level has limits, so make sure every tap moves you toward the objective.
Choose links that keep future options open, so a single bad connection does not block a long chain you could still make.
Take the early levels slowly to learn how stacks link, because later levels add more challenge.
faq: What is the goal of Stack Up?
Connect stacks of the same color to combine them into longer chains. Reaching stacks of length 10 or more is one of the main objectives.
How do I select and combine stacks?
Tap a stack to select it, then link it to other stacks of the same color. Each connection adds to the chain you are building.

monster-truck-racing-game-truck-race.intro: Monster Truck Racing Game Truck Race is a racing game where you drive 4x4 monster trucks over offroad tracks and try stunts. Steer with the keyboard arrows or WASD, and use the mouse for buttons.
tips: Use gentle, short key presses when steering so the truck stays balanced on rough ground instead of tipping over.
Before attempting a jump or stunt, check the landing area so you can come down with the wheels pointed forward.
Ease off the forward key on steep uphill sections to keep the truck from losing grip and sliding back.
Try a track a few times to learn where the bumps and dangerous spots are, then push your speed on the next run.
Keep an eye on the truck's angle after each jump; if it is tilting, correct it with left or right before you land.
faq: How do I drive the monster truck?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward and S or the Down Arrow to move back. A and D, or the Left and Right Arrows, steer the truck left and right.
Do I need the mouse to play?
The mouse is only needed to click buttons in the menus. All driving is controlled with the keyboard.

soccer-drop-game.intro: Soccer Drop is a physics-based puzzle game where you release a soccer ball at the right moment and guide it into the goal. Each level adds obstacles that test your timing and reactions.
tips: Watch the ball's path for a moment before you release it, so you can predict where it will bounce or roll.
Aim for a clean, simple drop first. Small changes in timing can send the ball far off course, so adjust in small steps.
When a level stalls, look at the obstacles and ask which one the ball must get past. Solving that single problem often unlocks the rest.
Stay calm and avoid rapid repeated clicks. A single well-timed click usually works better than several quick ones.
After a failed attempt, note exactly where the ball went wrong and change only that part of your timing on the next try.
faq: What is the main goal in Soccer Drop?
Drop the soccer ball at the right time and guide it into the goal to complete each level. The obstacles in each level make this harder than it looks.
How do I control the ball?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Your click decides when the ball is dropped, so timing is the key skill.

relic-runway.intro: Relic Runway is a 3D endless arcade runner. Run as far as you can, collect coins, and use arrow keys or swipes to dodge and steer through ancient adventures.
tips: Use the arrow keys or swipes early to get comfortable with steering, since every move keeps you running.
Grab coins whenever they are safely within reach, because they help you upgrade bonuses that can support your runs.
Spend coins on the upgrades that match how you play, so your bonuses help you go farther.
Collect relic parts consistently rather than chasing one reward, since they lead to discovering ancient artifacts.
Try to beat your own best distance before comparing with friends, and use each run to notice which obstacles you handle poorly.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use the arrow keys or swipe in the direction you want to go. Swiping works the same way as the arrows.
What should I spend my coins on?
Coins can be used to upgrade useful bonuses. Focus on the upgrades that help you survive longer, since that lets you run farther.

pro-football-eleven-2027.intro: Pro Football Eleven 2027 is a 3D eleven-a-side football game with assisted controls, offside, fouls, and set pieces. You can play a quick Exhibition match or enter the 8-club BREYMANTECH Cup.
tips: Hold J or K for longer to build more power on your passes and shots, since both controls use a power gauge.
Use Shift to sprint into open space, then pass or shoot before defenders can close you down.
Save the through ball (L) for moments when a teammate is running into a gap behind the defence, and use the cross (I) when you have wide players in the box.
Try the finesse shot (K then E) or the chip shot (Q then K) when the goalkeeper is well positioned and a power shot would be easy to save.
Use Q to switch players so you can control the defender closest to the ball, and keep an eye on the offside line when attacking.
faq: How do I score goals in Pro Football Eleven 2027?
Move with WASD or the arrow keys, then use K or Space to shoot. Hold the button for more power, and use the finesse or chip shot variations to change how the ball flies.
What happens if a cup match is tied?
In the BREYMANTECH Cup, draws go straight to penalties, so there is no extra time before the shootout.

twisted-rope-3d.intro: Twisted Rope 3D is a tangle puzzle where you untie knotted ropes by selecting and moving them. The challenge gets harder as you progress, so careful planning matters.
tips: Study the whole knot before you move anything, and trace where each rope starts and ends.
Avoid moves that create new knots, since the goal is to untangle without tying more.
Try small, deliberate moves and check the result after each one so you can spot mistakes early.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the rope arrangement from a different angle, since the 3D view can hide overlaps.
Keep your attention steady on each level, because the puzzles rely on critical thinking and precise rope placement.
faq: What is the goal of Twisted Rope 3D?
The goal is to untie the knots in each level by moving the ropes so they no longer tangle. Each level presents a new arrangement to solve.
How do I control the ropes?
You use simple touch controls to select a rope and move it. Pick the rope you want to adjust, then move it into a position that loosens the knot.

escape-ancient-egypt.intro: Escape Ancient Egypt is a 3D puzzle adventure set in ancient ruins. You solve puzzles in each room to unlock the next door and find your way out of the pharaoh's curse.
tips: Look at the whole room before clicking anything, since clues and objects are often spread across different walls and corners.
Pick up items and keep track of what you have, because a tool you find early may be the key to a door later on.
When a puzzle seems stuck, step back and check the room again for details you may have skipped, such as symbols or markings.
Solve one room completely before moving on so you know which doors are unlocked and what is still left to do.
Use the mouse to examine objects up close, as small details in the carvings or artifacts can contain the answer to a puzzle.
faq: What is the goal of Escape Ancient Egypt?
The goal is to solve the puzzles in each room, unlock the doors, and escape from the pharaoh's curse.
How do I interact with the game?
You use the mouse or touch to click on objects, open doors, and examine things in the rooms.

stack-colors.intro: Stack Colors! is an arcade game about collecting bricks. You slide your character to gather bricks, and the bricks stack up behind you as you go.
tips: Keep an eye on the color of the person in each scene, since you only want to pick up bricks that match it.
Slide smoothly rather than in quick jerks so you can line up with bricks of the right color before reaching them.
Plan your route a little ahead of time so you don't have to make sudden turns near mismatched bricks.
Pay attention to how tall your stack is getting, because a bigger stack can make it harder to steer past obstacles.
Try to carry as many bricks as you can without losing track of which ones are the wrong color, since that is what the game rewards.
faq: What is the goal of Stack Colors!?
Transport as many bricks as possible while avoiding bricks of a different color. Each new level shows a new scene with a person of a different color.
How do I move my character?
Slide your finger or pointer to move. Touching a brick is enough to add it to your stack.

traffic-jam-hop-on.intro: Traffic Jam Hop On is a puzzle game set in a colorful parking lot. Your job is to help different vehicles get out of traffic jams so they can drive away smoothly.
tips: Before you click anything, look at the whole lot and find which vehicles are blocking the exit or the path of others.
Clear the vehicles that sit closest to the way out first, since they often unlock the most moves for the rest.
Try to plan two or three moves ahead instead of reacting to each jam one step at a time.
Use the game's quick reflexes element by acting promptly when a clear path opens, so you do not lose momentum.
If you get stuck, step back and move a vehicle in a different direction to free up space rather than repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of Traffic Jam Hop On?
Your goal is to help all the vehicles in the parking lot get out of traffic jams and start moving smoothly.
How do I control the vehicles?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap on the vehicles to move them.

idle-vlogger-simulator.intro: Idle Vlogger Simulator is a clicker where you plan, film, and edit videos to grow your views, money, and subscribers. Keep releasing videos and reinvesting your earnings to build your channel.
tips: Check which themes are trending before you pick a topic, since the instructions say trending topics give better results.
Adjust the sliders for each video based on what its topic needs, balancing visuals against conversation and choosing a tone that suits your audience.
Spend your money on equipment upgrades to improve video quality, and use video coins to upgrade your team for better new videos.
Use the editing suite to arrange clips, add transitions, and apply text effects, since these boost a video's quality and viral potential.
Keep an eye on the 2X views bonus and AFK profit bonus, and aim for milestones like the Silver Button at 100,000 subscribers.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You aim to become a top YouTuber by creating videos on different topics, gaining subscribers and views, and earning money to improve your videos and room.
How do I upgrade my equipment and team?
Equipment is upgraded with money to improve video quality, and your team is upgraded with video coins to improve the quality of new videos. Upgrades are made from the right-side panel.

pathfinder.intro: PathFinder is a 2D puzzle game where you dig tunnels to guide colored balls into pipes beneath the surface. Across 30 levels, obstacles like metal blocks and thorns make each route a planning challenge.
tips: Before you dig anything, look at where each colored ball starts and which pipe it needs to reach, so you can plan the route first.
Treat metal blocks and thorns as fixed walls to work around, and dig your tunnels along paths that avoid them.
Dig in small, deliberate steps and pause to watch how the balls respond, rather than cutting a long path all at once.
If a level stalls, undo your thinking by considering a completely different route instead of making small tweaks to a failed one.
Later levels get more complex, so take time to plan on each new puzzle; careful thinking usually beats quick guesses.
faq: What is the goal of PathFinder?
Dig tunnels so that each colored ball reaches and fits into its matching pipe beneath the surface. You need to complete this in each of the 30 levels.
How do I control the digging?
Touch or click on the screen to dig your path. The controls are simple, so most of the challenge comes from planning where to dig.

bus-mania-parking-puzzle.intro: Bus Shift: Parking Jam is a colorful logic puzzle about moving buses out of a crowded parking area. Each tap matters, so plan the order of moves before you start clearing the jam.
tips: Before each tap, trace where a bus's arrow points and check whether anything is in its path. Buses that are already free to leave are good starting points.
Look for buses that are blocking several others and clear those first, since a single bus can hold up the whole lot.
Pay attention to passengers and bus colors. Matching each passenger to the correct colored bus is part of clearing the level, so keep track of which colors remain.
Avoid moves that trap a bus behind another one. If a move makes the puzzle harder to untangle, try a different order.
When a level gets tricky, stop and map the layout in your head before tapping. New layouts and obstacles in later levels reward patient planning over quick clicks.
faq: How do I move a bus?
On desktop, select a bus with the left mouse button. On mobile, tap the bus, and it moves in the direction shown by its arrow.
What is the goal of each level?
Clear the crowded parking area by moving buses in the correct order and matching passengers with the correct colored buses.

ice-scream-horror-adventure.intro: Ice Scream Horror Adventure is a 3D adventure in which you try to find out where the ice cream seller Rod takes your kidnapped friend Bob. You must hide from Rod and uncover the secrets of his ice cream van.
tips: Rod listens to every movement you make, so move carefully and pause when he may be nearby.
Use hiding spots and try to mislead Rod so he does not see you, rather than running in the open.
Explore each new scenario fully before moving on, since the van holds several secrets you need to discover.
Pay attention to small details about Bob and the other children, as they may point to where Rod is taking them.
Plan your route before you act, because every movement you make can give away your position.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to discover where Rod takes Bob and to uncover the secrets hidden inside his ice cream van.
How does Rod find you?
Rod listens to all your movements, so moving quietly and staying still when he is close gives you the best chance to stay hidden.

fps-shooting-game-multiplayer.intro: A pixel-style 3D shooter set in towns, farms and train stations full of zombies. Move with WASD, shoot with the mouse, and team up or fight other players in multiplayer.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since zombies and other players can approach from several directions.
Scan each new area before you enter it, especially the open spaces in towns and farms where enemies may gather.
Collect the lotions you come across early, because you will need them to last longer when enemies press in.
Use buildings, terminals and train station structures as cover when you are under fire, then step back out to shoot.
Treat other players as a mix of threats and possible allies, and watch how they move before deciding whether to fight them.
faq: What is the goal of FPS Shooting Game Multiplayer?
You try to survive through towns, farms, terminals and train terminals filled with zombies while staying alive against other players. The game focuses on endurance and fighting back.
How do I move and shoot?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move your character and use the mouse to shoot. Keep your movement active so you are harder to hit.

cut-cut-game.intro: Cut Cut Game is a one-player arcade game where you help the rabbit Dorote slice oranges for a village event. Some oranges hide explosive surprises, so you need to slice carefully.
tips: Slide your finger or mouse in a smooth line across each orange so the cut is clean and complete.
Before each slice, check the object's shape and position so you can tell oranges apart from the hidden bombs.
Keep your movements steady rather than rushed, since the game rewards careful cutting over fast swiping.
Watch the whole screen between cuts instead of focusing on one item, so you spot the next orange early.
If you make a mistake, take a short pause to reset your focus before continuing.
faq: How do I play Cut Cut Game?
Tap and slide your finger or use your mouse to cut the oranges. Avoid cutting the explosive items hidden among them.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to help Dorote cut the oranges carefully while avoiding the bombs left in the orchard.

tile-match-explorer.intro: Tile Match Explorer combines classic tile matching with new puzzle twists. Tap open tiles, match three of the same kind, and clear each board to move on to the next level.
tips: Before you tap, check which tiles already sit in the bottom bar and look for open tiles that match them, so you can complete a triple sooner.
Keep an eye on how full the bar is, because a level can fail if the bar is filled completely.
Avoid collecting too many different tile types at once, since a crowded bar leaves less room to make a match.
When you get stuck, use a booster or a shuffle rather than forcing more tiles into the bar.
Plan a few moves ahead by thinking about which tiles will be uncovered once the ones on top are removed.
faq: How do I clear a level?
Keep tapping open tiles and matching three of the same kind until the full board is cleared.
What happens if the bottom bar fills up?
The level may fail if you fill the tile bar completely, so plan your moves to keep space free.

kindergarten-kids-learning-games.intro: A learning game for toddlers and preschoolers that mixes letter tracing, counting, shapes and simple arcade activities. It is played with mouse touch controls.
tips: Start with the tracing or alphabet sections if your child is just learning letters, then move on to counting and shapes once those feel comfortable.
Keep sessions short and switch activities when attention drifts, since the game is built around the short concentration span of young children.
Encourage your child to say each letter, number or shape name aloud while tracing or choosing, so the lesson sticks along with the action.
Try the arcade-style activities such as the apple archery, basketball and dog hopping games as a reward after a learning section.
Revisit the charts for animals, fruits and colors together, pointing out items in the real world to connect what is on screen with everyday life.
faq: What is the main goal of this game?
The goal is to learn basics like letters, numbers, shapes, counting and words through short interactive activities and puzzles. Each section teaches a different skill.
How do I control the game?
Everything is controlled with the mouse using touch-style clicks and drags. Use the mouse to trace letters, select answers, and play the action activities.

draw-the-perfect-shape.intro: Draw the Perfect Shape! is an arcade precision game where you trace a circle, square, or triangle in one unbroken stroke. Your accuracy is scored from 0% to 100% once you let go.
tips: Plan the shape before you start. Picture where the corners or the starting point will be so your stroke has a clear path.
Start your stroke from a point you can return to easily, so the line closes cleanly where it began.
Move slowly and steadily. Quick, jerky movements tend to pull the line away from the intended shape.
For squares and triangles, aim for straight edges and sharp corners. Small wobbles along the sides can lower your score.
Use a relaxed hand position and keep your movements smooth, since the game rewards consistency more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Draw the Perfect Shape!?
Your goal is to draw the requested shape as accurately as possible in a single continuous stroke to reach a 100% score.
How do I draw the shape?
Click and drag with the mouse on PC, or touch and swipe with your finger on mobile. Keep drawing without lifting your finger or releasing the mouse button.

the-queen-s-jewels.intro: The Queen's Jewels is a casual physics-based puzzle game about matching jewels. Click jewels to line up matching pairs, and use the three helper items when a level gets tricky.
tips: Look at the whole board before clicking, so you can spot which matching jewels are easiest to reach first.
Watch how the jewels move and settle, since the physics can shift the board after each click.
Save your three helper items for levels that seem stuck rather than using them right away.
Each level introduces different mechanics, so pause for a moment at the start to see what is new before you play.
If a level stops making progress, step back and rethink which jewels are blocking the matches you need.
faq: What is the goal of The Queen's Jewels?
Your goal is to click jewels so that matching jewels line up and match with each other across each level.
How do I match the jewels?
Click the jewels and make the same jewels match. The game is built around matching identical jewels together.

gas-station-simulator.intro: Gas Station Simulator is a clicker tycoon where you fill up cars to earn cash, then reinvest in pumps, staff, and upgrades. Growth comes from keeping service moving and spending wisely.
tips: Keep serving cars steadily from the start, since cash from each fill-up is what pays for every upgrade.
Save up for new pumps before hiring staff, so you can handle more cars at the same time.
Look at which upgrades speed up service first, because faster service brings in money more quickly.
Check back between sessions to collect idle earnings and spend them on the next upgrade.
Try upgrades for luxury car perks once your station is busy, since they add to profit per car.
faq: How do I move around and control the game?
Use the WASD keys on a computer, or the mouse if you prefer. On a phone, use your finger to play.
How do I earn money?
You earn cash by filling up cars quickly. Each completed car adds to your total.

monster-match-mania.intro: Monster Match Mania is a Halloween-themed puzzle game where you match three monsters of the same color to clear them and move through increasingly challenging levels. Plan each drop to keep the board under control.
tips: Before each drop, look at the whole column and the monsters around it so you can see which colors can line up in threes.
Try to build matches of three in a row or stacked so you clear several monsters with one move.
Avoid stacking columns too high on one side; spreading drops across the board keeps you with more options.
If a column is nearly full, drop a monster where it helps you form a match rather than where it is simply empty.
Take a moment to plan the next drop when the board gets crowded, since rushing usually leaves mismatched colors blocking the way.
faq: How do I drop a monster?
Touch or tap a column to drop a monster into it. Choose the column carefully, since the monster will land on top of whatever is already there.
What do I need to do to clear monsters?
Line up three or more monsters of the same color so they are eliminated from the board. Clearing them lets you move on to the next challenge.

goods-sort-3d.intro: Goods Sort 3D is a sorting puzzle where you tap similar 3D items, such as snacks, beverages, and fruits, and group them on shelves. Clear sets of three identical items to finish each level.
tips: Scan the whole shelf before you tap anything. Spotting every set of three identical items first helps you plan a clear order.
Tidy one shelf section at a time instead of spreading moves across the board. Finishing areas one by one keeps the layout easy to read.
Watch for items that are hard to reach or partly hidden, and clear the ones on top first so you can see what is underneath.
Use your time calmly. Each level gives you ample time, so rushing usually causes mistakes, such as grouping the wrong items.
Since clean, organized shelves boost your score, aim for neat results rather than just clearing items fast. Replay levels if you want to improve your score.
faq: What is the goal of Goods Sort 3D?
Tap similar 3D items to sort them into groups, then match three identical items to clear them. Complete the level to move on.
How do I clear items?
Match three identical items to clear them. Each set of three that you remove helps you finish the shelves.

crazy-difficult-game.intro: Crazy Difficult Game is a reflex-based puzzle game with more than 50 levels. It gets harder as you go, so steady movement and patience matter as much as speed.
tips: Move slowly and deliberately, especially near the start of each level, before you try to go fast.
The description warns that the difficulty rises after level 10, so slow down and look at each layout carefully from that point on.
Use WASD or the arrow keys with small, controlled inputs rather than holding keys down, which makes it easier to stop in time.
If you use a controller, enable joystick control in the settings first so your movement matches what you are used to.
When a level keeps beating you, take a short break and come back with a fresh look at the route instead of repeating the same mistake.
faq: What is the goal of Crazy Difficult Game?
Your goal is to complete all of the more than 50 levels, testing your reflexes as the challenge increases.
Which keys control the game?
You can move with WASD or the arrow keys. You can also turn on joystick control from the settings menu.

pop-it-now.intro: Pop It Now is a relaxing puzzle game based on the Pop It fidget toy. Press the bubbles to pop them and unlock a colorful toy as you go.
tips: Work across the board in a steady pattern, such as row by row, so you can see which bubbles you have not popped yet.
Check the edges and corners before you finish, since a missed bubble in those spots is easy to overlook.
Take your time and click with a calm, even rhythm. There is no need to rush, and the game is meant to be relaxing.
Before you move on, scan the whole board once more to make sure nothing is left behind.
faq: What is the goal of Pop It Now?
Your goal is to press the popits to pop them all. Popping every bubble unlocks a colorful toy.
How do I play Pop It Now?
Use the left mouse button to click each popit. Each click pops a bubble.

color-sorting.intro: Color Sorting is a colour-only puzzle where a shuffled gradient must be restored tile by tile. Pinned tiles stay put, and your aim is to finish in as few swaps as possible.
tips: Begin with the pinned tiles and the corners, since they fix the gradient and show you which way the colours should run.
Work out where each tile belongs by comparing its colour with its neighbours, rather than swapping at random.
Use Undo to step back one swap when a move makes the board harder to read, instead of resetting the whole puzzle.
Try to finish the board in fewer swaps than par, since par is the exact minimum number of swaps for that board.
Use Hint when you are stuck, then study why that swap was optimal so you can spot similar moves on the next board.
faq: What is the goal of Color Sorting?
Put the shuffled gradient back in order until colour flows evenly across the whole board. Pinned tiles never move.
How do I swap two tiles?
Drag one tile onto another, or tap (click) a tile and then a second tile. Each trade counts as one swap.

tile-match-puzzle.intro: Tile Match Puzzle is a match-3 puzzle game where you tap tiles into a box and remove groups of three or more matching tiles. Clear the whole board to finish each level and move through the journey.
tips: Before you tap, scan the board for a tile style that has at least two other copies you can reach. Picking tiles at random can quickly send you back to the start.
Pay attention to which matches uncover new tiles underneath. Clearing those first opens up more options for later moves.
Test your memory by remembering where you have seen each tile style. This makes it easier to find the next match when the board gets crowded.
Plan your taps so you are always one step ahead. Since you only need three matching tiles, look for groups you can complete without adding extra tiles you will not use.
Since coins are awarded for beating each level as well as possible, take a moment to think through your moves on harder boards rather than rushing.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to remove every tile from the board. Match three or more of the same tile to clear them, and keep going until nothing is left.
What happens if I select too many tiles without a match?
If you select too many tiles without at least three matching each other, you have to start your journey from the beginning. Only tap a tile when you can see a clear path to a match.

steal-a-pet.intro: Steal Pet is a running and collecting game where you grab eggs from guardians, hatch them, and build income. Speed upgrades let you outrun tougher guardians across six levels.
tips: Spend early money on treadmill upgrades first, since speed decides whether you can escape each guardian.
Watch how fast the guardian is before you go for an egg, and only attempt a steal when your speed is clearly ahead of them.
Put your strongest hatched creatures in the pen first, because they earn money every second and fund the next upgrades.
Check your trails and equip the ones that add speed multipliers, since they stack with your treadmill progress.
Keep stealing and hatching steadily instead of waiting, because passive pen income builds up while you play.
faq: What is the main goal of Steal a Pet?
The goal is to become the richest and fastest player by stealing eggs, hatching them, and building a strong collection. You also push forward through six guardian levels.
How do I move and interact?
On PC, use WASD or the Arrow Keys to move and press E to interact. On mobile, use the on-screen touch controls to move and interact.

1942-pacific-front.intro: 1942 Pacific Front is a turn-based WWII strategy game set in the Pacific. You choose the US or Japan and command land, sea, and air forces across shifting terrain.
tips: Pick a side early and learn its strengths, since the US and Japan start the war in different positions and call for different plans.
Use land, sea, and air forces together rather than relying on one branch, so each unit type covers the weaknesses of the others.
Watch your resources closely each turn and avoid spending everything on one attack, so you can respond when the situation changes.
Study the terrain before moving, because the battlefield changes and the best position can shift from one turn to the next.
Think a move through from the opponent's side before you commit, since turn-based play rewards careful positioning over quick action.
faq: Which side should I choose, the US or Japan?
Both sides are playable, so pick the one whose forces and starting position suit your style of planning. Try each side to compare how the battles unfold.
How do I win a battle in 1942 Pacific Front?
The game is about outmaneuvering your opponent on a changing battlefield. Control key positions, manage your resources, and use your land, sea, and air forces to gain the upper hand.

jigsaw-solitaire-puzzle.intro: Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle asks you to slide colorful cards and lock matching patterns together to reveal a jigsaw picture. Plan each move so your connected groups grow instead of breaking apart.
tips: Before you drag a card, check which matching patterns it can touch, so each move locks cards into a group.
Build one large connected group instead of several small ones, since a bigger group is easier to move as one piece.
Avoid placements that sit between two groups in a way that could split them when you move a card later.
Move cards slowly at first to learn how the locking works, then speed up once you can predict the results.
In the Christmas countdown mode, pause to scan the board before each move, because the faster pace makes mistakes more likely.
faq: How do I move a card?
Press and drag a card to a new spot. You can place it anywhere on the board.
What happens when cards lock together?
When cards with matching patterns touch, they lock automatically. You can then move the whole connected group as one piece.

save-the-girl.intro: Save The Girl is a click-based puzzle where you help a girl escape danger by picking the right prop from several options. One wrong choice and the bad guys catch her.
tips: Look at the whole scene before you click, and note every danger the girl is facing.
Compare the available props against each danger instead of picking the first one that looks useful.
Ask what each prop would actually do in the situation, since a tool that helps with one threat may not help with another.
If you get caught, go back over the scene and check which prop you chose and why it did not solve the problem.
Take your time with each choice, because the game rewards careful thinking over quick clicking.
faq: What is the goal of Save The Girl?
Help the girl escape and survive the dangers she meets by choosing the correct prop or article each time.
How do I play Save The Girl?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select one of the props offered in each situation.

last-night.intro: LAST NIGHT! is a short story-driven horror adventure about a YouTuber chasing a Gold Play Button when strange things start happening to his PC. It is played with the keyboard and offers three different endings.
tips: Read every on-screen message and follow the in-game tutorial, since the game is linear and tells you what to do next.
Use WASD to move and E to interact, and try interacting with objects that look unusual, because they often drive the story forward.
Take your time in each area and look around before moving on, so you do not miss clues about what is happening to the PC.
Pay attention to the survey and any choices you are offered, as they can affect which of the three endings you reach.
Plan for a session of about 30 to 60 minutes, and consider playing again to see the other endings.
faq: What is the goal of LAST NIGHT!?
The story follows a YouTuber who is trying to earn a Gold Play Button while strange events happen on his PC. Your job is to uncover what is going on and see the story through to an ending.
How do I control the character?
Use the WASD keys to move and the E key to interact with things in the game. The in-game tutorial will show you how these work at the start.

jewel-gem-puzzle.intro: Jewel Gem Puzzle is a relaxed puzzle game where you sort colored jewels into matching groups and reveal pixel art as you go. It is built for calm, low-pressure play.
tips: Look at the whole shelf before you tap anything, so you can spot which colors are easiest to group first.
Keep your jewel shelf tidy by placing each jewel where it will be needed later instead of stacking mismatched colors together.
Think a step ahead when clearing a puzzle, since a small early choice can make the rest of the sorting much smoother.
Pay attention to how the pixel picture builds up as you place jewels, which can give hints about what colors you still need.
Take breaks between levels whenever you like, since there is no pressure and the game is meant to be a peaceful pause.
faq: How do I sort the jewels?
