Tap and arrange the sparkling jewels into their matching color groups. The controls are simple and there are no complicated steps.
What happens as I complete a level?
Each level reveals a new pixel art image as you sort and place the jewels. Finishing the picture completes the level.

mechanic-simulator-car-repair.intro: Mechanic Simulator: Car Repair puts you in a service station to fix cars, then lets you test them by driving, drifting, and crashing through the city. This guide covers the controls and some habits that make the work easier.
tips: Pick up parts with E and drop them with Q, so you can move an item around the workshop without losing track of it.
Use the left mouse click to deliver an item, and make sure it reaches the right spot before you let go.
Sit down with X when you want to take a seat in the car, and use WASD to move once you are in control.
Try the Space bar handbrake to practice drifting on open ground before you take a car into busier areas of the city.
Save Right shift nitro for moments when you are already driving in a straight line, so you can control the car's speed more easily.
faq: What is the main goal of Mechanic Simulator: Car Repair?
Your main job is to fix all the cars in the service station. After repairs, you can drive the cars around the city.
How do I pick up and move parts?
Press E to raise an item and Q to drop it. Use the left mouse click to deliver an item where it needs to go.

aura-clicker.intro: Aura Clicker is an idle clicker where you tap around your hero to build aura, then spend it on upgrades, pets, and rebirths to climb from Noob to GOAT. Progress keeps going while the game is open.
tips: Spend early aura on Click Power and Auto Click, since tapping by hand and passive earnings both feed your rank.
Hold a purchase button to buy several upgrade levels at once instead of clicking each one separately.
Remember that rank progress counts the aura earned in your current run, so upgrades will not push you back a rank.
Summon pets from the shop whenever you can, because every owned pet gives a permanent bonus even when it is not your active companion.
Save rebirth for when you reach the requirement shown on the rebirth button, since rebirth keeps your pets, heroes, and prestige while resetting aura, rank, and upgrades.
faq: What is the main goal of Aura Clicker?
The goal is to earn as much aura as possible while moving up through the ranks from Noob to GOAT. Your hero's appearance and aura evolve as you climb.
How do I earn aura?
Click or tap around your hero to earn aura, and Auto Click will keep generating it while the game is open. Treasure chests and daily rewards also give extra aura.

electron-dash.intro: Electron Dash is a magnetic maze game where you switch charge with a slider to attract and repel off walls and pillars. Collect every coin, reach the Finish Zone safely, and beat the timer.
tips: Before you move, check where all the coins are, since you need every one before the finish will complete the mission.
Switch charge in short bursts rather than holding one side, so you can steer around corners instead of being pulled into walls.
Use repulsion off walls to launch across open gaps, and plan the landing so you do not slam into a trap on the way.
Let go of the slider to return to neutral when you want to keep your momentum and coast through a clear stretch.
Keep an eye on the timer and take the safest route first, because a risky shortcut that gets you caught by a trap can cost more time than it saves.
faq: What is the main goal of Electron Dash?
You need to collect all the coins, reach the Finish Zone safely, and finish before the timer runs out.
How do I control my movement?
Use the slider at the bottom of the screen. Slide left for negative charge (blue), slide right for positive charge (red), and let go to return to neutral with momentum only.

help-me-tricky-story.intro: Help Me: Tricky Story is a brain puzzle game with 17 levels. Each scene asks you to complete an action based on a prompt, using everyday situations like pulling a tooth or eating fries.
tips: Read the prompt carefully before you click, since it tells you exactly what the scene wants you to do.
Try the most obvious action first, then look at the other objects on screen if it does not work.
Take your time between clicks or taps so you can see how each scene reacts before you move on.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the scene again with fresh eyes instead of repeating the same click.
Think about how the situation works in real life, because most solutions follow everyday logic.
faq: What is the goal of Help Me: Tricky Story?
Your goal is to complete the correct action for each prompt and move through all 17 levels.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to select objects and perform the actions shown in each scene.

hula-hoops-rush.intro: Hula Hoops Rush is a 3D arcade game where you slide to collect matching hula hoops while avoiding a lava pool. It is built to be quick to pick up and relaxing to play.
tips: Watch the color of the hoops ahead and line up with the ones that match the rule before you reach them.
Start with small slides so you can react quickly when the path or lava pool changes direction.
Look a few steps ahead instead of at your feet, so you have time to move away from the lava.
Keep a steady pace and avoid rushing into turns, since a single mistake near the lava ends your run.
Use short play sessions to build your rhythm, then try to beat your own number of collected hoops.
faq: How do I control my character?
Slide your finger or pointer across the screen to move and pick up hula hoops.
What should I collect?
Pick up only the hula hoops that match the right color, and try to gather as many as you can along the road.

try-again.intro: Try Again is a physics platformer where you roll a ball through 70 trick levels. Each death shows you a trap or timing lesson you can use on the next attempt.
tips: Watch the first few seconds of each level before moving. Traps often reveal themselves when you pause and look around the start area.
Treat every death as information. Note where the ball fell or what triggered the trap, then change your timing or route on the retry.
Do not rush jumps. Some traps wait for the perfect moment, so a short pause before jumping can be the difference between safe and falling.
Expect the floor to change. Some floors vanish, so keep moving toward the next solid ground rather than staying still on one spot.
Use pause with Esc or P to take a breather and plan your route before continuing, especially on boss levels.
faq: What is the goal of Try Again?
Roll your ball through each level and reach the portal at the end. The game has 70 levels split into zones, with a boss level every 10 levels.
How do I move and jump?
Use the arrow keys or A and D to roll, and Up, W or Space to jump. On touch screens, hold the left button to roll and tap the right button to jump.

smash-and-steal-an-egg.intro: Smash and Steal an Egg! is an arcade farming game where you crack eggs with a pickaxe, steal the animals that hatch, and outrun guards to fill your farm. Work through nine zones and collect all 72 animals.
tips: Upgrade your pickaxe before trying the toughest eggs, since stronger pickaxes are what let you crack them.
Spend time on the treadmill before pushing into a new zone, because you need to run fast enough to reach the next one.
Plan your route back to the base before you grab an animal, so you can get your loot home before the guard catches you.
Merge identical animals into new eggs whenever you can, and check the Index to see which animals you still need.
Keep an eye on the clock for the Titanic Egg, which appears every half hour, and be ready to go after it.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Break eggs, steal the animals that hatch, carry them back to your base, and place them in your pen to earn money and build your farm.
How do I keep a guard from catching me?
Run faster by training on the treadmill, and take a route that gets your loot back to base before the boss guard reaches you.

build-an-island.intro: Build an Island is a casual building game where you create an island with a house, a boat, and a seaport in the middle of the ocean. It is tagged as an educational adventure with construction and exploration.
tips: Decide on the layout before you start placing pieces, so the island, house, and seaport fit together without rebuilding.
Begin with the island base, since the house and platforms depend on it being in place first.
Try the large ships and platforms early to see how the construction mechanics work before you commit to a design.
Build the boat and seaport as a pair so you can see how they connect and whether the design makes sense in the ocean setting.
Take your time with each step, because the game focuses on learning how the pieces fit, not on speed.
faq: What is the main goal of Build an Island?
The goal is to build your own island with a house and a boat, creating a small oasis in the middle of the sea or ocean.
How do I control the game?
You interact with the game by tapping or clicking.

dice-merge.intro: Dice Merge is a timed puzzle where you roll dice, combine matching numbers, and race the clock. Your score depends on the dice you destroy and how much time is left.
tips: Each roll resets the 10-second timer, so roll when you need fresh dice, not while the timer is already running low on useful moves.
Look for pairs and sets that add up to 6, such as 1+5, 3+3, or 2+2+2, since 6 is the building block for the X die.
Two sixes merge into an X die, so try to build a pair of sixes early. Save the X die for high-value dice to earn more points.
Use the "?" button to review every merge combination when you are unsure what your current dice can make.
Your dice count is limited, so plan a few merges ahead before you roll again. Avoid filling the board with dice you cannot combine.
faq: What is the goal of Dice Merge?
Merge matching dice to build higher numbers and aim for the best score before the timer reaches zero. Each roll resets the timer.
How do I make a 6?
Merge dice that add up to 6, such as 1+5, 3+3, or 2+2+2. The "?" button lists every valid merge combination.

the-windows-game.intro: The Windows Game turns a Windows 10 style desktop into a set of mini-games, including shooting, painting, and multitasking challenges. It mixes nostalgia with short, replayable play.
tips: Explore the familiar system elements on the screen first, since the mini-games are built into the interface itself.
Try each type of challenge, such as the shooting simulations, painting, and multitasking tasks, to find the ones that suit your style.
Look for hidden gems, because some rewards or extras are tucked away rather than shown up front.
Pay attention to the sounds, as the game uses authentic soundscapes that can help you notice what is happening around the desktop.
Come back after a short break and switch between activities, which keeps the mix of mini-games fresh.
faq: Is there one main goal to reach in The Windows Game?
The description presents the game as a collection of mini-games rather than a single fixed objective. Playing through the different challenges and exploring the desktop is the main way to progress.
What kinds of activities can I expect to play?
The game includes shooting simulations, painting, multitasking challenges, and other mini-games spread across the Windows 10 style interface. Each one uses a different set of skills.

leaf-clean-up.intro: Leaf Clean Up is a relaxed collecting game where you gather fallen leaves by hand, sell them for cash, and upgrade your gear to clear bigger areas faster. Your progress comes from steady loops of collecting, selling, and spending.
tips: Start by collecting leaves with your bare hands until your bag fills, then head to the sell zone. Selling often keeps your cash flowing for early upgrades.
Prioritize upgrades that help your current routine most. Bag capacity means fewer trips to the sell zone, while suction radius and movement speed help you collect more with each pass.
Save cash for the glowing upgrade pads when you have enough to buy something useful, since each one improves a specific part of your cleanup.
Once you unlock the Leaf Blower or Lawnmower, switch tools to match the area. The Leaf Blower suits quick sweeping, and the Lawnmower mulches leaves instantly.
Use the number keys or scroll wheel on desktop, or the bottom tool carousel on mobile, to switch tools quickly without breaking your movement through the area.
faq: What is the main goal of Leaf Clean Up?
Your main goal is to collect fallen leaves, sell them at the sell zone for cash, and use that cash to upgrade your bag, suction, and speed as you move through the worlds.
How do I switch between tools?
On desktop, press keys 1, 2, or 3, or use the mouse scroll wheel. On mobile, tap or swipe the bottom tool carousel.

math-crosswords.intro: Math Crosswords replaces words with numbers. Fill the empty cells so every equation on the board is correct, using the numbers in the side panel. It works for quick mental math practice.
tips: When an equation turns red, check both of its numbers before moving on, since one wrong number can make two equations fail at once.
Look at the numbers left in the panel early and note which operations they seem to fit, so you do not run out of options near the end.
After each correct placement, check whether the cells next to it now have only one possible number, and fill those next.
Use the hint only after you have made a real attempt, because solving without hints gives the highest score.
Try the daily puzzle to build a streak, and practice on the simpler levels first so the bigger grids feel less daunting.
faq: How do I clear a level?
You clear a level once every equation on the board is correct. Each correct equation turns green.
How do I remove a number I placed by mistake?
Tap the filled cell and its number is sent back to the panel.

cats-go.intro: Cats Go! is an obstacle course platformer where you guide a cat across a challenging map to reach the fish. The cat can only move forward, so every jump matters.
tips: Since the cat only moves forward, look ahead at each section before you commit to a jump.
Press the on-screen jump button with steady timing rather than tapping rapidly, so you land where you intend.
Pay attention to the spacing between platforms and obstacles, and jump early when a gap looks wider than you expect.
Take each section one at a time, and focus on clearing the current obstacle before worrying about the rest of the map.
Stay calm after a missed jump, since the hardcore challenge rewards patience and careful timing more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Cats Go!?
Your goal is to play as the cat, pass through the map, and reach the fish at the end.
How do I make the cat jump?
On both mobile and PC, press the on-screen jump button to make the cat jump.

tap-tap-reloaded.intro: Tap Tap Reloaded is a fast rhythm game where you tap along to songs using your mouse. You can practice tricky parts, adjust how the notes look and move, and request songs for the community to vote on.
tips: Use the section skip feature to jump straight to a part of a song you keep missing, and practice just that section until it feels natural.
Lower the note speed while you learn a song, then raise it once you can keep up with the notes comfortably.
Change the note size and color so they stand out clearly against the highway and background, which makes it easier to read upcoming taps.
Try adjusting the lane angle and highway design to find a layout that feels comfortable for your mouse movements.
Focus on keeping a steady, consistent rhythm with each tap rather than rushing, since accuracy matters more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Tap Tap Reloaded?
The goal is to tap along with the notes in time with each song. Playing accurately is how you build your score.
How do I control the game?
The game is played with mouse control, so you tap or click in time with the notes as they reach the lanes.

bbq-sort.intro: BBQ Sort is a grill-side matching puzzle. Tap skewers to move them and build sets of three identical ones to finish orders before time runs out.
tips: Plan a few moves ahead before tapping, since each level has limited time and grill space.
Group matching skewers onto the same grill early so you can clear them in one go.
Keep some open grill space free so you have room to place skewers while you sort.
Watch the time on large orders and focus on completing those first when you can.
Save your boosters for tricky arrangements where you are stuck, since they are meant to clear obstacles.
faq: What is the goal of BBQ Sort?
Move and sort three identical BBQ skewers onto the same grill to complete an order and clear the grill for the next match.
How do I move the skewers?
Tap a skewer and then move it onto the grill where you want it to go.

magic-coloring-book-for-little-artists.intro: Magic Coloring Book for Little Artists is a calm drawing game where you build a picture step by step. A magical marker draws the outline while you hold the screen, then you color it in with bright, friendly colors.
tips: Hold steadily and let the marker finish each part of the outline, since it only draws while you keep pressing.
Watch the outline as it appears and get a sense of the shape before you start coloring.
Work slowly and carefully when coloring, staying inside the lines to build control and patience.
Pick colors on purpose rather than at random, and try to make the picture look balanced across the whole drawing.
Take short breaks between drawings if you start to feel rushed, since the game is designed to feel relaxing.
faq: How do I draw the outline?
Press and hold the mouse button or touch the screen, and the magical marker will draw the outline while you hold it.
What do I do after the outline is finished?
Use the bright, friendly colors to color in the drawing you have created.

bubbles-clicker.intro: Bubbles Clicker is a fast action game where you burst colorful bubbles before they escape. Quick reflexes and smart tapping help you build your score as the pace picks up.
tips: Watch the whole screen rather than fixating on one bubble, so you can spot the ones that are about to escape first.
Start slowly and focus on accuracy early, since the pace increases and missed bubbles become harder to recover from.
Keep an eye out for power-ups and try to collect them when they appear, because they are meant to boost your score.
Tap with a steady rhythm instead of frantic clicking, which helps you stay accurate when bubbles come fast.
Take a short mental break between rounds to reset your focus, since sharp reflexes matter more as the game speeds up.
faq: What is the main goal in Bubbles Clicker?
Your goal is to burst the vibrant bubbles before they escape. Each bubble you burst adds to your score.
How do power-ups help my score?
Power-ups are described as unexpected bonuses that boost your score. Grab them when you can, since they can give your total a meaningful lift.

army-run-3d.intro: Army Run 3D is an arcade runner where you steer a soldier down desert roads, firing at enemies and barrels as you go. Choose useful gates and spend your earnings on upgrades between battles to push further.
tips: Your soldier fires automatically, so focus on steering rather than timing shots. Keep your position lined up with targets ahead.
Look ahead at the gates before you reach them and steer toward the ones that look most useful, since picking the right gate is part of the challenge.
Use the space between enemies to reposition. Drag steadily instead of making sudden large moves, which can make it easy to miss targets.
Between battles, decide which upgrade matters most for how you are struggling. Improve health if you are taking too much damage, or damage and fire rate if battles are lasting too long.
Save some earnings for later battles rather than spending everything at once, because the enemies get tougher as you go further.
faq: How do I steer my soldier?
Drag left or right with your mouse or finger. Your soldier fires automatically while you move.
Do I need to press a button to shoot?
No. Your soldier fires automatically, so you only need to aim by steering toward enemies, barrels, and gates.

solitaire-picture-puzzles.intro: Solitaire Picture Puzzles asks you to swap cards around a board until matching pictures line up and reveal a photograph. You start with small 3x3 boards and work up to harder levels.
tips: Look for matches before you start moving. Scan the board to see which cards already sit next to a partner that fits.
Once cards are matched, keep them in mind. They stay grouped when you drag, so avoid moving a card out of a group unless you have a clear reason.
Make steady moves rather than random ones. The more moves you make, the better your chances of landing correct matches.
Use the 3x3 levels to learn how swapping works before moving on. Getting comfortable with the drag motion helps you as the boards get bigger.
Pay attention to the picture as it appears. Recognizing parts of the image can help you guess where a card belongs.
faq: How do I move a card?
Press on a card with your cursor or finger and drag it onto another card on the board. The two cards swap places and may match if they are valid neighbors.
What happens when cards match?
Matched cards stay grouped together, so they move as a unit when you drag. This makes it useful to build groups that fit the picture.

mini-asmr-relaxing-game-relax.intro: Mini ASMR Relaxing Game Relax is a collection of calm mini-games with soft sounds and smooth effects. You pick an activity from the menu and tap to pop, press, pour or spin.
tips: Try a few different mini-games from the menu to see which sensations you enjoy most, such as popping, squeezing or pouring.
Wear headphones if you have them, since the soft ASMR sounds are a big part of the experience.
Play at a slow pace and focus on one sound or movement at a time rather than rushing through the menu.
There are no timers, so take as long as you like and stop whenever you feel ready.
Use it as a short break from work or stress, and come back to the same activity when you need to settle your mind again.
faq: What do I do in this game?
Choose a mini-game from the menu, then tap the screen to pop, press, pour or spin. The game focuses on relaxing sensations rather than goals.
Is there a score or a winning condition?
The description does not mention scores, levels or winning. The game is designed to be played at your own pace with no timers or pressure.

kitty-grid-puzzle.intro: Kitty Grid Puzzle is a relaxing logic game where you give each cat a rectangular room that matches its number. Fill the whole grid so that no squares are left empty.
tips: Start by scanning the board for squares that can only belong to one room, such as a corner or a spot surrounded by other rooms, and plan those first.
Count the squares in each rectangle as you drag so you can confirm it matches the cat's number before you move on.
Remember that every rectangle must hold exactly one cat, so avoid placing a room that covers two cats.
Look for cats with larger numbers early, since their rooms take up more space and leave fewer options for the rest of the board.
Check the empty squares often; a leftover square that cannot join any nearby room means an earlier room needs to change.
faq: What is the main goal of Kitty Grid Puzzle?
Your goal is to draw one rectangular room for each cat so that every room has the exact number of squares shown and the whole grid is filled.
How do I create a room?
Touch and drag across the grid to form a rectangle. Rooms cannot overlap or extend outside the grid.

koenigsegg-jesko-absolut-puzzle.intro: This jigsaw puzzle features six images of the Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut. Each picture can be played in four modes, with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, so you can pick a challenge that suits you.
tips: Start with the 16-piece mode for each picture to learn how the car looks and where its main shapes sit.
Sort out the edge pieces first, since their flat sides make it easier to build the outline of the image.
Group pieces by colour, such as the dark body, the bright highlights, and the background, before you try to fit them together.
Move on to the 36, 64, and 100-piece modes once you can finish a picture comfortably, because the larger counts take more time and patience.
Use the mouse steadily and check each fit before moving on, so you do not have to undo many placements later.
faq: How many images are in this puzzle?
There are six images, and all of them show the Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut car.
What piece counts can I choose from?
Each picture has four modes: 16, 36, 64, and 100 pieces.

boom-cell.intro: Boom Cell is a top-down arena game in the .io style where you start as a single cell and grow into a larger cell brigade. You battle rival cell armies and try to become the dominant force in the arena.
tips: Grow your group steadily before picking fights, since larger cell groups can overpower smaller ones.
Keep an eye on nearby armies and avoid running into bigger groups head-on.
Pick fights with smaller groups when you have the numbers advantage to grow faster.
Move with WASD for precise steering, and use the left mouse button for your main actions.
Stay aware of your surroundings at all times, since a rival can close the distance quickly in an arena.
faq: What is the goal of Boom Cell?
The goal is to grow from a single cell into a powerful cell brigade and become the dominant cell force. You do this by battling other cell armies.
How do I control my cell?
Use the left mouse button or the WASD keys to play. The description does not list any other controls.

optical-illusion.intro: Optical Illusion is a short puzzle game built around eight perplexing optical illusions. It is meant to give your brain a workout while you explore how your eyes can be fooled.
tips: Look at each illusion for a few seconds before you interact with it, since many effects only become clear once you notice what your eyes are doing.
Try moving your focus between different parts of the screen instead of staring at one spot, which can help reveal how the illusion works.
Take a short break between illusions if your eyes start to feel tired, so you can judge each one with a fresh view.
If an illusion seems confusing, try a different approach or angle of attention rather than repeating the same action over and over.
Play in a comfortable position with the screen at a steady distance so you can see the details clearly.
faq: How many illusions are in the game?
The game includes eight optical illusions to explore.
How do I control the game?
You play with a mouse or by tapping the screen.

obby-steal-an-egg-the-great-escape.intro: Obby: Steal an Egg - The Great Escape is a race to build the best pet collection. You steal eggs from NPC creatures and other players, hatch them at your base, and use coins to get faster.
tips: Put your first coins into the treadmill, since speed helps with training, stealing, and escaping thieves.
Watch other players before you move in. A slow player carrying an egg is an easier target than a fast one.
Look for eggs that glow or look unusual, because these are the ones that give the most valuable pets.
Bring stolen eggs back to your base and activate the incubator quickly so the pet can start earning coins.
Keep upgrading your base to make your collection harder for other players to take from you.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Steal eggs from NPCs and other players, hatch them into pets, and use the coins they earn to upgrade your base and treadmill. Climbing the leaderboards is the long-term aim.
How does speed affect stealing and escaping?
The higher your speed, the more stealthy your theft is. Speed also lets you escape from slow bosses and from thieves who try to take your eggs.

sudoku-block-puzzle.intro: Sudoku Block Puzzle mixes a 9x9 sudoku-style grid with wood block placement. You drag shaped blocks onto the board and clear rows, columns and 3x3 squares to keep it open.
tips: Keep the board as empty as possible in the middle, since open space gives you more places to fit future blocks.
Before placing a block, check which rows, columns or 3x3 squares it could complete, and prefer moves that clear them.
Set aside large shapes early and fill gaps with small pieces, so you do not run out of room for awkward blocks.
Try to finish several lines or squares with one move, because multi-clear moves are where the combo bonus comes from.
Make several clears in a row to build a streak, and use the Daily Challenges as a short goal to aim for in each session.
faq: How do I clear blocks?
Fill an entire row, an entire column or a full 3x3 square with blocks. Completed areas are removed from the board.
What happens when the game ends?
The game ends when none of the remaining blocks can fit anywhere on the board. Plan ahead so you always have room for the next pieces.

code-breaker-deluxe.intro: Code Breaker Deluxe is a digital take on the classic Mastermind puzzle. Work out a hidden four-peg color sequence through logic and guesses before you run out of attempts.
tips: Use each guess to test colors you have not tried yet, so you learn which colors are in the code as well as where they sit.
Read the feedback pegs after every submission and write down what each one tells you before making the next guess.
Change one or two positions at a time when you are narrowing things down, so you can tell which change caused the feedback to shift.
Keep your attempts in mind, since the puzzle is timed and limited, and avoid spending several turns on a guess that gives you little new information.
Save the lightbulb hint for a stuck moment rather than using it at the start, so you still have room to reason through the puzzle yourself.
faq: How do I place a peg?
On desktop, click and drag a colored peg from the bottom row into a guess slot. On mobile, tap a peg in the bottom row and then tap a guess slot to place it.
How do I submit a guess?
Click or tap the green check button once all four slots are filled. The feedback pegs for that guess will appear afterward.

steal-an-egg-farm.intro: Steal an Egg: Farm is a chase game where you grab eggs from baskets, race a guard back to the safe zone, and raise animals on your own farm. Each hatched animal earns coins for your pasture.
tips: Look at the guard's position before you grab an egg, and only take one when you have a clear route back across the safe line.
Use the treadmill with empty hands to train your speed, since you need to be carrying nothing to train there.
Get hatched animals into your pasture quickly, because coins are earned automatically every second once they are placed.
Venture farther from the start to find rarer pets, and balance that risk against the chance of being caught.
Put your coins toward expanding your pasture, upgrading your treadmill, and growing feed, since each of these boosts your animals' earnings.
faq: What happens if the guard catches me?
The stolen egg returns to its basket, so you lose that run's progress but keep the game going. Stay alert and time your escape carefully.
How do I earn coins?
Bring a secured egg to the incubator, wait for it to hatch, then carry the animal to your pasture and place it inside. Coins are earned automatically from there.

merge-for-renovation.intro: Merge For Renovation is a puzzle game where you combine identical items to craft new essentials for your home. Earn stars as you go to upgrade and customize your dream house.
tips: Before each move, look for identical items that can merge, and pick the merge that opens up the most follow-up options.
Plan a few moves ahead rather than merging whatever is closest, since good planning is central to this game.
Save your stars for upgrades that help your current renovation goals instead of spending them as soon as you earn them.
Keep an eye on which new essentials you craft, because they can be the key to finishing the next renovation tasks.
If you get stuck, step back and check the whole board for pairs you may have overlooked before making a hasty merge.
faq: What is the main goal of Merge For Renovation?
The goal is to merge identical items to craft new essentials, complete renovation tasks, and transform your home over time.
How do I merge items?
Combine two identical items to create a new essential. The game's description does not list other merge rules, so test combinations to learn what works.

rescue-the-princess.intro: Rescue The Princess is a puzzle tower defense game where you push crates to build turrets and merge matching ones to make them stronger. Your aim is to knock back the Dragon and keep the Princess safe.
tips: Think about where each crate will end up before you push it, since turrets are built from crate positions and a bad push can block a good merge.
Look for pairs of matching turrets that can be joined, and merge them when it helps your defense rather than just because you can.
Place your strongest turrets where they can cover the path the Dragon takes toward the Princess.
Use knockback on the Dragon when it gets close, so you gain time to set up your next merge.
Check the battlefield after every move to spot gaps in your defense before the Dragon reaches them.
faq: What is the main goal of Rescue The Princess?
Protect the Princess from the evil Dragon by building and upgrading turrets, and knocking the Dragon back when it comes close.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to push crates and make your moves. There are no other controls to learn.

annoying-boss-game.intro: Annoying Boss Game is a cartoon office stress-relief fighter. Punch, kick, and smash your boss with mouse clicks and keyboard moves while the office gets wrecked around you.
tips: Click rapidly with the left mouse button to chain combo attacks, since the game is built around fast clicking.
Use the arrow keys to move around before you attack so you stay in range of your boss and the objects you want to throw.
Save the Spacebar powerful punch for moments when you have an opening, rather than spending it on every hit.
Drag the mouse to aim when you use special attacks like flying chappals, eggs, or water balloons, so your throws land where you want.
Try different special attacks in each round to see which reactions and office damage you enjoy most, and mix them with regular punches.
faq: What is the main goal of Annoying Boss Game?
The goal is to smash, slap, punch, and kick your annoying boss while creating chaotic office destruction. The game is meant to be a fun way to release stress.
How do I perform a combo attack?
Click the left mouse button rapidly. Fast repeated clicks trigger combo attacks.

color-dots-challenge.intro: Color Dots Challenge is a puzzle game where you tap colored dots and move each one into its matching slot. Precision and careful placement are the main skills it asks for.
tips: Before tapping anything, scan the board and note which dot matches which slot so you can plan your moves.
Start with dots whose path to their slot is clear, which keeps the board easier to read as the puzzle gets busier.
Watch for routes that would cross other dots, since the game asks you to avoid hitting them.
If a dot is about to be placed in the wrong spot, pause and check the path again rather than rushing the tap.
Short breaks work well with this game, so come back fresh if a level starts to feel frustrating.
faq: What is the goal of Color Dots Challenge?
The goal is to place each colored dot into its matching slot. You tap a dot to move it to the right place.
How do I move a dot?
Tap on the color dot you want to move, and it will travel to its place. Plan the move first so it lands in the correct slot.

penguin-splash.intro: Penguin Splash is a puzzle game where you match colorful penguins by connecting same-colored flippers. Clear each level by scoring well and using power-ups when you need them.
tips: Before you drag, scan the board for the same-colored flippers that form the largest connected group, since bigger matches help you score more.
Look for moves that set up explosive combos, because clearing one group can make new matches possible on the board.
Save your power-ups for levels that feel stuck rather than using them right away, so they are ready when the board gets tricky.
If a level seems hard, pause and look at the whole board before making a move, as a careful plan often beats quick, random connections.
faq: How do I play Penguin Splash?
Drag across same-colored penguin flippers to connect and match them. Each successful connection clears penguins from the board.
How do I score big?
Focus on larger matches and explosive combos, since connecting more penguins at once and chaining combos can raise your score.

roshambo.intro: Roshambo is a colorful take on Rock Paper Scissors, also known as a classic hand game. You play against a friend or the computer, and the first player to reach 3 points wins.
tips: Watch for patterns in your opponent's choices, such as always opening with the same move, and try to predict their next pick.
Avoid repeating the same move too often, because a predictable pattern makes it easier for your opponent to counter you.
Before the first round, check which key in the A S D and J K L sets matches each move so you can choose quickly under pressure.
Use short rounds to test your opponent's habits, then adjust your choices once you have a read on them.
If you are playing with touch controls, tap clearly on your chosen move so you do not accidentally pick the wrong one.
faq: What is the goal of Roshambo?
The goal is to be the first to reach 3 points by winning rounds of Rock Paper Scissors against a friend or the computer.
How do I control the game?
You can use touch controls or the A S D and J K L keys on a keyboard to make your moves.

underwater-survival-deep-dive.intro: Stranded on an alien ocean planet, you must explore the depths, gather resources, and avoid lurking monsters on your way to escape. This guide covers the controls and habits that help you stay alive underwater.
tips: Keep an eye on your oxygen while you explore, and head back toward the surface before it gets low.
Use the flashlight with F when you enter dark areas, since threats are hard to spot in the dark.
Save Shift for short bursts when you need to get away from a monster, because speed matters most in an escape.
Use the stun gun with Q when a monster gets close, then move away rather than waiting around to fight.
Rotate the camera with the left mouse button before you move into a new area so you can see what is around you.
faq: What is the main goal of Underwater Survival: Deep Dive?
Your goal is to escape the alien ocean planet by navigating its underwater labyrinth, gathering resources, and getting past the monsters. Each encounter requires you to strategize and adapt.
How do I move and dive?
Use W, A, S, and D to move, and press the spacebar to dive or surface. Hold Shift to accelerate.

safety-sheriff-labrador.intro: Safety Sheriff Labrador is an arcade game where you guide Sheriff Labrador through safety scenarios, such as crossing streets and bicycle safety, using drag-and-drop moves.
tips: Read each scene before you move anything, and look for what could be unsafe, such as traffic or a rider without protection.
Think about the safe choice first, then drag the item or character to that spot rather than trying the first option you see.
Take your time with each drag. Placing things carefully is the main skill this game is testing.
If a scenario does not go the way you expected, try it again and compare what changed. Repeating scenes helps the safety tips stick.
Pay attention to the reasons behind each safe choice, since the game is built to help you make smart decisions in everyday situations.
faq: How do I control Sheriff Labrador?
You use drag-and-drop mechanics to move items and guide Sheriff Labrador through each scenario.
What kinds of situations will I face in the game?
The scenarios include crossing streets and bicycle safety, along with other imaginative everyday safety situations.

brain-puzzle-tricky-choices.intro: Brain Puzzle: Tricky Choices is a puzzle game where you solve brain teasers and pick the right choices to move through the storyline and pass each level. Everything is played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Read each puzzle and the choices carefully before you click, since the wrong pick can send the story in a different direction.
Think about what the storyline is asking for at each step, then choose the option that fits that goal rather than the first one that looks appealing.
If a choice seems too simple, consider whether it hides a trick, because the description warns that the game is harder than it looks.
Use your imagination and try a few different ideas on a tough level, noting which choices lead you forward and which do not.
Stay patient and take a short break when you get stuck, so you can return with fresh thinking about the puzzle.
faq: What is the main goal of Brain Puzzle: Tricky Choices?
The goal is to solve each tricky brain puzzle, find the right storyline, and pass the level by making the right choices.
How do I play the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, selecting the choices and answers you want on each screen.

brick-slide.intro: Brick Slide is a block puzzle where you slide colored bricks sideways to fill gaps and clear full horizontal rows. Plan moves carefully so the stack never reaches the top.
tips: Before each move, look for rows that are almost full and find the brick that completes them.
Remember that bricks fall automatically when empty space is beneath them, so a slide can open up gaps you did not expect.
Try to set up a move that clears several rows at once, since multiple rows in a single move earn combo bonus points.
Keep the board as low as you can, because a new row rises from the bottom after every move that does not clear a line.
Avoid stacking tall columns on one side, since the game ends as soon as the brick stack reaches the top row.
faq: What is the goal of Brick Slide?
Fill empty gaps with sliding bricks to complete solid horizontal rows, which clear and award points. The game ends if the stack reaches the top row.
How do I move the bricks?
Swipe or click and drag any brick left or right. Bricks fall on their own when there is empty space beneath them.

dice-puzzle.intro: Dice Puzzle is a merging puzzle where you place numbered cubes on a grid. Line up three or more matching dice to combine them into a higher-value die and clear space for what comes next.
tips: Before placing a die, look at the grid and find where it can join a matching face, since merges happen when three or more matching dice touch.
When you get a pair, tap it to rotate it before dropping it, so both halves fit into open spots next to matching dice.
Use your storage tray to hold dice that do not fit yet, rather than forcing them onto the grid where they could block other merges.
Avoid building up many single dice of different faces in the same area, because scattered values make it harder to set up a three-die merge.
Plan one or two moves ahead by checking which faces are already on the board and where a new matching die would complete a group.
faq: How do I win or make progress in Dice Puzzle?
You progress by merging dice into higher-valued cubes while keeping the grid open enough to place new ones. Good merges free up space and keep your options open.
How do I place a die or a pair?
Select a die or pair from your tray and drag it onto the grid where it fits. Tap the dice in the tray to rotate them first if you need a different orientation.

block-craft-3d-school.intro: Block Craft 3D School is a pixel-style building game where you construct and defend a school out of blocks of different shapes. Enemies can appear anywhere, so you need to build and stay alert at the same time.
tips: Collect blocks as you go so you always have materials ready when you need to build or repair.
Start by placing blocks that form walls or barriers, since protecting the school is as important as building it.
Keep an eye on every side of your build, because enemies can come from anywhere rather than one direction.
Mix different block shapes to create covered spots and corners that make the school easier to defend.
Pause your building now and then to scan the area so enemies do not catch you off guard.
faq: What is the main goal of Block Craft 3D School?
You build and protect your school using blocks of various shapes while staying safe from enemies that hide around the world.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Click to collect and place blocks and to interact with the world.

bubble-gum.intro: Bubble Gum is an arcade game about inflating a balloon and climbing as high as you can. Tap to control its size, avoid the spikes, and earn coins as your balloon grows.
tips: Tap in short bursts rather than holding for long stretches, so you can adjust the balloon's size before it gets too big to steer safely.
Keep an eye on the spikes at all times and plan your route around them early instead of reacting at the last moment.
Remember that a bigger balloon earns more coins, so grow it when you have room to do so safely, but don't push it so far that a single spike ends your run.
When you reach a lock, check the number on it first, then inflate your balloons with that number in mind so you can open it.
Since lightness is part of the game's appeal, avoid overinflating in tight spaces where you have little room to dodge.
faq: What is the main goal of Bubble Gum?
Your goal is to climb as high as you can by inflating your balloon and dodging obstacles. The game asks how big you can grow your balloon.
How do I control my balloon?
Tap the screen to inflate the balloon and control its size. Tapping is the only control mentioned in the instructions.

subway-clash-3d.intro: Subway Clash 3D is a shooter set in an underground Moscow metro, where you fight off KGB soldiers and climb the rank table. Learn the controls early so you can move, crouch, and jump under pressure.
tips: Use jumping and crouching to change your height and dodge incoming fire, rather than standing still in one spot.
Keep moving with WASD so enemies have a harder time lining up a clean shot on you.
Grab weapons as you find them and switch to whichever one suits the fight in front of you.
Pay attention to where enemies come from in the tunnels and deal with the nearest threats first to avoid being surrounded.
Use the rank table as a gauge of your progress and aim to stay alive while you rack up points.
faq: What is the goal of Subway Clash 3D?
You fight through an underground Moscow metro area against angry KGB soldiers and try to climb to the top of the rank table. Picking up weapons helps you defend yourself along the way.
Which keys do I use to move and jump?
Use W, A, S, and D to move, Space to jump, and C to crouch.

survival-race.intro: Survival Race is a car battle on a hexagonal arena where tiles collapse under you as you drive. Stay on the platform, knock rivals off, and collect coins to unlock better cars.
tips: Keep moving. Tiles collapse behind and under you, so standing still on one spot for long is the fastest way to lose your footing.
Plan turns a little early. Sharp turns are needed to stay on solid tiles, and a late turn can send you toward a gap.
Use jumps when you can see a safe landing tile. A well-timed jump helps you cross gaps, but a badly timed one can drop you off the arena.
Look for chances to knock rivals toward water, lava, or acid. Eliminating an opponent earns a golden crown, so each push is worth taking when it is safe.
Pull off stunts and collect coins when the path is clear. These help you complete challenges and unlock new cars, and rank increases will bring tougher opponents.
faq: What is the main goal of Survival Race?
Your goal is to stay in the arena longer than your rivals by avoiding gaps, outmaneuvering opponents, and being the last car on the platform. Eliminating rivals also earns golden crowns.
How do I eliminate opponents?
Knock them off the platform with your car so they fall into hazards like water, lava, or acid. Each eliminated rival rewards you with a golden crown.

don-t-whack-your-boss.intro: Don't Whack Your Boss is a comedy office revenge game with exaggerated, over-the-top ways to vent frustration at a fictional boss. The game has no written instructions, so exploring is the best way to learn it.
tips: Spend the first few minutes trying different actions to see which ones the game responds to.
Try each option at least once, since the game is built around a variety of creative approaches.
Watch how the boss and the office react after each action, and repeat the ones that get the biggest response.
Play in short sessions so you can notice patterns and come back with fresh ideas.
Keep in mind that the game is meant to be silly, so focus on enjoying the exaggerated humor rather than chasing a particular result.
faq: What is the goal of Don't Whack Your Boss?
The game is described as an office revenge simulator where you explore creative, outrageous ways to express your frustration with a fictional boss. It does not list a specific win condition.
How do I control the game?
No controls are listed in the instructions, so try clicking and pressing keys to see what happens. Testing different inputs is the quickest way to learn them.

rally-race-pro-3-0-car-racing.intro: Rally Race Pro 3.0 is an offline rally racing game with realistic physics, rugged hill roads, and changing weather. You drive with the keyboard, drift through sharp turns, and work to improve your lap times.
tips: Brake before a sharp turn rather than in the middle of it, so the car keeps its grip and you can steer through the corner cleanly.
Use the Spacebar handbrake for drifting only where the road allows it, since a long drift can slow you down on a tight course.
Ease off the accelerator with W or Up Arrow when the car starts to slide, then steer gently back toward your line.
Pay attention to the weather, because rain or other conditions can change how much grip your tires have on rough terrain.
Use your lap times to find the sections where you lose the most time, then focus your practice on those corners.
faq: What is the goal of Rally Race Pro 3.0?
You race across rally courses with rugged hills, sharp turns, and varied terrain, aiming to improve your lap times and climb the leaderboard.
How do I drift in the game?
Steer with A and D or the Left and Right Arrow keys, then press the Spacebar to use the handbrake drift while you take a corner.

vikings.intro: Vikings is a card-based strategy game where you build up your heroes and cards, then conquer new lands across many adventures. This guide covers the main systems for growing your heroes and cards.
tips: Keep your hero's level in mind before spending experience banks, because a card cannot go above the hero's level. Raising the hero first lets your cards keep growing.
Focus experience banks on Warriors, since banks can only be used on simple cards.
Open chests as you go, since they are how you raise stars on the map. More stars both unlock new attack types and increase damage.
Equip items on your hero early, since each one adds health, and aim to wear all 6 to raise the hero's rank for more health.
Collect silver from the maze when you can, and use the wheel when you run short. Daily tasks and raids are also good sources of hero experience.
faq: What is the main goal of Vikings?
You build up your heroes and cards, then use them to conquer new lands across the game's adventures.
Why can't my card level go higher?
A card's level cannot be higher than your hero's level. Raise the hero's level first, then use experience banks on the card.

reversi-classic.intro: Reversi Classic is a 3D take on Reversi (Othello). You place discs to sandwich your opponent's discs and flip them, and the player with more discs when the board is full wins.
tips: Early on, avoid flipping lots of discs at once, since a wide board with few discs gives you more options later.
Before each move, check which squares you are giving your opponent access to, and avoid opening up new legal moves for them.
Grab corners whenever you can, because a corner disc can never be flipped back and anchors the edges around it.
Be careful with squares next to an empty corner, since they can hand your opponent that corner on their next turn.
Use training mode to hover over cells and preview what will flip before you commit, which helps you learn the patterns quickly.
faq: How do I win a game of Reversi Classic?
The game ends when nobody can make a move, and the player with more discs of their color on the board wins. Corners are especially valuable because they can never be flipped back.
How do I know where I am allowed to place a disc?
Dots appear on the board to show every legal move. A move is only allowed if it sandwiches at least one opponent disc in a straight or diagonal line.

extreme-space-rush.intro: Extreme Space Rush is a fast 3D space racer where you pilot spaceships through traffic and obstacles across futuristic worlds. Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer, accelerate and brake.
tips: Look ahead rather than at your ship, so you can spot gaps and traffic early enough to steer around them.
Brake before tight sections instead of braking late, since keeping control matters more than top speed when you are cornered by obstacles.
Take overtakes when the lane beside you is clear, and avoid risky passes when traffic is packed closely together.
Try each map once at a relaxed pace to learn its layout and hazards before you push for higher speeds.
Upgrade your ship's speed and performance as you unlock new ones, and switch to a stronger ship before entering the tougher levels.
faq: What is the main goal of Extreme Space Rush?
Drive as fast as you can, avoid obstacles and traffic, explore the different maps, and unlock new spaceships.
Which keys control the spaceship?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer and drive, including accelerating, braking and steering.

block-combo-blast.intro: Block Combo Blast is a block puzzle where you drag tiles onto a grid and fill rows or columns to score. With over 1800 levels, it rewards careful placement and planning ahead.
tips: Before placing a tile, check whether the other tiles you could pick next will still fit the open spaces.
Try to build up rows or columns that are nearly full, so a single well-chosen tile can complete them.
Avoid leaving isolated single gaps in the grid, since they are hard to fill with the tiles you are offered.
Look at all three available tiles before you drag one, and choose the option that fits the gaps you already have.
Keep some open space in the middle of the grid, because a crowded board leaves fewer places for future tiles.
faq: How do I score points in Block Combo Blast?
You score by filling an entire row or a whole column on the grid with tiles. Completed lines are what earn points.
How do I play each turn?
Choose one of the three tiles offered and drag it onto the grid. Place it where it fits, then keep going with the tiles you have.

tank-war-battle-game.intro: Tank War Battle Game is an action tank combat game set in war zones. You drive, aim, and shoot to destroy enemy tanks across different battle arenas and missions.
tips: Use W, A, S, and D (or the arrow keys) to reposition often, so enemy tanks have a harder time lining up a shot on you.
Before you attack, look at where the enemy tanks are and plan your approach rather than charging in.
Fire at the right moment instead of shooting constantly, since the game rewards careful, deliberate attacks.
Explore each battle arena early on to learn its layout and where you can take cover or move safely.
Stay alert at all times, because enemy tanks can strike without much warning.
faq: What is the goal of Tank War Battle Game?
Your goal is to drive your battle tank through war zones and destroy enemy tanks before they take you down. Missions and arenas add challenge as you play.
How do I move my tank?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to move left and right.

fat-2-fit-online.intro: Fat 2 Fit Online is a 3D casual runner where you sprint through obstacles, avoid tempting but unhealthy burgers, and collect cucumbers to build your fitness. Follow the in-game tutorial to learn the basics before you start.
tips: Play the tutorial through first so you know how the controls work before the obstacles get in your way.
Keep an eye on what is coming down the track so you can spot burgers early and change course in time.
Plan your route toward cucumbers when it is safe, but do not swerve into danger just to grab one.
Watch the obstacles ahead rather than only the ground under you, so you have time to react and keep your speed.
Keep your sprint going between obstacles, since losing momentum makes the next one harder to clear.
faq: What is the goal of Fat 2 Fit Online?
You run through a 3D track to win by sprinting to the finish while getting fitter. Avoid the burgers, collect cucumbers, and get through the obstacles.
What should I avoid while running?
Avoid the burgers, which look tasty but are bad for your fitness. Hitting them works against your run.

survival-sandbox-for-99-nights.intro: Survival Sandbox for 99 Nights is a 3D adventure where you search a changing forest for four missing children before the 99 nights run out. Days are for exploring and crafting, while nights bring the forest's horrors.
tips: Use daylight to explore, gather resources, and craft before night arrives, since the forest is described as relatively safe then.
Keep an eye on health and hunger together, and eat or recover before heading out after dark when danger rises.
Gather weapons and craft what you can during the day so you are better prepared for wolves and bears at night.
Plan your route through the most dangerous zones, and make sure you know where shelter is before the sun goes down.
Remember the Deer cannot be killed with ordinary weapons, so focus on driving it away, deceiving it, or temporarily restraining it when it appears.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You must find and lead each of the four missing children to safety before the 99 nights are over.
How do I move and jump on a computer?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the Spacebar to jump, and Shift to sprint. Use I and U for abilities.

robot-scrapyard-arena.intro: Robot Scrapyard Arena is a 3D top-down shooter where you salvage parts, merge them into stronger tiers, and build a robot to survive 10 waves and two giant bosses.
tips: Keep duplicate parts instead of selling or ignoring them, since two identical parts merge into a higher tier.
Check the Workshop with Tab after each wave so you can merge parts before the next fight starts.
Spread your upgrades across the five slots (two arms, core, head and legs) rather than stacking only one area, so your robot stays balanced.
Use Space or Shift to dash out of trouble, and save Overdrive for moments when you are under heavy pressure.
Only start the next wave early with Enter once your current robot feels strong and you have finished merging parts.
faq: How do I make my robot stronger?
Collect parts from enemies and crates, then drag one part onto an identical one in the Workshop to merge them into a higher tier. Equip the best parts you have in your five slots.
How do I aim and fire?
Use the mouse to aim. Left mouse button fires your left arm and right mouse button fires your right arm. Move with WASD or the arrow keys.

say-cheese.intro: Say Cheese! is a 3D arranging puzzle where you line up a wandering family for the camera before the timer runs out. Get everyone in the right spots and keep them looking at the lens.
tips: Place the tall relatives at the back and the kids in front first, so the rest of the group has a clear layout to fill in.
Put the couple on the gold stars early and keep them centered, since the request for each shoot depends on them.
Keep an eye out for anyone who looks away or blinks, and tap them right away instead of waiting until the end.
Save Space or the Say cheese! button for the last few seconds so everyone is smiling at the moment of the shot.
Check each client's request before you start moving people, so you know what the photo needs to show.
faq: How do I earn 3 stars on a photo?
Everyone needs to be in the frame, with eyes open and looking at the camera. Meeting that standard earns the full 3 stars.
When should I press Say cheese!?
Press Space or the Say cheese! button in the last seconds before the timer ends, so the whole family smiles for the shot.

save-woman.intro: Save Woman is a puzzle game where you pick a path through rescue scenarios. Each scene offers two actions, and only one leads to a successful rescue.
tips: Look at the full picture of the situation before choosing, and note what is dangerous and what could help.
For each option, picture what happens next and which outcome is safer, rather than picking the first choice that looks appealing.
Treat each level as a separate puzzle, since every scenario presents its own challenge and a choice that worked before may not work again.
If you fail a scenario, go back and compare the two options again to see which details you may have missed.
Take your time on each decision, because a single wrong choice ends the attempt and you cannot rely on guessing through the level.
faq: What is the goal of Save Woman?
Your goal is to rescue the girl in each scenario by choosing the one action out of two that leads to success.
How do I choose an action in each scenario?
Read the picture of the situation, think about the possible consequences of each option, and then choose one of them.

match-challenge.intro: Match Challenge is a puzzle about spotting groups. You look over a mix of items and pick the four that share a category, then submit to see if you were right.
tips: Scan the whole row before tapping anything. Note which items look alike, then check whether a fourth item fits the same group.
Watch for near-matches like a tool that could also be a household object. Pick the group where all four items clearly fit.
Tap your four picks, then take a moment to recheck them before you submit. A wrong submission costs you the time you spent.
Once you can name the category quickly, look for it first in each new round. Quick recognition helps most when the clock starts running in later levels.
If a round feels hard, reset your focus by checking one category at a time: fruits, tools, animals, then household objects.
faq: What is the goal of Match Challenge?
Your goal is to tap four items that belong to the same category, such as fruits, tools, animals, or household objects. Then submit your match to check it.
Do I have to get the match right on the first try?
The game checks your submission, so a wrong match means you need to try again. Take time to confirm your four picks before you submit.

counter-terror-battle-simulator.intro: Counter Terror Battle Simulator is a strategy game set in desert battles, where you complete high-stakes missions using tactical positioning and teamwork. Its instructions are not listed, so the tips below focus on general approach.
tips: Pick your cover and position before engaging, since the game centers on tactical positioning.
Keep track of where the enemies are coming from and adjust your position to avoid being caught in the open.
Identify the critical objective early so you can plan your route and decide which threats to deal with first.
Coordinate with your team: move in groups and cover each other rather than pushing forward alone.
If a approach fails, pause and rethink your plan instead of repeating the same move against relentless adversaries.
faq: What is the main goal of Counter Terror Battle Simulator?
The game's description says you execute high-stakes missions and secure critical objectives in intense desert battles. Focus on completing the objective for each mission.
Does the game use special controls I need to learn?
The game is described as having intuitive controls, and no detailed control list is provided. Try the basic actions first and look for any on-screen prompts.

offroad-truck-driving-simulator.intro: Offroad Truck Driving Simulator is a 3D off-road truck game with 4x4 trucks, mud, and dirt courses. You drive with WASD or the arrow keys and work through racing challenges, time trials, and obstacles.
tips: Try a few different 4x4 trucks early, since each one is described as having its own characteristics. Pick the one that handles the terrain you find hardest best.
Use the tuning and customization options to adjust your truck to the challenge. Make changes one at a time so you can tell what actually helps.
Use the simple in-game map to plan your route before you commit to rough ground. Knowing where the extreme obstacles are lets you choose a safer line.
Approach obstacles slowly and steer with small inputs. Smooth driving gives the truck a better chance to stay stable on uneven ground.
For time trials, practice a single course repeatedly until you know where to slow down and where you can push. Consistent lines usually beat speed alone.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You drive a 4x4 truck across off-road terrain and complete challenges such as offroad racing, time trials, dirt races, and extreme obstacle courses.
What are the basic controls?
Use W A S D or the arrow keys to move the truck, R to reverse, and H to sound the horn.

get-a-screw-puzzle.intro: Get a screw: puzzle! is a 3D puzzle game where you twist screws and collect mechanisms by choosing the right parts quickly and accurately. Each level is a separate task.
tips: Look over the whole level before you start choosing parts, so you know what the final piece needs to look like.
Take your time with the first pick of each level, since the description says you need to choose details accurately as well as quickly.
Rotate the model to check it from different sides before you commit, because a part that looks right from one angle may not fit from another.
Use the controls gently and steadily, so you keep full control of the model rather than spinning it past the part you want.
Play in short sessions and come back to a level with fresh eyes if you get stuck, since the puzzles reward careful observation.
faq: What is the goal of Get a screw: puzzle?
Each level is a separate puzzle where you solve a task, twist the screws and collect the mechanisms in the 3D world.
How do I rotate the model?
On desktop, squeeze the paintwork and move toward the sides. On a smartphone, press your finger on the screw, squeeze, and drag to the sides to turn the model.

idle-cinema-tycoon.intro: Idle Cinema Tycoon is a business simulation where you run a movie theater and grow it into a small empire. You buy cinema halls, schedule screenings, and upgrade interiors to raise profits.
tips: Spend your earnings on upgrades that raise profit before buying new halls, so each purchase pays back faster.
Check your missions regularly, since completing them unlocks rewards that can help you expand.
Pick films with care when you curate your collection, as different genres are worth exploring to see what keeps guests coming.
Give VIP room guests attention when they appear, because they are part of how you squeeze more profit from each screening.
Come back between sessions to collect profits and reinvest them, since this is an idle game where your theater keeps earning over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Cinema Tycoon?
The goal is to grow your movie theater into a larger empire by buying cinema halls, scheduling screenings, and increasing your profits.
How do I control the game?
Use the left mouse button to click through the interface to manage operations, make upgrades, and carry out your decisions.

wild-horse-simulator-racing-games.intro: Wild Horse Simulator Racing Games lets you live as a wild horse in an open world. You can build a horse family, run a farm, race, or roam forests and valleys.
tips: Try the Family, Farm, Racing, and Free Roam modes early to see which one suits your play style before committing to long missions.
Press I to check the info screen when you are unsure about a mission or what you should do next.
Use Q to sprint when you need to cover ground quickly, and save it for moments that matter, especially during races.
Use Space to jump over obstacles on your route, and combine it with movement so you keep your speed up.
Adjust your settings with Ctrl before you start if the default controls feel uncomfortable, and use P to pause whenever you need a break to plan.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The game is open-ended, with four modes: Family, Farm, Racing, and Free Roam. You can choose the mode that fits what you want to do, such as building your horse family, managing a farm, or racing.
How do I move and attack?
Use W, A, S, and D to move your horse. Press E to attack, and use F for actions, which can also be done with the mouse.

drawing-games-for-girls.intro: Drawing Games For Girls is a drawing and coloring worksheet with animated pictures of animals, dolls, mermaids, and fairy tale characters. You play by clicking with a mouse or tapping the screen.
tips: Pick one picture and finish it before moving on, so you can see how a complete drawing looks.
Start with the larger shapes, like a character's body or a dress, before adding small details such as hair or accessories.
Try a few different subjects, such as an animal, a doll, and a mermaid, to see which ones you enjoy drawing most.
Work slowly on the outlines first, then fill in areas of color so the final picture looks neat.
Take breaks between pictures to keep your focus and make each new drawing feel fresh.
faq: What is the goal of Drawing Games For Girls?
The goal is to draw and color the animated pictures on the worksheet, which include cute animals, dolls, mermaids, and fairy tale characters.
How do I control the game?
You use a mouse or tap the screen to play. Click or tap where you want to draw or color.

slidey-sliding-cat-puzzle.intro: Slidey is a sliding block puzzle where you move rows of cat blocks left or right to build and clear full lines. There are no timers, so you can take your time planning each move.
tips: Each slide pushes a new row up from the bottom, so think about where the rising row will land before you move.
Look for moves that complete a full line, since clearing lines is how cats disappear from the grid.
Keep an eye on the top of the grid, because the game ends if cat blocks reach it. Clear lines before the stack gets too high.
Try to avoid leaving gaps that you cannot fill later, since those make it harder to finish a line.
Take breaks and come back with fresh eyes if a puzzle feels stuck. With no timer, there is no pressure to rush.
faq: What is the main goal of Slidey?
Slide the cat blocks left or right to create and clear full lines. Clearing a full line makes the cats in it disappear.
How do I move the blocks?
Slide or move the cat blocks left or right. Each slide also causes a new row to rise from the bottom of the grid.

nitro-ball.intro: Nitro Ball is a browser car soccer game where you drive, jump and boost to hit a giant ball into the enemy goal. You can play quick matches, a knockout tournament, Hockey mode, timed Challenge Maps or solo Free Play.
tips: Keep an eye on your boost level and grab the glowing boost pads when you pass them, so you have enough for a jump or a flight when the ball comes high.
Before you go for an aerial hit, check where the ball is heading so you commit early instead of boosting after it has already passed you.
Use the walls and ramps to reach high balls rather than always jumping straight up, since this keeps you in the play for longer.
Practise in Free Play mode first to get a feel for jumping, flipping and the powerslide without an opponent pressuring you.
In Challenge Maps, focus on hitting each checkpoint cleanly first; a steady run with no wasted time is usually faster than a risky shortcut that sends you off course.
faq: How do I win a match?
You win by scoring more goals than your opponent before the clock runs out. Defending your own goal matters just as much as attacking.
What is the goal in Challenge Maps?
You race through the timed obstacle course, hit every checkpoint, and reach the finish as fast as you can. Your best time for each course is saved so you can try to beat it.

epic-battle-simulator.intro: Epic Battle Simulator mixes strategy, action, and idle play as you defend your castle against waves of invaders. Build defenses, unleash heroes, and push your army as far as it can go.
tips: Spend your early resources on defenses before upgrading units, since your castle has to hold while your army grows.
Watch which enemy waves get through, then strengthen that side of your defenses before the next wave arrives.
Save your most powerful units for the waves that threaten to break through, instead of using them on small early attacks.
Upgrade your army steadily rather than all at once, so you always have a balanced force to respond to new threats.
Time your attacks around enemy positions and how many forces are on the field, so your army does not get overwhelmed.
faq: What is the main goal of Epic Battle Simulator?
Your goal is to defend your castle from waves of invaders by building defenses, unleashing heroes, and crushing enemy forces before they breach your base.
How do I get stronger as I play?
You train and upgrade your army over time, which lets you push further and aim for higher levels.

american-18-wheeler-truck-sim.intro: American 18 Wheeler Truck Sim is a driving simulator where you haul cargo with a big rig over varied weather and rough mountain roads. Use WASD to steer and drive your load to its destination.
tips: Ease off the throttle before steep climbs and downhill slopes so the heavy trailer stays under control.
Take corners slowly, since a loaded 18-wheeler needs more distance and time to turn safely.
Pay attention to changing weather and lower your speed when visibility or road grip gets worse.
Learn the handling on flat roads first, then move to mountain routes once steering feels natural.
Plan each delivery as a route, not a dash, and keep steady speed to protect your cargo over long hauls.
faq: What is the main goal of American 18 Wheeler Truck Sim?
The goal is to drive your 18-wheeler and move freight from one place to another. The game focuses on realistic trucking across different terrain and weather.
How do I control the truck?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to drive and steer. The instructions list WASD as the only control scheme.

number-sums.intro: Number Sums is a logic puzzle where you circle the numbers that add up to the clues for each row, column, and colored region. Each board has one solution, and you can use the toggle to switch between circling and erasing.
tips: Look at the clues before you start circling. Rows, columns, and regions with small sums usually limit your choices fastest.
Use the erase mode to rule out numbers you are sure you don't need. Fewer options make the remaining moves clearer.
Check rows, columns, and colored regions together. A choice that works in one line can break another, so test each change against all of them.
Work through a smaller board first to get used to how the clues fit together before moving to larger boards up to 10x10.
If you get stuck, step back and look for a region or line with only a few possible combinations. Narrowing one area often unlocks the rest.
faq: What is the goal of Number Sums?
You need to circle numbers so that the sums in every row, column, and colored region match the clues shown on the board. All of them must work at the same time.
How do I use the toggle?
Switch between circling and erasing modes. Circle the numbers you need and erase the ones you don't, so the board shows your working clearly.

skateboard-city.intro: Skateboard City is an acrobatic skateboard game for kids. Your goal is to skate and collect all the stars in each level while keeping your skater on the board.
tips: Press the right arrow to get your skater moving before you try anything else, so you can build speed on the level.
Before you drop down from a high point, check where you will land, since a bad fall sends you back to the start of the level.
Plan a route that passes all the stars, and look ahead so you do not miss any on the way.
Practice the Z and X trick buttons and the SPACE jump on the early parts of a level before you attempt harder sections.
Go slowly through tricky parts, because each level has only one life and a single mistake means starting over.
faq: What is the goal of Skateboard City?
You complete a level by collecting all the stars in it. Skate through the level to reach every star.
How do I control the skater?
Use the arrow keys to control the skater. Use Z and X to make tricks, and the SPACE button to jump.

snow-plowing-simulator.intro: Snow Plowing Simulator starts with a shovel on a small house and builds up to large plow trucks clearing streets, highways and airports. Each level unlocks after you finish the one before it.
tips: Start by clearing the paths around the small house with the shovel so you learn how the snow removal works before moving on to bigger jobs.
Use the left mouse button for manual snow removal on tight spots that the vehicles cannot reach easily.
Use WASD to move your character or steer the car, and keep your moves steady so you cover the area without missing patches.
Press Esc to pause when you need a break or want to check your progress, then return to the job.
Work through the areas methodically and make sure every section is cleared, since you win only when the task is fully completed.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You win each level by completing the snow removal task fully and clearing the whole area. Levels open one after another as you finish them.
What controls do I use?
Use WASD to control your character or car, the left mouse button for manual snow removal, and Esc to pause the game.

tile-jumper-3d.intro: Tile Jumper 3D is a music game where you jump along vibrant 3D tiles in time with the beat. Timing and focus keep the melody going as you aim for a place on the leaderboard.
tips: Listen to the beat before you start moving, and try to match your jumps to its rhythm rather than reacting to each tile as it appears.
Keep your attention on the upcoming tiles instead of the one you are standing on, so you have time to prepare each jump.
Stay relaxed and steady. Rushing or tensing up often causes missed timing, so focus on a calm, even rhythm.
Play short sessions when you are fresh, since concentration is central to this game and tired focus tends to break the flow.
Use your attempts to learn the pattern of the music, then try to beat your own best run before aiming higher on the leaderboard.
faq: What is the main goal in Tile Jumper 3D?
The goal is to jump across the 3D tiles in harmony with the beat and keep the melody flowing. Each successful, well-timed jump moves you forward.
How is progress measured?
The game includes a leaderboard, so your results can be compared with other players. Focus on improving your timing run by run.

dot-and-dot.intro: Dot and Dot is a puzzle game about connecting matching colored dots on a grid. Draw a path for every pair without any paths crossing, across 300 levels.
tips: Start with the pairs that have the fewest possible routes, since they limit the paths that other colors can take.
