Look for corridors and corners where one path would block another, and plan those routes before drawing anything else.
Use the hint feature when you are stuck, but first try to spot which pair is easiest to finish on your own.
If a path ends up in the wrong place, right-click to remove it rather than working around a bad line.
When only one pair is left and its route is clear, double-click to let the game finish that last line automatically.
faq: What is the goal of Dot and Dot?
Connect each pair of matching colored dots with a path so that every pair is linked. No two paths may cross each other.
How do I remove a line I drew by mistake?
Right-click on the line to remove it, then try a different route.

queens.intro: Queens is a puzzle game where you place each queen on a board so that no two share a line of sight. Color-coded boards and a ticking clock test your spatial thinking.
tips: Check the whole board before placing anything, and look for rows or color regions that have only one or two possible spots.
Treat diagonals as part of a queen's line of sight, so mark those squares as blocked after each placement.
Work through the color-coded areas one at a time, since each region is a useful limit on where a queen can go.
Keep an eye on the clock, but avoid rushing. A wrong placement often costs more time than a short pause to recheck.
If you get stuck, step back and recheck your last few queens, because a mistake earlier on is usually the cause.
faq: What is the goal of Queens?
Your goal is to place every queen on the board so that no two queens share a line of sight. You need to finish each puzzle before the clock runs out.
How do I avoid mistakes when placing queens?
After each placement, check the row, column, and diagonals for conflicts before moving on. Tracking which squares are blocked helps you avoid errors.

deadshift-halloween-night.intro: Deadshift Halloween Night is a 3D zombie-driving racer. You complete mission objectives in a quarantined arena, then reach the green extraction ring before time runs out.
tips: Follow the orange markers so you always know where the next mission objective is, and avoid wandering while the timer runs.
Keep an eye on your car's condition and nitro. Green supply crates repair the car, refill nitro, and give you scrap, so grab them when you are low.
Use collisions on zombie groups to clear the path, since powerful hits send them tumbling, but avoid crashing into walls that could slow you down.
Plan your route to the green extraction ring before the final objective is done, so you are not searching for it with little time left.
Spend scrap on engine, armor, and nitro upgrades as you go, since tougher later missions depend on a car that can take hits and recover quickly.
faq: What is the goal of each mission?
Complete the objectives shown on screen, then stop inside the green extraction ring before time runs out. Rescuing survivors and collecting supplies are part of the job along the way.
How do I keep my car going during a run?
Collect green supply crates. They repair your car, refill nitro, and earn you scrap.

find-the-key.intro: Find The Key is a maze puzzle where you collect stars, pick up the key, and reach the exit. Each maze gets more complex, so planning your route matters more than moving quickly.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole maze and trace a route to the key and then to the exit so you do not wander into dead ends.
Collect stars along your route when they are on the way, but check that you still have a path back if you need to reach the key later.
Think about the order of steps: the key must be collected before the exit path opens, so save the exit for last.
If you get trapped, step back the way you came rather than pushing forward, since backtracking is often the quickest fix.
Move one step at a time in tricky areas and pause to think, especially in the later, more complex mazes.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use the arrow buttons to move through the maze one step at a time.
What do I need to do to finish a maze?
Collect enough stars to open the way to the key, grab the key, and then reach the exit.

office-escape-to-date.intro: Office Escape to Date is a click-based hypercasual game where you finish office tasks and get ready for an evening date before time runs out. You play with the mouse and must close activities quickly whenever the boss shows up.
tips: Keep an eye on the boss at all times, since a sudden appearance means you need to act right away.
When the boss appears, close the current activity immediately instead of finishing it, so you avoid getting caught.
Work out which tasks take the longest and start them early, so the clock does not catch you with unfinished preparations.
Watch the timer closely and do not spend too long on any single step, because the date deadline is firm.
Keep your clicks steady and deliberate, since you only have the mouse to control everything in the game.
faq: What is the goal of Office Escape to Date?
Your goal is to complete your office tasks and get ready for your date before time runs out, without getting caught by your boss.
What should I do when the boss appears?
Quickly close the current activity to avoid being caught, then return to work. The game asks you to be fast about it.

meow-pair-pop.intro: Meow Pair Pop is a relaxing connect-two puzzle game with cat-themed food tiles. Match identical tiles along clear paths and clear the whole board before time runs out.
tips: Look for the tiles that are hardest to reach first, such as those in corners or behind others, so they don't get blocked later.
Before tapping a pair, trace the path in your head and check that it has no more than three straight segments.
Scan the board for matching pairs that sit close together and clear them early to open up space.
Save Hint for when you have truly run out of moves, and use Shuffle only when the remaining pairs are all blocked.
Keep an eye on the clock from the start, and avoid leaving scattered tiles that could make the final pairs hard to connect.
faq: What is the goal of Meow Pair Pop?
The goal is to clear every tile on the board by tapping two identical tiles to connect and remove them, all before time runs out.
What makes a connection valid?
The path between the two matching tiles must be clear of other tiles and use no more than three straight segments.

airplane-factory-tycoon.intro: Airplane Factory - Tycoon is an idle clicker where you build an aviation business, starting with lightweight planes and working up to airliners and fighter jets. This guide covers how to grow your factory efficiently.
tips: Start with the lightweight planes and focus on getting your first production lines running before spending on anything else.
Reinvest your profits into expanding production lines so your output keeps growing while you are busy elsewhere.
Upgrade your factory facilities steadily rather than all at once, so no part of production becomes a bottleneck.
Improve your manager's skills early, since a stronger manager helps your operation run with less of your attention.
Unlock new aircraft types as soon as you can afford them, because larger airplanes are the main way to boost your profits over time.
faq: How do I move my character around the factory?
On desktop, use WASD or hold the left mouse button to move. On mobile, swipe across the screen in the direction you want to go.
What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to grow your aviation empire by manufacturing increasingly advanced aircraft, from lightweight planes up to giant airliners and advanced fighter jets.

jelly-links.intro: Jelly Links is a logic puzzle based on Sudoku, with connected lines that count as groups alongside rows and columns. There is no timer and no lives, so you can take each board at your own pace.
tips: Start with the Tutorial boards so you understand how a connected line counts as its own group before you reach the larger Normal stages.
Before changing anything, scan each line for the numbers already placed and note which values are still missing from that group.
Look at rows, columns and lines together. A number that can only fit in one spot in one group often unlocks a chain of other beads.
Pencil in candidates mentally or on paper for a tricky bead, and only commit once one option is the only fit.
Use HINT sparingly on bigger boards. It fills one bead, which can reveal the pattern for the rest, but working one step at a time keeps the puzzle satisfying.
faq: What is the goal of Jelly Links?
Fill every row, column and connected line with the numbers 1 to N so that each number appears exactly once in each group. The clues you are given cannot be changed.
How do I change a number?
Tap a bead to change its number, and tap again to cycle through the options. Only beads with a gold ring can be edited.

gt-racing.intro: GT Racing is an arcade racer inspired by 80s racing games. You drive across 21 circuits, control your car with mouse clicks or taps, and use turbo boost at key moments.
tips: Spend your first few laps getting a feel for the car control system before pushing for top speed, since the handling responds to how you steer.
Save the turbo boost for critical moments, such as straights or exits from tight corners, rather than using it the moment it is available.
Watch each circuit closely for hidden surprises, and note where they appear so you can prepare for them on your next attempt.
Treat the 21 circuits as a learning curve: replay the ones that give you trouble and focus on one corner or section at a time.
Keep your attention on the road ahead, because the vibrant track layouts can make it easy to miss upcoming turns.
faq: What is the goal of GT Racing?
The goal is to race through the circuits at high speed and get the most out of your car on each track. The game is built around intense arcade racing action.
How do I control the car?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The game uses an intuitive car control system, so short practice runs help you learn how the car responds.

wall-rush-3d.intro: Wall Rush 3D is a one-player racing game where you run along buildings and walls, dodge gaps and obstacles, and try to reach the finish before your rivals.
tips: Keep your eyes on the path a few steps ahead so you can line up with gaps and obstacles before you reach them.
Watch the wall edges closely, since the goal is to run along them without falling, and a small misstep can cost you the race.
Use your swipes early and in small adjustments rather than sudden large moves, which helps you stay on the course.
Pick up coins when they are on your route, but do not change your line so much that you risk falling or hitting an obstacle.
Keep an eye on your opponents' positions so you know when you need to push harder to reach the finish first.
faq: How do I move my runner?
Swipe left and right to steer the runner along the course. Smaller, controlled swipes make it easier to avoid obstacles.
What makes a run end early?
Falling off the course or running into obstacles and dangerous gaps will stop your run. Staying on the course is key to keeping up with the others.

hatch-that-egg-tap-and-crack.intro: Hatch That Egg is a fast clicker where you crack eggs against the clock and spend what you earn on upgrades. Each run builds toward a bigger skill tree and longer campaign.
tips: Keep your taps steady from the first second, since every run is a timed race and early eggs set your pace.
Spend shell and gems on stronger taps first, because faster hits crack each egg sooner and bring in more rewards.
Use the skill tree between runs to balance branches instead of pushing one path too far, so your income and tap power grow together.
Look at the lucky bonuses and time upgrades when a run feels tight, since extra seconds can carry you past the tougher eggs.
Pause with Esc or the pause button when you need a moment, so you can come back to the next egg without rushing.
faq: What is the goal of each run?
Tap or click the egg as fast as you can to crack it before the clock runs out. Each cracked egg opens the next, tougher one, and the eggs you hatch in that run make up your score.
What do I spend shell and gems on?
You spend them in the skill tree between runs. Upgrades include stronger taps, income that flows by itself, lucky bonuses and more time.

wood-chopping-game.intro: Wood Chopping Game is a fast-paced hypercasual chopping game. You play a lumberjack working through colorful forests while avoiding tricky branches.
tips: Watch the branches before you act, since the game is built around dodging them. Reading the next obstacle early gives you more time to react.
Focus on timing rather than speed alone. Quick, well-timed moves usually work better than rushing every chop.
Stay relaxed and keep your attention on the screen. Reflex-based games often go wrong when you get tense or distracted.
Practice a few rounds to learn the rhythm of the obstacles. Repeated play helps your timing become more consistent.
Use the sound cues as a second source of information if they help you track the action. The game is designed to be immersive, so listening can support your focus.
faq: What is the goal of Wood Chopping Game?
The description says you chop through vibrant forests while dodging tricky branches. The game is built around quick reflexes and sharp timing.
What controls does the game use?
The game does not list specific controls in its instructions, so you will need to find out what keys or inputs work by trying them in the game. Check the on-screen prompts when you start.

dead-lands-driver-open-world.intro: Dead Lands Driver is an open-world survival shooter set in a collapsed world overrun by zombies. You explore deserted cities, military bases and dark forests, gathering weapons and resources to stay alive.
tips: Use your vehicle to cover ground quickly between areas, since the world is large and the roads are mostly empty.
Look for markers in the world before heading into a fight, as they lead to missions like deliveries and zombie cleanup as well as garages and shops.
Check your inventory with I regularly so you know which weapons and resources you have before you enter dangerous places.
Keep an item in the middle slot and use it with U when you need it outside the car, so you are not searching for it mid-fight.
Press ESC to pause when you need a moment to read the in-game instructions and plan your next move.
faq: How do I start a mission?
Drive into a mission marker while inside your car, or stand at it outside the car and press E to start the mission.
How do I attack zombies on foot?
Outside the car, press the left mouse button to attack or shoot, and use WASD or the arrow keys to move.

crazy-aunty-slap-and-punch.intro: Crazy Aunty is a one-touch 3D stress-relief game set at a noisy family gathering. Tap to punch and use the other attacks to blow off steam as the chaos builds.
tips: Keep your taps quick and steady, since the controls are built for fast back-and-forth action.
Mix up your attacks instead of relying on punches alone, so you get to try kicks, slaps, and the thrown and launched items.
Watch what you hit and how it reacts, then choose the next attack that suits the moment.
Save your playtime for experimenting with the different items, such as eggs, tomatoes, water balloons, flying chappals, and paintballs, to see which ones feel most satisfying.
Keep an eye out for power-ups and costumes, and try to unlock them as you go to add variety to your play.
faq: What is the main goal of Crazy Aunty?
You fight back against Aunty's annoying comments about dating, diet, and wasted potential by punching, kicking, slapping, and throwing items at her. The game is about having fun and releasing stress.
How do I control the character?
The game uses simple one-touch controls. Tap to punch, and the controls are designed to feel smooth and responsive for quick action.

hand-over-hand.intro: Hand Over Hand is a physics-based climbing game where you guide a ragdoll character up through obstacles to grab the red flag at the summit. Your timing and grip control decide how far you get.
tips: Use short, controlled drags when climbing so you can see where the character's hand lands before you commit to the next move.
Release the click at the right moment to grab a hold, and wait for the character to settle before pulling again.
When a ledge is out of reach, drag left and right to build a swing, then release near the peak of the arc to catch the higher position.
Slippery surfaces and tricky terrain can cost you progress, so cross them quickly and avoid stopping on them when you can.
Collect stars when they lie along your route, since they unlock customization options, but don't risk a fall to reach one.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Climb to the summit and grab the red flag. Obstacles and slippery terrain make the route harder.
How do I reach higher positions?
Drag left and right to swing the character, then release the click to hold onto a higher object.

toolbox-sort.intro: Toolbox Sort is a logic puzzle where you move workshop parts between trays, fusing matching pieces into bigger tools. Your goal is to sort every tray so each holds only one kind of tool.
tips: Before each move, check which part sits on top of each tray, since you can only pick up the top parts.
Look for trays you can empty completely, because an empty tray gives you room to rearrange other parts.
Fuse matching parts early when you can, so the bigger tools take up less space in later moves.
Keep long tools in mind when planning, since they take more space and can block a tray sooner than you expect.
Aim for fewer moves if you want 3 stars, so think a few steps ahead instead of tapping at random.
faq: How do I move parts?
Tap a tray to pick up its top parts, then tap another tray to drop them there. You can only place parts on an empty space or on the same kind of part.
What counts as winning a level?
You win when every tray holds only one kind of tool. Using fewer moves earns 3 stars.

makeup-studio-halloween.intro: Makeup Studio - Halloween is a dress-up game where you transform avatars with spooky makeup styles. A professional artist guides you as you create creepy, stylish Halloween looks.
tips: Pick a theme before you start, such as gothic, vampire, or monster, so each choice you make supports the same look.
Follow the artist's guidance closely in the early steps, since it shows how the styles are meant to come together.
Keep the overall costume in mind as you go, because the best results usually come from makeup that matches the avatar's outfit and mood.
Try a few different bold styles on separate avatars to see which Halloween looks you enjoy most.
Step back and check the full avatar before you finish, so small details do not clash with the rest of the design.
faq: What is the goal of Makeup Studio - Halloween?
The goal is to transform avatars with bewitching Halloween makeup and create a costume you are happy with. The game focuses on creative, spooky looks guided by a professional artist.
Does the game have scores or levels to beat?
The game description does not mention scoring, levels, or challenges. It is best approached as a creative experiment where you decide when a look is finished.

lets-kill-evil-nun.intro: Lets Kill Evil Nun is a first-person shooter set in an abandoned asylum. You search for eight crosses to prove Evil Nun exists, then try to escape alive.
tips: Pick up items with F as you explore, since you will need to track down all 8 crosses before you can finish the mission.
Use Right Mouse Button to aim when enemies are at a distance, and fire with Left Mouse Button in short bursts to save ammo.
Keep an eye on your reload timing with R, ideally reloading when there is a quiet moment rather than in the middle of a fight.
Use Left CTRL to crouch or X to go prone when you need to lower your profile and make smaller targets.
Switch weapons with the Mouse Wheel depending on the threat in front of you, and save G grenades for groups or tight spots.
faq: What is the main goal of Lets Kill Evil Nun?
Find all 8 crosses in the abandoned asylum to prove Evil Nun's existence, then get out alive.
How do I change weapons?
Scroll the Mouse Wheel to switch between weapons. Press G to throw grenades.

war-robots-battles.intro: War Robots Battles is an arcade game about piloting robots on a future battlefield. You pick your robot, equip weapons such as a wind sword or imperial bow, and fight to win.
tips: Before each battle, choose a robot and weapon combination that suits how you like to fight, since the weapons are the main way you attack.
Watch how your opponents move and attack early on, then use that information to decide when to press forward and when to hold back.
Mix up your weapons rather than relying on one, so you can respond to different situations on the battlefield.
Keep your robots building toward a strong combat team instead of focusing on one unit, as the description emphasizes team strength.
Use the mouse click or tap controls with steady, deliberate actions so you do not waste attacks or lose position.
faq: What is the goal of War Robots Battles?
You lead your robots into battles on the future battlefield and use powerful weapons and strategy to win.
How do I control my robot?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to aim and attack during battles.

buggy-racing.intro: Buggy Racing is an off-road driving game with three modes: Racing against opponents, Time Lap against the clock, and Endless survival. You pick from three buggies and three characters, each with their own style.
tips: Try each of the three buggies in Racing Mode before settling on one, and keep the one that handles the tracks best for you.
In Time Lap Mode, focus on keeping a steady line through the track rather than taking risky shortcuts that cost control.
In Endless Mode, prioritize avoiding obstacles over speed, since survival time is what counts.
Use speed control carefully on sharp turns and tricky sections so you do not lose control of the buggy.
Learn the controls on a calm stretch first, whether you play with the keyboard or the on-screen buttons on mobile, so your steering feels natural when the track gets busy.
faq: What is the goal of Buggy Racing?
The goal depends on the mode you choose: finish ahead of opponents in Racing Mode, beat the clock in Time Lap Mode, or survive as long as you can in Endless Mode.
How do I control my buggy?
On the keyboard you steer and control your buggy with the keys, and on mobile you use the on-screen buttons to move left and right and control speed.

robots-battle-mech-arena.intro: Robots Battle: Mech Arena is an arcade fighting game where you control giant robots in an arena. Chain combos, defeat your enemies, and upgrade your hero to win each battle.
tips: Try to chain combos rather than making single attacks, since linking hits is the main way the game rewards skill.
Pay attention to how your enemies move and attack so you can time your own actions around them.
Decide whether to upgrade damage or health based on how you fight: choose damage if you like finishing battles quickly, and health if you tend to take a lot of hits.
Keep your attention on the fight itself, because the goal is to defeat enemies and claim victory.
Use the same clicks or taps consistently while you learn, so you can build a rhythm for your combos.
faq: How do I win a battle in Robots Battle: Mech Arena?
You win by defeating your enemies in the arena. Focus on landing strong attacks and chaining combos to bring them down.
How do I control my robot?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use these inputs to control your massive robot during the fight.

pickaxe-crusher-idle.intro: Pickaxe Crusher Idle is a clicker set in underground mines. You guide a bouncing pickaxe deeper into the caves, collecting resources and upgrading your gear and skills along the way.
tips: Spend your early resources on upgrades that help you collect faster, then move on to new tools once your collection rate feels steady.
Check the UI after each dive to see which tools, talents, and skills you can now afford, so you do not leave upgrades unbought.
Use talents to speed up progress in the parts of the game you play most, since they can shorten the time between major steps.
Keep an eye on the achievements list, because unlocking them can point you toward mechanics you might otherwise overlook.
Think about the prestige system as a planned reset: once progress slows, it is worth weighing a fresh descent against continuing at your current depth.
faq: How do I move the pickaxe?
Click the left and right arrows to dash the pickaxe in that direction. Each dash is how you explore the cave.
What should I upgrade first?
Start with upgrades that increase how quickly you collect resources, since they help fund everything else. Save bigger purchases for when you have enough to buy them in one go.

super-willie-world.intro: Super Willie World is a platformer where you guide Willie the mouse back to his steamboat through slow, peril-filled levels. You collect coins and defeat enemies by jumping on them.
tips: You only get one life per level, so slow down and check the path ahead before each jump.
Time your jumps carefully rather than rushing, since precise timing is what keeps Willie safe.
Jump on enemies to deal with them, and plan which ones are worth approaching from above.
Collect coins when they sit along your route, but never at the cost of a risky jump.
If a level goes wrong, restart it and take the same route again with more deliberate movement.
faq: What is the goal of Super Willie World?
Your goal is to guide Willie the mouse back to his steamboat by getting through each level.
What happens if Willie gets hurt?
You only have one life per level, so any mistake means you must start the level again.

monster-cafe-idle-tycoon.intro: Monster Café: Idle Tycoon is a cosy clicker about running a café at the edge of the haunted woods. You tap orders, upgrade machines and hire monster waiters to keep the tills busy.
tips: Tap order bubbles and machines early on, since serving monsters is your main source of coins. Keep an eye on which orders are waiting.
Use the bottom tabs to upgrade machines, buy tables and decorate regularly so your café earns more as you grow.
Hire monster waiters before you leave, because they keep serving while you are away and help your coins build up.
Collect coin bags on tables and tap lucky bats whenever they appear to add bonus coins to your total.
Check your daily treats and tasks each session, and look at the sticker album and trophies to see what you are working toward.
faq: What is the main goal of Monster Café?
You run a café by serving monsters, collecting coins and tips, and upgrading your machines and tables. Over time you open new places such as Crooked Café and Castle Crypt.
How do I earn coins the fastest?
Tap order bubbles and the machines to serve monsters, then collect coin bags on tables and tap lucky bats for bonus coins. Upgrading machines also helps your income grow.

stealth-silent-squid.intro: Stealth Silent Squid is a 3D action puzzle where you guide a squid's tentacle through guarded tower rooms to free it from a cage. Grow longer, grab and throw whatever you can, and find a path through each room.
tips: Collect the lost tentacle parts whenever they are safe to reach, since each one increases your growth range and makes later reaches easier.
Before grabbing a soldier or object, look at what is nearby; furniture and enemies can be thrown at other enemies or used to break barriers.
Scan each room for puzzle elements and dangerous obstacles before moving, so you can plan a route instead of reacting to them.
Use short, controlled movements with W, A, S, and D or the mouse pointer so you can keep the tentacle precise near obstacles.
If a room seems blocked, try interacting with the barriers and objects around you, because solving the puzzle is how the way forward opens.
faq: What is the main goal of Stealth Silent Squid?
Guide the tentacle through the guarded rooms of the tower and free the squid from the cage at the top.
How do I move the tentacle on desktop?
Use W, A, S, and D to move it, or hold the left mouse button to move the tentacle toward the pointer.

brain-dots.intro: Brain Dots is a physics puzzle where you draw lines and shapes to guide two colored balls until they touch. Each level presents a different layout, so plan your drawing before you start.
tips: Look at the whole level first and find the gap or obstacle that separates the two balls before drawing anything.
Use gravity to your advantage: a sloped line can roll a ball toward the other one without extra effort.
Try to solve each level with as few lines as possible, since the instructions encourage economical drawings.
Use momentum by letting a ball build speed down a ramp so it can carry across a gap.
Keep lines away from the balls' paths where they are not needed, so you do not block the route you planned.
faq: What is the goal of Brain Dots?
Your goal is to draw lines or shapes that make both balls touch each other. A level is complete when the two balls meet.
What do I use to move the balls?
You draw lines or shapes anywhere on the screen, and the balls react to them along with gravity and physics.

rodha.intro: Rodha is a minimalist platformer where you guide a ball-shaped hero through 60 levels of deadly obstacles. Quick reflexes and good timing are the core skills, and coins help you unlock upgrades.
tips: Watch each obstacle for a moment before you move, so you can spot the safe timing rather than reacting late.
Treat coin collection as part of your route: grab coins when they are safe to reach, since they fund your upgrades.
Keep your focus on timing over speed. The game rewards precise moves more than rushing through a level.
If a level keeps defeating you, pause on the sections where you failed and plan the exact moment you need to act there.
Try different unique characters as you unlock them to see which one suits your reflexes best.
faq: What is the goal of Rodha?
Guide your ball-shaped hero through all 60 levels while avoiding deadly obstacles. Each level asks you to time your moves carefully.
What are the coins used for?
Collect coins to unlock upgrades and customization options for your hero. Picking them up along the way helps you build up your options.

golden-boot-2022.intro: Golden Boot 2022 is a soccer game where you aim to become the top scorer. Get past the defenders and the keeper, and try to pull off a hat trick on the way to the trophy.
tips: Watch where the defenders and the keeper are standing before you shoot. Look for a gap rather than taking the first chance you get.
Move into position first, then shoot. Rushing a shot while the defense is still close often leads to a blocked attempt.
Use the lift-your-finger shot to release at the moment you have the clearest line to goal, so you are not shooting on instinct.
Aim for a hat trick by staying focused after each goal. Keep the same calm approach instead of getting careless.
Play each attempt with patience. Since you only need to click or tap to move and shoot, small pauses to read the situation can make a big difference.
faq: What is the main goal of Golden Boot 2022?
The goal is to become the top scorer and win the Golden Boot trophy. Along the way you can also earn other trophies, including a hat trick.
How do I move and shoot?
Use your mouse or tap and hold with your finger to move, then lift your finger to shoot. You do not need to swipe.

hatch-surprise-pets.intro: Hatch Surprise Pets is a cute virtual pet care game where you look after fuzzy, ultra-cute pets and collect them all. You play with the mouse or by tapping the screen.
tips: Take your time with each pet rather than rushing through them, since care is the core of the game.
Try different pet care actions to see how each pet responds, and keep an eye on what each one seems to need.
Keep track of which pets you have already collected so you know which ones you still need to find.
Work through the grooming and puzzle parts at a calm pace, and go back to a pet if something doesn't look right.
If you want to collect a particular pet, focus on that one first instead of spreading your attention across all of them.
faq: What is the goal of Hatch Surprise Pets?
The goal is to take care of the little pets and collect them all. Caring for each pet is the main activity.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse to click or tap the screen to play. Everything in the game is controlled this way.

sponge-challenge.intro: Sponge Challenge is a 2D puzzle platformer where you guide a bouncy yellow sponge through traps and obstacles. Collect purple diamonds and reach the portal to move on to the next level.
tips: Before you jump, look at the whole level and find the portal route first, then work backward to the first move.
Use walls and platforms to change direction mid-air, since a well-timed bounce off a surface can carry you past an obstacle you could not clear straight on.
Keep your taps short and deliberate. Trying to jump again too quickly often sends the sponge into a trap.
Grab the purple diamonds when they sit on your route, but do not risk a dangerous jump for one unless you can recover safely.
Expect later levels to demand more precision. If a path keeps failing, pause and check how the sponge's sticky surfaces can help you climb or reposition.
faq: What is the goal of Sponge Challenge?
Guide the yellow sponge through each level, collect the purple diamonds, and reach the magical portal that leads to the next stage.
How do I control the sponge?
Tap the screen to make the sponge jump. You can also use walls and platforms to change your direction while in the air.

raccoon-bubble-shooter.intro: Raccoon Bubble Shooter is a puzzle game where you aim, match, and burst bubbles to clear levels and earn rewards. A clever raccoon guides you through colorful challenges that grow harder with each level.
tips: Look for bubble groups you can clear in one shot before taking a shot you cannot control.
Plan a few moves ahead by noticing which colors remain on the board, so you can set up matches.
Try to build combos when you can, since linked bursts help you clear levels more efficiently.
When an obstacle blocks your path, work around it by clearing the bubbles that support it first.
Take your time on early levels to learn how the bubbles behave, which will help when challenges get tougher.
faq: What is the goal of Raccoon Bubble Shooter?
The goal is to aim, match, and burst bubbles to clear each level. Clearing levels also earns you rewards.
How do I use the mouse in this game?
The instructions say to use the mouse to click any button. Use it to select buttons on screen as you play.

voxel-playground-ragdoll-noob.intro: Voxel Playground: Ragdoll Noob is a physics sandbox where you drag, throw and blow up a ragdoll character among buildings and objects. Your goal is to break the character into pieces to finish the level.
tips: Hold the left mouse button, or touch and hold on a phone, to grab the character or objects before you move them. Test small drags first to learn how heavy each object feels.
Throw the character into obstacles rather than dropping it gently, since impacts are what cause the body to deform and break apart.
Look for dynamite and saws near the character and use them to set off chain reactions, because nearby objects affect each other.
Try different launch heights and angles and watch how the body reacts each time, so you can find the setup that breaks it fastest.
Clear out or move objects that block your path before you start, so your throws and explosions hit the character cleanly.
faq: How do you complete a level?
You complete a level by exploding the character until it is destroyed into pieces. Use throws, impacts and explosives to get there.
How do I move the character and objects?
Hold down the left mouse button on a computer, or press and hold your finger on a phone, then drag to move them.

mad-max-zombie-arena.intro: Mad Max Zombie Arena is a 3D racing game where you drive a modified vehicle through a zombie-filled arena. Keep moving, avoid the undead, and take down as many as you can to stay alive.
tips: Use the handbrake with space to swing through tight turns and drift around corners, which helps you keep your speed while staying clear of zombies.
Save nitro for open stretches or moments when you need to escape a crowd, rather than using it the second it is available.
Keep moving rather than stopping, since staying in one spot lets the undead close in around your vehicle.
Pay attention to where the zombies are gathering and steer away from dense groups before you get trapped against an edge of the arena.
If you play on a touchscreen, get comfortable with the on-screen controls first so you can steer and use nitro without looking down at the buttons.
faq: What is the main goal of Mad Max Zombie Arena?
You pilot your vehicle across the zombie-infested arena, avoid the undead, and annihilate them to stay alive. Keep going as long as you can.
Which keys control the car?
Use W, A, S and D to move the car, space for the handbrake, and N for nitro. On mobile, the controls are shown on screen.

live-eating-simulator.intro: Live Eating Simulator puts you in charge of a livestream where you eat big food challenges, manage your hunger, and keep viewers entertained. Click or tap to play and build your streamer persona.
tips: Watch your hunger level as you go, since it affects how you should pace your bites. Eating too fast without a plan can leave you with nothing left for the later challenges.
Pay attention to what your viewers respond to. Keeping them entertained is what grows your subscriber count, so vary your actions rather than repeating the same move.
Grab dishes in an order that keeps your eating steady. Planning two or three moves ahead helps you avoid being stuck with a hard dish at the wrong moment.
Treat each food challenge as a timing test. Take a breath between bites and focus on the rhythm of clicks or taps instead of rushing every single one.
Use your early runs to learn how the controls respond. Once you know how quickly a click or tap registers, you can aim for faster, cleaner bites.
faq: What is the main goal of Live Eating Simulator?
Your goal is to run a livestream by eating food challenges, managing your hunger, and keeping your virtual viewers entertained. Doing this well grows your subscriber count.
How do I control my character?
You play entirely with mouse clicks or taps. Use them to control each bite and to grab dishes during the stream.

stretch-guy.intro: Stretch Guy is an arcade game where you help a boy get back home by moving his limbs. He can only press against the wall, so each move has to be controlled carefully.
tips: Drag gently and steadily, because pushing too hard is what makes him spread out.
Move one limb at a time and watch how his body shifts before you add more force.
Keep his limbs pressed against the wall, since that is the only thing that supports him.
Pause between moves to plan the next reach so you don't overextend.
If he starts to spread, ease off the drag and reset your approach instead of forcing it.
faq: What is the goal of Stretch Guy?
You help the boy stretch out and gradually move back home.
How do I control the character?
Drag to play, and use the drag motion to move his limbs.

shooting-range.intro: Shooting Range is an arcade-style first-person shooter built around precise aiming. Hit moving targets, unlock new weapons, and take on challenges across different zones.
tips: Aim slightly ahead of moving targets so your shot lands where they will be, not where they are.
Focus on steady, deliberate shots instead of firing quickly, since accuracy is the main skill the game tests.
Try each weapon you unlock to find which one suits your aim and pace best.
Spend a little time in each new zone learning how its targets move before you rush for hits.
If your accuracy starts to slip under pressure, slow down and reset your focus rather than firing faster.
faq: What is the main goal of Shooting Range?
The game centers on testing your aim against moving targets. Staying accurate while the pressure builds is the core challenge.
What can I unlock?
You can unlock new weapons as you play. Each one gives you a different option for handling the targets.

cat-boba-tea-food-asmr-master.intro: Cat Boba Tea: Food ASMR Master is a cat-themed cooking simulation where you play a little cat chef. You prepare dishes, serve them to your audience, and build a livestream setup.
tips: Think of each dish as a full cooking session, from preparing ingredients to serving, so you keep a steady rhythm.
Pay attention to your audience while you cook, since the livestream and ASMR eating side of the game is a big part of the experience.
Try different style combinations early on to see which mix of looks suits your cat chef and livestream best.
Spend time on character customization and shopping to make your setup feel personal, rather than rushing through them.
Take it slow and enjoy the calm, casual pace, as the game is designed as a relaxed experience with no pressure to hurry.
faq: What is the main goal of Cat Boba Tea: Food ASMR Master?
You play as a little cat chef who prepares tasty dishes, serves them to your audience, and builds a unique livestream setup.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps, so you click or tap on the items, dishes, and options on screen to move through the game.

hero-time.intro: Hero Time puts you in control of Ben 10 as he transforms into one of his ten alien forms to stop Billy Billions and his plan. Each alien has its own power for getting past obstacles.
tips: Before you move on from an obstacle, think about which alien power would solve it best, since each form has its own ability.
Switch aliens only when the current form can't handle the obstacle ahead, so you learn which forms work best in which situations.
Pay attention to what each obstacle requires, such as height, speed, or strength, and match it to the power you have.
If you get stuck, pause and try a different alien rather than repeating the same approach, because the game rewards trying each power.
Use the control you find most comfortable, mouse or finger as the instructions allow, and keep your movements steady so you don't overshoot jumps.
faq: What is the goal of Hero Time?
You take control of Ben 10 and use the Omnitrix to transform into different aliens, getting past obstacles to ruin Billy Billions' plan.
How many alien forms can Ben use?
Ben can transform into ten alien forms, and each one has its own special power.

draw-couple.intro: Draw Couple is a drawing puzzle where you complete unfinished pictures by drawing a single line. Each scene is a small brain challenge played with mouse or tap controls.
tips: Study the whole picture before you start drawing, and look for the gap or missing part that your line needs to connect.
Plan one continuous line in your head first, since the puzzle is built around finishing the drawing with just one stroke.
If a line goes the wrong way, try a different route rather than repeating the same stroke, because the puzzle usually has a clear intended path.
Take your time on early scenes to learn how the drawing responds to your mouse or tap, then move faster as you get comfortable.
Pay attention to the story details in each situation, since the drawing often hints at what the finished picture should look like.
faq: What is the goal of Draw Couple?
The goal is to finish the unfinished part of each picture by drawing it with one line so the puzzle is solved.
How do I control the drawing?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to draw. The game is played entirely with this single input.

merge-items-build-city.intro: Merge Items Build City is a puzzle game where you combine matching objects to gather materials and build houses, streets, and city services. Your goal is to keep residents happy while your income grows.
tips: Merge matching items whenever you can, since stones become bricks and trees become boards, and both are needed for construction.
Before starting a building, check which tasks are still open, because every task must be completed before the building is finished.
Use the materials you collect to finish one building at a time rather than spreading them across many unfinished projects.
Pay attention to buildings that generate income, and build them early so your earnings can help fund later construction.
Finish quests when you can, since completing tasks and quests raises your income and helps you unlock hospitals, kindergartens, shops, and banks.
faq: How do I start building in Merge Items Build City?
Click on the building you want to construct, then select a task by clicking on it with your mouse or finger.
Where do bricks and boards come from?
Connect stones to get bricks, and connect trees to get boards. Drag and connect two of the same objects to merge them.

mini-shooters.intro: Mini Shooters is a 2D multiplayer shooter where you collect and switch between several weapons in deathmatch battles. Move, aim, and pick up guns to stay in the fight.
tips: Pick up weapons as you find them so you are not caught with only one gun when a fight starts.
Keep moving rather than standing still, since staying in one spot makes you an easy target for other players.
Aim with the mouse before you start firing, and fire in short bursts to keep your shots on target.
Watch where other players come from and try to position yourself so you can see them before they see you.
Use the weapon you have that suits the distance of the fight: close-range guns when enemies are near, and longer-range options when they are farther away.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Shooters?
The game is a deathmatch, so your aim is to outlast and outshoot other players in the arena. Stay alive and keep attacking opponents.
How do I pick up a weapon?
Move your character over a weapon and press Space to pick it up. You can carry multiple weapons at once.

cooking-korean-lesson.intro: Cooking Korean Lesson is a colorful cooking game where you learn to make Korean dishes such as Kimchi and Bibimbap. You work through step-by-step cooking challenges and earn rewards as you master the flavors.
tips: Follow each step in order, since the challenges are built to teach one part of a dish at a time.
Pay attention to flavor as you go, because the game rewards you for mastering the taste of each dish.
Try Kimchi and Bibimbap both, so you can compare how different ingredients and steps come together.
Take your time with each challenge rather than rushing, so you can spot what each step is teaching.
Revisit a dish you found tricky, since repeating a recipe is the easiest way to remember its steps.
faq: What is the goal of Cooking Korean Lesson?
The goal is to learn to cook authentic Korean dishes, such as Kimchi and Bibimbap, by completing step-by-step cooking challenges. You also earn rewards as you master the flavors.
How do I earn rewards?
Rewards come from completing the cooking challenges and mastering the flavors of each dish. Working through the steps carefully is the best way to earn them.

angry-bird-friends.intro: Angry Birds Friends is a slingshot adventure built around one-on-one Star Cup matches against other players. Win matches to climb the leagues and the leaderboards, and collect feathers to power up your birds.
tips: Check the tournament schedule first, since new Competitive Tournaments start every Monday, Thursday and Saturday and themed tournaments run every other week.
Use your mouse to aim carefully before each shot, because each level gives you a limited set of birds to work with.
Look at the Power Ups, Level Effects and Special Slingshots available on each level and plan which ones to use before you start shooting.
Put your feathers into leveling up your birds, since they add more scoring power for later matches.
Try to build a win streak, because winning several matches in a row increases your rewards.
faq: What is the main goal of Angry Birds Friends?
Win one-on-one matches against other players in the Star Cup to advance to higher leagues and climb the leaderboards.
How do I control the game?
The game uses mouse controls only. Use the mouse to aim and launch your birds from the slingshot.

find-match-3d.intro: Find Match 3D is a puzzle game where you look for three identical objects in a cluttered pile and tap them to clear them from the board. You race the clock while working through levels and aiming for higher scores.
tips: Scan the whole pile before tapping anything, and look for matching items near the edges or on top, since those are the easiest to reach.
Keep an eye on the timer from the start so you do not spend too long on a single difficult group.
Clear items that are sitting on top of others first, because hidden pieces underneath often reveal new matches.
Save your boosters for levels that feel stuck instead of using them early, so they are available when you really need them.
Try to finish levels with a high score, since completing them that way is how you unlock new challenges.
faq: What is the goal of Find Match 3D?
Your goal is to find three identical objects, tap each one to select them, and clear the whole board before time runs out.
How do I select objects?
Tap on each object you want to match. When you have three identical items selected, they disappear from the board.

jump-ball-2021.intro: Jump Ball 2021 is a 3D bouncing game where you hop from tile to tile. Each tile shows a number, and you must tap it that many times before moving on.
tips: Read the number on each tile before you land so you know how many taps to make.
Finish all the taps on the current tile before you jump, since the game requires this before you can move to the next one.
Keep your taps steady and even rather than rushing, so you do not lose track of the count.
Look ahead to the next tile while you are tapping so you can line up your jump early.
Work toward the target missions one stage at a time instead of trying to chase the highest score right away.
faq: What is the goal of Jump Ball 2021?
Your goal is to bounce from one tile to the next and complete the target missions. The game also mentions a winning point you can try to reach.
How do I control the ball?
Click on the screen to tap and make the ball jump. The number of taps needed is shown on each tile.

color-cube-puzzle.intro: Color Cube Puzzle is a relaxing logic game where you slide colored shapes into place so cubes from the conveyors can fill them. Plan each move, because the order you act in matters.
tips: Before moving anything, look at which cube colors are on each conveyor and which shape colors need filling. Matching these pairs first gives you a clear plan.
Think a few moves ahead. The instructions warn that wrong moves can block your path, so check whether a shape you move will stand in the way of another.
Work on one shape at a time when you can. Finishing a shape removes it from the board, which frees up space for the rest of the level.
There is no timer, so take your time on each level. Try a different approach if you get stuck instead of repeating the same moves.
Save your boosters for levels that feel truly difficult. Try the level on your own first so you learn its layout before you use one.
faq: What is the goal of Color Cube Puzzle?
Your goal is to fill all the shapes on the board so the level clears. A shape disappears once it is completely filled with cubes.
How does a shape get filled with cubes?
Move a shape to a cube conveyor whose cube color matches the shape's color. The shape then starts filling with cubes.

help-me-tricky-story-of-puzzles.intro: Help Me: Tricky Story of Puzzles is a logic puzzle where you guide a character through tricky situations by dragging a hand to collect the right items. Each step can lead to a funny outcome, so watch closely how the scene changes.
tips: Before you move, look at the whole scene and note every obstacle and every item you can reach. Planning first saves many wasted drags.
Try the most obvious tool last in your head; puzzles like this often hide a less obvious item that solves the problem.
Pay attention to what happens after each step, because the funny reactions often reveal a clue about what the character still needs.
If you get stuck, go back to the start of the situation and check which obstacle you have not dealt with yet.
Take your time with the drag controls: press on the character first, then move the hand slowly around obstacles so you do not grab the wrong thing.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to help the character pick up the right tools and get out of each difficult situation while avoiding obstacles.
How do I move the hand?
Click on the character, then drag the hand across the screen. Hold and drag over obstacles to reach the items you need.

animal-evolution-simulator.intro: Animal Evolution Simulator is a survival game where you start as a worm and grow into stronger animals by eating, fighting predators, and leveling up. This guide covers the basics to help you progress.
tips: Eat mushrooms early on, since the game points them out as the way to become stronger when you start as a weak worm.
Dodge enemy attacks before you strike back, because some animals hit hard and you can lose ground by trading blows carelessly.
Pick fights that are winnable. Defeating a stronger animal gives more experience, so it is worth choosing those battles when you are ready.
Keep an eye on the map and explore it. New areas, such as the savanna, hold new animals and special types of beasts.
Decide early whether you want to play as a stealthy hunter or a defender of your territory, and stick with that approach to keep your choices consistent.
faq: What is the main goal of Animal Evolution Simulator?
You fight to survive in the wild, eat plants and mushrooms, and evolve from a worm into stronger animals, reaching a lion and beyond.
How do I level up faster?
Defeat more animals. Beating an opponent stronger than you gives extra experience, so you grow much faster.

screw-master-3d-pin-puzzle.intro: Screw Master 3D: Pin Puzzle is a 3D puzzle game where you twist screws, collect mechanisms and choose the right parts in each level. The challenge is to be accurate and quick.
tips: Look at the whole model before you act, so you can spot which screw or part matters most.
Work accurately rather than rushing, since each level asks you to choose the necessary details carefully.
Rotate the model by dragging to the sides to check the piece from every angle before you commit to a move.
Keep your moves steady and deliberate, because the game rewards precise choices made at a good pace.
If a level stalls, step back and review the parts you have already collected, since the solution often depends on earlier steps.
faq: What is the goal of Screw Master 3D: Pin Puzzle?
Your goal is to solve each 3D puzzle by twisting screws, collecting mechanisms and choosing the right details. Every level is a separate task.
How do I control the game?
Press the desired color with the left mouse button, and press on a screw to pick it up. To rotate the model, drag to the sides.

monster-go.intro: Monster Go is a brain puzzle where you connect cube-shaped monsters on a colorful grid. Levels get trickier as you go, and you earn stars by working through each stage strategically.
tips: Study the whole grid before you make your first connection, so you can see which monsters might block others later.
Look for monsters that have fewer possible paths and plan around them early, since they are easiest to get stuck on.
Think a few moves ahead rather than reacting to the nearest option, because a quick connection can cut off a better route.
If a level stalls, step away for a moment and look at the board again with fresh eyes. Puzzle games often reward a new angle more than repeated attempts.
Pay attention to how the difficulty rises from stage to stage, and treat early levels as practice for the planning habits you will need later.
faq: What is the goal of Monster Go?
Connect the cube-shaped monsters on each grid to conquer the stage and move on to the next, more challenging level.
How do I earn stars?
Stars are earned as you strategically complete each stage, so careful planning matters more than speed.

golf-orbit.intro: Golf Orbit is a one-button golf game where you aim to hit the ball as far as possible, even up to Mars. Set your power carefully, because each swing's distance is recorded and rewarded.
tips: Watch the green section on the power indicator and try to release inside it. The description says this gives a stronger shot that flies further.
Use bounces to your advantage. The ball gains extra distance each time it bounces off objects, so plan shots that land and rebound toward open ground.
Collect coins during the flight. You can spend them on upgrades like ball flight speed and shot power, which make later shots easier to land well.
After a green zone hit, take another shot right away to keep your distance going. Missing the green zone or landing in water or sand ends the attempt.
Try for birdies and eagles when you can. They award far more points and can improve the features of your future shots.
faq: What is the goal of Golf Orbit?
Hit the ball as far as possible and try to get it into the holes. Your distance is recorded with each shot, so the aim is the longest distance you can reach.
What happens if my ball lands in water or a sand bunker?
As in regular golf, your shot ends there. Aim more accurately to avoid these spots and keep your progress going.

click-that-button.intro: Click That Button is a tapping game built around one big red button. Tap to earn cash, spend it on upgrades and hired hands, and grow your empire over time.
tips: Put early cash into upgrades that raise your income per tap first, since every later tap and hand benefits from it.
Hire hands once you can afford them, because they keep earning while the game is closed.
Tap in steady bursts to build the combo meter, which is what unlocks critical hits.
Watch for golden buttons drifting across the screen and click one when you can for a burst of cash.
Merge three matching hands whenever you can, since a stronger tier is worth more than three weaker ones.
faq: What is the goal of Click That Button?
The goal is to grow your empire by tapping the big red button, spending cash on upgrades and hands, and unlocking more buttons to collect.
How do I beat a boss guardian?
Tap fast when a boss guardian appears, which happens as you level up. Keep your tapping quick until the guardian is beaten.

relaxing-games.intro: Relaxing Games is a collection of short, casual mini-games covering elimination, simulation, shooting and puzzles. You switch between them freely, using mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Try a few different mini-games first to find which style you enjoy most, since each one plays differently.
Keep your moves unhurried. The games are built for relaxing, so steady, calm play usually works better than rushing.
Pay attention to the goal shown in each mini-game before you start, so you know what counts as success.
If a puzzle or challenge feels stuck, switch to another mini-game and come back with fresh eyes.
Play in short sessions. The mini-games are quick, so stopping after a few rounds is an easy way to unwind.
faq: How do I control the games?
Use mouse clicks on a computer or taps on a touchscreen. The instructions do not mention any other controls.
What types of games are included?
The collection includes simple elimination games, simulation challenges, shooting games and puzzle games. You can switch between them freely.

slide-block-jam.intro: Slide Block Jam is a colour-matching block puzzle. Move each coloured block to the door of the same colour to clear the way, and plan ahead as new obstacles appear in later levels.
tips: Before you move anything, check which blocks are standing between each coloured block and its matching door. Those are the ones to deal with first.
Look for a block that can reach its door in one slide and clear it early. Removing pieces opens up space for the harder moves later.
Avoid pushing blocks into spots where they trap another block or block a door you still need. Think about where a block will stop before you slide it.
When you feel stuck, step back and look at the whole board rather than the one block you were focused on. The solution often starts with moving a block that seems unrelated.
Expect new obstacles to appear as you complete levels. Pay attention to how each new barrier changes the order you need to clear blocks.
faq: What is the goal of Slide Block Jam?
Move each colourful block to the door that matches its colour to clear the path and finish the level.
How do I know which door a block belongs to?
Each block matches a door of the same colour, so use the colour to decide where it needs to go.

doodle-halloween-momo-cat-academy.intro: Momo the magic cat has to draw the symbols shown above ghosts to cast spells and drive them out of her school. This guide covers how to keep up as the ghosts speed up across the five levels.
tips: Look at the symbol above each ghost as soon as it appears, then draw it right away instead of waiting for the ghost to get close.
Draw slowly enough to get the shape right the first time, since a sloppy symbol costs you the time it takes to redo it.
When several ghosts are on screen, handle the one closest to Momo first so that no ghost reaches her.
Boss ghosts may need a long chain or repeated spells, so keep your drawing steady and do not rush the second or third symbol.
Pay attention to the new area of the school in each level, since the ghosts there are quicker and trickier than before.
faq: What is the goal of Magic Cat Academy?
Your goal is to get through all five levels, defeat every ghost and boss, and get the stolen spellbook back.
How do I cast a spell?
Draw the symbol shown above a ghost's head with your mouse or your finger on a touchscreen. Symbols can be simple lines, shapes like a V, or a lightning bolt, and some ghosts need a sequence of them.

brick-breaker-ball.intro: Brick Breaker Ball is a fast arcade game about smashing bricks with a ball. Collect power-ups and extra lives as they fall, and try to beat your own high score.
tips: Watch the falling items closely, since power-ups and extra lives only count if you grab them before they drop out of reach.
Decide early which falling items matter most to you, such as extra lives, and let less useful ones go if they put you at risk.
Pay attention to where the ball is heading so you can react in time rather than chasing it at the last second.
Keep an eye on your remaining lives and adjust how cautiously you play as they run lower.
Replay the game with the aim of beating your previous high score, and note what you did differently on your best run.
faq: How do I start playing?
Click or tap on the game to begin. The game uses only mouse clicks or taps as its input.
What is the goal of Brick Breaker Ball?
Smash the bricks with the ball and try to set a new high score. The game is built around fast, continuous brick-breaking action.

this-is-blast.intro: This is Blast is a colorful bubble puzzle game where you aim and shoot balls to create blasts and chain reactions. Each level has its own layout, and you clear the required targets to finish it.
tips: Adjust your aim before every shot and look for a spot that can hit several objects at once.
Look for groups of similar items you can match, since bigger matches clear more space.
Before you release a ball, think about how one shot might set off multiple blasts in a chain.
Save boosters and power-ups for sections that become hard to clear instead of using them early.
In later levels, slow down and plan your timing and aim, because the puzzles need more strategy.
faq: What is my goal in each level?
Your main goal is to clear the required targets in the puzzle layout to complete the level.
How do I aim and shoot?
Drag or move the aim direction to choose where to shoot, then release the balls toward the puzzle area.

glam-doll-salon-makeup-and-dressup-game.intro: Glam Doll Salon is a dress-up game where you style a model's hair, makeup, and outfits. Tap or click to build a look until she looks perfect.
tips: Start with hair, then makeup, then clothes, so each step fits the one before it and you don't have to redo pieces.
Pick a theme early, such as a bold evening look or a soft everyday style, and choose items that match it.
Try a few cosmetic and dress combinations before settling on one, since the right mix is easier to spot when you compare options.
Check the full look from several angles and against the rest of the outfit before you finish.
Keep the makeup and hair toned to match the dress so no single part overpowers the others.
faq: How do you play Glam Doll Salon?
You tap or click to choose hair, makeup, and dresses and apply them to the model. Keep styling until she looks perfect.
What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to design the latest styles and dress the model until she looks perfect, combining hair, makeup, and outfits.

superstar-family-dress-up-game.intro: Dress up a superstar family of four in this fashion game. Choose clothes, makeup, pets and fireworks, pick a background, then capture your finished scene to share with friends.
tips: Start by choosing a theme, such as glam, sporty or sparkly, so every family member's outfit fits the same look.
Work on one family member at a time, and check how their clothes and makeup match before moving to the next.
Pick your background early, since a bright or night-time setting can change how the outfits and colors look in the final picture.
Add pets and fireworks last to finish the scene, and make sure they add to the mood rather than crowding the family.
Before you capture your picture, look over the whole scene once more to check that everything you want to show is visible.
faq: What is the goal of this game?
The goal is to design dazzling looks for a superstar family of four and capture a finished scene you are happy with. There is no set target to beat.
What can I customize?
You can change clothes, makeup, pets, fireworks and the background. The description says the options are wide, so you can build many different styles.

1-pickaxe-hit-break-blocks.intro: Walk into block walls while your spinning pickaxes do the work. Gain XP, level up, and rebirth to push into harder worlds.
tips: Approach walls head-on so your spinning pickaxes can hit as many blocks as possible at once.
Keep breaking blocks steadily, since XP from destroyed blocks is what drives leveling up.
Level up to unlock more pickaxes, then check your collection so you know which weapons you have available.
Rebirth when progress slows down, because it boosts your progress for the tougher obstacles ahead.
Destroy enough blocks to spin the reward roulette, and use the temporary boosts it gives you when you need them most.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Break blocks, earn XP, and level up to unlock more pickaxes and move on through the map and new worlds with increasing difficulty.
How do I move my character and rotate the camera on desktop?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and hold the right mouse button while dragging to rotate the camera.

last-chair.intro: LAST CHAIR is a fast-paced musical chairs battle with 100 players. Run the obstacle course while the music plays, then grab a seat when it stops. Survive nine rounds to win.
tips: Steer early and keep your path clear of obstacles, since your character runs automatically and you cannot stop to recover.
Watch the arena as you run and try to stay in a central, open position so you are close to chairs when the music stops.
Time your jumps for obstacles rather than jumping constantly, so you keep your momentum and steering control.
When the music stops, head straight for the nearest empty chair without changing direction, because other players will be racing for the same seats.
Focus on staying in a good position each round instead of only avoiding one hazard, because a single bad spot can eliminate you.
faq: What is the goal of LAST CHAIR?
The goal is to survive all nine rounds and claim the final chair. Players without a chair are eliminated each round.
How do I steer and jump?
On desktop, move the mouse to steer and left-click to jump. On mobile, drag to steer and tap the JUMP button to jump.

niko-adventure.intro: Niko Adventure is a platformer where you move through colorful landscapes, dodge obstacles, and collect coins. You also outsmart Dinos to earn keys as the levels get harder.
tips: Collect coins along your route as you go, since they are one of the main things to gather on each stage.
Look at the layout before you jump and watch how obstacles move or repeat so you can time your moves.
Take your time with the Dinos and plan how to get past them rather than rushing in, because you need their keys to progress.
Expect the levels to get harder, so treat early stages as practice for the timing and patterns you will need later.
Explore off the direct path a little, since the description mentions hidden rewards that are easy to miss.
faq: What is the main goal in Niko Adventure?
Move through each level, dodge obstacles, collect coins, and outsmart Dinos to gain keys. The levels become more challenging as you progress.
What controls does the game use?
The game instructions do not list specific controls, so check the in-game prompts or on-screen hints when you start playing.

slingshot-shooting-game.intro: Slingshot Shooting Game is a casual puzzle shooter where you pull back a slingshot, pick an angle, and release at the right moment. Each level adds new challenges that reward careful aim and planning.
tips: Use the mouse to pull the slingshot back before each shot, and take a moment to adjust your angle before you release.
Look at the whole level before shooting. Identify which obstacles block your targets and which ones you can knock out first.
Try to finish each level in as few shots as possible, since the goal is to complete objectives efficiently.
Watch how your shots travel and bounce off obstacles, then use that to improve your accuracy on the next attempt.
If a level stalls, reset your plan and try a different angle or power rather than repeating the same shot.
faq: How do I aim and fire the slingshot?
Use the mouse to pull back the slingshot, adjust the angle, and release when you are ready to shoot. The game is designed around aim and timing.
What is the main goal of each level?
Hit the targets, destroy the obstacles, and complete the level objectives. Using fewer shots is part of the challenge.

swat-ops-body-camera.intro: SWAT OPS: Body Camera is a first-person tactical shooter told through an operator's body cam. Race to the most kills in three-minute matches against bots or real players, across four maps.
tips: Aim down sights when you are shooting at long range, since the game notes this gives more accurate shots.
Press Tab or Esc now and then to check the scoreboard and see how close you are to the kill target.
Reload during quiet moments rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Keep an eye on the three-minute timer, because the match ends whoever is ahead when it runs out.
Use the weapon switch (Q or mouse wheel on desktop, the on-screen button on mobile) to change to a better weapon for the distance you are fighting at.
faq: How do I win a match?
In Deathmatch the first player to 15 kills wins, and in Team Deathmatch the first team to 30 wins. If the three-minute timer ends first, the most kills at that point decides the result.
How do I shoot more accurately?
Hold aim down sights before you fire, which the game recommends for accurate shots at range. On desktop this is the right mouse button, and on mobile it is the Aim button.

witch-s-shop-potion-brewing.intro: Witch's Shop: Potion Brewing is a cozy 3D simulation where you run a magical potion shop, gathering ingredients, brewing potions, and helping customers with unusual problems. Your shop can grow over time.
tips: Explore the shop and gather rare ingredients before you start brewing, so you have options when a customer asks for something unusual.
Read each visitor's request carefully, since every customer has a different problem and the right potion depends on what they actually need.
Try different potion combinations to learn what each mixture does, so you can recognise good matches faster for future customers.
Spend what you earn on upgrades and shop expansions that help you serve more customers or brew more efficiently.
Take the cozy pace in stride: moving steadily between gathering, brewing, and serving keeps the shop running smoothly.
faq: How do I move my witch around the shop?
On PC, use the W, A, S and D keys to move your character. The game is played in 3D, so you can walk around the shop and its surroundings.
What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to create the right potion for each customer and grow your small shop into a well-known magical store. Successfully fulfilling requests is the key to that growth.

robotex.intro: Robotex is a robot-building game where you drag and drop parts to assemble unique robot models. Each new challenge adds complexity as you practice your design and problem-solving skills.
tips: Look at the whole model before you start placing parts so you know what shape the finished robot should take.
Build the core or base parts first, then attach smaller components around them to keep the structure stable.
Try a different arrangement if a piece does not fit a spot, rather than forcing it into place.
Pay attention to how each new challenge differs from the last, since the complexity increases as you go.
Experiment with different component combinations to see which designs work best for your ideas.
faq: What is the goal of Robotex?
The goal is to assemble robot models by dragging and dropping components. Each challenge builds on the last and gets more complex.
How do I move the robot parts?
Drag and drop each component into place to build your model. Release the part where you want it to sit.

alien-quarantine.intro: Alien Quarantine is a top-down shooter where you fight through 20 missions aboard an alien-infested research station. Each level ends with a larger boss, so pace your ammo and grenades.
tips: Watch the first and second waves closely so you learn each enemy's attack pattern before the third, harder wave arrives.
Keep moving rather than standing still, since dodging enemy fire is as important as shooting back.
Save grenades for groups of enemies or for the boss instead of using them on single targets.
Before you head for the exit, plan your route to restore consoles, rescue crew, and recover samples, since these objectives are tied to progressing through the level.
Expect new alien types and visuals in each sector, so adjust your approach when you enter a new area rather than reusing the same tactics.
faq: What is the goal of Alien Quarantine?
You survive 20 missions aboard a research station overrun by aliens. In each level you clear three waves of enemies, defeat the boss, and work toward the exit.
Which keys control the game?
Move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, fire with left click, and throw a grenade with right click. Press E to use consoles, collect items, and activate exits, and Esc to pause.

rise-of-the-dead.intro: Rise of the Dead is a zombie shooter where you fight waves from every direction while completing quests to uncover what caused the outbreak. Upgrades and different mission types keep each run varied.
tips: Keep moving so zombies coming from several angles do not surround you. Check where they are before you stop to shoot.
Reload when you have a safe moment rather than in the middle of a crowd, since an empty magazine during a wave can be costly.
Spend upgrades on the skills and weapons that match how you play, and focus on one or two rather than spreading points thin.
Use the Zoom control on sniper missions to line up distant targets before you fire.
Save your punch for when a zombie is close and your gun needs time to reload, and keep your props for emergencies.
faq: What is the main goal of Rise of the Dead?
Survive the waves of zombies while completing task-driven quests that reveal the cause of the apocalypse.
How do I change weapons during a fight?
Press Q to switch weapons, and use left click to shoot once you have the one you want.

formula-car-stunt.intro: Formula Car Stunt is a driving adventure set on sky-high tracks above the clouds. You control a powerful formula car across five modes, from stunts to police chases and zigzag roads.
tips: Ease off the accelerator before sharp turns so the car keeps its grip and you can steer through the bend cleanly.
On narrow tracks, keep your steering small and steady, since sudden corrections are what usually throw you off balance.
Use the brake early on tricky sections rather than late, which gives you more control when the road twists.
Try Stunt Mode first to learn how the car handles in the air and on the ground before you move on to faster challenges.
In Police Chase and Zigzag Mode, pick your line ahead of time and look a little further down the road than your car, so you are not reacting at the last second.
faq: What is the goal of Formula Car Stunt?
Drive your formula car across the sky-high tracks, perform stunts, and get through each road's challenges. The game also asks you to escape police pursuits and master impossible roads.
Which keys control the car?
Use W, A, S, and D or the Arrow Keys. You accelerate, brake, and steer with these controls, and you need to keep your balance on narrow tracks.

vials-asmr-sand-sort-puzzle.intro: Vials is a calm sand-sorting puzzle where you pour coloured sand between glass vessels until each one holds a single colour. There is no timer, so you can take your time with every move.
tips: Before each pour, check which colour sits underneath the top layer of every vessel, since that layer may block the sand you need to move.
Look for a vessel you can empty completely first, because an empty vessel gives you a place to park a colour that is in the way.
Avoid mixing two colours in a vessel that could be cleared; keep sand of one colour together so it can be gathered in a single move later.
Plan a few moves ahead on harder levels, especially around the tougher levels that appear about every twenty levels.
Save your coins for when you are truly stuck. Try working out a move first, and only use an undo, shuffle or extra empty vessel if the board has no clear path.
faq: Is there a time limit or move limit?
No. The game has no clock and no rush, so you can take as long as you like over each move.
What happens if I run out of moves?
If no moves are left, you restart the level. Restarting or giving up costs one life, and lives refill over time.

kingdom-defender-tower-defense.intro: Kingdom Defender is a tower defense game where you place towers and use special abilities to stop orcs, trolls, and undead from breaching your kingdom. Battles take place in forests, mountains, and deserts.
tips: Watch the type of enemy coming before you commit to a tower layout, since each enemy has unique skills that some defenses handle better than others.
Save your special abilities for key moments, such as when a large group is bunched up or a strong enemy is about to reach your defenses.
Adjust your strategy when the battlefield changes, because forests, mountains, and deserts call for different defensive setups.
