Spend upgrades on towers that work well together rather than spreading them thinly across the map.
Use the built-in encyclopedia to read what each tower and ability does before you rely on it in a tough wave.
faq: What is the main goal of Kingdom Defender?
Your goal is to stop waves of enemies from getting through and breaching your kingdom by placing towers and using special abilities.
How do special abilities help in battle?
Abilities such as summoning flames under enemies or freezing them can change the course of a fight if you activate them at the right moment.

screw-color-puzzle.intro: Screw Color Puzzle is a brain game where you match each screw to the case of the same color. Clear every screw in a level to move on to the next one.
tips: Scan the whole board before you start and note which screw colors appear most often. Clearing the common colors early can free up space for the harder ones.
Look for screws that are locked in by others and work out the order to remove them. Taking out a blocking screw first usually saves time.
Keep track of which cases are still empty so you do not send a screw to the wrong color. A quick mental check after each move helps avoid mistakes.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the board from a different angle rather than trying the same move again. Fresh attention often reveals the next step.
Play in short sessions and take a break when your focus drops. Steady concentration tends to matter more than speed in a logic puzzle like this.
faq: What is the goal of Screw Color Puzzle?
The goal is to match each screw with the screw case of the same color. You must remove all the screws in a level to progress to the next one.
How do I know which screw goes where?
Each screw has a color, and it belongs in the case with that matching color. Compare the screw colors with the case colors before you remove it.

knock-down.intro: Knock Down is a skill game where you aim a slingshot and launch a ball to knock over every bottle in the level. You have a limited number of balls, so each shot counts.
tips: Before you launch, look at the whole layout and find which bottles are closest to the ball's path, then aim to clear several at once.
Drag the slingshot slowly while aiming so you can see the trajectory settle before you release.
Take a moment to plan a shot that knocks over bottles in a chain, since one well-placed hit can topple more than one.
Count your remaining balls before each shot and save the trickier shots for when you have spare ones.
If a shot misses badly, adjust your aim for the next ball rather than repeating the same angle.
faq: What is the goal of Knock Down?
The goal is to knock down all the bottles in each level using the slingshot and ball. Clearing every bottle wins the level.
What happens if I run out of balls?
If you throw all your balls without knocking down every bottle, the level is failed and the game is over.

protect-my-dog.intro: Protect My Dog is a casual puzzle game where you draw defensive lines to keep your dog safe from bees and other hazards. The challenge grows across 50 levels.
tips: Plan your line before you start drawing, since the game is built around one drawing line per level.
Look at where the bees come from and where your dog sits, then block the path between them first.
Watch for lava, thorns and other environmental hazards, and keep your line away from anything that could hurt the dog.
Expect harder levels as you progress, so try to clear early levels cleanly to build a feel for how the lines behave.
If a level doesn't work out, try a different line shape rather than repeating the same one.
faq: How do I draw the protective line?
Use your mouse to create a drawing line on the level. The line is your defense against the bees.
What is the goal of each level?
Protect your dog from the bee attacks and from hazards such as lava and thorns. The game has 50 levels in total.

satispuzzle-perfect-tidy.intro: SatisPuzzle Perfect Tidy is a brain puzzle game with many short mini-games, from sorting and delivery to cooking and spooky searches. Messy scenes gradually become neat as you tap and drag your way through each one.
tips: Look over the whole scene before you start moving things, so you can spot which items belong together.
Group similar objects first, since sorting them into sets often makes the rest of the scene easier to finish.
Use tapping for quick single actions and dragging for moving items into place, and switch between them as the task calls for.
Each level uses a different theme, so pay attention to the instructions shown at the start before you begin.
When a puzzle feels stuck, check the parts you have already finished for clues about what still needs to be placed or delivered.
faq: What is the goal of SatisPuzzle Perfect Tidy?
The goal is to solve each level's small challenge, whether that is tidying a messy scene, completing a delivery, cooking a dish, or finding hidden items. Each theme has its own task.
How do I control the game?
Tap and drag to play. You click or tap to interact with objects and drag them to sort, organize, or move them into the right spots.

egg-thief.intro: Sneak past sleeping guardians, steal their eggs, and carry them home. Your pets earn coins that unlock new zones, from the snow to space.
tips: Use a gentle touch or a light Shift-hold when you are near a guardian. Sneaking keeps the noise down, and a guardian that stays asleep lets you grab the rare eggs.
Start with the common eggs at the edge of the nest to learn the guardian's pattern. Save the rare eggs under its nose for when you are sure of your timing.
Remember that rare eggs are heavy. Plan your route home so you are not caught while carrying one, and avoid sprinting when you need to stay quiet.
Watch for other thieves in the nest. When a guardian chases one of them, the eggs left behind are yours, so use that moment to grab a few.

Spend your coins on new zones as soon as you can afford them, since each zone brings a fresh setting and new challenges. Keep your collection growing so you can aim for higher rarities after a rebirth.
faq: What is the main goal of Egg Thief?
Steal eggs from sleeping guardians and bring them home before the guardian wakes up. Each egg you deliver hatches into a pet that earns coins.
How do I sneak and how do I run?
On mobile, a short drag sneaks quietly and a long drag runs. On desktop, hold Shift to sneak and use WASD or the arrow keys to move.

sort-the-beads.intro: Sort The Beads is a color-sorting puzzle where you move colorful beads into their matching containers. Each level gets harder as new colors, obstacles, and layouts appear.
tips: Look over the whole board before your first move so you can see which beads are blocking others.
Work on one color at a time and clear its path to the container before starting the next.
Avoid moves that block a path you will need later, since a jammed lane can cost you the level.
If a level stalls, step back and check which container still needs a certain color before tapping anything else.
Slow down on new levels, where extra colors and obstacles first appear, and build a habit of checking each move.
faq: What is the goal of Sort The Beads?
The goal is to move every bead into its correct container and clear the board. You finish a level once all colors are sorted.
How do I move the beads?
Tap or interact with the beads and objects that are available to move. Each move should take a matching color toward its container.

anime-girl-high-school-simulator.intro: Anime Girl High School Simulator lets you live a school day as an anime schoolgirl. You attend classes, take quizzes, join sports day, handle school missions, and explore the Sakura-themed campus.
tips: Use WASD to get around quickly, and hold Left Shift when you need to cross the campus fast between classes and activities.
Press I to check the controls list whenever you forget a key, since F is the action button you will use most for interacting with people and objects.
Keep an eye on your school missions and finish the ones tied to classes and friends first, so the story missions open up in a natural order.
Before you start a surprise quiz or a sports day activity, pause with P to look over your surroundings and plan your next move.
Try different outfits, hairstyles, and hair colors from the customization options to find a look you enjoy before you spend time exploring the school.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The game focuses on enjoying school life by attending classes, completing school missions, and taking part in sports day and love-story missions with classmates.
How do I move my character?
On desktop, use WASD to move and the mouse to move the camera. On mobile, use the joystick to move your player.

owl-hunter.intro: Owl Hunter is a slingshot game set in the forest of Willowvale. King Alden hunts owls hiding in blocks and barriers, and you must break through them using a limited supply of balls.
tips: Count your balls before each shot and look for the shot that can break several barriers at once.
Study how the blocks and barriers are arranged before you fire, so you can plan which one to hit first.
Avoid wasting shots on easy targets that don't lead to an owl, since your ammo is limited.
If a shot doesn't clear the way, adjust your next attempt instead of repeating the same aim.
Use the simple controls to take your time: a steady, deliberate shot usually beats a rushed one.
faq: What is the main goal of Owl Hunter?
Break through the blocks and barriers with your sling so you can reach and hunt the owls hidden inside them.
Why does the number of balls matter?
Balls are in limited quantities, so you need to use as few as possible while still clearing every barrier to finish the hunt.

sidefire.intro: SIDEFIRE is a tactical 2D side-view team shooter. You play 5v5 Team Deathmatch against bots on a multi-level factory map, and the first team to 40 kills or the leader after 5 minutes wins.
tips: Watch the scoreboard with Tab now and then so you know whether your team is ahead when the 5-minute timer runs out.
Use the different levels of Plant 7 to get height on enemies, and move between catwalks and scaffolding so you are not standing still in one open spot.
Crouch behind containers for cover when you are reloading or waiting for an enemy to come into view.
Aim down sights with right click for more precise shots, and save full-auto bursts for close range.
Pick a weapon that suits how you like to fight, and try attachments like optics and magazines to adjust it to your play style.
faq: How do I win a match?
Your team wins by reaching 40 kills first, or by being the leading team when the 5-minute time limit ends.
Which keys control movement and combat?
Use A and D to move, Space to jump, S to crouch, the mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to aim down sights, R to reload, and G to throw a grenade.

cat-hotel-24-7.intro: Cat Hotel 24/7 is a cozy isometric management game where you run a cat hotel, checking in guests, cleaning rooms and growing your business. The pace is relaxed, so focus on keeping guests happy and rooms ready.
tips: Watch for the yellow bell above guests and tap it quickly, since checking guests in is how the hotel starts earning.
Keep an eye out for the broom bubble above rooms and clean them as soon as it appears so the next guest can move in.
Spend early earnings on building new rooms on empty plots, because more rooms means more guests checking in at once.
Hire a receptionist and a housekeeper when the workload grows, so check-ins and cleaning keep up without you running everywhere.
Read the letters from neighbors and chat with your cat guests, since helping with their small requests is a good way to fill your album.
faq: What is the main goal of Cat Hotel 24/7?
You run a cat hotel by checking in guests, cleaning rooms and getting paid when guests check out. Over time you expand the hotel and build up your guest album.
How do I move the manager around?
Tap or click the floor to walk there, or hold and drag to steer. On desktop you can also use the arrow keys or WASD.

find-a-pair-3d.intro: Find a Pair 3D is a matching puzzle where you find two identical objects in a pile and merge them. Each merged pair earns a star, and later levels bring more varied items.
tips: Scan the whole pile before you start dragging, so you can spot matching shapes and colors across the screen.
Place objects on the round platforms one at a time and check what is already there before adding the next one.
Pay attention to small differences between similar items, since later levels include more diverse combinations.
Focus on finishing each level by finding all pairs, because the goal is to merge as many pairs as possible to build up stars.
If you are aiming for the leaderboard, try to keep a steady pace rather than rushing, since mistakes slow you down on harder levels.
faq: What is the goal of Find a Pair 3D?
The goal is to find two identical objects from the pile and merge them. Each successful pair earns one star, and you need to find all pairs to complete a level.
How do I move the objects?
Drag each object onto one of the round platforms at the bottom of the screen.

survival-island.intro: Survival Island is a tropical survival adventure where you gather wood and stone, craft tools, and build a base on a wild island. Resources are limited, so planning matters as much as exploring.
tips: Gather wood and stone early, since both are needed for building and crafting. Collect a steady supply before you start on bigger projects.
Craft and upgrade your tools as soon as you can. Better tools make gathering faster and help you keep up as the island gets harder.
Keep track of what you are running low on before you leave base. Heading out with a plan saves you from running out of key resources far from home.
Expand your territory in steps, building up your shelter first. A secure base makes it easier to explore new areas and return safely.
Spend upgrades on the abilities that help your current goal most. Focusing on one or two skills at a time is usually more effective than spreading points thinly.
faq: What is the main goal of Survival Island?
Your goal is to survive on the island by gathering resources, crafting items, and building a base you can keep improving. The game asks whether you can build your own paradise.
How do I move around the island?
Use the game's controls to move your character and explore. The instructions describe the controls as simple, so you can focus on gathering and building.

battle-simulator-sandbox.intro: Battle Simulator - Sandbox lets you build a custom army and test it against many scenarios or in open sandbox mode. This guide covers practical ways to plan your army and plan your battles.
tips: Use sandbox mode to test how different troop types perform against each other before you tackle a harder scenario.
Build a mixed army rather than relying on one type of troop, so you can respond to whatever the enemy brings.
Watch how each battle unfolds and note which troops struggled, then adjust your army for the next attempt.
Think about your strategy before you start, such as whether you want to overwhelm the enemy quickly or hold a defensive position.
Take time to learn the controls early, since quick and accurate commands make it easier to act on your plan during a fight.
faq: What is the main goal of Battle Simulator - Sandbox?
Your goal is to lead your custom army to victory in each challenge you face. Sandbox mode also lets you experiment freely with your troops.
How do I choose the right troops for my army?
Try a variety of troops in sandbox mode to see how they perform against different opponents. Then pick a combination that covers the weaknesses of your favorite units.

cubetopia-parkour.intro: Cubetopia Parkour is a parkour course of floating platforms that uses Minecraft-style physics. Success depends on precise timing and careful movement as you climb toward greater heights.
tips: Look ahead to the next platform before you leave the current one, so you can line up your jump early.
Because the physics feel like Minecraft, judge your momentum carefully and avoid running into jumps at full speed when a short hop is enough.
When a gap looks too wide, pause on the edge and study the landing spot before committing, rather than rushing the leap.
Practice tricky sections several times, noticing where your timing tends to go wrong, and adjust your next attempt based on that.
Keep your focus on the platforms directly ahead, since losing sight of the edge is one of the easiest ways to fall off the course.
faq: What is the main goal in Cubetopia Parkour?
The goal is to move through the course of floating platforms and reach greater heights without falling off. Each successful jump brings you closer to the top.
What makes the jumps in this game difficult?
Precise timing and careful control of movement are required, and the Minecraft-style physics mean your momentum carries through the air. Misjudging a jump by a little can send you off the platform.

last-archer.intro: Last Archer is an arcade defense game where you shoot arrows to stop monsters from reaching your tower. Aim carefully and use explosive barrels to clear groups of enemies.
tips: Watch where monsters enter and start aiming before they get close, so you have time to line up your shot.
Save explosive barrels for moments when several enemies are bunched together, since one hit can take out a group.
Keep an eye on the tower's condition and prioritize the monsters closest to reaching it.
Use the mouse or touch aim to make small adjustments rather than rushing your shots, because accuracy matters more than speed here.
Pay attention to how the physics of your arrows affect where they land, and adjust your aim based on what you see after each shot.
faq: What is the goal of Last Archer?
Your goal is to stop every monster before it reaches your tower and keep the fortress standing through the attacks.
How do I aim and fire arrows?
Use the mouse or touch controls to aim and fire your arrows at enemies and explosive barrels.

nextboot-horror-online.intro: NextBoot Horror Online is an adventure where you are trapped in a nightmarish place and must outsmart and outrun the boots that chase you. Move carefully, look around often, and keep your escape route in mind.
tips: Use the mouse to look around before you move into a new space, so you know where the boots are coming from.
Save Shift for moments when you really need to get away fast instead of holding it the whole time, so you can react when a threat appears.
Move with WASD or the arrow keys in short steps when you are unsure what is ahead, rather than rushing in blind.
Pay attention to the sound effects, since they can warn you that something is close before you see it.
Keep calm when the tension rises; stopping for a moment to check your surroundings often works better than panicking and running in circles.
faq: What is the main goal of NextBoot Horror Online?
Your objective is to outsmart and outrun the relentless boots that lurk around every corner while trapped in a nightmarish scenario.
How do I move and run in the game?
Use the arrow keys or the WASD keys to move, hold Shift to run, and use the mouse to look around.

lovely-virtual-cat-at-school.intro: Lovely Virtual Cat At School is a dress-up and creative game where you look after a virtual cat at school. You can dress your pet, paint, add stickers, and colour in pictures.
tips: Pick a theme first, such as the art room, so your costume and decorations fit together.
Try the colored pencils on a small area first to see how the colours blend before you commit to a larger part of your drawing.
Use the stickers to finish your creation once the painting is done, so you can place them without covering up detail you want to keep.
Use the coloring game when you want a calmer activity or a warm-up before making your own artwork.
Experiment with the fruit and vegetable decorations to create unusual looks you would not get from stickers alone.
faq: How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Click or tap on the tools, costumes, and decorations you want to use.
How do I dress up my cat?
Choose a costume from the many available, and start with a theme such as the art room. You can then change the outfit to suit your style.

jiffy.intro: Jiffy is a fast-paced retro platformer where you run, jump, and shoot your way to the end of each level. Timing matters, so learning the rhythm of jumps and shots is the key to getting further.
tips: Watch enemies for a few seconds before moving in so you can see their pattern and time your approach.
Use the double-tap jump shot sparingly at first, and fire when an enemy is directly in your path rather than wasting shots into empty space.
Break destructible blocks when they open a shortcut or a safer route, but check what is behind them before you commit to a jump.
Keep your jumps short and controlled when landing near hazards, since a rushed leap is the most common way to lose progress.
Treat boss fights as a pattern to learn: retry them calmly and note when the boss is most vulnerable.
faq: What is the goal of Jiffy?
Your goal is to reach the end of each level while overcoming obstacles and defeating enemies.
How do I shoot in Jiffy?
On desktop, press Spacebar more than once to shoot. On mobile, tap the jump button more than once.

good-guys-and-bad-boys-zombie-survival-g.intro: Good Guys & Bad Boys Zombie Survival GUI is a fast shooting game where you survive waves of zombies on the battlefield. You move, aim, switch guns, and jump to stay alive as enemies close in.
tips: Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, so zombies have a harder time closing in on you.
Aim with the mouse and fire in short bursts rather than holding the button, which helps you keep your shots on target.
Check your weapon menu with the Tab key between waves so you know which gun you have ready before enemies arrive.
Use the space bar to jump when you need to change position quickly or get out of a tight spot.
Pay attention to how close the enemies are at all times, and deal with the nearest threats first before they surround you.
faq: How do I move and aim my character?
Use W, A, S, and D to move around the battlefield. Aim with the mouse and click to shoot.
How do I switch between guns?
Press the Tab key to open the gun menu and choose the weapon you want to use.

food-tower-defense.intro: Food Tower Defense is a tower defense game where you place food towers in your kitchen to stop waves of hungry invaders from reaching your base. Each tower has its own attack style.
tips: Place long-range towers like the Burger Mortar and HotDog Sniper where they can reach enemies before they get close to your base.
Save close-range and surround-style towers, such as the Pizza 360° and Cookie Roll, for spots where enemies bunch up or come from several directions.
Try pairing towers near each other, since the description mentions combo effects like BBQ + Fries creating a Sizzling Combo Bonus.
Use the Turkey Wall to hold back invaders in a path while other towers keep damaging them.
Upgrade towers you already have in key positions instead of spreading your budget too thin across many weak ones.
faq: What is the goal of Food Tower Defense?
Your goal is to stop all the enemies from reaching your base by building and upgrading food towers. The game runs in Classic Mode with endless waves.
How do I place and upgrade towers?
Drag and drop a tower onto a spot to place it. Click on a tower to upgrade it.

stickman-punishment-2.intro: Stickman Punishment 2 is a funny arcade game where you hold Stickman accountable for setting you up. Watch the story, then choose how to punish him.
tips: Watch the full story animation before you choose a punishment, since it sets up why Stickman deserves what comes next.
Press each button to see every punishment Stickman has before you decide, so you can compare them instead of picking the first one.
Use your mouse for the cleanest control. On a touch screen, a finger or stylus works the same way.
Try different punishments in separate playthroughs to see which ones you find most entertaining, rather than rushing through them.
Take your time with each button press, since the game is built around exploring the options rather than racing against a clock.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Punishment 2?
The goal is to punish Stickman for setting you up. You do this by choosing one of the available punishments, using the unique superpower the game gives you.
How do I control the game?
Use your computer mouse. On a mobile device, use a stylus or your finger instead.

hugi-wugi.intro: Hugi Wugi is a 3D adventure where you run through a level to find the lucky block before time runs out. Hugi Wugi is chasing you, so you need to keep moving.
tips: Keep moving rather than stopping, since the description says Hugi Wugi is chasing you and pausing too long can let it catch up.
Use the mouse to rotate your view 360 degrees before you commit to a direction, so you can spot the lucky block early.
Keep an eye on the remaining time and plan your route toward the lucky block from the start.
Press P to pause when you need a moment to decide where to go next, then press it again to resume.
Use WASD for steady movement and avoid sudden direction changes that could cost you time.
faq: What is the goal of Hugi Wugi?
Find the lucky block before the time runs out and reach it to jump to the next level. Hugi Wugi may catch you if you are too slow.
How do I move my character?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to play. Move the mouse cursor to rotate the view a full 360 degrees.

boat-merge.intro: Boat Merge is an idle puzzle game about combining matching boats into faster, more valuable ones. Build your fleet, earn coins automatically, and work toward the highest-level boats.
tips: Merge boats as soon as you have two identical ones, since each higher-level boat earns more coins once it is on a route.
Spend coins on new boats and upgrades in a steady rhythm rather than all at once, so your fleet keeps growing while you earn.
Check your tasks regularly, because completing them is one of the main ways to keep moving forward.
Save boosters for moments when you want to speed up progress, such as when you are waiting for coins to build up for a big purchase.
Expand your waterways when you can afford it, since more routes give your boats more places to earn.
faq: How do I merge two boats?
Click and drag one identical boat onto another with the mouse, or tap and drag with one finger on touch screens. The two boats combine into a higher-level boat.
How do I earn coins?
Place boats on available routes and coins are earned automatically over time. You then use those coins to buy more boats and upgrades.

soccer-random.intro: Soccer Random is a one-key football game for one or two players. Each side uses a single key to try to score five goals, while the field, ball, players and goal posts keep changing.
tips: Take a moment to check the ball, player and goal posts after each change, since the setup can shift without warning.
On an icy field or a beach, test a few short presses before committing to a big push so you learn how the surface affects your movement.
Your single key is your only control, so time your presses rather than holding or mashing them to avoid wasting chances.
When playing against a friend, agree on who uses which key before the match starts so the controls are clear from the first kick.
Stay focused after each goal, because the next round can look different and the early moments often decide who gets the first chance.
faq: How do I win Soccer Random?
The goal is to score five goals before your opponent does, even though the balls, players and goal posts can change during play.
What keys do I use?
Player 1 uses the W key and Player 2 uses the Up Arrow key. On touch devices, you can play using touch controls instead.

break-and-steal-eggs.intro: Break and Steal Eggs is a 3D arcade game about smashing eggs, grabbing the pets that hatch, and racing them home past the zone guard. Build your pen, upgrade your pickaxe, and push into farther zones.
tips: Break eggs in a zone long enough to build up your luck, since that is what gives you a chance at rarer pets.
Head home right after you grab a pet. The zone guard and other players can catch you, so keep moving toward your base.
Use the bat to stun rivals who are carrying pets you want, then steal those pets back to your pen.
Spend your earnings on stronger pickaxes and more speed so you can reach farther zones.
Merge three pets into a stronger one when you have duplicates, so your pen earns more over time.
faq: How do I grab a pet after it hatches?
Hold E near the pet that jumps out of the egg. Press R to drop it if you need to put it down.
How do I earn money?
Place your pets in your pen and money is earned every second. Buying stronger pickaxes and more speed helps you reach farther zones.

join-the-gang-and-fight.intro: Join the Gang and Fight is a physics-based multiplayer brawler where stickman fighters battle in wobbly ragdoll arenas. Team up with friends and try several event modes, each with its own goal.
tips: Since physics make every fight unpredictable, watch how your stickman wobbles before committing to a move. Positioning often matters more than the hit itself.
Try each event at least once, since Brawl, Kick the King, Steal the Chicken, Racing, and Football all reward different skills.
In Steal the Chicken and Kick the King, keep an eye on where the objective is and where your gang is, so you can support each other instead of fighting alone.
Use your punches and kicks in short bursts and watch the results before repeating them, because ragdoll reactions can send you flying off balance.
Playing with friends in a gang makes coordination easier, so agree on a target or objective before each round starts.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The goal is to knock out opponents and win each event, whether that is a brawl, a race, a football match, or another mode. Each event sets its own objective.
How do I control my stickman?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use clicks to launch punches, kicks, and other ragdoll moves during the match.

tile-pair-jam-mahjong-master.intro: Tile Pair Jam is a sliding mahjong puzzle where you shift rows and columns to line up identical tiles. Each board gets harder, so planning a few moves ahead helps you clear every tile.
tips: Before each swipe, look for identical tiles that already share a row or column and check whether anything sits between them.
Clear the tiles that are blocking others first, since a cleared path can open up several matches at once.
Avoid sliding a row or column in a way that splits up a pair you could have matched on the next move.
Look at the whole board for tiles that appear only once or twice, and plan to bring those pairs together early.
If you get stuck, think about which move would bring a tile into line with its match, rather than trying random swipes.
faq: How do I move the tiles?
Swipe up, down, left, or right to shift tiles along a row or column. Tiles cannot move diagonally.
When are two tiles removed?
Two identical tiles are removed when they sit in the same row or column with no other tile between them.

magic-castle-invasion-idle-rpg.intro: Magic Castle Invasion is an idle RPG where you defend your castle as a wizard. Move with WASD or the joystick, and your character attacks enemies nearby on its own.
tips: Because your wizard attacks nearby enemies automatically, focus your attention on positioning. Move to where monsters are gathering so your attacks reach them.
Spend your progress on magical upgrades steadily rather than all at once. Stronger abilities make later monsters and bosses much easier to handle.
Use exploration to find hidden treasures and pick up quests, since both help you progress. Checking the map regularly keeps you from missing useful rewards.
Build and strengthen your castle as you go, because it is the core of your defense. A well-defended castle protects you while you explore dungeons.
Before taking on a boss fight, gather your team of magical helpers and upgrade your wizard. Entering a boss battle underpowered is the most common reason to lose progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Magic Castle Invasion?
You play as a wizard defending your castle from monsters, and the aim is to survive. Upgrading your wizard and castle helps you last longer against stronger enemies.
Do I need to aim or press attack manually?
No. The character attacks nearby enemies automatically, so your main job is moving with WASD or the on-screen joystick to stay in range of threats.

boing-bang.intro: Boing Bang is a retro arcade game where you control a quirky creature with a blaster. You move through bouncing chaos, shatter large balls into smaller pieces, and use platforms to stay safe.
tips: Watch how the big balls bounce before you shoot, since their patterns are unpredictable and timing matters.
Shatter large balls early while you have room to move, so the smaller pieces do not catch you in tight spaces.
Use platforms to get above the bouncing action and reposition yourself rather than standing still on the ground.
Make every shot count by aiming at the balls that threaten you most, instead of firing constantly at whatever is nearby.
Stay calm during busy moments and keep moving, because survival depends on avoiding collisions as much as hitting targets.
faq: What is the main goal in Boing Bang?
You control a creature with a blaster and aim to shatter massive bouncing balls into pieces while surviving the chaos on screen.
How do I deal with the bouncing balls?
Shoot the big balls to break them into smaller pieces, and pay attention to their bounce patterns so you can predict where they will go next.

baby-supermarket.intro: Baby Supermarket is a shopping game where Baby and Mommy Panda visit the biggest supermarket in town. You pick your favorite panda and help them shop in an animal's supermarket, alone or with friends and family.
tips: Choose the panda you like best before you start, since you can help either Baby Panda or Mommy Panda with the shopping.
Take turns with friends or family if you are playing together, so everyone gets a chance to guide the shopping.
Move slowly and check each part of the store before you click or tap, so you do not rush past what you need.
Keep both hands free for a mouse or touchscreen if you can, so your clicks and taps stay steady and accurate.
Play in short sessions and try the store again later, since revisiting the same shopping trip can help you learn where things are.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Supermarket?
The goal is to help your chosen panda do the shopping at the biggest supermarket in town. The game is about enjoying the shopping trip with Baby and Mommy Panda.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to play. Click or tap on the items and areas you want to interact with.

boo-brew.intro: Boo Brew is a Halloween puzzle game where you run a witch's potion café. Match ingredients, stir brews, and serve monster customers before their patience runs out.
tips: Check which customer is waiting and what they want before you start adding ingredients, so you don't have to dump a mixture and start over.
Use DUMP to reset a mixture that has gone wrong rather than serving something you know won't match the order.
Stir after adding ingredients, using the STIR button, Space, or Enter, so the brew is ready when you tap a customer.
Watch the patience of each customer and serve the ones closest to leaving first, since they can't wait long.
Build combos by serving matching potions in quick succession, which is the main way to build toward rainbow fever.
faq: What is the goal of Boo Brew?
Brew the potions customers ask for and serve them before their patience runs out. Get through all 12 midnight shifts while keeping customers happy.
How do I add ingredients to the cauldron?
Tap an ingredient or drag it into the cauldron with the mouse or touch. On a keyboard, keys 1 to 6 add ingredients.

cuphead-rush.intro: Cuphead Rush is an endless 2D runner where you guide a Cuphead character through dangerous areas, dodging spikes and rockets. Collect stars and power-ups to unlock new characters and beat your best score.
tips: Keep your eyes a step ahead of your character so you can plan your jump, slide, or roll before an obstacle reaches you.
Learn which obstacles need a jump and which need a slide or roll, and react early rather than at the last moment.
Grab stars whenever it is safe to do so, since they are needed to unlock new characters.
Pick up power-ups and boosters when they appear, but do not take risky detours just to reach them.
Play several short runs in a row to learn the patterns of obstacles, then try to beat your previous best score.
faq: What is the main goal of Cuphead Rush?
The goal is to keep running through the dangerous environments for as long as possible while avoiding spikes and rockets. Because the game is endless, you aim to beat your best score.
How do I unlock new characters?
Collect stars during your runs and use them to unlock new characters.

half-life-2-platformer.intro: Half Life 2: Platformer is an illustrated action platformer where you guide Gordon Freeman through five chapters. You fight the Combine using a crowbar, an SMG, and a gravity gun.
tips: Use the mouse click or tap to play, and get comfortable with the controls in the first chapter before moving on to harder sections.
Save the crowbar for close encounters and use the SMG when enemies are further away, so you do not get caught in melee.
Treat the gravity gun as a problem-solver as well as a weapon, and look for objects in the environment that you can use to clear threats or reach higher ground.
Pause to scan each area before you move forward so you can spot enemies and platforms ahead of you.
Play the five chapters in order, since each one builds on the last and the difficulty rises as you progress.
faq: How do I play Half Life 2: Platformer?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. The game is controlled with these simple inputs as you move through each chapter.
What weapons does Gordon Freeman use?
Gordon uses three weapons: the crowbar, the SMG, and the gravity gun. Each one is suited to different situations during the fights against the Combine.

residence-of-evil-quarantine.intro: Survive a zombie outbreak in an infected city and uncover the truth behind the deadly virus. You will fight through monsters using a range of weapons, grenades, and melee attacks.
tips: Use Mouse 2 to aim before you fire, since precise shots conserve ammo better than rapid fire.
Press R to reload during a lull rather than in the middle of a fight, so you are not caught with an empty weapon.
Keep grenades (G) for groups of monsters or dangerous spots, and save melee attacks (V) for when you are low on ammo.
Use Left Shift to sprint between encounters, and crouch or go prone with Left Ctrl or X when you need a lower profile.
Press F to use items when you need them, and check your holstered weapon with H so you know what you are carrying before a fight.
faq: What is the goal of Residence of Evil: Quarantine?
You fight your way through the infected city and discover the truth about the deadly virus outbreak.
Which keys control shooting and aiming?
Mouse 1 fires your weapon and Mouse 2 aims. Use Block to hold your position if needed.

ultimate-lawn-mowing-simulator-mower-mas.intro: Mow lawns of different sizes and shapes using swipe controls, then cover every patch of grass to finish each job. Finished jobs earn rewards that unlock better mowers.
tips: Before you start, look at the whole lawn and plan a route that covers it in neat, overlapping rows so no patch is missed.
Check the corners and edges near the end of each job, since they are easy to skip and must be cut before the job is complete.
Compare your mower types before each job and pick the one that suits the size and shape of the area, especially when the lawn has tight corners.
Move slowly through tight spots so you can control the mower and avoid cutting back over grass you have already finished.
Spend your earned rewards on the mower upgrades that will help you with the jobs you find hardest.
faq: What is the goal of each job?
Your goal is to cut all the grass on the lawn by covering every patch. Once the job is fully mowed, it is complete.
How do I control the mower?
Swipe on the screen to move your mower. The swipe gestures are the only movement control described in the instructions.

go-octopus-find-pearl.intro: Go Octopus Find Pearl is a puzzle game where you guide a small octopus through the deep sea to collect gems. Each level asks you to pick a safe route past obstacles and creatures.
tips: Look at the whole level before you move so you can see where the gems are and which paths look blocked.
Plan your route in short steps, checking after each move whether a creature or obstacle is nearby.
If you get stuck, go back a step and try a different path rather than repeating the same moves.
Keep an eye on dangerous creatures and move when they are at a safe distance, rather than rushing past them.
Collect the gems in an order that keeps your path clear, so you do not block your own way back.
faq: What is the goal of Go Octopus Find Pearl?
Your goal is to collect all the gems in each level by choosing the right path through the deep sea.
How do I move the octopus?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys to move in each direction.

xtreme-motorbikes-rider.intro: Xtreme Motorbikes Rider is a bike game set in busy city streets and an open world. You can join racing battles, perform stunts, and customize your motorbike.
tips: Try a few short rides in the open world before starting races, so you can get a feel for how the realistic physics affect your bike.
Pay attention to how your bike handles at speed, since weight and momentum matter more when the physics are realistic.
Use the open-world streets to practice stunts in quiet areas before attempting them during a busy race.
Customize your bike with an eye toward the kind of riding you do most, whether that is racing or performing stunts.
Stay focused in crowded city areas, because racing battles can be more demanding when traffic and turns come up quickly.
faq: What is the main goal of Xtreme Motorbikes Rider?
The game centers on speeding through city environments, taking part in racing battles, and performing stunts on your motorbike. You can also customize your bike as you play.
Does the game have realistic physics?
Yes, the description says the game uses realistic physics, so your bike's movement and balance should respond in a believable way. Practicing at different speeds helps you learn how it reacts.

the-long-way-home.intro: You are alone in a damaged suit with limited fuel and oxygen, trying to reach Earth across a long stretch of space. Every burn is a choice, so plan your route before you move.
tips: Use planets' gravity to swing yourself onward before you spend fuel on a burn.
Keep your engine taps short, since fuel cannot be replaced once it is gone.
Use STOP early when you need to slow down, because it is the only way to brake out here.
Open the planning map and set a destination so your scanner acts as a compass.
Use DRIFT to sidestep rock and pass debris fields slowly instead of hitting them at speed.
faq: What is the main goal?
Reach Earth before your oxygen runs out, then repeat the trip while carrying cargo.
How do I slow down?
Press STOP or X, which flips you around and burns retrograde to brake your ship.

flip-trickster-parkour-simulator.intro: Flip Trickster is a parkour game set in urban landscapes, where you perform flips and stunts and aim for clean landings. Its physics and rising difficulty reward careful timing.
tips: Watch your jump arc before committing to a flip, since the physics make the landing spot predictable once you have seen a few jumps.
Practice a single flip or stunt on your own until you can land it consistently before chaining moves together.
Time your landing rather than rushing it, because a well-timed touchdown is the main goal of each jump.
Learn the controls by trying small movements first, so you know how much input a flip needs before harder levels arrive.
When a level becomes difficult, slow down and plan your route through the urban setting instead of repeating the same failed jump.
faq: What is the main goal of Flip Trickster?
Your aim is to perform flips and stunts and land them cleanly as you move through the urban levels. Each level gets harder as you progress.
What makes a good landing in this game?
Good landings depend on timing, so you need to time your flip so you come down at the right moment. The game's realistic physics affect how each jump plays out.

quizmasters.intro: QuizMasters is a trivia quiz-show game where you pick the correct answer from four options to climb a prize ladder. Each correct answer brings you closer to the grand reward, and you can also challenge other players.
tips: Read each question all the way through before choosing, since the four options are designed to test careful thinking.
Answer quickly but stay focused, because the questions get harder as you move up the prize ladder.
Keep track of which topics you answer confidently and which you miss, so you can notice where you need to focus.
Save your cash and crystals for unlocking new collections rather than spending them without a plan.
Try a few head-to-head trivia battles to see how your knowledge compares with other players.
faq: How do I move up in QuizMasters?
Each correct answer moves you higher on the prize ladder and closer to the grand reward. Choose one answer from the four options for each question.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes. Each level becomes harder, and the questions become more difficult as you progress.

stampede-evolution.intro: Stampede Evolution is a 3D nature platformer where you lead a growing herd through changing biomes. Run, jump, and steer through gates to grow your herd and evolve into bigger animals.
tips: Plan your route ahead of time. Look for green gates to grow the herd and avoid red ones, since the wrong gate can shrink it.
Use blue upgrade boards when you can. Picking the right upgrade can help your herd through the harder parts of a level.
Keep your herd large before you reach the finish arch. The goal is to arrive with as many animals as you can, so gate choices matter as much as speed.
Spend time walking around camp to level up. Evolving into bigger animals is part of getting stronger for the later biomes.
In Stampede mode, focus on dodging walls and water as the pace increases. Staying steady matters more than rushing, because the run keeps getting faster and wilder.
faq: What is the main goal of each level?
Reach the finish arch with as many animals in your herd as you can. Earning three stars on every level is also part of the challenge.
How do I control my herd?

On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys, or drag with the left mouse button to move, and press Space or right-click to jump. On mobile, use the left thumb as a joystick and tap JUMP or the right side of the screen to jump.

gun-festival-shoot.intro: Gun Festival Shoot is a fast arcade shooter where you chase robbers through 3D levels, using math gates to build your firepower. Stop the heist before it gets away.
tips: Before you pass through a barrier, check whether it multiplies or reduces your firepower and choose the path that gives you the bigger gain.
Keep an eye on the obstacles ahead so you can dodge them early instead of reacting at the last moment.
Watch how your firepower changes after each barrier, since a few reductions can cancel out earlier gains.
Save your strongest firepower for boss fights, where you will need the most damage to win.
Keep firing steadily, because the game rewards constant pressure on the robbers as you pursue them.
faq: What is the main goal of Gun Festival Shoot?
You pursue the robbers through each 3D level, defeat bosses, and stop the heist. Staying alive while you chase them is the core challenge.
How do the barriers affect the game?
Barriers either multiply or diminish your firepower, so you use math to decide which ones will make your arsenal stronger. Choosing carefully is a key part of doing well.

skating-hero.intro: Skating Hero is a sports game about gliding across the ice through three events. Your goal is to pull off figure-skating moves with good timing and earn high scores.
tips: Learn the timing of each event before chasing a high score, since precise timing is central to this game.
Watch how your skater responds in the first moments of each event so you can judge when to make your next move.
Focus on one event at a time, and avoid switching too fast until you are comfortable with its rhythm.
Stay calm and keep your reactions steady, because the game rewards precise reflexes over rushed inputs.
Use your early attempts to build up your skater's skills, then aim for cleaner runs to push your score higher.
faq: What is the main goal in Skating Hero?
The goal is to perform figure-skating moves across three events and reach high scores through precise timing and reflexes.
How do I improve my score?
Focus on timing your moves accurately and build your skater's skills over repeated attempts, aiming for cleaner runs each time.

holemart.intro: HoleMart is an arcade game where you control a growing hole in a busy market. Swallow objects, get bigger, and clear the whole area.
tips: Start with the tiny goods near your hole, since they grow you quickly and make the bigger items reachable sooner.
Before heading for a large shelf or cart, check whether your hole is big enough to swallow it, so you don't waste time circling it.
Sweep through one section of the market at a time instead of zigzagging, so you don't leave small items scattered behind you.
Keep a steady rhythm of swallowing small objects as you move, because each one you take adds to your size.
Save your largest moves for the end of a level, when the remaining objects are the bigger ones that need a bigger hole.
faq: What is the goal of HoleMart?
The goal is to keep swallowing objects until the market is completely cleared. Growing bigger helps you finish faster.
How does my hole get bigger?
Absorb smaller objects, and the more items you swallow, the larger your hole becomes.

train-puzzle.intro: Train Puzzle is a logic game about building a railway. Slide and rotate the tracks on the grid so your train can reach the finish line without running into dead ends.
tips: Before you move anything, trace the route from the train to the finish line. Look for the track pieces that must connect to make a clear path.
Check every track end for a dead end before you lock in a piece. A piece that looks right on its own can block the whole route.
Focus first on the tracks closest to the train, since its path starts there. Working outward from the start keeps the layout easier to follow.
Make one change at a time and watch how the route shifts. Small, deliberate moves are easier to undo than a series of quick clicks.
If you get stuck, step back and look for pieces that only fit one way. Solving those first often reveals the rest of the path.
faq: What is the goal of Train Puzzle?
Your goal is to slide and rotate the tracks so the train and its wagons can travel across the grid to the finish line.
How do I move the tracks?
Use mouse clicks or taps to slide and rotate the track pieces on the grid.

tic-tac-toe-multiplayer-x-o.intro: Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer X O is a two-player take on the classic X and O game on a 3x3 grid. Players face off in quick, tactical matches to outwit each other.
tips: Take the center square early when it is open, since it belongs to more winning lines than any other square.
Always check whether your opponent has two marks in a row with an empty third square, and block it before building your own line.
Look for forks: a move that creates two separate winning threats at once is very hard for your rival to stop.
Think one or two moves ahead by asking where your opponent will go after each of your choices.
Keep matches short and focused, since the board is small and each move can change the outcome quickly.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to place three of your marks, X or O, in a straight line across a row, column, or diagonal on the 3x3 grid before your rival does.
What should I do if my opponent is about to win?
Block the empty square in their line right away, because a missed block usually ends the match on their next turn.

marble-maze.intro: Marble Maze is a head-to-head 3D maze puzzle. Swipe to roll your marble and paint every open tile, and race your rival to finish more mazes before the timer runs out.
tips: Before each swipe, scan the board for dark unpainted tiles and pick the direction that will carry your marble over the most of them.
Remember that the marble keeps rolling until it hits a wall, so plan where it will stop, not just where it will start.
Leave yourself a path back to unpainted areas, since a roll that cuts off a section can leave tiles you have to come back for.
Keep an eye on the 90-second timer and pace yourself so you finish more mazes than your opponent.
Use the lightbulb hint when you are stuck, but remember it costs 50 coins, so save it for tricky spots.
faq: How do I win a round?
Finish more mazes than your opponent before the 90-second timer runs out. Each maze is complete once every open tile is painted.
Is there a finish line I need to reach?
No. There is no finish line, so the maze is done only when the whole board is painted.

perfect-wax-3d.intro: Perfect Wax 3D is a hypercasual game about timing and precision. You play a barber who gathers hair, dodges obstacles, and moves the hair onto a bald head.
tips: Focus on timing before speed. The game rewards precise moves, so a slower, cleaner run usually beats a rushed one.
Keep an eye on obstacles as you collect hair. Plan your route so you pick up hair without running into hazards that could cost you progress.
Practice the transplant step until it feels natural. Getting hair onto the bald head accurately is the core of each attempt.
Since the controls are simple, spend your attention on reading the layout ahead rather than on complicated inputs.
Play in short sessions and retry quickly. Each attempt teaches you more about timing and where obstacles tend to appear.
faq: What is the goal of Perfect Wax 3D?
You play as a barber collecting hair, avoiding obstacles, and transplanting your hair onto a bald head.
How hard is Perfect Wax 3D?
The game focuses on precision and timing, so it can take a few tries to get the rhythm of collecting and transplanting hair.

mr-bullet-3d-online.intro: Mr Bullet 3D is a 3D shooting game where you aim and fire Mr Bullet at agents across more than 15 normal levels, then take on the harder Hostage mode. Plan each shot carefully, since bounces and ammo both matter.
tips: Before you fire, look at the walls and surfaces around the target so you can plan a bounce shot instead of aiming straight at the agent.
Count your shots before you start a level and use the ammo you have on the agents that are hardest to reach directly.
Test small angles early in a level to learn how your shots rebound, then apply that pattern to the trickier targets.
Finish the normal mode first, since the Hostage mode is described as much more demanding and builds on what you learn there.
Collect the kizkoins you come across, because they are used to unlock rewards.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim and click to shoot, or touch the screen to point and shoot. Aim carefully, because each shot uses ammunition.
What makes a level hard?
Levels require you to calculate angles and rebounds while managing your limited ammunition to eliminate every agent. Planning your shots before firing is the key skill.

super-bike-racing.intro: Super Bike Racing is an arcade racing game where you ride a superbike along fast tracks with tight turns, steep hills and open plains. Complete the challenges, pick a bike design and race to win.
tips: Use the arrow keys to steer your bike smoothly rather than making sudden changes, especially on tight turns.
Slow down slightly before sharp bends so you can keep control and stay on the track.
Watch the terrain ahead: steep hills and open plains call for different handling, so adjust your speed before you reach them.
Try a few different bike designs and see which one feels best for your riding style before you commit to a race.
Replay the tracks you find hardest, focusing on one section at a time, until you can get through them consistently.
faq: How do I control the bike?
You control the bike with the arrow keys. Tap the screen to start the game as shown in the instructions.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to run through the tracks at high speed, complete the challenges and win the race.

shadow-fights.intro: Shadow Fights is a 2D fighting game for one or two players, decided over three rounds. Blue and Orange each control a shadow fighter with their own key set.
tips: Learn both attacks early: Punch and Kick have different keys for each player, so practice them until you can use them without looking down.
Dodge before you attack. Watching your opponent's stance and stepping back for a moment can stop their hit and open a gap for your own.
Use short bursts of punches rather than button mashing, since you need to stay ready to move between exchanges.
Keep track of the round count. The match is three rounds, so a lost opening round means you must win the next two, which can change how cautious you play.
In two-player matches, take turns trying different approaches with a friend to see how the other player reacts to your moves.
faq: What is the goal of Shadow Fights?
The goal is to beat your opponent and win the fight. The description says the fight will only have one winner, decided across three rounds.
Which keys control the Blue player?
Blue moves with W, A, S and D, punches with F and kicks with G.

idle-airport-tycoon.intro: Idle Airport Tycoon is a simulation game where you build and manage an airport, starting from a small airstrip and growing it into a busy travel hub. You upgrade planes and terminals and unlock new revenue streams to raise your profits.
tips: Check your upgrade options regularly, since planes and terminals are the main parts of the airport you can improve.
Spend your profits with a plan rather than all at once, so you can afford the upgrades that matter most at each stage.
Look for new revenue streams as they become available, because adding income sources helps your airport grow faster.
Use the + and - keys to zoom the camera in and out so you can see your whole airport layout or focus on a specific area.
Use the left mouse button to interact with the on-screen menus, and return to them often to see what you can afford next.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Airport Tycoon?
The goal is to grow a small airstrip into a world-class travel hub and become the busiest airport in the world. You do this by upgrading your airport and increasing your profits.
How do I control the game?
Use the left mouse button to interact with the in-game menus and UI. Use the + and - keys to change the size of the camera view.

music-tools.intro: Music Tools lets you play piano, guitar, and drums while you experiment with sounds and rhythms. Build your own compositions and see how you rank on the online leaderboards.
tips: Try each instrument, piano, guitar, and drums, before settling on one. Each one has its own feel, so you may find a favorite.
Start with a simple rhythm and build from it. Adding one sound at a time makes it easier to hear what each change does.
Experiment with different sounds on the same melody. Small changes in tone can make a composition feel very different.
Record or repeat the sections you like most so you can compare versions. This helps you notice what works in your compositions.
If you are new to music, focus on keeping a steady rhythm before adding complexity. If you are more experienced, try layering instruments to create fuller pieces.
faq: What is the goal of Music Tools?
The game is built around creating your own compositions with piano, guitar, and drums. Experimenting with sounds and rhythms is the main activity.
How do I score points or climb the leaderboards?
The description mentions online leaderboards but does not explain how scores are earned. Try the game's features and check the on-screen display for score details.

dead-paradise.intro: Dead Paradise is a 3D apocalyptic racing shooter where you drive and fire at enemies at the same time. Finish each level while surviving the attacks, then spend coins on upgrades in the garage.
tips: Keep your car moving with the up arrow, but ease off with the down arrow when enemies bunch up in front of you so you can line up shots.
Use the z key to adjust your firing direction before you commit to a missile with x, since missiles are your heaviest hits.
Save the space bar nitro for stretches where you need to pull away from pursuers or reach the finish quickly, rather than spending it early.
Pick upgrades based on how you struggle: choose armor if you take too much damage, missile upgrades if fights last too long, and engine or fuel upgrades if you fall behind.
Remember that finishing the race is only half the goal, so watch your health between enemy waves rather than focusing only on the finish line.
faq: What is the main goal of Dead Paradise?
You need to finish each race level while also surviving the enemies that chase you in all sorts of vehicles. Finishing the race alone is not enough.
How do I shoot while driving?
Steer and accelerate with the arrow keys, then fire missiles with the x key. Use the z key to adjust your firing direction.

flows.intro: Flows is a calm logic puzzle where you pour colored liquids between flasks until each one holds a single color or stays empty. Work through 40 levels at your own pace.
tips: Before each pour, look at what sits beneath the top color of both flasks. A color buried under another can only be reached after the one above it moves.
Empty flasks are your most useful space. Moving a top color into an empty flask can free up the color underneath it.
Gather one color at a time. Consolidating a color into a single flask makes the rest of the level easier to read.
If you get stuck, try undoing your thinking by tracing back which pours you made first, then look for a different order rather than repeating the same moves.
Use the hint if a level stops making sense, and remember that finishing quickly matters only if you want to compare times on a level's leaderboard.
faq: What is the goal of Flows?
You win a level when every flask contains only one color or is completely empty. Pour colors between flasks until that is true.
How do I pour a color?
Tap one flask, then tap a second flask to pour the top-most color into it. On desktop, use mouse clicks; on mobile, use taps.

hospital-surgeon-doctor-game.intro: Hospital Surgeon: Doctor Game is a simulation where you diagnose patients and complete surgeries across heart, emergency, dental, eye, ENT, and orthopedic cases. You work with medical tools under time and decision pressure.
tips: Read the diagnosis carefully before you pick up any tool, since each case starts with figuring out what the patient needs.
Follow the on-screen instructions step by step instead of rushing ahead, because each surgery is completed in a set order.
Take your time with the drag motion when moving tools, and keep a steady hand so you do not undo progress in the procedure.
Pay attention to patient condition as the case goes on, and prioritize the most critical issue when several problems appear.
Try different departments to build a broader set of skills, since each one brings a new kind of challenge.
faq: What is the basic goal of the game?
Your goal is to diagnose patients, complete surgeries, and help them recover while building your career as a doctor. Each case you finish successfully moves you forward.
How do I control the surgical tools?
You tap and drag medical tools to carry out each step of the operation. Follow the on-screen instructions to know which tool to use and where.

evade.intro: EVADE is a car chase game where you deliver packages around a city while police pursue you. Lose the cops, reach each drop point, and then move on to the next job.
tips: Shake off the police before you head to a drop point, since you can't deliver while they are still chasing you.
Save Shift boost for straight stretches or getting clear of a pursuer, so you don't run out of control on tight turns.
Use Space handbrake to whip the car around corners quickly when a cop is closing in behind you.
Keep an eye on where the police are coming from and steer away from dead ends where you could get boxed in.
Plan your route to the drop point early, so you can lose the chase on the way instead of circling back with cops still on your tail.
faq: What is the main goal in EVADE?
Drive to each drop point to deliver the package, but only after you have lost the police chasing you. Completing a drop lets you move on to the next job.
Why can't I make a delivery during a chase?
The game does not let you complete a drop while police are still on your tail. You need to shake them off first, then drive to the drop point.

transport-tycoon-deluxe-open-ttd.intro: Transport Tycoon Deluxe - Open TTD is a strategy puzzler about building and managing transport networks. You combine land, sea, and air routes with different vehicles to grow your transport empire.
tips: Plan your network before you build it so that routes connect logically instead of overlapping wastefully.
Use a mix of land, sea, and air routes where each one makes sense, rather than relying on a single transport type.
Pay attention to how efficient each route is, since efficiency is one of the main things that drives your overall rating.
Try different vehicles on the same route to see which combination gives you the best results for your empire.
Expand gradually, checking that your existing network runs well before adding new routes.
faq: What is the main goal of Transport Tycoon Deluxe?
The goal is to build and manage transport networks that boost your transport empire's efficiency and rating. The game encourages you to keep expanding your business over time.
How do I improve my rating?
Your rating improves when your transport network runs efficiently. Focus on well-planned routes and choose vehicles that suit each route.

portal.intro: Portal is a hyper casual game where you guide a ball to safety while dodging a relentless black hole. Physics-based puzzles and quick reactions are needed to get through each new level.
tips: Watch the black hole's pull for a few seconds before you move, so you can spot a safe path instead of reacting late.
Plan your route through the level before committing, since physics-based puzzles often reward a smooth, deliberate path over rushed moves.
Make small, precise adjustments rather than large ones, which helps you stay clear of the black hole's grasp.
Expect each level to introduce something new, so pause to read the layout and figure out what has changed before you start.
If you fail a level, restart and try a different approach rather than repeating the same move that sent the ball into danger.
faq: What is the goal of Portal?
Your goal is to guide the ball to safety while avoiding the black hole. Each level presents a new challenge that tests your reflexes and precision.
How does the game test my skills?
It combines quick reactions with physics-based puzzles, so you need to both move fast and think ahead. Careful planning is as important as speed.

life-of-a-tree.intro: Life of a Tree is a 2D puzzle game for one player that teaches how trees grow, survive, and support the world around them. It is played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Read each screen carefully before you click, since the game is built around learning about how trees grow and survive.
Take notes on the facts you notice, such as how a tree changes over time, so you can recall them later.
Try different clicks or taps on the same area to see what responds, which helps you understand how each part of the tree works.
Play slowly and think about why each stage of a tree's life happens, rather than rushing to finish.
Come back after a break and replay parts you found confusing, because the puzzles build on the ideas about tree life.
faq: How do I control the game?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. No other controls are listed in the instructions.
What is the main goal?
The game aims to help you learn how trees grow, survive, and contribute to the natural world while you solve puzzles.

zombie-raft.intro: Zombie Raft is a survival racing game where you steer a raft ahead of a zombie tsunami. You protect yourself and other survivors, push forward across the barren land, and rescue any stranded survivors you find.
tips: Keep moving forward, since the goal is to get away from the zombie tsunami and conquer the barren land.
Watch for stranded survivors as you travel and rescue them when you spot them, because they are part of your job on the raft.
Use short, deliberate clicks or taps and watch how your raft responds before making bigger moves.
Pay attention to the vehicles ahead of you, since you may need to squeeze through them or push them when necessary.
Keep your focus on the tsunami behind you so you can react early instead of being caught off guard.
faq: What is the main goal in Zombie Raft?
Your goal is to survive on the raft, escape the zombie tsunami, and keep going across the barren land. Rescuing stranded survivors is also part of your responsibility.
How do I control the raft?
You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen. Use these inputs to move forward, squeeze past vehicles, and push them when needed.

fps-gun-shooting-game-3d.intro: FPS Gun Shooting Game 3D is a first-person shooter where you lead a commando unit against terrorist enemies. You can play offline or online multiplayer, and you progress by increasing your player level and unlocking stronger weapons.
tips: Use Shift with the arrow keys to sprint between cover, and move at normal speed when you need to be quiet or precise.
Save the G key bomb for groups of enemies or spots where several shooters are hiding, rather than using it on a single target.
Use left mouse to zoom in before a long-range shot, especially during sniper missions, and fire with the right mouse button once your aim is steady.
Jump with the spacebar only when you need to get over an obstacle or change position, since jumping can throw off your aim.
Keep your team safe by checking the battlefield before you advance, and reposition when you spot enemies approaching from a new direction.
faq: How do I shoot and aim in this game?
Press the right mouse button to shoot and the left mouse button to zoom in and aim. Zooming first makes it easier to hit distant enemies.
How do I move faster?
Hold Shift and press the arrow keys to move faster or sprint. Use normal movement when you need more control over your position.

ultimate-flying-car.intro: Ultimate Flying Car is a racing and flying game set on long city streets. You can explore the sky in stylish flying cars, unlock new cars through races, and play alone or with a friend in 2 player mode.
tips: Try free flying before entering races so you can learn how your car handles in the air and on the ground.
Use the handbrake (SPACE for Player 1, K for Player 2) to tighten sharp turns instead of slowing down with the move keys.
Save NOS (SHIFT for Player 1, M for Player 2) for straights or moments when you are clearly ahead, so you still have boost when it matters most.
Look back (T for Player 1, L for Player 2) when you need to check where rivals are before you overtake or change lanes.
If your car gets stuck or flips, use the fix car position key (R for Player 1, U for Player 2) rather than losing time struggling to recover.
faq: How do I unlock new cars?
You unlock new cars by taking part in races. Keep racing to expand your options.
What are the controls for Player 1?
Use W, A, S, and D to move, SHIFT for NOS, SPACE for the handbrake, T to look back, and R to fix the car's position.

connect-puzzle-image.intro: Connect Puzzle Image is a jigsaw-style game where you drag virtual pieces into place to reveal a picture. Levels grow more complex as you progress.
tips: Look at the overall shape of the pieces before you start placing them, so you can spot which edges and corners fit together.
Work on one area of the picture at a time rather than scattering pieces across the screen, which makes it easier to see how they connect.
Check each piece after you place it. Pieces only complete the picture when they sit in the correct position, so a small misalignment can slow you down later.
Use the pause option when you feel stuck, then return with fresh eyes. Short sessions work well for this game.
Pay attention to the quirky characters, dishes, or objects in the picture, since their colors and outlines can help you match nearby pieces.
faq: What is the goal of Connect Puzzle Image?
The goal is to tap and drag puzzle pieces so they connect or align correctly. Once all the pieces are placed properly, the full picture appears.
How do I move the puzzle pieces?
Tap a piece and drag it to its position on the screen. Release it when it is connected or aligned with the pieces around it.

crocodile-online-draw-and-guess.intro: Crocodile Online is a multiplayer drawing game where one player draws a word and the others race to guess it in chat. You can join a quick game or play with friends in a private room.
tips: As the artist, sketch the main shape of the word first, then add details only if time allows, since the timer is limited.
As a guesser, type your guesses quickly in chat, because the first player to guess the word earns the point.
Use the eraser to fix a mistake instead of redrawing the whole picture, which saves time during the round.
If you are playing with friends, create a private room and send the room ID before starting so everyone can join together.
Pay attention to the drawing as it develops and combine it with other players' guesses in chat to narrow down the word faster.
faq: How do I earn points?
The first player to guess the word correctly earns a point, which also helps you move up the leaderboard.
What tools does the artist have?
The artist can use a pencil, a marker, and an eraser to draw the word on the canvas.

zombie-apocalypse-now-survival.intro: Zombie Apocalypse Now Survival is a 3D shooter where you hold off waves of zombies, upgrade your weapons, and take on zombie bases and supervisors. Aim carefully, because every zombie you miss keeps coming.
tips: Shoot zombies as soon as they come into view rather than chasing them, since the game describes them as savage and aggressive.
Upgrade the weapons you use most, because higher levels reduce reload time and that can make the difference in a crowd.
Use the Q and E keys to try camos and attachments, and pick combinations that suit how you fight.
Keep moving with WASD and jump with Space so you don't stay in one spot while a swarm closes in.
When you attack a zombie base, prioritize lethal weapons, since the description says they improve your chances of clearing it.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?

You need to survive a zombie apocalypse by shooting zombies, clearing their bases, and eliminating zombie supervisors in special missions. The description says you must kill all the zombies rather than leave any alive.
How do I aim and shoot?
Move your mouse to aim and click to shoot. Keep your finger on the trigger and fire at each zombie as it approaches.

dora-candy-land.intro: Dora Candy Land is a match-3 puzzle game with Dora and candy. Swap two candies to line up three or more in a row, using your mouse or by tapping.
tips: Scan the whole board before each move and look for swaps that line up three candies of the same kind.
Try to set up matches that make four or more in a row, since longer lines clear more candy at once.
Watch for moves that line up candies in a row without forcing a swap, so you do not waste turns.
Keep your swaps short and deliberate, and avoid tapping quickly without checking where the candies will land.
If the board looks crowded, look for the one swap that clears the most candy and make that move first.
faq: What is the goal of Dora Candy Land?
The goal is to swap neighboring candies so that three or more of the same kind line up in a row. Each match clears candy from the board.
How do I make a move?
Use your mouse or tap to select one candy and then the candy next to it to swap them. If the swap creates a line of three or more, the match is made.

detective-max-mystery-the-disappearance-.intro: Detective Max receives a postcard from his neighbour, Benedict Winters, who has left in a hurry and wants Max to find a lost mystery box. Search the apartment to learn where Mr. Winters went.
tips: Click every area of the apartment you can reach before solving anything, since evidence can be hidden in unexpected places.
Pick up items that seem useful and keep them in your inventory, because puzzles often need objects you collected earlier.
When you examine the crime scene, note who the suspects are and what each one's motive and alibi might be, so you can check their stories against the evidence.
If a puzzle or riddle stalls you, step back and look at the objects you already have, then try combining or dragging them in new ways.
Use the hint feature when you are stuck rather than clicking at random, which can make it harder to spot the clue you need.
faq: What is the goal of Detective Max Mystery: The Disappearance of Mr. Winters?
The goal is to find out where Mr. Winters went by exploring his apartment, collecting evidence, and finding the mysterious box.
How do I interact with objects in the game?
Point and click on areas of the screen to investigate them, and click and drag objects to solve puzzles.

coloring-book-color-by-number.intro: Pixel Art Book is a calm color-by-number game where you fill numbered pixels with matching colors to reveal a picture. Choose an artwork and work through it at your own pace.
tips: Zoom in with the scroll wheel before coloring small areas, so you can see the numbers clearly and avoid filling the wrong square.
Pick a brush size that suits the area: use the larger brush for big open sections and the smaller one for edges and tight details.
Finish one color at a time across the whole picture rather than jumping between colors, which keeps you from losing track of matches.
Save the Finder power-up for pixels that are hard to spot, and use it when you have been searching the same area for a while.
Start with a quick and easy picture to learn how the numbers and drag coloring work, then move on to a detailed artwork once you feel comfortable.
faq: How do I color a section quickly?
Select a numbered color, then hold the left mouse button on a matching square and drag across other squares with the same number. Larger brush sizes cover more pixels per stroke.
What should I do when I cannot find the last few pixels of a number?

Zoom in and scan the picture for that number, or use the Finder power-up, which is designed to help locate hard-to-spot pixels. Moving the picture by dragging can also help you check areas that are off screen.
