neon-maze.intro: Neon Maze is a logic puzzle where you clear the grid by tapping arrows in the right order. Each level has a limited number of moves, so think before you tap.
tips: Before tapping any arrow, check that the path in front of it is completely free. A blocked arrow will not clear the way.
Look for arrows that are already free and note which arrows they are blocking. Clearing those first often opens up the rest of the board.
Plan a few moves ahead instead of tapping at random. Since each level has a limited number of moves, a wasted tap can make the puzzle harder to finish.
Work through the board in a sequence, tracking which arrows you have removed. This keeps you from losing track of the remaining tangles.
Use the hint when you are stuck on a section, then go back to planning on your own. Hints can help you learn the pattern for later levels.
faq: What is the goal of Neon Maze?
Your goal is to clear the board by removing every arrow in the right order. You win when the full maze is untangled.
How do I remove an arrow?
Tap an arrow only when the path in front of it is free. A correct move removes that arrow and opens more space on the grid.

madness-online.intro: Madness Online is a top-down multiplayer survival shooter where you fight zombie waves, gather resources, and build fortified bases alone or with friends.
tips: Use Spacebar to dodge incoming zombies and enemy attacks rather than standing still and trading shots, since dodging keeps your health up during long waves.
Press B early to check your inventory and keep room for resources you will need to craft gear and repair defenses.
Reload with R during quieter moments, not in the middle of a crowd, so you are never caught with an empty weapon.
Use Q to swap weapons quickly when a different weapon suits the enemy in front of you, especially when several zombies approach from different directions.
If you play with friends, split up roles such as gathering, crafting, and guarding, and use Enter to chat so everyone knows where to build and where to hold.
faq: What is the main goal of Madness Online?
The game is about surviving in a hostile, infinite world by fighting off waves of zombies and enemy entities while gathering resources and building fortified bases.
How do I aim and shoot?
Move the mouse to aim and click to shoot. Use WASD to move around the map while you fire.

stickman-io.intro: Stickman.io is a real-time arena game where you grow your stickman by eating food and smaller opponents while avoiding bigger ones. Good positioning and timing matter more than speed alone.
tips: Eat food and smaller opponents whenever it is safe, since growing is the main way to get stronger in the arena.
Keep track of larger stickmen near you and move away from them early, before they close the distance.
Save speed boosts for escaping a dangerous situation or catching a target, rather than using them constantly, so you do not lose control of your position.
Use the mouse to make small, steady movements instead of sharp swings, which makes it easier to steer around larger foes.
Watch the whole arena rather than focusing only on one opponent, so you can spot openings to grow and threats coming from other directions.
faq: How do I grow my stickman?
You grow by consuming food and smaller adversaries in the arena. Each one you collect makes your stickman bigger.
What should I do when a larger opponent is near?
Dodge them rather than trying to fight head-on. Moving away early gives you more room to maneuver and outsmart them.

curve-free-kick.intro: Curve Free Kick is a 3D free kick game where you bend the ball around a wall and past the goalkeeper. Wind and spin both affect the shot, so reading the conditions matters on every level.
tips: Before you shoot, check which way the wind is blowing. Curving with the wind gives a much bigger swerve, so you may need less angle to reach the target.
Use the angle of your run-up to control how much the ball curves. A wider angle adds more curve, which helps when the wall blocks a straight line.
Make your run-up longer when you need more power, but keep in mind that a longer run-up also changes your approach. Practise a few shots to find a balance.
Watch the goalkeeper's position before you shoot. The keeper can be fooled by wind and spin, so aim for the side he is not covering.
You have 10 tries and every goal gives one back, so scoring early helps you keep shooting. Do not waste tries on shots that are clearly going wide.
faq: How do I aim my free kick?
On desktop, move the mouse to position your player behind the ball, then click to shoot. On mobile, drag to position your player and tap the SHOOT button.
How does the wind affect the ball?
The wind blows from the left or right on every level and pushes the ball in the air. Curving with the wind gives a huge swerve, while curving against it cancels the wind out.

mini-car-racing.intro: Mini Car Racing lets you design a small car and race it through circuits full of obstacles. Earn bonuses along the way to upgrade your ride and improve your lap times.
tips: Look at the track layout before you commit to a design, since the obstacles you will face should guide which car features you prioritize.
Pay attention to where bonuses appear and try to collect them without losing control of your car, because they are meant to improve your ride.
Take a few early laps to learn how your car handles at high speed, then adjust your approach to corners and obstacles accordingly.
Avoid pushing at full speed into every section. Slowing down briefly before a tricky obstacle often lets you recover faster than crashing.
After each race, compare how your car performed against your previous attempt and change one design choice at a time so you can see what actually helps.
faq: What is the main goal of Mini Car Racing?
You design your own mini car and race it through thrilling circuits while navigating obstacles. The aim is to become a skilled mini car racer.
How can I make my car faster or better?
Earn bonuses during races, which are used to enhance your ride. Testing different designs and seeing how they perform on the track will help you decide what to change.

worms-zone.intro: Worms Zone is a Snake-style game where you steer a worm through colorful zones, eating to grow longer while rival worms compete for space. The goal is to become the longest worm on the map.
tips: Keep your worm moving toward open space rather than tight corners, since running into a wall or a rival's body ends your run.
Use speed sparingly: boosting helps you cut off rivals or escape danger, but it can leave you with less room to react when you grow long.
Watch the rivals around you and try to steer them into dead ends or away from your path instead of racing them head-on.
Pick up power-ups when they are safe to reach, but do not chase them through crowded areas where a collision is likely.
Plan a few moves ahead by heading toward wide areas of the zone, so your long body has space to curl without trapping you.
faq: What is the main goal of Worms Zone?
The goal is to grow as long as possible and become the longest worm, while avoiding collisions with walls and rival worms.
How do I avoid losing a run?
Stay away from edges and the bodies of other worms, and turn early so you always have an open path ahead.

bumbly-bee.intro: Bumbly Bee is a casual pixel arcade collectathon where you fly a bee through 40 levels, collecting honey while dodging local wildlife. You can chase gold medals against the clock or take your time and gather everything.
tips: Scan each level before moving so you can spot where the honey is and which wildlife tends to sit in the way.
If you are going for a gold medal, plan a route through the level first and then repeat it, rather than improvising every run.
Collect all the honey on your first pass of a level when you can, since that is the goal you can return to without pressure from the timer.
Use short, controlled movements to dodge enemies instead of big swings, which can carry you into danger.
Replay levels you found tricky once you have the layout memorized, as the timed runs become much easier with practice.
faq: What is the main goal of Bumbly Bee?
Move your bee through each level while collecting honey and avoiding the wildlife. You can aim for gold medals against the clock or simply collect all the honey at your own pace.
What controls does the game use?
On PC, you move with the mouse and can optionally use the spacebar. On mobile, you control the bee with touch.

bandits-bane.intro: Bandits Bane is a 2D Wild West shooter set in a robbed city bank. Aim with the mouse, shoot the most dangerous bandits, and rescue hostages across five levels.
tips: Before you fire, check who is in the line of fire. Hostages are in the scene too, so a careless shot can hurt your progress.
Pick your targets rather than shooting at everything. The game asks you to focus on the most dangerous bandits first.
Keep moving your aim toward the next threat as soon as one falls. Quick re-aiming helps you clear a room before the time runs out.
Clear every bandit in a level before moving on, because you only advance once they are all gone. Track where any remaining enemies are hiding.
Replay earlier levels when you want a steadier run. Learning the layout of each level makes it easier to spot the bandits and hostages quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Bandits Bane?
Save the city from the bandits by shooting the most dangerous ones and rescuing the hostages. You must kill all the bandits in a level to advance to the next one.
How do I shoot in Bandits Bane?
Move the mouse to aim, then click the mouse button to shoot. Mouse movement controls the aim direction.

geometry-vibes-x-arrow.intro: Geometry Vibes X Arrow is an arcade game where you steer an arrow through geometric paths and reach the portal at the end of each route. Your timing and control of altitude decide how far you get.
tips: Use short, light taps instead of holding the button down, since each tap raises your arrow and holding sends it higher than you want.
Release the button early when a path starts to slope downward, so you have room to react to the next obstacle.
Watch the pattern ahead rather than the arrow itself, because obstacles appear in sequence and you can plan your altitude a moment before you reach them.
If you are playing multiplayer, practice with the H, L and Up Arrow keys on their own first so you know where each player's controls are before the round starts.
Try a few runs in different modes, since each one tests a different skill and you may find one that suits your timing better.
faq: What is the goal of Geometry Vibes X Arrow?
Guide your arrow through dangerous geometric paths and reach the portal at the end of each route without touching anything. The paths get harder as you go.
How do I control the arrow?
Click the left mouse button or press SPACE to move upward, and release to move downward. On touch screens, tap to accelerate upward.

untangle-threads.intro: Untangle Threads is a puzzle game where you drag glowing nodes until no thread crosses another. Six worlds each add a new mechanic, and you earn up to three stars based on how few moves you use.
tips: Look for the red threads first, since they show exactly which crossings still need fixing.
Move one node at a time and check the thread colors after each move, so you can tell which change helped.
Try to keep your moves few in every world, because stars depend on move count and the Crystals world limits how many you can make.
In the Space world, plan around the locked nodes first and work the free nodes around them.
In the Steampunk world, remember that linked nodes mirror each other, so one move can fix or create a crossing on both sides.
faq: How do I know when a puzzle is solved?
The threads turn green when no thread crosses another. Red threads mean at least one crossing is still there.
How are stars awarded?
You earn up to three stars, and using fewer moves gives you more stars.

stack-the-blocks.intro: Stack the Blocks is a puzzle game played on a 10x10 grid. You place the blocks you are offered to complete horizontal or vertical lines, which clear away to make room for new pieces.
tips: Keep the board open in the middle so you still have space for larger or awkward pieces when they appear.
Before placing a block, check which rows and columns are nearly full, and aim for the spot that completes one of them.
Try to clear lines in a way that leaves gaps you can fill with the next offered blocks, rather than isolated single holes.
Avoid filling a row or column with a single stray cell, since a lone gap can be hard to fit later.
When you have several options, pick the one that keeps the most flexible shapes on the board for future turns.
faq: What is the goal of Stack the Blocks?
The goal is to place the offered blocks on the 10x10 grid so that complete horizontal or vertical lines form. Each completed line disappears and earns points.
What happens when a line is completed?
A completed line disappears from the board, which frees up space for new pieces to be placed.

the-man-from-the-window.intro: In The Man from the Window, you play as Mama Rabbit, protecting your family while you piece together a dark mystery. Strategy, puzzles, and close attention to detail drive the story forward.
tips: Look closely at your surroundings before making a move, since the game says every detail matters.
Treat each decision as one that could affect your family's safety, and think about the likely outcome before you commit.
Keep notes on clues and events as you go, so you can connect them when a puzzle or story thread comes back around.
When tension rises, slow down and review what you already know rather than rushing into the next choice.
Revisit earlier scenes after learning something new, because a detail that seemed minor may now make sense.
faq: What is the main goal of The Man from the Window?
You play as Mama Rabbit and work to keep your family safe while unraveling the dark narrative behind the danger around you.
How does the game make progress?
Progress comes from making strategic decisions and solving puzzles that reveal more of the story.

click-click-clicker.intro: Click Click Clicker is an idle clicker where you click a button to earn cash, then spend it on upgrades and unlock new buttons, cursors, backgrounds, and music. Your progress keeps building between clicks.
tips: Early on, keep clicking yourself, since every click adds to your cash while you are still building up your first upgrades.
Compare the three upgrade types, which are passive earnings, cash per click, and cursors, and buy whichever gives you more cash over time for your current amount.
Buy passive or cursor upgrades when you want income to keep coming in while you step away from the game.
Check which unlocks are close to being affordable, so you can save toward the one you want most instead of spreading cash thin.
Come back after a break to collect your idle earnings, then spend them right away on the next upgrade.
faq: What is the goal of Click Click Clicker?
The goal is to build up cash by clicking and idle earnings, then use it to unlock new buttons, cursors, themes, and music.
How do I earn money?
Click the button to earn cash with each click, and your passive income adds money over time without clicking.

ping-pong-table-tennis.intro: Ping Pong: Table Tennis is a casual sports game where you control a racket, hit the ball accurately, and fight for every point against opponents who get tougher as you go. The game is played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Watch where the ball is heading before you act, since accurate hits matter more than fast clicking.
Vary where you send the ball instead of hitting it the same way each time, so your opponent has to move.
Pay attention to how each opponent returns the ball and look for a pattern you can exploit.
When opponents get tougher, change your approach rather than repeating what worked earlier.
Stay focused on each point, because every point counts and a single lapse can cost you a rally.
faq: How do I control the racket?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. Time your clicks so the racket meets the ball where you want it to go.
What is the goal of the game?
Beat your opponent by winning points in each match. The game rewards accurate hits and quick reactions.

mini-golf-3d.intro: Mini Golf 3D is an arcade mini golf game with more than 40 levels that grow harder as you go. You aim, charge your shot, and try to sink the ball using careful, precise strikes.
tips: Before you swing, study the whole course and plan a route that avoids sand traps and water hazards.
Charge your shot with a moderate amount of power on early levels, since overshooting is a common way to lose strokes.
Treat sand traps as slow ground and keep your next shot short and controlled when the ball is stuck in one.
When the ball is near water, aim for a safer line even if it means taking an extra stroke, because a water penalty costs you a stroke anyway.
Use the mouse click or tap to aim and release calmly, and stay patient on tricky courses so precision matters more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Golf 3D?
The goal is to get the ball into the hole in as few strokes as possible on each of the 40+ levels. Sand traps slow you down and water hazards cost you a stroke.
How do I control the ball?
Use mouse click or tap to play. Aim, charge your shot, and release to strike the ball.

4-color-card-game.intro: 4 Color Card Game is a quick card game where you match cards by color or number and try to empty your hand first. Action cards can shift the round, so keep an eye on what others play.
tips: Before you play, check whether you have a card that matches the discard pile by color or by number, and choose the one that leaves you with the most flexible hand.
Hold on to Wild cards for moments when no other card matches, since they let you pick the color that suits your hand.
When you are down to your last card, click TAP right away so you avoid the penalty.
Watch which colors other players are getting rid of, and try to keep cards in colors that are still in play for you.
If you have no matching card, draw from the draw pile rather than waiting, because each turn ends automatically after an action.
faq: What is the goal of 4 Color Card Game?
The goal is to match cards by color or number and be the first player to get rid of all your cards.
How do I play a card?
Move your cursor over a matching card in your hand at the bottom of the screen and left-click it to place it on the discard pile.

color-sorting-rooms.intro: Color Sorting: Rooms is a calm puzzle game where you pour colored liquids between flasks until each one holds a single color. Each level adds more colors and tighter layouts, and rewards you can use to decorate rooms.
tips: Look for a flask whose top layer is a color that appears in only one place, and move that color first. Clearing the top of a flask gives you more room to work with.
Before each pour, check what is underneath the top layer. A move that looks fine can bury a color you need to reach later.
Try to empty one flask early in a level. An empty flask accepts any top color, so it is your best spare space for moving stacks around.
If you get stuck, use the undo bonus to step back one move rather than restarting. You can also try the extra flask or remove a color bonus when the layout is truly blocked.
Keep an eye on your quests while you play. Collecting specific colors across levels earns points, so it helps to notice which colors a quest asks for.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by sorting all the colors so that every flask holds only one color. Plan your moves so no flask ends up with mixed layers.
How do I pour liquid from one flask to another?
Tap a flask to pick up its top color, then tap another flask to pour. The pour only works if the colors match or the target flask is empty.

rolling-balls-sea-race.intro: Rolling Balls Sea Race is a physics-based racing game where you roll along narrow elevated tracks to the finish line without falling into the water. You can race solo or head-to-head with a second player on the same keyboard.
tips: Ease off before sharp corners, since speed carries your ball toward the edge on elevated tracks.
Hug the inside of turns to keep more control over your ball's momentum.
Survive first and collect coins second, especially in the early levels where the edges are most dangerous.
In two-player mode, use wide sections to bump your opponent, but keep your own ball away from the edge while you do it.
Make small, smooth inputs rather than sudden presses, because the controls respond tightly and momentum carries through every turn.
faq: How do I move my ball?
In solo mode, use W, A, S, D or the Arrow Keys. In two-player mode, Player 1 uses W, A, S, D and Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys.
How do I win a two-player race?
The first player to cross the finish line wins, so keep your ball moving forward while staying on the track.

knockback.intro: Knockback is a party board game where you race your pegs home while arenas erupt and black holes swallow pieces. Pop the dome to roll, then move a peg and try to get all your pegs home first.
tips: Check the board before each move, especially for black holes and erupting arenas, since they can remove a peg you have already advanced.
Knock back a rival when you can, because a peg sent to the start loses all the progress it made.
Save Power-Ups for moments when a board change will help you most, such as when a rival is about to get home first.
Choose which peg to move based on risk and reward: advance a peg that is safe and close to home, and think twice before moving one into danger.
Watch the how-to video when you start if you are new, so you know the rules before your first roll.
faq: How do I start my turn in Knockback?
Pop the dome to roll, then pick one of your pegs to move.
How do I knock a rival back?
Land your peg on a rival's peg to send it back to the start.

kart-chaos.intro: Kart Chaos is a 3D kart racer with Grand Prix races against CPU racers, Time Trial ghost races, a Daily Challenge, and online rooms for racing friends. Drifting is the key skill to learn.
tips: Drift through corners on purpose, since that is how you charge speed boosts. Practice the same corner until you can hold a drift through it consistently.
Watch for ramps and aim for them with enough speed to attempt a ramp trick, because landing tricks gives you extra speed.
In Time Trial, race against your own ghost lap by lap and focus on the corners where you lose the most time.
Use the Daily Challenge to practice a fixed setup and compare your results against your earlier attempts.
If you play on gamepad or touch, learn the steering and drift inputs on a quiet track before entering a Grand Prix race.
faq: What is the goal of Kart Chaos?
You race karts around tracks to finish ahead of your opponents. The Grand Prix pits you against CPU racers, while Time Trial lets you chase ghost times.
How do I get speed boosts?
Drift through corners to charge speed boosts. Landing ramp tricks also gives you extra speed.

tangram-puzzle-2.intro: Tangram Puzzle 2 asks you to fill a target outline with colorful tangram pieces, with no overlaps or gaps. Fewer moves earn more stars, so planning each placement helps.
tips: Start with the corners or edges of the outline, since those spots usually have only a few pieces that can fit.
Look at the colors along the borders. Pieces must match bordering colors exactly, so check those edges before placing a piece.
Work out the rotation on paper or in your head before dragging, so each piece goes down in one clean move and you save moves for stars.
Use undo if a placement blocks a better option, rather than building on a mistake.
Save hints for when you are truly stuck. Using them early leaves less room to work out the puzzle yourself.
faq: How do I rotate a piece on PC?
Select the piece with a left click, then use the mouse wheel or press the R key to rotate it. Right-click flips the piece when that option is available.
How do I rotate a piece on a touchscreen?
Tap and hold a piece to select it, then use a two-finger rotate gesture. Tap outside the piece to deselect it.

moto-extreme-halloween-land.intro: Moto Extreme: Halloween Land is a spooky 3D side-scrolling motorcycle game. Ride dark, mysterious tracks, keep your bike balanced, and try to reach the end of each course.
tips: Use the balance keys (A and D, or Left and Right) in small, steady taps rather than holding them down, so your bike doesn't tip too far in either direction.
Before a jump or rough patch, ease off the forward key slightly so you can adjust your balance in time.
Watch the obstacles ahead and plan your line early, since the tracks are described as dangerous and you need room to react.
If you tip over or get stuck, use the backward key to reposition your bike before pushing forward again.
Keep a steady rhythm of forward throttle and balance corrections instead of making sudden big inputs, which tend to cause crashes on uneven ground.
faq: What is the goal of Moto Extreme: Halloween Land?
Your goal is to overcome the obstacles and reach the end of each dark, spooky track while keeping your motorcycle balanced.
How do I control the motorcycle?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward and S or the Down Arrow to move backward. Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrows to balance the bike.

duckling-rush-io.intro: Duckling Rush.io is an arcade game where you lead a mama duck around a pond, gathering ducklings into the longest conga line before the 90 second round ends.
tips: Since the duck always swims forward, plan your route a few seconds ahead and steer in wide, smooth curves so your line does not tangle.
Keep an eye on where rival lines sit, and look for chances to cut through them when your own line is long enough to benefit.
Save the QUACK burst for a moment when it counts, such as escaping the pike or getting into position to make a rival wobble.
Pay attention to the duckling personalities and go out of your way for the rare golden ducklings, since they are worth extra.
Check the timer as the round goes on, and use your last moments to grab any nearby ducklings that will extend your line.
faq: What is the goal of Duckling Rush.io?
Finish each 90 second round with the longest conga line of ducklings to win bread.
How do I steer the duck?
Hold and drag with your mouse or touch, or use the arrow keys or WASD. The duck always swims forward, so you steer its direction rather than its speed.

bean-party-obby.intro: Bean Party Obby is a 3D party game where you race, jump, and survive against 14 computer-controlled beans. You can pick a bean character and hat, then try one of five modes, from three obstacle courses to survival and color-matching rounds.
tips: Start with Rainbow Road, which is listed as the easy course, to learn the jump timing before trying High Peaks or Turbo Galaxy.
Use the double jump to correct your position mid-air, especially on the bridge and ramps in High Peaks.
Reach a checkpoint before attempting a hard section, so pressing R sends you back to a point you have already passed.
In Color Block, look for the announced color right away and move toward it, since the other tiles fall before the round ends.
In Hexagon Survival, keep an eye on which layers are about to vanish and move to a solid hexagon early rather than waiting until the ground drops.
faq: What is the goal in Hexagon Survival?
Four layers of hexagons vanish under your feet, and you must be the last bean standing.
How do I return to my progress after a fall?
Press R to return to the last checkpoint you reached in the course.

age-of-heroes.intro: Age of Heroes is a strategy and tower defense game where you build an army of heroes and pets, then lead them through eras from the Stone Age to space. Each era brings new battles, towers and wars.
tips: Build a balanced squad that mixes knights, mages and warriors, since the game highlights these three types combining their strengths.
Protect your towers first and treat defense as the base of your strategy before you push into enemy territory.
Strike first when you can, because the game encourages you to take the initiative in tower defense battles.
Keep developing your heroes as you go, since they grow alongside your army and you will face tougher waves in later eras.
Focus on one era at a time and learn how its tower and army work before moving on, as each era introduces a new battle and a new evolution.
faq: What is the main goal of Age of Heroes?
Your goal is to summon warriors and heroes, destroy enemy towers, and lead your army through all eras and centuries. Each battle decides the outcome of your campaign.
Which eras can I play through?
The game covers the Stone Age, Middle Ages, Age of Gunpowder, Modern Era, Future and Space Era. After finishing all eras on Earth, new worlds and planets open up.

draw-path-to-finish.intro: Draw Path To Finish is a puzzle game where you sketch a line that becomes the route for a moving platform carrying the heroine. Your drawn path must carry her past saws, fire, lava, cannons and other traps to the finish.
tips: Before you start drawing, study the whole level and note where each hazard sits so you can plan the full route in your head.
Keep your line a little away from saws and fire, since the platform needs room to pass safely around them.
Watch how the platform moves after you release, and use short test lines to learn how the route behaves before committing to a long one.
Look for coins on the way, but do not risk the run just to collect them; reaching the finish matters most.
If a level keeps failing, try a different route shape instead of small tweaks, because each level mixes hazards in its own way.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to draw a route that lets the heroine's moving platform reach the finish without being caught by traps.
How do I control the platform?
Press or touch the screen and, without releasing, draw a line from the starting point toward the finish. Releasing sends the platform along the path you drew.

roadster-dash-halloween-night.intro: Roadster Dash: Halloween Night is a 3D arcade racer where you drive a flying car down a haunted highway. Chain stunts, collect pumpkins, and race solo or against a friend in split-screen.
tips: Chain jumps, flips and barrel rolls together to build stunt combos, since the combo is what drives your score up.
Save Left Shift boost for stretches where the road is clear so you can use it at full effect.
Use the slam (S) to come down fast when you need to land cleanly, rather than staying in the air past the traffic.
Grab power-ups when you can, and keep your item (Q) ready for the moment you need it most.
In 2 Player mode, watch for your rival's hexes such as fog, blackout and reversed controls, and stay calm when the controls flip.
faq: What is the goal of Roadster Dash: Halloween Night?
Your aim is to build a high score by chaining stunts, collecting glowing pumpkins and staying on the haunted highway. In 2 Player mode, you race a friend on the same road over best of 3 rounds.
How do I control my car?
Player 1 moves with A and D, jumps with W, slams with S, boosts with Left Shift, uses items with Q and hexes with E. Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys to move and Right Shift to boost.

kick-the-zombie-ragdoll-sandbox.intro: Kick the Zombie is a physics sandbox where you play with Gus, a cartoon zombie, using a set of tools. Drag him around, pick a tool, and see what happens when you launch him, kick him, or freeze him.
tips: Drag Gus gently at first to see how he moves before throwing him hard, since his body reacts differently depending on how fast you fling him.
Use the bouncy headstones and walls as launch points by flinging Gus into them, which can send him flying in unexpected directions.
Switch tools often from the toolbar so you can compare the kick, smack, zap, and freeze effects on the same setup.
Try the balloons and pumpkin cannon for longer, more varied reactions, since the floating and blasting results are some of the most distinct.
Tap the door to move between rooms when you want a fresh space to experiment, rather than staying in one spot.
faq: How do I move Gus?
Drag him with your mouse or your finger to grab him and fling him around the screen.
How do I use a tool?
Select a tool from the toolbar, then tap or click to use it on Gus. Tap the toolbar again to switch to a different tool.

the-space-mover.intro: The Space Mover is a logic puzzle where you guide a robot through space-like levels, using magnetic power to move boxes into the right spots. Timing and planning matter as much as quick reactions.
tips: Look at where each target block needs to end up before you touch any box. Working backward from the goal often reveals the order you need to move things in.
Plan your robot's route before you start moving. Mistakes in timing can make a puzzle harder to fix, so think through a few steps ahead.
Use the jump only when you need it to reach a higher spot or clear an obstacle. Jumping without a plan can put you in a worse position.
If you get stuck, reset your thinking by checking which boxes are already in the correct position and which are not. Focus on one box at a time.
On PC, keep one hand on WASD for movement and the other ready for Space and E, so you can react quickly when you need to jump or interact.
faq: What is the goal of The Space Mover?
Your goal is to complete each mission by placing every target block into its correct position. You do this by guiding the robot and using magnetic power to move boxes.
What are the controls on PC?
Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and E to interact. These controls let you steer the robot and operate the magnetic movement.

vega-mix-2-adventure.intro: Vega Mix 2: Adventure is a match-3 puzzle game set on a mysterious island. You swap colorful pieces to make lines and clear the board while working through obstacles and levels.
tips: Look for moves that create power-ups before clearing small groups, since a Rocket, Spinner, Bomb or Rainbow Flower can clear far more of the board in one turn.
Combine two power-ups when you can. The game says pairing any two gives a variety of strong effects, which is often the fastest way to finish a hard level.
Scan the board for obstacles first and plan moves that break them, especially when they block pieces you need for the level goal.
Save the Rainbow Flower for a color that appears often on the board, so it clears many pieces at once.
Check the level goal before each move and choose matches that help meet it, rather than only chasing the highest score.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear the board and complete the level's objective, which can involve breaking obstacles as you progress through the island. The exact goal is shown at the start of each level.
How do I make a Bomb?
Make a T-shaped match of 5 pieces. The Bomb then creates a massive explosion across the board when it is activated.

spotless.intro: Spotless is a pressure-washing game where you clean 100 jobs, from small signs to huge ships and rockets. Spray away mud, moss, rust and grime, and chain combos to build your progress.
tips: Switch nozzles often with the number keys, the scroll wheel, or the toolbar on mobile, so each surface gets the spray it needs.
Use the dirt detection key (E or F on PC) to find hidden grime before you start spraying a large area.
Spend your coins on pump upgrades early, since a stronger pump makes big jobs much less tedious.
Keep your spray moving in steady passes instead of holding in one spot, which helps you keep combos going.
Save the Boss and Legendary contracts for when your pump and nozzles are well upgraded, as they are the hardest challenges.
faq: What is the main goal of Spotless?
Your goal is to clean 100 jobs, removing mud, moss, rust and grime. Larger jobs range from stop signs to cargo ships and rockets.
How do I earn coins?
You earn coins by cleaning jobs and building up combos. Use the coins to upgrade your pump and unlock new nozzles.
